special_desc: Based on the book MONSTER IN HIS EYES by J.M. Darhower! Karissa Reed, 19, is trapped by her controlling mother and abusive ex, Tommy, but her world shifts when Naz Conti, a dangerous ex-con mafia boss, rescues her. Drawn to his danger, she challenges him to let her be his, with every kiss and daring move, risking everything for desire, curiosity, and forbidden love. Can she survive his world, and dare to love the man everyone warns her to fear?

Reborn after her stepsister’s deadly betrayal, Diana shoots an arrow to choose her mate. It lands on Alexander, the hidden Lycan King. But with Ivy still plotting and her bond with Alex unclear, Diana must fight to change her fate—before it’s too late.
A college freshman comes home for her family's legendary Thanksgiving feast and starts to suspect there's something very wrong with her parents.

In Regret is the Punishment movie, MC Karen is a stay at home mom, her husband Tom is a rich Lawyer. While Karen is out, her house catches on fire and their five year old daughter Anna falls to her death. 
Good samaritan Merry goes with the fire truck to take Anna to the hospital, driven by Bob, the fire captain. They need to take Anna to the ER for surgery as soon as possible.
The fire truck hits Karen's car, on her way back from cheating on her husband. She demands they grovel for forgiveness, then pay for damages, wasting their time. Merry and Eve, the paramedic, as well as kind passerbys, try to get her to move. Karen does not give in, not realizing the fire truck is trying to save her own daughter.

In The Adjuster movie, after his sister dies due to losing health coverage, Matteo Leone, a broken man, takes justice into his own hands by killing the insurance company CEO. But he isn't just out for revenge, he has a bigger goal: Expose corrupt health insurance companies for preying on their most vulnerable customers. Matteo stays one step ahead of the police, leaving a trail of clues to send his message, soon becoming a hero to the people the evil CEO's thought they could silence.

Eve takes a flight to Hawaii to attend her big brother's wedding, booking an extra-wide seat because of her broken leg in a cast. A nasty woman and her bratty son demand Eve switch seats with them. The kid trips because of turbulence, his mom demands the flight turn back and fights the pilots, forcing an emergency landing. The mom's sister, Clara, shows up to back her up. Clara accuses Eve of being her fiancée's mistress, not realizing that she's her fiancée's little sister. The wedding is canceled, and Clara is sent to jail.

In Alpha Mate Unchained movie, he killed his vicious father to save her.  Now the new Alpha King must hide his fated mate and use a decoy fake Luna to keep her alive. But while he’s away battling, she’s discovered by the Fake Luna and brutally tortured.  Can she survive long enough for the Alpha King’s return and vengeance?

Sarah Loren is a widow with a teenage son, Ethan Cole is a big shot CEO who wants to acquire her company. He is arrogant, brilliant, and unnecessarily good looking, and he'll stop at nothing to get what he wants, and what he wants… is Sarah's heart.

Rachel finds herself without a groom on her wedding day, only to realize that her soon-to-be husband is in bed with her own cousin! Refusing to become the laughing stock of town, Rachel decides to continue on with the wedding, there's just one little thing she needs to do… find a new groom!

book_title: How My Boss Became My Hubby
special_desc: Allison Lang is the personal secretary of Lucas Ager, Forbes 30 under 30 and hot shot CEO of Ager Enterprises. To get her ex-boyfriend Kyle off her back, Allison texts him that she's now dating Lucas Ager, but what happens when a twist of fate happens and the entire company sees her text message?! Will Lucas Ager fire her… or will secrets from their past come to light?

In I Am Bloody Mary movie, Mare and her fiancé Nick may not have much money, but they have love. As a foster kid with no family of her own, Mare dreams of a wedding with Nick’s family by their side, but Nick is secretive about his estranged relatives. Then, unexpectedly, his mother arrives, warmly inviting Mare into the wealthy and mysterious Thornwood family. She even offers to host the wedding at their grand estate. But the morning of the ceremony, a horrifying discovery shatters Mare's dream, and she realizes she’s not walking into a happy-ever-after, but into a nightmare twisted by the Thornwood family’s dark history--one that might end up killing her.

book_title: My Gorgeous Wife is an Ex-Convict
special_desc: Brielle is wrongfully accused of killing her fiancé's sister. Her fiancé refuses to believe her, and sends her to rot in prison. Three years later, after her release, Brielle works to prove her innocence. A mysterious and handsome stranger, Jay, lends her a helping hand... But there may be more to him than what meets the eye.

book_title: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up! 2
special_desc: Ellie Holland is forced to marry bigshot billionaire Wayne Lyons in order to save her father's life. For the hefty price of five million dollars, Ellie sold herself into the Lyons family with the promise of delivering an heir. There's just one catch… Wayne Lyons is in a coma!

After realizing she's been hating the wrong man her entire life, Elena dies in the arms of her husband Marcus. In a twist of fate, Elena is brought back in time. It's not too late, she still has time to change everything. In this life, she won't hate her husband... she will protect him at all cost.

book_title: My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire
special_desc: In My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire movie, Archer is nowhere to be seen on his wedding with Alice—rumor has it he died in an explosion during a firefighting mission. Alice’s greedy parents try to marry her off to a sleazy suitor, Philip. At the new wedding, Alice finally sees her husband again—but he’s now engaged to someone else.

After Dr. Adrian Marksman, the most renowned surgeon in the country, gets dismissed by his boss's son, he joins forces with Dr. Vivian Hart, the brilliant and ambitious head of a rival hospital. This move drives his former hospital into financial ruin, and when Preston realizes he has let go of the wrong doctor, it's already too late...

book_title: Uncle William, Please Say I Do!
special_desc: After Alaina saves powerful businessman William from a near-fatal car accident, he gives her a promise. Months later, William finds her at his nephew Jason's engagement party—only to discover she's Jason’s fiancée. Though he hides his feelings, William gifts her a family heirloom. When Jason betrays her, Alaina breaks off the engagement. With her grandmother's Alzheimer’s worsening and a wedding wish unfulfilled, Alaina asks William to marry her in a secret one-year contract. William sees this as his chance to win her heart, and as he protects her, Alaina also starts to fall for him.

Caroline has just been diagnosed with cancer in Love Me After My Death movie. And told she only has three months to live when Stacy, her husband Eric's old flame, shows up with a six-year-old kid that she claims is Eric's Child. Eric goes on to repeatedly wrong Caroline, and as her cancer symptoms worsen and she slips into despair, she decides to divorce him. Only after their separation does Eric realize that he can't live without her, and he then finally learns of his ex-wife's cancer diagnosis. By then, it'stoo late for reconciliation, as Caroline is determined not to spend her final days loving him.

In Feast of Power movie, Nick, who's secretly the wealthiest man in the world, lives as stay-at-home husband with his wife, Bella. Just as he’s about to reveal his true identity and share his wealth and power with her, he discovers Bella’s betrayal. Nick realizes he had mistaken Bella for his true love. He later finds Elena, a woman who loves him for who he is, not for his wealth or power. Determined, Nick takes back everything he had planned to give Bella and chooses to share it with Elena instead, leaving Bella full of regret.

book_title: Was the Heiress Switched at Birth?
special_desc: In Was the Heiress Switched at Birth movie, on the same day, two best friends give birth. But Edith, born into poverty, secretly swaps her baby with her CEO friend’s—hoping to give her daughter a life of luxury. What she doesn’t expect is that the CEO sees everything and quietly switches the babies back. Eighteen years later, just as Edith’s plan is about to succeed, she discovers the shocking truth: the daughter she’s mistreating all these years is her own.

book_title: Cross My Heart and Hope to Die
special_desc: In search of the truth behind her sister’s death, Zoe Hale marries billionaire Ashton Cross, whom she suspects to be the killer. However, as she gets to know him better, she discovers truth more twisted, and love more powerful than she could’ve ever imagined.

book_title: My Husband Killed Me, then I Won the Mega Ball!
special_desc: Adoria Cummins gets murdered by her husband and is taken back in time! She uses the knowledge from her previous life to get revenge on all those who wronged her, starting with winning the Mega ball! Then comes Elijah Snyder, a lawyer who seems to have her best interest in mind, but there's just something about him… that seems too familiar.

Sophie McKenzie runs straight into the arms of James Knight after she was being pursued by a gang. James Knight takes her in according to Goodbye, My CEO Movie, and offers her protection but that came with a price. However, Sophie wants to break free from this bond, but she finds herself stuck as James Knight refuses to let go.

Emma and Liam shared a magical night together that ended abruptly when Liam left the next morning without a explanation. Six months later, they get reunited at Emma's sister's wedding where Liam is the best man. As their unsolved feelings come rushing back, Emma decides to fake date Liam for the weekend to get her ex to leave her alone.

Noah Preston returns as a billionaire after six years of being away, and his fiance breaking up with him because he was poor in We Will Love Again Movie. Noah didn't know that his fiance did not mean to break up, but his mother pressurized her into doing it. He sought revenge against her until he found out the truth.

Years after an unexpected separation, Bella and Adam—once college classmates who fell in love at first sight—are unexpectedly reunited. Now a successful doctor, Bella is stunned when Adam, her first love and now a renowned NHL superstar, appears in her office, seeking help. As old feelings resurface, a twist of fate binds them in a contract relationship, giving their unfinished love a second chance. With each passing day, the spark between Bella and Adam grows stronger, but both must decide if this second chance will allow their long-dormant love to flourish into something lasting.

In The Elite Heir's Ultimate Comeback movie, Hector and Alice have been in love for years. But just as Hector is about to reveal his true identity, a tragic accident leaves him in a coma. Alice’s family, despite their limited resources, contributes what they can to his recovery. As Hector slowly regains consciousness, he can only communicate by pressing a call button. Meanwhile, an antagonist posing as a doctor manipulates the family. In a critical moment, Hector finally speaks, warning the antagonist that with a single phone call, he can bring them to justice.

book_title: I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend?!
special_desc:
I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend?! is based on the novel published by Tapas Entertainment, Inc.

In I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend movie: when Kaitlyn Sinclair moves into her off campus apartment with her high school sweetheart for her freshman year of college, she immediately catches him cheating on her. She is forced to move into her brother’s apartment and share a space with his best friend who is in grad school on the same campus. When her childhood crush reignites, Kaitlyn and Cole must navigate their newfound adult relationship while evil exes, mean girls, and worst of all- Kaitlyn’s brother, try to tear them apart.

Bella, heir to the wealthy Walton family, is tired of being surrounded by calculating rich kids. She falls for Marc, a plus-size guy who seems to love her for who she is, hiding her identity and even helping him get recruited to Harvard’s football team. But betrayal hits hard, Bella discovers Marc has been cheating on her with her classmate - and bully - Jessie, who constantly mocks Bella’s body. Even worse, Marc has stolen her identity, claiming he is the Walton heir to win clout and rise to the top of Western High’s social scene. Bella dumps him, has a stunning glow-up, and embraces her curves. When they mock her college future… could Bella’s next move leave them speechless?

In The Fashion Queen Returns movie, once the Queen of the Red Carpet, Eve Corbelle is content with her new life as a housewife--until a sudden betrayal brings her back to the center of her fashion empire at the Grand Maple Gala.

Lucy Harris and Luke Walker had an affair, but that was before she found out that he was her boss in The Boss’ Affair Movie. Lucy woke late for her first day at work and had to leave in a hurry. When she arrived at work, she got the shock of her life as she saw who her boss was.

In Mother Warrior Unleashed movie, when her teenage daughter is grabbed by sex traffickers, the legendary warrior, Navy SEAL Lieutenant Phoenix Ryan, abandons her life of anonymity as a small town diner owner to rescue her daughter and destroy the Navarro Cartel that has taken her.

When her boyfriend suddenly drops out of their roadtrip to her best friend's wedding, Samantha Smiles is forced to take the long drive from LA to NYC with the boy she's spent the last five years trying to forget. The boy she spent one secret summer night with. The boy she let take ALL her firsts: Tristan Montgomery, AKA her best friend's older brother! Torn between loyalty and her resurfacing (mutual?) feelings for Tristan, Samantha has to make a choice: will she keep living for others, or will she finally, for once, do something for herself?!
After being mistreated by his wife’s family for years, Leo discovers that he is the heir to a vast fortune. Now it’s time — for revenge!
A werewolf cursed to never shift. A vampire with dark secrets. Kaiya and Talon are supposed to be mortal enemies, but what will the two do when the impossible happens and... they form a mate bond?!

book_title: Never Divorce a Secret Billionaire Heiress
special_desc: In Never Divorce A Secret Billionaire Heiress movie, Joyce has been a walking blood bank for her sister, Selena. It was the price she had to pay for forcing Tristan into marrying her. Joyce realized herself when she lost her baby and got no support or care from her husband. Now, the heiress wants a divorce.

book_title: Go Away Stepmom, You Have It All Wrong!
special_desc: In Go Away Stepmom You Have It All Wrong Movie, on the day of her father’s wedding, Margaret rushes home early from college exams to attend the ceremony. She only to be mistaken by her future stepmother, Chloe, as her father’s mistress. While her father is away, Chloe takes every opportunity to humiliate and mistreat Margaret. Can Margaret clear her name and expose Chloe’s true colors before it’s too late?

In Freeze! Runaway Groom movie, to pay for her father's medical bills, Ivy is forced to marry Byron, a wealthy heir, instead of her stepsister. But on their wedding day, Byron doesn't show up, leaving Ivy humiliated in front of all their family and friends. After they finally marry, they set three rules—agreeing they won't fall in love with each other. Eventually, Byron tells Ivy that the agreement is ridiculous because he's already fallen in love with her. He asks her if she loves him back. So, will Ivy reciprocate his feelings?

In The Quarterback’s First Love movie, after her quarterback fiancee’s betrayal, cheerleader Maddie’s life unravels. Drawn to Cameron, another football player who feels oddly familiar, she faces new challenges as her ex, the cheer captain, and Cameron's mother plot to tear them apart.

In America's Favorite Ex-Husband movie, an aspiring writer’s life is turned upside down when he rescues an up-and-coming Hollywood starlet.  Ten years later, Daniel’s the house husband to America’s Sweetheart, ignored and invisible to the paparazzi and his own family.  When a megastar old flame comes back to seduce his wife, Daniel’s life reaches a new level of hell and he realizes he must do the unthinkable: divorce America’s Sweetheart!  By the time his famous wife realizes what she’s lost, it may be too late to win him back.

Daisy and Alex share a one night stand and part ways on one fateful night -- which leaves Daisy pregnant. Alex is on his way to her when he gets into a car accident and loses his memory. 5 years later, Daisy runs into a homeless Alex, and her daughter Poppy insists he's her father. When will Daisy realize this homeless man is her baby daddy? Will the family of three work together to take revenge against scheming villains?

Marabella's dark powers made her the target of her pack after she accidentally killed Kyan's father. No one understands her except for Jonah, her boyfriend and the future Alpha. When the Moon Goddess pairs her with Kyan instead, her only hope shatters, Will this mate bond turn out to be a blessing, or another curse?

Fatal Temptation: Between Two Alphas movie summary will take us on a steamy ride as we see Mia, pregnant with her chosen mate Cameron's child, ends up as a rogue when a witch casts a spell on Cameron, he chooses her leaving Mia heartbroken.
As Mia gets expelled to be a rogue she meets her fated mate. But she's tied to both Cameron and her newly found mate.
The alphas are not willing to share, thus making the love triangle hot and curious to watch.

book_title: My Firefighter Ex-Husband Burns in Regret
special_desc: My Firefighter Ex-Husband Burns in Regret tells a story that following the tragic death of their daughter Alyssa in a youth center collapse, Hazel seeks justice and revenge on her firefighter husband Jace, who chose to save his ex-lover Candace and her daughter, Kimberly, instead. Consumed by grief and rage, Hazel holds Jace and Candace responsible for Alyssa's death. As she navigates her sorrow, Hazel transforms her pain into a drive for charity, establishing a foundation to help children. Burdened by guilt, Jace tries to make amends for his decisions, leading to his self-imposed exile. Ultimately, Hazel moves on, finds new love, and leaves Jace to face the consequences of his actions.

book_title: After Divorce, My Ex-Wife Became a Billionaire
special_desc: In After Divorce My Ex-Wife Became a Billionaire movie, Claire, secretly the heir to a vast fortune, hides her true identity to marry Milo out of love. Living in Los Angeles, she quietly uses her wealth and influence to smooth out the obstacles on Milo's path to building his startup. Just as Milo is on the brink of success, Claire discovers he's been unfaithful. Confronted, Milo admits he's fallen out of love, speaks harshly to her, dismisses all she's done for him, and pressures her into a divorce. Heartbroken and deeply disappointed, Claire decides to reclaim her position as a billionaire heiress. She withdraws all her support, and lets Milo face the consequences of his actions, making him regret everything he's done.

book_title: Pregnant and Spoiled by the Billionaire
special_desc: In Pregnant and Spoiled by the Billionaire movie, Amelia is a hard-working Junior in College. In order to pay rent, she needs to find work. Her roommate got her a job at a local bar, but her first night on the job took a dark and twisted turn. Her roomate drugged her and pimped her out to a customer for the night. But at a critical moment in the night, Leo saved Amelia from being trafficked. After a night of passion, Amelia became pregnant with Leo's baby, but Leo thinks she's a gold digger. Where will she go? What will she do?

In Submitting to My Ex's Dad movie, after catching her fiancé cheating with her best friend just before their wedding, Flora runs away and has a wild one-night stand with a handsome stranger. Little does she know he's her ex-fiancé's father, and he has a dark secret. Will she surrender to the heat—or is it time to run again?

book_title: Boss Me Around If You Dare
special_desc: In Boss Me Around If You Dare movie: Just after she is falsely accused of sleeping with her boss and fired, Olivia lands a new job at Wilder Conglomerate—only to realize her new boss is Theo Wilder, the man she hooked up with last night! Olivia says they can’t work together, but Theo challenges her to stay and take a bet: he says he can make her fall for him, while Olivia bets she can resist his seduction… but just how long can she last against her boss’ sexy advances?

The Stay-At-Home Dad Levels Up tells the story of Jack Parker, a penniless orphan deeply devoted to his wife and son. Unfortunately for Jack, his wife’s family has always disapproved of him, and are actively trying to sabotage their relationship. All that changes when Jack becomes the heir to one of the richest companies in the world. Now Jack must convince them that he is really a billionaire, before they sabotage his marriage, get his daughter taken away, or even have him killed.

"Retired special forces soldier Cole Slade—codename “Reaper”—goes into hiding as a security guard to fulfill his fallen comrade Alexander’s last wish: protect his younger sister, Victoria. On Victoria’s wedding day, the groom runs away, the guests vanish, and a carefully planned corporate conspiracy comes to light. When the proud Victoria forces Cole into a fake marriage, they’re pushed into an uneasy alliance against their sworn enemy, Tristan—an ambitious man set on taking over the Kingsley family’s tech empire. As Cole’s lethal battlefield instincts resurface—from a bloody fight in the church to displays of overwhelming power at high-society banquets—they face not only Tristan’s deadly retaliation, but also the shocking truth that Victoria’s uncle, Conrad, is the mastermind. When a bloodstained dog tag reveals what really happened to Alexander, Cole must use the most extreme measures to protect this marriage—born from a lie—through both corporate warfare and gunfire."

“The Alpha’s Daughter”
Daphne Sinclair’s life shatters when her father, a powerful Alpha, is murdered on her 18th birthday. Betrayal by Alpha Atlas fuels her desire for revenge. Identity, transformation, power, and resilience collide. Daphne navigates a hostile environment, forging alliances and seeking justice. New situations are stressful, avoiding danger at the same time sucks. Survival game?

Natalie is a hybrid. She is a werewolf, dragon and vampire, and due to this, she is targeted by different people who are after her for so many reasons in Fatal Temptation: The Hybrid Princess Movie. Following her flee from her pack because of heartbreak, she returns when she hears of the death of her parents and a new Alpha.

At her wedding, ordinary girl Lillian experiences a heartbreaking betray when she catches her boyfriend cheating with her best friend. In the moment of desperation and defiane, she determined to prove her own worth and impulsively takes the hand of a scruffy mechanic Luca, who stands beside her as it happens. Instead of becoming a burden, their marriage flourishes as they navigate a series of sweet, unexpected moments and overcome challenges together. To Lillian's surprise, Luca is not just a simple mechanic - he is secretly Hamilton, a billionaire CEO and legendary race car driver. What started as a fake marriage turns into genuine love. Watch as the two of them join forces to write a extraordinary rising love story!

In Kidnapped by the Devil movie, when a ruthless arms dealer kidnaps a bride after her fiancé fails his test of love in a deadly game of Russian roulette, she finds herself torn between her moral principles and her growing attraction to the dangerous man who will stop at nothing to make her his.

In Baby Please Don't Marry Him movie, to secure her boyfriend’s future, Gloria pretends to be superficial and breaks up with him. Seven years later, she's forced into an arranged marriage, only to find her fiancé's uncle is her now-successful ex. As old feelings resurface and misunderstandings unravel, the two are drawn back together for a second chance at love.

Swallow Me Whole is based on the novel by Gemma James, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish.

I need to know how to blow a guy. Ashton Levine is my best friend's brother and totally off-limits... until one reckless night under a bar table changed everything. The rules of him being my sex tutor are simple: No kissing. No screwing. No falling in love. But the more I use my body in the name of experimentation, the more I know being friends isn’t enough. Is it too much to want it all with him?

When you're forced to wed the dark and dangerous Alpha Ronan — your mortal enemy — you're sure you'll kill each other before you make it to the altar. But when a common enemy threatens to destroy your pack, will you accept that you are fated to one another? Or reap deadly consequences?

book_title: Falling for My Dad's Best Friend
special_desc: In Falling for My Dad's Best Friend, Kylie, a bold young woman infatuated with her dad's best friend. Jaxon tests his limits as she tempts him with Kylie's charm. As Jaxon struggles to resist her, the tension between them escalates, leading to an ultimate betrayal that changes everything.

In Never Reject A Wolf Princess movie: Lia was born a princess, but all she really wants is a life of her own. So she chooses love over duty—only to be betrayed and rejected by her mate. But she’s not one to stay broken for long. When she unexpectedly bonds with a new mate hiding his own secrets, Lia is thrust into a world of power, deception, and second chances. Now, she’s done following the rules. It’s time to reclaim her throne—and make everyone who doubted her regret it!

book_title: Don't Mess with a Prep School Princess
special_desc: Sierra Lane thought she was getting her life back when she was finally released from juvie after taking the fall for her boyfriend, Jake. Instead, she’s met with a shocking truth: she’s the long-lost Lancaster Heiress, heir to one of the biggest fortunes in the country. Armed with a new identity and eager to reclaim her place at Hawthorne Prep, Sierra returns to school, ready to share the news. But instead of a warm welcome, she finds that Jake has moved on with her ex-best friend, Fallon. Even worse, Fallon has already been telling everyone that she and the heiress are best friends, making Sierra’s arrival a direct threat to Fallon's reign as queen bee of the school. As Sierra battles relentless gossip, sabotage, and an entire school that wants her sent back to juvie, she’ll have to prove she’s exactly who she says she is before Fallon destroys her reputation for good.

book_title: The Billionaire Married a Homeless Girl
special_desc: In The Billionaire Married a Homeless Girl movie, after a one-night-stand, Adele Moore becomes pregnant. She wants to keep the child, but her father kicks her out of the house. With nowhere else to go, Adele becomes homeless.  She tries her best to raise her son despite her challenging circumstances. One day, Adele's son, Brad Moore, runs into billionaire Heston Deleon.  By chance, Heston discovers that Brad is his son. He tries to track down Brad, but loses their trail. Through a series of misunderstandings, Adele and Heston become entangled again!

book_title: My Billionaire Husband Left Me for Him？
special_desc: Joyce wants to divorce her husband Henry because he can't get hard, but Henry won't let her leave their sexless marriage. His inheritance is at stake, as his parents demand an heir before deciding whether to give their business and fortune to him or his brother. Henry is convinced Joyce married him for money, not love. Joyce is determined to prove him wrong, but then her mother is diagnosed with cancer, and they desperately need money...

After Erik, the biggest tech hotshot in all of Silicon Valley, gets sacked by his CEO's son William, he joins forces with Evelyn, the beautiful CEO of his old company's competitor. This causes his former employer to go bankrupt, and when William realizes he's fired the wrong guy, it's already too late...

book_title: The Break-up Bet With My Billionaire Ex
special_desc: In The Break-up Bet With My Billionaire Ex movie, when Layla and Joshua break up, they sign a separation agreement: If they're both still single in five years, they get married. Five years later, after becoming the world's hottest and wealthiest chef, Joshua takes the position of head chef at the restuarant where Layla works. Joshua wants her to fulfill the contract, but with her health in an unstable condition, Layla lies and says she's already engaged. Still, an undeniable chemistry builds between them, and the flames of love become hard to suppress. Will Joshua ultimately discover Layla's lie? Can they bridge the gap of lost time and truly be together again, love conquering all?

Dani, a mousy, plain-looking designer, saves her company's Paris Fashion Week show only to have her success stolen by lazy but stylish intern Brynn, who gets Dani FIRED by her boss's power-hungry daughter. But when a rival fashion house recruits Dani, she gets the glow-up of the century and becomes determined to show off her design skills and reclaim her title as the true couture QUEEN.

book_title: I Had a Baby without You
special_desc: Five years ago, curvy waitress Scarlett saved Brandon's life and spent one unforgettable night of passion with him before vanishing. Now she's back, slimmed down and unrecognizable, and he's the reclusive CEO who unknowingly fathered her daughter.

book_title: Mistaken as His Mate: The Luna’s Regret
special_desc: In Mistaken as His Mate The Luna’s Regret movie, Alpha Caspian’s pregnant sister Marina arrives for his Luna’s coronation, but Luna Willow mistakes her for a rogue mistress. In a jealous rage, Willow bullies Marina, causing her miscarriage. Now the Brooks siblings want blood.

book_title: The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband
special_desc: It was supposed to be an emotionless contract marriage and nothing more. But Sebastian couldn't resist growing a soft spot for Natalie. With her family planning her downfall and her estranged husband cooking up a deadly plan, what should Natalie expect? The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband trailer has a lot to reveal.

In Fated to My Forbidden Alpha movie, on her 18th birthday, Selene found out that her mate was her nemesis, Alpha Jackson. He plans on rejecting her. Selene never planned on accepting him as her mate. He didn't know she wasn't any wolf but a Luna, kidnapped and mistaken for a regular wolf. As Selene plans on escaping her pack, she meets Alexander, her fated mate.

Aria Walker needs a husband to get out of an arranged marriage. When her long-term boyfriend reveals he's leaving her for her best friend, a heartbroken Aria turns to old acquaintance/"food truck worker," Norman Hill. Little does she know Norman Hill is actually a billionaire CEO. Aria's selfish family and bitter best friend try to sabotage her at every turn, but with Norman's support, Aria's marriage only gets stronger.

book_title: A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother
special_desc: In A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother movie, Olive Parry agrees to be her BFF Sam’s fake girlfriend, and in return, he would pay for her expenses to save her little brother from his evil foster mom. One condition: don't fall in love with Sam’s older brother. Everything was working perfectly until Olive found out that the man she’d secretly pined for after a one-night stand, and Sam’s off-limit older brother were the same person.

In Forgive Me, Forget Me Not movie, Lottie is forced to give up on the man she loves in order to save his life. Year later, she runs into him again and he's a bigshot lawyer with billions at his disposal. But not only that, he has a cold hard vendetta against her... for stabbing him.

book_title: How to Land a Movie Star
special_desc: When ambitious casting assistant Cleo Marlowe risks everything to convince movie star Blake Wilder to act in her movie, she doesn’t expect him to say yes, or for the paparazzi to catch her walking out of his house. Branded as the girl who slept her way to a get ahead, Cleo becomes Hollywood’s favorite rumor. But while her reputation takes a nosedive, the notoriously cold and gruff Blake starts to show up for her in ways she never saw coming.

In Once Upon A Breakup movie, after being abandoned on her birthday by her college boyfriend, Mia impulsively proposes to Carson, the charming but dangerous leader of the Moretti crime family. Though their relationship begins as a rash escape, it quickly turns into something real. But Mia’s ex refuses to let go. Obsessed, jealous, and spiraling out of control, he’ll stop at nothing to win her back, even if it means destroying the new life Mia’s trying to build with Carson. However, Mia isn’t looking back. She's thriving with Carson by her side and ready to show Aiden exactly what he threw away.

In True Luna movie, Emma is a powerful wolf known as the true Luna. Her kind is rare. When she got her wolf, a warning came along with it. Emma will be in danger soon as the rogue king is after her. Her joy of getting a wolf and finding a mate is torn when her mate rejects her.

book_title: The Lady Boss's Small Town Valentine
special_desc: In The Lady Boss's Small Town Valentine Movie, a workaholic's life is turned upside down when she finds out her fiance is having an affair with her horrible assistant. She blows the biggest deal of her life when she has a breakdown over it during the pitch. Now, her grandfather, the CEO of her hotel company, relocates her to a tiny mountain town to take over one of their failing properties. To make matters worse, she's stuck with a small town (but devilishly handsome), co-manager, who cares more about people than profits. And she has to live with the co-manager in a little chalet...

book_title: The Billionaire Firefighter and His Sweet Wife
special_desc: In The Billionaire Firefighter and His Sweet Wife Movie, on the wedding day, a fire breaks out. Chloe's fiancé, Kevin, abandons her to save his stepsister, Rachel, leaving her in danger. Leo rushes into the flames to rescue her. To reclaim her mother’s inheritance, Chloe impulsively marries Leo, unaware that he’s actually a billionaire CEO. As time passes, Leo begins to fall for Chloe ultimately becoming utterly devoted to her.

In Kiss Me 99 Times a Day movie, Alice Breslin, desperate to ditch a sleazy guy, impulsively kisses CEO Anson Vega. The next thing she knows, he whisks her away and they get married on the spot. After their whirlwind wedding, they slowly start developing feelings for each other as they spend their days together. In a dramatic twist, Anson unexpectedly discovers that the genius "Sam" he's been searching for all along is actually Alice.

book_title: How to Dump a Hockey Star
special_desc: In How to Dump a Hockey Star movie: After leaving behind her life as a billionaire heiress, Renee dedicates herself to helping her husband recover from a vegetative state and pursue his NHL dreams. However, after suffering a devastating miscarriage, she is faced with a brutal truth: the man she sacrificed everything for might have chosen someone else.

book_title: Two Alphas Are in Love with Me
special_desc: The wolfless Lyra, has been captive in the Wolfsbane pack for seven years, during which she was constantly abused by Alpha Roland. During one of her escapes, Lyra has an accidental one-night stand with Alpha Alfred, Moonshadow pack's strongest Alpha, and becomes pregnant with his child. Alpha Alfred rescues Lyra from Alpha Roland and brings her back to his pack. To protect her, Alfred and Lyra form a Fake Luna contract.

In Sadness Knows No Boundaries movie, Charlotte Hasting's life is turned upside down after her daughter dies due to her husband's negligence and favoritism for a pretty employee. To make matters worse, her husband won't believe her, and thinking that she's hiding their daughter from him, continuously makes her life a living hell.

Nina runs into hot hockey captain Enzo at a party after she catches her boyfriend Justin cheating. Since Enzo's a known player who only sleeps with girls once, Nina agrees to a no strings attached night of fun with Enzo, but when they both catch feelings, Nina learns that Enzo's player reputation is due to a rule: he can't have sex with anyone twice, or they'll die. The catch is...if Nina's his fated mate, she's safe. But that's not all. Enzo's got a crazy ex-hookup who won't let him go and wants to make Lisa's life a living hell. And once Nina lost her virginity, her true hybrid nature emerged, putting her sister Selena's crosshairs. Selena wants to escape the Lycan World by switching places with Nina. While Enzo and Nina try to navigate their budding romance amidst never ending drama, the Sister kidnaps Nina to the Lycan World--all with the help of Nina's internship colleague James. All the while Enzo is fighting to stake his pack's place in the human world by winning a hockey tournament against his sworn enemy Ronan, while Enzo's father plans to marry him off to none other than Nina's sister Selena. In the end, Enzo wins his tournament, and Selena comes into the human world and pretends to be Nina, until Enzo's father blows her cover. Enzo races to the Lycan World to save Nina, and they finally have sex for the second time and learn that Nina is, indeed, Enzo's fated mate. Enzo has one more rule...no more sex without engagement, and he takes Nina as his fiance...and they live happily ever after.

The day Ellie's IVF process is a success, she finds out her fiance and her best friend are having an affair. Devastated, she decides to raise her child alone. The doctor reveals there's been a mix up at the sperm bank - she's pregnant with the Mafia Boss' baby. Ellie has been unwillingly dragged into a mafia war of succession. In order to protect her unborn baby, she agrees to a contract marriage with the mafia boss. They never thought this would lead them to true love.

Pampered real heiress Ellie is framed and sent to juvenile detention by her family. They believe she lives comfortably, unaware that under the fake daughter's orders, Ellie suffers brutal abuse. Three years later, she is released, broken inside, but still seen as spoiled. Only when her father beats her and her prosthetic falls off do they realize the truth...

Their families slaughtered each other, and they’re sworn to hate one another… but the pull between them can't be denied. Maeve, the alpha princess, enters Luperiom determined to survive the kingdom’s brutal war college. What she doesn’t expect is a fated bond with Saxon Blackmoor—the most powerful wolf there… and her enemy. Now, the one wolf she shouldn’t want might be the only one who can save her.

Nicole loses everything the night she’s framed—her freedom, her child, and the love of her life. Seven years later, she returns as a nanny in the very house that once destroyed her. Ethan, her ex-fiancé, still haunted by the woman he once loved, starts to feel something for the new nanny—without knowing it’s her. Secrets simmer, memories resurface, and Lila, their stolen daughter, is the unexpected thread pulling them back together. He doesn’t remember her. But his heart never forgets.

The One that Got Away summary is all about Anna Starr who finds herself stuck in a loveless marriage after giving up her passion to settle down.
Her husband is cheating on her thus making her marriage a misery. Anna meets her rock star ex-boyfriend Adrian, who still ignites the old passion in her.
This time around Anna has to follow her heart as she dreams of Adrian.

Freya is kidnapped by a coven of witches, hidden away in a tower like Rapunzel, waiting for the day her magic awakens. The evil witche's plan is thwarted when a brave witch hunter saves Freya and runs away with her. Now Freya must navigate a modern world that she's never lived in before, and learn the true meaning of love and sacrifice.

book_title: The Return of My Mafia Husband
special_desc: The Return of My Mafia Husband movie summary is all about Leo Marino who keeps his identity as the don of the Marino family as he dates Olivia Gray, an ordinary girl. After being in a coma for eight years, he finds Olivia still waiting by his side as he proposes to her. But a don can't marry a nobody as he promises to give Olivia the world.

A car accident leaves Winnie's daughter on the brink of death. Her doctor husband, Aaron, chooses to save his first love Monica's child instead, leading to the death of his own daughter. Winnie seeks justice for her lost child, only to face relentless interference from Monica and distrust from her husband.

In The Ex-Wife's Comeback Strategy Movie, after hooking up with her husband Benjamin who she's never met before, Aria learns that he wants a divorce with her. Her plan to just run away is demolished by her studio's new commission, which is to design Benjamin's new house. Aria hides her identity and starts working with Benjamin for the cash. Benjamin falls for his designer Aria during this time, as she develops feelings for him too...

book_title: Secret Boss of the Five Keys
special_desc: In Secret Boss of the Five Keys movie, Grayson Rodgers is a gardener with a secret: Over the last five years, he's taken out the five heads of the Five Nation Syndicate, and taken their Gold Keys: The symbols of their authority, but also the keys to the vault that acts as a bank for their entire fortunes. He's now ready to stop, and give his wife a life of luxury and peace. But before he can reveal himself to her, he discovers her sleeping with a high ranking syndicate general, Ivan. Ivan wants Grayson to use his clearance as a gardner to help him break into the Golden Key Vault. Now Grayson must find a way to prove to everyone that he's the true leader, while catching Ivan in the act... all the while being thought of a just a gardener.

In My Stepbrother's Dirty Secret movie, Alice transfers to St. Mary's High School after her mom remarries a millionaire--only to butt heads with James, a hot classmate who turns out to be her new stepbrother! Will Alice and James learn to get along? Or will their irresistable chemistry turn into something else?

In CEO Queen A Mother’s Revenge movie, after 15 years of living as a humble orphanage worker, Mary Miller's peaceful life is shattered when a brain hemorrhage leaves her comatose. While her youngest adopted daughter Grace desperately tries to save her life by selling her own blood, her other children Rose and William reveal their true cruel nature. When Mary finally wakes and claims to be Phoenix Group's legendary CEO, she faces brutal mockery and violence. But those who dare abuse the "delusional old woman" are about to learn they've made a terrible mistake—as Mary's vast empire prepares to strike back against all who wronged her family, while rewarding the one daughter who loved her without knowing her true identity.

Katie Walker is the janitor’s adopted kid — bullied, humiliated, a nobody. Then the golden Maddox brothers show up looking for their long lost heiress sister: Katie! But the school’s queen bee steals her place. Now it’s Katie’s turn to level up, take back her crown, and make them all regret underestimating her.

book_title: Snatched a Billionaire to be My Husband
special_desc: What happens when you fall in love with your ex's uncle?!

book_title: Bound by Honor: Kidnapped by the Mafia King
special_desc:
Bound by Honor: Kidnapped by the Mafia King summary talks about the world of mafia families, the Saviano and the Mancinis who are bound by marriage alliance to help retrieve their family's glory.
When Luca meets Harper she's sold by her father at an auction.
Luca saves her not caring about the fact that he's betrothed to someone else. Their love can destroy their lives.

Charlotte Swan's put the past behind her to focus on her new job at the prestigious St. James Academy. Everything changes when Timothy Wolfe, king of the school decides that he wants HER. It's forbidden, it's taboo, but what's more... Charlotte has a dark secret that could ruin them both.

Deadly Affair with My Brother-in-Law summary talks about Aurora who's engaged to Patrick, but she falls for Patrick's brother Noah.
When Patrick turns abusive towards Aurora Noah will do everything to keep her as his.
This forbidden romance is so hot that you can't help but root for the couple. As the title suggests, the movie is filled with drama, action, and romance.

Emily's fiance Henry breaks up with her on their wedding day. Pushed by her toxic best friend, Fiona, she agrees to enter a fake marriage with another man, but mistakes William, her mysterious billionaire CEO, for the man she's supposed to marry. After the wedding, William finds out that Emily is one of his employees, while Emily mistakenly believes that William is drowning in debt. William hides his identity till the day of the design competition when Fiona and Henry plot to sabotage Emily.

book_title: The Heiress and Her Possessive Bodyguard
special_desc: Three years ago, Jack Hawkins saved heiress Grace Christensen from an evil stalker, but when they reunite, a misunderstanding turns them into enemies. Now, with Grace's safety threatened again, her father hires Jack as her personal bodyguard. When they're forced to spend every second together, will they be able to resist each other?

In The Cursed Alpha's Mute Bride movie, cursed mute Wren believes no one will ever love her— until she meets Alpha Hunter Silver, who says they’re mates! But Hunter is cursed, too… Can they find love together and break their curses?

In Pretty Baby movie, Rosy Dolores, the city's most sought-after escort, enters a fake engagement with billionaire single father Tad Williams to locate the daughter ripped away from her at birth. Unbeknownst to her, Tad's charming daughter, Lily, is the very child she's been searching for.

book_title: Doctor Boss Is My Baby Daddy
special_desc: In Doctor Boss Is My Baby Daddy movie: When med intern Molly has a one-night stand with a stranger, she thinks it’s a one-and-done kind of deal. But a month later, she discovers two shocking truths: she’s pregnant with his baby… and the stranger is her new boss, Dr. Graham Weston. As soon as Molly’s secret comes out, so do her rivals, including her jealous family and a figure from Graham's past, each determined to keep her and Graham apart. With pressure mounting from all sides, can they survive the chaos and find love in the process?

book_title: Pregnant by My Ex's Professor Dad
special_desc: In Pregnant by My Ex's Professor Dad movie: on her first day of the semester, Emily catches her boyfriend cheating on her. That night, she has a wild one-night stand with a stranger named Charles. The next day, they are mutually shocked to find out that Charles is Emily's new professor. They maintain a professional student-teacher relationship, but there's an undeniable tension between them. Just when Emily thinks everything will get back on track, she unexpectedly finds out she's pregnant...

In Queen Never Cry movie: 7 years ago, Nicole leaves her family fortune behind for her husband Ethan. She thought she's the happiest wife and mother -- until Ethan and her best friend Elaine sent her to jail and took her daughter away. Now seeing their true color, Nicole decides to regain her heiress status, take back her daughter and show everyone what a real queen looks like.

book_title: Secret Surrogate to the Mafia King
special_desc: In Secret Surrogate to the Mafia King movie, Vanessa Peters is in for a surprise when she goes to sell her eggs to pay off her boyfriend's debt...and ends up pregnant due to a clinical error. She decides to keep the child after finding out her boyfriend is cheating on her, but begins to fear her decision when she finds out that the father is no other than Marcello Lavigne, a ruthless, murderous Mafia King. After saving her life from thugs who try to attack her for having mafia money, Marcello moves Vanessa to his mansion against her will. As he continuously proves his commitment to keeping her safe from criminals, bullies, and his mafia family, Vanessa begins to develop feelings for him despite his player behavior and his murderous capacity. Will she accept Marcello as the father to her child, and accept his offer to become queen of the Mafia empire?

book_title: Don't Miss Me When I'm Gone
special_desc: After losing my parents, I move in with my godmother, Aunt Sandra. I live under her roof with her two sons-the Miller brothers-surrounded by love and care. I think I’ll end up with one of them. But everything changes when the maid’s daughter, Lola, moves in. The Miller brother I love most breaks my heart into pieces. After I leave, they lose their minds trying to find me.

book_title: Fated to My Homeless Billionaire Alpha
special_desc: Elara catches her fiancé, Victor, cheating on her with her best friend, Helena. Devastated, Elara impulsively marries a humble homeless man named Liam. Unbeknownst to Elara, Liam is actually the billionaire Alpha leader of the werewolf world. And he spoils Elara beyond her wildest dreams!
At her parents' anniversary party, a successful CEO is dismissed as a low-class nobody, her diamond gift called fake, and she's even banned from the table!

book_title: Pregnant by the Golden Billionaire Bachelor
special_desc: After a one-night stand with an infertile billionaire silver fox, a 45 year old maid discovers she’s pregnant with his twins… as he strives to secure his company’s legacy by producing heirs, they must navigate their clashing worlds and unexpected feelings to see if they can build a family together.

book_title: Super Godfather: My Ex Begs Me on Her Knees
special_desc: Cain Hunter is a broken man after his wife betrays him and ruins him financially. Just as all hope is lost, Cain is suddenly brought to the mysterious Don Ludwig, who makes him an offer: pass his tests, and Cain will succeed him as the new Godfather of Bourne Syndicate.

After being dumped by her ex, Nola unexpectedly finds herself in the arms of Ryan Laren—her ex’s future father-in-law, a man of immense wealth and power. Learning of her complicated bond with his daughter, Ryan tries to stay away. But Nola keeps breaking his rules, drawing him deeper into a dangerous attraction.

Carl Oliver, the legendary sharpshooter known as the King of Guns, broke the world record for longest confirmed kill then vanished from the public eye. He hid his identity, working as maintenance at a shooting range. He endures humiliation from the dismissive shooting club captain, Albert, unaware of his true identity. The shooting range is facing a hostile takeover. In order to protect Jane, the owner, and her daughter Rebecca, Carl steps up and shows his legendary shooting skills, drawing attention to his mysterious identity...
After a one-night stand with Ben, the hottest guy on campus, Kelsey realizes she's pregnant...and decides to keep the baby. But will Ben stick around - or will he stay a flirty fratboy forever?

In Audrey in Full Bloom movie, Harvard MBA Audrey Lorenzo Bloom is on her way to shatter barriers as powerful conglomerate BloomCo’s first female and non-white CEO. She’s been preparing for years, even using an alias as a Latina cleaning lady to learn the inner workings of the company. Now on the eve of the banquet introducing her, Audrey discovers her fiancé thinks she’s an illegal alien and plans to defraud and deport her, the senior executives are plotting a coup to put her white cousin in charge, and her bitterest enemy since childhood, Ryder Marlow, might not be her enemy after all…

book_title: My Boss Is My Secret Sperm Donor
special_desc: In My Boss Is My Secret Sperm Donor movie, Leia, struggling with infertility, is caught slacking off at work by her boss, Alec, while browsing a sperm donor website. Mortified by the encounter, she tries to move on. After carefully selecting a donor at the sperm bank, fate takes an unexpected turn—she ends up choosing Alec’s donation without realizing it. When will Leia discover that the child she’s carrying is actually Alec’s?

In Mistaken as the Mistress movie, Vivian comes home early to celebrate her son Noah's engagement party. But his fiancée Mia mistakes her as his mistress, resulting in Vivian's public shame and abuse. When Noah arrives and finds his mother missing, he quickly erupts in anger and vows to find his mother at all costs!

book_title: Fuel to Our Fire: My Racer Stepbrother
special_desc: In Fuel to Our Fire My Racer Stepbrother movie, struggling to pay the bills to support her ailing mother and abusive step-father, Elaine turns to her work as a dancer at illegal street races. But, as fate would have it, she unknowingly runs into the world's most-feared and envied world-championship street racer... her step-brother. And gives him her virginity.

In The Billionaire's Virgin Surrogate movie, what happens when a student surrogate proposes to her client that they should conceive the baby the natural way?  In the movie The Billionaire's Virgin Surrogate, desperate to save her father, Harper agrees to carry a baby for Will Trenton— a single, mouthwateringly hot billionaire. As their worlds collide and the boundaries blur, Harper finds herself irresistibly drawn to Will. But beneath the surface, a question remain: Is Will feeling the same?

book_title: The Lost Son Returns as the Duke
special_desc: In The Lost Son Returns as the Duke movie: Kidnapped as a child, Arthur, Duke of Mercia, returns to his village to reunite with his long-lost family. What he didn't expect was to find them abused by everyone in town. With his identity a secret, will Arthur be able to avenge them?

Billionaire magnate Jack retired to spend time with his family. He was once CEO of the world's biggest defense contractor, but he's not just a school janitor. His son throws him out of their house to make space for his new baby. Jack saves a young woman from danger. She's so impressed by his heroics she sets him up with her mother Emma, the icy cold headmistress. They start a contract marriage. The school dean keeps trying to overthrow Emma, Jack swooping in to save her from his schemes, even saving the school from bankruptcy! Right when Emma is facing unprecedented challenges, about to be removed from the school board, he steps in with billions of dollars to save her from humiliation. His true identity is finally revealed - he's the richest man in the world!

book_title: The Divorced Wife is a Genius Surgeon
special_desc: 8 months pregnant, Alyssa is abandoned by her husband for his mistress and their lovechild Lilly. Little do they know, Alyssa is actually Jane Davenport M.D.--heiress to the Davenport fortune, and the only heart surgeon in the world that can save Lilly.

In Coaching His Heart movie, after a one-night stand, Kate and Tom are separated by a misunderstanding. They reunite one month later when Kate becomes the assistant coach of a men's hockey team and Tom joins as their new captain. Forced to work in close proximity, sparks of their unresolved passion begin to reignite. Only this time, Kate must hide a big secret to keep her job—she's pregnant with Tom's child - a revelation that could change everything.

Raised in rural poverty, Taylor gets into MIT, but her father and older brother rip up the acceptance letter and sell her to an old rich man for cash. With help from her mom and little sister, Taylor escapes—but loses all contact with them. Seven years later, Taylor is the richest person in the world. She returns home in glory—only to find her mom beaten and her sister sold by her brother. Fueled by rage, Taylor shows up at the welcome banquet held for the world’s top CEO—her brother, now her employee, doesn’t recognize her and calls her a whore in front of everyone. Can Taylor prove who she is, find her sister, and bring justice to those who crushed her? And when the truth comes out—what punishment awaits those who looked down upon Taylor?

book_title: Claimed by My Ex's Alpha Brother
special_desc: Ella is wolfless amongst the wolves, but at least she has her mate, Beta Noah Gravens... until she catches him cheating with her rival Ava. Shattered, Ella falls straight into the arms of Noah's brother, Liam Gravens, the newly returned Alpha of the Crescent Pack, who has loved her since childhood and knows she's his fated mate. But with jealous rivals, bitter exes, and two worlds pulling them apart, can Ella and Liam embrace the love they are destined for?

In Callsign Legacy movie, when lowly enlisted man Cole Summers sneaks into a Navy Flight Simulator and completes mission simulation that no one else can, the Navy realizes that he's their only hope to prevent WWIII...  but first he must deal with crooked politicans, evil tech billionaires, and even his own disgraced family legacy.

book_title: Ex-Husband Roll Out of My Life
special_desc: In Ex-Husband Roll Out of My Life movie, Trina, a housewife betrayed by her husband and humiliated by her entire family, finally finds the strength to leave a loveless home. Thus begins her countdown to freedom.

book_title: Married for Green Card, Stayed for Love
special_desc: Leslie Madison dated her boyfriend for two years in Married For Green Card, Stayed For Love Movie, so when she became desperate for a green card, she thought her boyfriend would get married to her, instead he broke up with her. Leslie eventually married someone who needed her as much as she needed him, Simon Williams. They fell in love.

book_title: Taming the Lion: Billionaire on Bikes
special_desc:
Taming the Lion: Billionaire on Bikes summary is all about Leo Striker, a sexy biker who saves Kara when being harassed by her ex-boyfriend.
Kara falls for Leo as he helps her learn how to protect herself.
However, Leo is a dominant who wants Kara. Can Kara enjoy being submissive?
Kara and Leo's romance is steamy, the biker gang trope is refreshing.

book_title: Rock On! Band Beauty in Disguise
special_desc: This story follows Astra, a determined girl gifted with extraordinary strength. When her twin brother loses his voice before a crucial band rehearsal, he’s threatened by a lawsuit. Astra steps in for him. Disguised as a boy, she resides in the boys’ dorm to uphold the ruse despite lacking musical talent and being unmistakably female. Amidst comedic mishaps and tense moments, Astra discovers unexpected love and genuine companionship.

Monica, a talent manager, and Adonis, an A-list star, have been in secret relationship for three years now. For Monica, it's all just unrequited love because Adonis has not even once expressed his feelings to her. Monica, now pregenant, decides to leave this relationship behind. It is only then that Adonis realizes all he needs is her. Years later, their paths cross again, and Monica is now an acclaimed film director. This time, will Adonis win back his love?

In I'm Done Being a Yes-Man movie, Enzo is the mysterious heir to the Quinn Corporation. He comes from a prominent family and has an extraordinary talent for football. He is infatuated with the daughter of his family's chauffeur, Stella Hall. One night, Stella gets into an accident from drunk driving, but she convinces Enzo to take the blame for her. Worried that her secret will eventually get out, Stella scams Enzo out of all his savings and hires a killer to murder Enzo. However, just as Enzo is about to die, a mysterious power sends him one month back into the past. Now that Enzo knows Stella's real personality, he's no longer in love with her. Enzo resolves to leave behind his "simp" image and make sure Stella gets what she deserves.

book_title: My Dear Daughter, Love Me Once More
special_desc: In My Dear Daughter Love Me Once More movie, The male lead only has eyes for his first love and won’t even let Aria, his own daughter with his wife/the female lead, call him “Dad.” Aria waits all day for him on her birthday, only to witness him propose to his ex. At the school talent show, the mistress and her daughter bully Aria, and the husband helps them. To steal Aria’s summer camp spot, he feeds her a strawberry cake, knowing she’s allergic—she nearly dies. That’s when the female lead decides to divorce him and finally reveals her secret: she’s the daughter of a duke. She uses her true identity to fight for justice for her daughter. In the end, even when he kneels and begs Aria for forgiveness, she never calls him “Dad” again.

book_title: Countdown to Life: Rescue at 30,000 Feet
special_desc: America’s top billionaire, Derek Wolf, is dying and hires elite surgeon Shaun to bring a donor kidney by plane for a secret transplant. But the flight is delayed when Kim — mother of Jessica, who’s engaged to Derek’s grandson Erik — goes to the bathroom. When Shaun urges them to hurry, Jessica humiliates him. After takeoff, Kim suffers a heart attack, and Shaun saves her, breaking her ribs in the process. Ungrateful, Jessica demands Shaun apologize in a humiliating way. When he refuses, she threatens to destroy the kidney. Forced to reveal Derek’s condition, Shaun pleads, but Jessica doesn’t believe him — until she smashes the case and sees the name on it: Derek Wolf, her own fiancé’s grandfather.

book_title: He Said the Baby Was Too Expensive
special_desc: In He Said the Baby Was Too Expensive movie, heiress Iris gave up her family fortune to marry Dorian, a poor average-joe. Three years later, she's about to welcome her first child, when suddenly, her crazy control-freak mother-in-law (Tessa) insists the hospital she's staying at is too expensive. Tessa manages to convince Dorian that they should switch to a cheaper hospital. Dorian, being a spineless mama's boy, gives in to all of Tessa's demands and starts bullying Iris too. Iris fights off increasingly unreasonable demands, all while dealing with unbearable pain in her heavily pregnant belly. Just as she can't take it anymore, Iris's father finally appears, bearing gifts for his new grandchild. How will Alec defend his daughter? When will Iris give her husband and mother-in-law a slap in the face?

Jax Carter, the bastard son of a disgraced housekeeper and a fight gym patriarch, secretly trains under three outlaw coaches. When he's entered into The Crucible, an elite, once-in-a-generation MMA proving ground, he must carry the weight of betrayal, shame, and thousands of pounds of hidden resistance training. As rivals rise and family tries to crush him, Jax must prove once and for all: he wasn’t born to break... he was built to fight.

book_title: I Married as the Replacement Bride
special_desc: Martina is the perfect Mafia daughter. Beautiful, quiet, and — most important of all — obedient. But to protect the one she loves most, she'll go against her father's orders and take her sister's place as bride to the deadliest, most notorious Mafia don of all... the Butcher.

In I Got Married Without You Movie, Rosalyn was a contract call girl for Andrew. She did it because she loves him not for his money. She was diagnosed with a terminal heart condition that could be cured with a heart transplant. Rosalyn tries to tell Andrew about her condition but he is quick to shock her with the news of his marriage.

book_title: Bound by Vendetta: Sleeping with the Enemy
special_desc: In Bound by Vendetta: Sleeping with the Enemy movie, on her birthday, Daiana's father was killed. She's yet to find out who the killer is but she has a suspect. Daiana is torn between love and vengeance as her suspect turns out to be her lover. Daiana must decide whether to avenge her parent's death or forgive her lover.

In How to Kiss a Vampire movie, eight years after Vincent abandoned her, Ella—now a single mom—is pushed off a rooftop and saved by a mysterious, flying masked man. She wakes up to find Vincent at her side. He denies being the masked man but insists his enemies are targeting her and demands she move in with him for protection. Why is the man who broke her heart now acting like her savior? And why does he seem... not entirely human? Can Ella trust him again—or is he hiding more than just a mask?

In The Lost Daughter's Silent Cry movie, in a cruel twist of fate, Annabella Walton's perfect life is shattered. Ten years later, to save her disabled adoptive father, Annabella, now named Amelia, is forced to deal with the Walton family again...this time, as the target of their attacks. Will the Waltons figure out the truth? Or will it be too late for Amelia?

book_title: Ex-Convict Nanny and Billionaire Single Dad
special_desc: Fresh out of prison, Grace landed a job as a nanny. Her boss, the ruthless billionaire Alex Hill, cares only about his precious daughter. Grace passed Alex's rigorous test and gradually won over his cold heart, but Grace holds a dark secret, one that could destroy everything good.

book_title: How I Made the Alpha Mine
special_desc: In How I Made the Alpha Mine movie, Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own Pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha -- and older brother's best friend -- Dalton Grey. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the Pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.

book_title: Leaving My Alpha Husband in Ice Cold Regret
special_desc: When Snow discovers her alpha husband cheating, she offers herself as ritual sacrifice to be eternally frozen. And when she leaves, she will finally break their mate-bond, leaving ice cold regret to be his new forever mate! But what will he do to bring her back?

Mia Harper, down on her luck, marries wealthy CEO Carter Prescott as part of a deal. Their fake marriage soon blossoms into real romance, but their love is tested when Carter's ruthless ex, Lily, stops at nothing to win him back. The drama intensifies when Mia discovers she's pregnant with Carter's baby and uncovers the shocking truth that Lily is her long-lost stepsister...

This Christmas, Eddie travels to his loving wife’s hometown to finally reveal he’s the billionaire CEO of the nation’s hottest start-up. But in a house and town full of Scrooges, will Eddie’s arrival be a Christmas present, or go down like a lump of coal?

Nerdy girl Pearl is determined to catch the eye of her longtime crush, but is clueless on how to do it. But after a shocking encounter with Ethan Hart, the school's biggest bad boy, she makes a deal with him that will finally get her noticed. With his help, Pearl catches the attention of the guy she wants and sparks do fly... but in the wrong direction.

After a medical mishap, the virgin Violet Gray becomes pregnant with the child of a billionaire stranger, Carter Watts. To provide for the child, they are forced into a hasty marriage. Carter leaves for a business trip and is away for six years, during which Violet raises their son, Patrick, on her own while working at a five-star hotel. Unexpectedly, the hotel is bought out by a mysterious new owner—Carter himself! However, after six years apart, they no longer recognize each other. By chance, Violet discovers that her charming boss, Carter Watts, is actually her long-lost husband...

book_title: Heiress Crash Lands on Her Husband
special_desc: In a marathon of trumping identities, Lily must own her cheating ex, his mistress, their moms, her new royal suitor, the women after her true love, and finally, the dominant mother-in-law! Can Lily win them all?

book_title: Watch Out! She's a Mastermind Heiress
special_desc: In Watch Out She's a Mastermind Heiress movie, after growing up in the countryside, 21-year-old Isabella Patton is sent back to her wealthy birth family. Before long, she becomes acquainted with the smoldering (and much older) Oliver Bates, who begins to relentlessly pursue her, oblivious to the fact that she is his fiancée. Meanwhile, Isabella's cousin Eliza, who was raised by the Patton family in her place, is on a desperate mission to turn the whole family against her for good. Unluckily for Eliza, Isabella is a hotshot genius with unparalleled talent in the medical and tech fields, and is able to outduel Eliza at every turn. As Isabella's unique skills are revealed, she wins the support of her five brothers and parents, becoming the crown jewel of the Patton family while always remaining just out of Oliver's grasp.

book_title: Why My Contract Ex-Husband Keeps Chasing Me
special_desc: In Why My Contract Ex Husband Keeps Chasing Me movie: Natasha marries Jaxon to be able to pay for her mom's hospital bills. Jaxon's grandfather had offered her a contract to be Jaxon's wife. While the two started their marriage happily, things got twisted when Jaxon is tricked into believing Isabella saved him. He grows resentment towards Natasha, who finally had enough when Isabella was attempting to frame her and sabotage her pregnancy. Natasha divorces Jaxon, who believes she is a cheater and was only ever after his money. Ultimately, Jaxon learns everything he knew about Natasha was wrong, and that she is a lost heiress herself. He learns that she genuinely loved him, and he lives in his regret trying to win her back.

book_title: Breaking the Deal with My Hockey Bad Boy
special_desc: Breaking the Deal with My Hockey Bad Boy movie shows Jane Wellsy has a secret — she's got a crush on her stepbrother Nate Duncan. No one knows except for her worst enemy, hockey badboy Zach Gates. Even worse, Jane finds out Nate's new transfer student girlfriend was her bully from high school, Melissa! When Melissa finds Jane's smutty story and demands to know if it's about Nate, Zach swoops in to save her, kicking off their fake relationship to keep her secret safe. As they spend time together, Jane finds there's a warm, kind heart under Zach's cold bad boy persona, ready to heal her broken heart and face the world at her side...

When a High Level Mafioso finds himself in the body of a bullied high schooler, he uses it as a second chance at finishing high school. But will his street smarts help him to fulfill his dream of going to college, or will a group of bullies drive him to drop out again?

In search of the "masculine energy" she needs to balance her magical power, naive witch Astrid Hall leaves her all-female coven for a co-ed private school where sparks fly between her and blind but devastatingly handsome Nate Woodford. When she discovers the curse that robs him of his sight, they make a deal: if she cures him and returns his vision, he'll do anything she asks. But Astrid is in for the culture shock of her life when she learns "sleeping together" doesn't quite mean what she thought it did!

For centuries, the most powerful vampires, the Tepes family and the Velda family have remained an alliance which, if broken, could send the world into chaos like never before. The alliance is threatened by a seemingly normal human girl Sammantha Evans, a waitress at Club Dracula owned by the powerful Alarik Tepes. One fateful night on New Years Eve, the world will be changed forever…

“OMG, You’re My Baby Daddy!” is hilarity at its most finest.
A hook-up turns into a lifetime commitment! A surprised dad-to-be navigates parenthood, relationships, and growing up. Chaos ensues in this hilarious film. Laughs, tears, and awkwardness abound. Can he step up and become the dad he never knew he’d be? Unplanned parenthood has never been so funny!

Astrid was dumped just when she thought she was comfortable with her fiancé in Knight In Shining Suit Movie. Humiliated by her family, Astrid goes to clear her head in a bar where she meets Ryder, her ex who humiliated her. She is confused about his identity; however, she dares to spark a conversation with him, leading to uncertain territory.

In All the Wrong Reasons episode 5, Andrea must handle a sex column or lose her job. She had no idea about sex as she was inexperienced at it. Andrea sets out to have sex. In the process, she met Justin, an old-time friend. Justin volunteers to help Andrea with her sex column. What starts as a simple research turns into a steamy romance.

book_title: The Return of My Drama Queen
special_desc:
The Return of My Drama Queen movie summary takes us to the world of France in a tale of rebirth as we meet Marie Antoinette who wishes to reunite with her while getting executed.
In her new life as Antonia she's not only reunited with her lover but is married to him.
However, their marriage is on the rocks as her husband Nick suggests a divorce.

book_title: The Lady Boss CEO is My Daughter
special_desc: After Matilda's only daughter, Elodie, is rescued from her kidnapper by local police - she is turned over to foster care and never to be seen again. Matilda and her son, Carson, never stopped searching for her -  spending every last penny on posters and PI invesitgations till they starved. Then, after twenty long years of desperate attempts to get Elodie back, she returns. Except, now she's Billionaire CEO Miss Atkins and her company is going to destroy the very home she grew up in - and the only remaining clue that could bring the family back together again.

Dr. Leah Anderson's life is turned upside down when she falls for the hot, seductive billionaire, Ryan Carter, whose obsession makes him a dangerous lover. Their passionate romance takes a dark turn as men in Leah's life begin to mysteriously disappear, and now she must face Ryan's chilling secrets, and confront her love for him.

In Freed by the Sexy Farmer movie, after her once-wealthy family loses everything, virgin heiress Lily Holt is sold to Mason Black. He is the notoriously cruel heir of the Black family fortune. Terrified of his violent reputation, Lily runs away from Mason the night of their fake marriage and crashes into Cal Foster, a sweet, sexy farmer who falls for her at first sight. However, when Cal discovers the man Lily’s running from is his landlord and long-time rival, he risks his life and livelihood to protect her.

book_title: Rules of Protection: The Bodyguard I Hate
special_desc: In Rules of Protection The Bodyguard I Hate movie, Elena and Ace used to be engaged for marriage. But, after Ace is disabled from the war, he pretends to cheat on Elena to save her from his new disability. Three years pass until the CEO of a medical insurance company gets shot. Elena needs a personal bodyguard, and Ace just happens to be the one for the job. Will Elena and Ace repair their rocky past and reignite the love they once had for each other?

book_title: My Three Ungrateful Brothers Come Crawling Back
special_desc: In My Three Ungrateful Brothers Come Crawling Back movie, Oriana's mom passed away when she was 6; her stepmother abandoned her at a trailer park. When she was 12, she saved the richest man on earth, Murray Morel, and was adopted as his granddaughter. 2 years later, her three brothers found her, and she decided to return to her biological family. In consideration of their egos, she hid her wealth from them but still secretly helped her brothers to succeed in school. However, the brothers are fooled by her evil stepsister and start to bully her. They kicked her out and almost beat her to death. After getting rescued by her adopted Grandfather, she finally sees the true colors of her brothers. She breaks up with them and plans to take everything back. The punished brothers eventually realize that Oriana is their real family and beg on their knees for her forgiveness.

In Escorting the Ruthless Billionaire Doctor movie, Violet, desperate to pay for her father’s surgery, decides to sell her virginity, but the good doctor she calls is determined to pull her back from the edge. However, as the two share a heated, unforgettable night, Dax finds himself hooked on Violet, despite thinking she’s just another gold-digger. When their darkest secrets are laid bare, will their fragile connection survive?

When Elle Vanderbilt, the secret tech-genius Dr. Nova, is divorced and dumped by her husband for an imposter, she flash marries handsome stranger Roy Grant - only to discover he's her ex’s biggest rival. Together, Elle and Roy battle her cheating ex and the fake Dr. Nova for the world's biggest tech contract.

In The Hacker Heiress Strikes Back movie, in a previous life, heiress Emily was a genius in the hacker field. In a global competition, fake heiress Olivia accuses Emily of plagiarism, which totally destroys her reputation. Her family believes these false accusations and kicks Emily out of the house. In the end, she’s killed by fake heiress Olivia. In her second life, not only does Emily cut off her ties with her blind to the truth family, but she also gives Fake Heiress Olivia who was falsely accusing her of plagiarism a slap in the face.

Uncle Jesse's smokin' hot tattoo and great technique on bed awakens Sophie Holland's fantasy in How To Break A DILF Trailer! She might be Jesse's best friend's daughter, and Jesse might have told her to date guys of her age. Still, something about Jesse lures Sophie. So, keep watching to know what lies behind their relationships!

Penny and Mason are childhood best friends who’ve quietly fallen in love. But after spending their first night together, Penny is diagnosed with cancer—and makes the agonizing choice to push Mason away to protect him from the pain of losing her.

In Operation Christmas Trap movie, six years ago, Winnie and Logan fell in love and had twin daughters. But after Selina sowed discord between them, a misunderstanding drove the couple apart. Six years later, with a little help from their twin daughters swapping places, the truth comes to light.

My Step-Brother is My Ex?! full movie tells a story that four years ago, a misunderstanding ripped Hannah Hart and Dean Dumont apart. Hannah vowed she would never see Dean again... until her father unexpectedly remarried Dean’s mother. Now Dean and Hannah are stepsiblings… but neither of them know it!

College student Sylvia Parker finds herself in a dangerous love affair with Lawrence Calhoun, the last man she should want. He's hot, he's harsh -- he's her professor. As Sylvia struggles to survive in a cutthroat campus and toxic family, never has she thought her hero would be the cold, strict and sexy Professor Calhoun. As their connection deepens, a forbidden romance blooms, threatening to destroy everything if discovered.

book_title: Carrying His Triplets, Becoming His Wifey
special_desc: In Carrying His Triplets, Becoming His Wifey movie, Daisy works in a warehouse to pay for her tuition, but her father steals her money. Financially desperate, gets another job at a strip club to make ends meet. There, she has a one-night stand with Marcus, a billionaire. Soon after, Daisy discovers that she is pregnant with triplets.
