Seduction Cove is a show designed to test couple's loyalties with hot baddies, cash prizes and insane challenges. After Hayley's cheating ex runs off with her sister, she's reunited with Adam, a man who saved her from a near death experience. Will the reunited soulmates survive Seduction Cove?

book_title: 30 Days Till I Marry My Husband's Nemesis
special_desc: In the future, Blair will be murdered by her husband, Jack. She was given a second chance to go back to the past and fix her life. To avoid marrying Jack again and getting killed, Blair married his nemesis and her enemy, Nathan. Will this be enough to prevent her death?

It's forbidden. It should be impossible. But you — a human — have been Marked: claimed forever as a dragon's mate. And not just any dragon... the Dragon King. A man whose dark beauty and lethal power are only whispered about. Will this mark mean your end? Or will it unlock a secret that could change everything?

book_title: The Double Life of a Billionaire Heiress
special_desc: After three years of marriage, CEO Wes Sterling is convinced that his wife Kira is a cheating gold digger. Fed up with Wes's accusations and mistreatments, Kira finally divorces him and re-embraces her true identity: a billionaire heiress! What will Wes do when he realizes he has made the biggest mistake of his life? Will Kira make him pay..or fall for him all over again?

In Fated to the Alpha Movie, Katya was yet to get her wolf. She's a unique wolf known as the Luna healer. The only wolf capable of healing her bully, her pack’s Alpha’s daughter. To escape the threats that come with her title, Katya flees to the Black Creek pack. There, she met Alpha Ezra, her fated wolf and protector.

Caroline Mills and Easton Black are in a wave of love in Breaking The Ice Movie. After it was certain that Easton Black was going out on a scholarship to continue his hockey dream, his mother warned pregnant Caroline to get rid of Easton’s baby, causing problems for the couple. Love won in the end, and they got back together.

A Fated Encounter movie summary talks about Emma Brown who is forced by her father Henry to take her sister Bella's place and marry Tommy Anderson to save her business. Unlike the rumor Tommy turns out to be a handsome and wealthy man. Soon Emma starts to fall for Tommy despite stating their relationship is just a contract to please their families.

book_title: Pregnant and Married to a Movie Star
special_desc: In Pregnant and Married to a Movie Star full movie, pregnant and broke bartender Lacey is offered the role of a lifetime when non-commital movie star Chris Powell asks her to pose as his fiancee. Neither of them knows that the baby she's carrying is actually his.

book_title: Resisting Mr. Lloyd: An Age Gap Romance
special_desc: In Resisting Mr. Lloyd: An Age Gap Romance Full Movie, facing family pressure to quit college and marry, Clarisse's world changes when she meets Austin, the CEO of Lloyd Group after helping his grandmother after a scam. Learning about her financial struggles, he offers her money in exchange for a fake marriage to fulfill his grandmother's wish. They form an unexpected alliance, while Austin keeps his true identity a secret from her.

book_title: Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas
special_desc: Damian, the CEO of the world's most powerful military-industrial group, is mistaken for a poor salesman earning only $3,000 a month. Unexpectedly, he enters into a quick contract marriage with Iris, a company’s boss. Damian accompanies Iris to her hometown for a Christmas dinner, where he faces constant belittlement from her relatives and ridicule from Iris's suitor. Damian continually turns the tables on the antagonists, proving his power and status, and ultimately finds true love with Iris.

book_title: Mommy Don't Cry, Daddy is Sorry
special_desc: In Mommy Don't Cry Daddy is Sorry Movie, when his wife Sienna dies in a mental hospital, Wayne is fooled by the cunning Alison into taking home the wrong daughter. Little does he know, his wife is still alive, reborn as her ruthless alter-ego Scarlett and determined to reveal Alison's trecherous schemes and enact vengeance in her daughter's name.

In Mama, Sing Me a Lullaby movie, Single mother Tracey works hard to raise her twins on her own.  Her youngest son Henry hates his family and considers Logan, his older brother with a heart condition, to be a burden. Logan is hit in a car accident and adopted by a rich man, changing his life forever.
Tracey continued to work odd jobs as a janitor. Both Tracey and Logan never gave up on finding each other, and Logan, now CEO, feels a connection to Tracey the moment they meet again.
Tracey's selfless sacrifice has been wasted on Henry. He finds her embarrassing and is eager to deny knowing her, even actively bullying her.
Finally, at Henry's wedding, just as Henry is about to smash a bottle of wine on Tracey, Logan receives the DNA testing results. The woman on stage being humiliated is his own mother!

book_title: The Billionaire Female CEO from the Trailer Park
special_desc:
In The Billionaire Female CEO from the Trailer Park movie, Elise Gray was called to serve her country the day of her wedding, developing cutting edge fighter jets for the military. She was also able to use found Lockheed Gray, the world's biggest aerospace and military defense contractor, becoming the richest billionaire in the world.
Four years later, she goes home to her husband Cato to give him the wedding they never had, hiding her identity in order to give him the surprise wedding of his dreams. However, when she returns to her small-town she finds trouble - Beatrice has been relentlessly pursuing Cato, plotting to destroy their marriage. Cato's family, especially his mother Stacy, are also trying to push Elise to divorce Cato so he can marry Beatrice, resorting to humiliating her to get their way. Cato's loyalty and earnest love for Elise gives her strength to fight back till the end. Elise won't back down - no matter the cost, she'll defend her marriage and take back her dignity.

book_title: The Ghost of You and I
special_desc: In The Ghost of You and I movie, Lieutenant Ryan Cross is fighting on the front lines, but he doesn't tell his wife, Alice, for fear of worrying her. Tragically, Ryan is killed in action while trying to save his comrades. However, his lingering regrets cause him to transform into a ghost and return to his wife’s side. Back home, Alice, who thinks Ryan is just hiding from her, is convinced he's been cheating! Pissed, Alice decides to get back at Ryan by marrying another man. On the day of the wedding, Alice’s bridal car passes Ryan’s funeral procession.

book_title: Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas
special_desc: In Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas movie, seven years ago, they shared one night. Now they’re fake-married—with a child he doesn’t know is his.

Marry the man of her dreams was supposed to be the key to Ivy Donahue's happily-ever-after. Instead, it was only the start to an endless cycle of misery and heartbreak. But when her husband crosses the ultimate line, Ivy reveals she's not just any housewife—she's a billionaire heiress, and she's going to make him pay.

book_title: Back Off! I'm the Real Mrs. CEO
special_desc: Who is the real Freya D’Lore? Time was against the original Freya D’Lore when a stranger stole her name and identity in Back Off, I'm The Real Mrs. CEO Movie. Freya D’lore was humiliated and insulted and could only watch her life-time's hard work go down the drain until she was eventually able to prove her identity on the spot.

Nancy, the long-lost Lancaster heiress, battles betrayal from her boyfriend Alan and his mistress Mia, who try to steal her place. When will Nancy establish her true identity and gain acceptance from those around her?

book_title: Found A Homeless Billionaire Husband for Christmas
special_desc: Victoria was set to return to Texas with her fiancé Carl to plan their wedding, but she was horrifically humiliated and betrayed by him. To save face with her family, Victoria reluctantly agrees to marry Simon, a homeless man she had been helping. Little did she know, Simon is not just any homeless man—he's a handsome and charming billionaire, the CEO of the prestigious Savage Group, ranked number one in the country. Upon returning to Texas with Simon, Victoria unexpectedly crosses paths with her arrogant ex, Carl. This time, she’s determined to reclaim all the dignity she lost.

book_title: How to Tame a Silver Fox
special_desc: In How to Tame a Silver Fox movie, Harper Reeves is just trying to finish up her senior year of Yale without being a completely friendless loser. However, when her party's suddenly crashed by her dad's best friend and mysterious business partner, Chris Collins, she realizes she'd much rather have been busted by the cops. Chris, always in over-protective mode, gets on Harper's nerves, until she realizes he needs to go. Together with her best friend Maria, she brainstorms Operation Seduction, planning to get Chris to fall in love with her so her dad will kick him out himself. But every time Chris saves Harper from trouble, she gets closer to realizing she may have feelings for him after all.

In The Alpha's Virgin Captive movie, Evelyn never meant to save the ruthless alpha, Dominic—but now she’s his mate. She’s wolfless and already chosen Harrison, but Dominic doesn’t take no for an answer. He kidnaps her, claiming her as his. She tries to run, but the more she resists, the hotter the desire burns between them. What terrifies her most? The way she’s slowly starting to crave him... more than anything.

Pregnant with Alpha Cyrus's child, the only thing that can save Ally Jones's life is the sacred fruit of the Arbor Vitae. But her true mate Cyrus only seems to care about another werewolf, Emma. As Ally's body grows weaker, will Cyrus choose her... just this once?

In The Prince's First Love movie, Lucas never expected to kiss a prince—least of all in front of the entire school. What began as a feud with Prince Nicholas turned into a forced friendship, and that into something far more complicated. Every glance, every brush of hands, pulls them closer... but Nicholas is torn between his royal duty and his growing feelings for the boy he once called an enemy. Neither dares to speak the truth—until the moment it can’t be hidden.

book_title: The Three Badasses Who Want Me
special_desc: You just got dumped by your cheating husband who doesn’t realize you are actually British royalty! Your dad finds you 3 badass fiancés to show him up. But you only have 7 days to pick! Who do you choose? Or can you have all three?

book_title: My Secret Husband is My Boss
special_desc: Kate married a stranger in order to secure her inheritance without ever seeing him. She returns two years later get a divorce, not knowing that her hot billionaire boss and crush Jack Townsend is her secret husband.

After getting her wolf, Maya learns that the alpha of her pack, Liam, is her fated mate. Meanwhile, the evil Rogue King searches for the True Luna who will be his bride, to make his power complete and help usher in a reign of darkness. Maya is this True Luna, and she must reckon with her destiny and the danger and transformation it brings.

book_title: Open Your Eyes, My Billionaire Husband
special_desc: Hailey is cash-strapped and desperate for a way to pay her mother's heafty medical bills. Her family agrees to help her, on the condition she marries the billionaire Samuel Trent, whom is in a coma after a near-fatal car accident. However, it wouldn't be long before the infamous Samuel Trent would wake up from his coma and discover he's engaged to a complete stranger.

book_title: My Loser Daddy is a Big Shot
special_desc: In My Loser Daddy is a Big Shot Movie, with the help of their daughter Cassie, Ethan, a veteran, and Leanne, CEO of Osborne Group, marry on a whim. Despite facing scorn from friends and family, Leanne stands by Ethan as he uses his exceptional skills to protect them from various threats. Unfairly labeled as a deserter and gold digger, Ethan eventually reveals his true identity as the leader of the secret justice group, 'GUARDIAN FORCE.' He hides his identity to root out traitors and dismantle an evil organization, all while being a devoted husband and father.

book_title: Swimming My Way Back to You
special_desc: In Swimming My Way Back to You movie, Hazel has been in love with Marcus for eight years and spent three of them as his secret lover. Just when she thought she had finally won his heart, she overhears Marcus confessing that the only person he’s ever truly loved is his first love, Zoe. Heartbroken, Hazel decides it’s time to break things off with him—only to find out she’s pregnant...

In Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire movie, small-town girl Emily moves to the city to collect a debt from her ex, Kevin, hoping to pay off her mother’s medical bills. But she discovers Kevin is now a sugar baby living off of wealthy woman, Rose, and together they humiliate her. Just as Emily hits rock bottom, she stumbles across Lucas. Through an unexpected misunderstanding, Emily becomes the contract wife of a CEO.

The Cursed Alpha's Mate is based on the novel by Cricket Colson, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish.

In The Cursed Alpha's Mate movie: Shay Santos is finally ready to lose her virginity, but when she tries to surprise her boyfriend, she finds him cheating on her instead! Heartbroken, she goes out with her BFF and vows to sleep with the first guy who approaches her… Who happens to be powerful Alpha Mal Haywood. Their attraction is instant, animal, and for a human and a werewolf… Forbidden. But that’s not the only problem: Mal’s been cursed, and if doesn’t mark Shay as his mate and impregnate her with his pup, he’ll die!

In My Husband Regrets Divorcing Me movie, Audrey hides her identity as a CEO to protect Cornell's pride, working behind the scenes to help him secure a major hotel project and climb to the top as the hotel's CEO. As she helps him make his way up the ladder, his first love, Cecilia, returns, putting a strain on their relationship . Meanwhile, Audrey faces relentless pressure from those around her, including Cornell, which pushing her to consider a divorce. After enduring countless humiliations, she finally recognizes her worth and the price of dedicating herself to the wrong person. With her confidence restored, Audrey eventually chooses divorce and fight to reclaim her place as the CEO.

In The Deaf Heiress's Secret movie, A deaf heiress regains her hearing just in time to discover the people closest to her plotting against her. Keeping her recovery a secret, she plays a dangerous game of deception against those who believe her disability makes her weak. As she investigates suspicious events from her past, she must carefully navigate a web of betrayal while pretending not to hear the conspiracies unfolding around her in order to bring those who wronged her to justice.

After falling into the water and losing his memory, Warren Davis, a once-powerful chairman, unknowingly becomes a porter at the very hotel he founded. He endures humiliation from his employees - and even his own son, as they treat him as nothing more than a lowly servant, until he remembers who he is.

Identical twins Erin and Elise were torn apart as kids. 20 years later, gently Elise is betrayed by the two people she trusted most — her husband and best friend — then tortured and left for dead. Grief-stricken and furious, badass CEO Erin steps into her dead sister’s life to exact revenge. Their faces may be carbon copies, but Erin is no one one to mess with as she systematically and pyschologically pits her sister’s husband and best friend against each other in a cat and mouse game to destroy the murderers.

Chloe and Mateo have been best friends for years, until they accidentally spend one fateful night together and end up in a flash marriage! Will Mateo confess he's been in love with Chloe for years, and pull her out of their "friend-zone"? And what will Chloe do, when she finds out Mateo is secretly a billaionire CEO?

book_title: Step Aside, I'm the King of Capital
special_desc: In Step Aside I'm the King of Capital movie, for six years abroad, Cassius builds the world’s top financial empire, the Enros Group, under the name “Mr. S,” even helping the current president rise to power. When he quietly returns home to propose to his girlfriend Isabella, she dumps him, chasing wealth and claiming only the mysterious Mr. S is good enough for her. Meanwhile, a small favor lands Cassius in a sudden marriage to Freya, the beautiful CEO of Mirror Media. At Isabella’s inauguration party, she tries to kick Cassius out again and again, never guessing who he really is—until Cassius finally decides to reclaim everything he once gave her.

book_title: The CEO's Wife is A Badass
special_desc: In The CEO's Wife is A Badass movie, Cora, a modest artist and the wife of billionaire Brandon Pearson, finds herself managing his gallery while he's away on business. However, her role as the CEO's wife is unexpectedly eclipsed by her college classmate Ashley, leaving Cora scorned by her colleagues. Can Cora reclaim her place and prove her worth?

book_title: Claimed by the Alpha I Hate
special_desc: All her life, Daisy Storm never knew what was wrong with her. Why couldn't she shift? Why didn't she have a wolf? Even though she was hated by her entire pack, Daisy thought at least she had her mate, the Alpha... until he cheats on her and breaks their mate bond on her eighteenth birthday, making her biggest bully into the new Luna. She ran away from home in tears, but just six months later her mother mysteriously dies, and she's ordered to return by the new Alpha in charge - the one she blames for her mom's death - Nolan Fenrir. She swears that she'll never forgive him for all he's done, and yet... Daisy feels this unnatural pull to Alpha Nolan, and despite his harsh surface somehow he feels the same. She can't have ANOTHER mate bond, could she? With the man she hates the most?!

book_title: Hey Boss, Your Company is Getting Bombed
special_desc: In Hey Boss Your Company is Getting Bombed movie, Clyde is a middle-aged salesman who has been marginalized in his job. One day, he wakes up with a superpower of seeing when and how people would die. He tries to save multiple people from death, but no one believes him. A few days later, his power tells him there is going to be an explosion at his company that will kill everyone in the building. To save everyone, he has to find out who planted the bomb and stop them.

Based on the novel by Havley McQueen, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish.
When Jayne Turner asks a stranger at a bondage party to teach her how to be a dominatrix, she has no idea he’ll turn out to be the man overseeing her father’s exit from the family company. What’s meant to be a single night of education about dominance and submission turns into something more when Jayne asks Dom to continue teaching her. Because of a morality clause in his contract, a relationship with her could mean his job if anyone finds out, but Dom agrees. They must keep their relationship strictly educational and entirely undercover, but as their passion grows, so does the risk of discovery. Jayne’s success on the movie set is thanks to Dom’s “instruction,” but as she begins receiving increasingly more threatening messages tying her to her deceased mother, famous actress Ingrid Hart, it's up to Dom to protect what he owns. With multiple enemies possibly behind the threats, Jayne isn’t sure who to blame. It turns out to be the gaffer on set, a man who’d worked with and been obsessed with Ingrid. Doug kidnaps Jayne but her quick thinking has Dom on the way to rescue her – which reveals their relationship and triggers the morality clause. Dom makes a deal with Jayne’s dad without her knowledge. Dad will back off trying to stop Jayne’s movie career, and Dom will return to London, never to see her again. The night of Jayne’s movie premiere, Dad reveals the truth and Jayne reaches out to the man she’s fallen in love with. At her message, Dom returns to beg forgiveness for leaving her. Jayne forgives them, and they can be together openly.

book_title: Tell Me Not to Love You
special_desc: Brie is the daughter of a servant who works for Teddy’s family. She grew up living in the household with her mother and developed mutual feelings for the young master, Teddy. Once they came of age, Teddy began pursuing Brie passionately, but Brie feels insecure because of her status as a servant’s daughter. Teddy struggles to convince her to be with him. Brie keeps trying to pull away, but through all their back-and-forth, she eventually admits how she truly feels.

For seven years, Christmas meant grief––until Raphael Stone sees a face he thought he'd never see again. Lucy, his beloved wife, is alive, but she can't move or talk anymore. Worse, she doesn't seem to remember him at all. Will true love triumph over pain and misfortune?

Serena caught her boyfriend, Ken cheating on her with her half-sister, Carol. He had always lied about holding it all in till marriage.  Furious by their actions, Serena gets drunk and ended up in the bed of Jesse. She thought he was her escort but he was a man who has been inlove with her for years.

Recipe For Faking A Marriage Movie is about a poor orphan, Every, entering into a contract marriage with billionaire Julian Barlow, until they fell in love with each other for a fact. Bella Barlow, Julian’s eight-year-old daughter was the architect of the meeting between Julian and Every, and it developed into a scintillating love affair which blossomed forever.

Jessica, the Wolf Queen, grew tired of war and bloodshed, so she disguised herself as a plain healer in the woods. To ensure a normal, happy life for her daughter, she sent her to the Russo pack. Little did she know, she had sent her daughter into a living nightmare. Her daughter was treated like a slave—humiliated, abused, beaten, and nearly raped, simply because she had no fame or power. Realizing her mistake, Jessica resolved to save her daughter and make those who mistreated her pay. Meanwhile, she discovered that the Russo pack had betrayed their country and collaborated with Lord Kilian Darkmoom. Finally, Jessica defeated them and restored peace to the wolf world once more.

Syrena and Harrison wake up next to each other one morning to find out they've announced their engagement through Instagram. To protect both of their company's reputations, Syrena and Harrison decide to fake their relationship for the public.

When her sister gets blackmailed by a ruthless sex club owner, Dakota James is desperate enough to offer a contract relationship to Jaxon Shaw, a mysterious billionaire who never touches his lovers.  Until Dakota.  From her first touch, Jaxon starts to feel.  Their secret relationship ends brutally when Dakota discovers she's dying and breaks up with Jaxon to protect him.  When Dakota gets in too deep with the club owner, she is saved by the masked man Hades—Jaxon in disguise.  But time is running out for the fated lovers. Will Jaxon uncover Dakota’s deadly secret in time to save her?  Or will the forces against them destroy their love before it’s too late.

book_title: Move Aside! I'm the Final Boss
special_desc: In Move Aside I'm the Final Boss Movie, Kingsley is the secret King of King's Corps and the richest man on Earth, but when he returns from the battlefield, his childhood sweetheart brutally dumps him, thinking he's a clown. How will the King of all men make her regret it?

In Pride & Prejudice movie, despite societal pressures to marry, Lizzie Bennet, second eldest of the Bennet sisters, has her heart set on spinsterhood. But when her father falls gravely ill, Lizzie is unexpectedly thrust into the classist world of courtship in order to save her family from destitution. After a fateful encounter with the broody, mysterious millionaire, Mr. Darcy, Lizzie’s forced to choose between denying her feelings for the sake of her family or allowing herself to fall recklessly in love.

book_title: Money, Robots, and a Happy 4th of July
special_desc: The Iron Marine, Toby Stark, returns home after saving the country only to be brutally dumped by his ex who as no clue he's the richest guy on Earth! How will Tobias slap back at her?

book_title: Betrayed Alpha Queen Rises from the Ashes
special_desc: Nessa, secret Wolf Queen, has her wolf sealed so that she can runaway with her fated mate, Alpha Blaze Ashclaw. But Blaze mistakes the birthmark on their son to mean Nessa cheated and makes them his slaves. Only when the life of their son is threatened, is there a chance for Blaze to realize the truth, but will it be too late then?

Eliza Spencer, self-made billionaire, survives a murder attempt and wakes with amnesia. Rescued by Justin Patton, a handsome stranger in a wheelchair- she marries him unaware he's also a billionaire faking his disability. When her memory returns, she keeps her identity a secret to reclaim her company from her greedy family and protect Justin from his vicious half-brother and step-mother.

Hannah, a Farm-raised Ballerina, uses a contract engagement to secure her place in the prestigious Hargrove Ballet Company, but she's interrupted by Jack, a handsome assassin, who coerces her to help him. He's a dangerous obstacle, until Hannah discovers he could actually give her everything. As she finally surrenders, he pulls away... But when they face death together, they realize, life's too short to waste true love.
Driven to despair after losing both her husband and baby, Vivienne only lives for one thing - REVENGE! But simple murder doesn't torture enough. Why not steal her husband and make her watch!

Fated to My Forbidden Vampire Summary shows how werewolves are bound by the moon goddess. The movie talks about Theo and Heather who are tied by blood oath. Heather, who was termed as unwanted for being an orphan, is wanted and loved by Theo.
Fiona, Heather's sister, conspires a revenge plan to ruin Heather's happiness. Heather has to find a way to break the magic spell to protect her love.

Evie wants to get away from her abusive, cheating husband, but he refuse to let her go. She finds herself broke and homeless, until she meets Hunter. Can Hunter be the lifeline Evie needs to escape her dangerous asshole husband who'd rather see her die than let her win?

A few minutes after getting married, Leila's husband was screwing another woman. She found out that his marriage to her was a plot to steal her wealth. Desperate for a husband and a child, Leila sleeps with an escort who turns out to be her admirer. Will Leila accept his love for her when he reveals his identity?

Austin Harrington was the love of Grace Mitchell’s life in Love Ages Like Fine Wine Movie until he unexpectedly stood her up on their wedding day. While Grace thought the worst about Austin, she did not know that Austin had been forced by his grandfather to take on family business which led him back to her on a grander scale.

Switched at birth, Allie had no idea who she really was until she fell for Xander Maddox. That's when she gets her DNA results. Now, she's torn between telling Xander who her father really is and risk losing him or keeping a lie from the man she loves.

book_title: OMG, I'm Surrounded by Three Princes
special_desc: Erin, a down-and-out street vendor, is betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, but no one knows that her true identity is the long-lost princess. Just when the three princes find the clues and Erin can return to the royal family, her true princess identity is claimed by her best friend. In the many subsequent dangerous situations, Prince Charles repeatedly protects Erin, causing Erin to develop a different feeling for her "brother" Charles.

In I Have Five Kick-Ass Brothers movie, Raina "Smith" Lincoln has to leave her life of luxury after finding out she was switched at birth. She reunites with her seemingly impoverished biological family, the Lincolns, who hide their extreme wealth from her. Despite finding out that her family is poor, Raina embraces the Lincolns and they reciprocate. As her old family, the Smiths, and their evil daughter try to take her down, her true family, along with super rich, super handsome, billionaire Theo Jones, do anything and everything to defend Raina.

book_title: If Loving You is a Sin, then I'll Go to Hell
special_desc:
In If Loving You is a Sin then I'll Go to Hell movie, Ellie Jones has been a good girl her whole life, that is until she loses her virginity to bad boy Asher King at her first high school party. The two fall for each other and she gets pregnant. However Ellie's father, the Pastor, and Asher's family, The Red Snakes Gang, wants to keep them apart and take away their baby. Now he has vowed to protect her, no matter the cost.
Episode List

In Never Underestimate Girl movie Math, Zosha is a poor orphan who gets bullied by all the rich Ivy League kids for working on a farm. But Zosha's about to beat them all at the one thing they least expect: math.

book_title: Stop Crying, I Married Someone Better
special_desc: Scarlett Winters is devastated when her fiancé, Carlton Simmons, abandons her at the altar. Fleeing in humiliation, she’s nearly hit by a car, an incident orchestrated by Leo Forester, genius and legendary CEO who recognizes the runaway bride. Leo offers her an unusual solution: a contract marriage to help her regain her dignity and rebuild her life. As Scarlett heals, Leo secretly supports her, hiding his true identity and intentions. But when old enemies resurface and buried secrets emerge, Scarlett feels betrayed and considers leaving. Now Leo must decide: confess his feelings or risk losing her forever.

In Miss You After Goodbye movie, to repay a debt of kindness, Neil signs a secret contract with Keira's father stating that he will marry Keira for five years and help her recover from a painful breakup with her first love, Simon. During their contract marriage, Neil is attentive and caring towards Keira, but she never treats him as anything more than Simon's substitute. When the contract comes to an end, Neil discovers Keira's persisting infatuation with Simon and finally decides to divorce her. When Keira sees the divorce agreement and learns from her father of Neil's departure, she is overcome with regret and travels the world searching for Neil, ultimately realizing that the man she lost was truly in love with her. However, it's all too little too late, as Neil has already embarked on a new, promising path and left her behind for good.

book_title: Dear Professor, You Are My Baby Daddy
special_desc: Med student Cora never expected to get pregnant—let alone with the baby of Damon Hawkins, the city’s most eligible billionaire bachelor... and her new visiting professor. She planned to keep the child a secret, but Damon kept pushing past her walls—until he dropped to one knee and asked her to marry him. What Cora thought would be a fleeting romance turned into a whirlwind of unexpected tenderness and indulgent love. But the closer they grow, the more dangerous secrets begin to surface. As betrayal and hidden bloodlines come to light, Cora must face the ultimate question— Can she truly find happiness... and reunite with the family she never knew she had?

In The Billionaire’s Baby Bargain movie, to save her dying sister, Abby, Amelia agrees to a contract marriage that will involve no sex, no love, and a baby by insemination. The arrangement was instigated by Nathan, a billionaire struggling to regain his position as CEO by fulfilling his father's wish. As they navigate their false marriage, unexpected feelings develop. This may complicate their business deal.

The Virgin And The Billionaire Movie is about how female lead Cindy found love under uncanny circumstances where she never thought it existed. Cindy, who was a child born through rape, was demoted to being a maid and a substitute bride in her father’s house until fortune smiled on her and billionaire Charles Kane fell in love with her.

In Accidental Surrogate for Alpha movie, Ella is a Luna werewolf kept hidden by her parents from everyone including herself. Without knowing this, Ella has always hated wolves. What she desired was motherhood. Her boyfriend has prevented that by drugging her. When Ella found out, she went for insemination but accidentally the sperm of an alpha wolf was placed in her.

5 years ago, Sienna and Damian had an one night stand. Now, she's back with their daughter Poppy as the CEO of a huge production company in LA. To reconnect with them, Damian hides his billionaire identity and becomes Poppy's manny. Will they stand against the world and build a new life as a family?

In The Nurse's Secret Marriage Full Movie, Nurse Aria Browne gets married to billionaire CEO Mason Adams to raise money for her dying mother's operation. Purely contractual, the two never actually see each other during their courthouse ceremony. They meet again three years later - Mason, as the owner of Aria's workplace, and Aria, as the nurse who saved Mason's grandpa's life. They don't recognize each other, but their feelings for each other grow as they spend more time together. Falling for his grandpa's nurse, Mason decides to divorce his wife who, unbeknownst to him, is the very woman he's falling in love with.

book_title: The Bad-ass Heiress Returns After Divorce
special_desc: Framed for cheating and losing her 8-month-old unborn baby, Sophia vows to get revenge on those who ruined her life—Ryan Allister and Lana Sullivan. When the Sullivan family tracks her down and reveals she's the real heiress, not Lana, Sophia sees her chance to make her ex-husband and the faker pay. She hides her newfound identity and starts her quest for revenge. Along the way, Ryan realizes he can't live without Sophia and he was fooled by Lana in the beginning.

When the fate of a business marriage seems inevitable, Emma Watson, the heiress of the Watson family, takes on an internship at Anderson Corporation. Meanwhile, Ethan Anderson, the heir of the Anderson family, steps in as the new CEO. Both hide their true identities while evaluating each other, but they unexpectedly fall in love at first sight. However, things take an unexpected turn when someone else mistakenly claims Emma’s identity, and she mistakenly believes another man is her “fiancé.” Determined, both Emma and Ethan set out to break off their "engagements" with their so-called "fiancés." Will they ever realize that the person they're searching for has been right in front of them all along?

Hallie Bildner, a successful NYC CEO engaged to a billionaire politician, is shocked to learn that her high school sweetheart never signed their divorce papers. Determined to settle the past, she returns to her hometown, only to find her ex hiding two big secrets: the true reason he broke her heart and that his 7-year-old daughter is actually hers. As old feelings reignite, Hallie faces a choice between the life she built and the one she left behind.

Adrian leaves his own daughter Esther in a car while he hangs out with his childhood sweetheart, Stacy and her son Lucas. Under the hot summer sun, the car overheats and shuts down. The A/C stops working and Esther starts to overheat. She's at risk of heatstroke and almost faints. Esther dials Adrian's phone to ask for help. Without listening to her, Adrian hangs up. Just before Esther's tablet runs out of battery, she calls her mother. She begs her mom to save her. However, before Esther can tell Claire her location, the tablet dies. Claire starts to desperately search for her daughter. Will Claire be able to successfully find and save her daughter before the unthinkable happens?

Wall Street tycoon Ryan Chase is poisoned and pushed overboard by his fiancée, Mia, during a lavish yacht party. He miraculously survives—but loses his voice, his identity, and everything he once had. Left with nothing, Ryan is rescued by a kind mute woman named Sophia, who brings him back to her family's small restaurant and offers him a job. Despite constant abuse from Sophia’s spiteful stepmother Diane, Ryan and Sophia grow close and eventually fall in love. When Sophia’s father, James, falls critically ill, Ryan steps up to help the family. Meanwhile, Mia forges a marriage certificate in an attempt to steal Ryan’s multi-billion-dollar empire. Ryan’s loyal assistant, Thomas, risks everything to protect what’s left. When Diane discovers Ryan’s true identity and still refuses to help James, Ryan finally reaches out to Thomas—ready to return to the battlefield and take back everything that was his.

In Caution! Cute Baby Alert! movie, One night with Robert the billionaire and Scarlett was pregnant. She never saw him again. Her parents rejected her and her baby was confirmed dead. Unbeknownst to Scarlett, her baby didn't die; instead, he was sold. Years later, a cute baby called her mommy. He wants her to marry his dad who pretends to be a chauffeur.

Stacy Van Ness, the heiress to the biggest winery in Napa Valley, conceals her identity to be with Pete Davis, just to get brutally dumped. She decides to show the world who she is - the richest heiress in the country...but no one seems to believe her?

Infatuated With The CEO movie talks about Emma Caldwell who ends up sleeping with August Hughes, her business partner, after finding out her fiancé Derek is cheating on her. To save herself from the scandal she pretends to be with Derek who manipulates her into not breaking up with him.
August Hughes, despite being called a Casanova by the tabloids, chases after Emma, wanting her to be more than a one-night stand.

book_title: Mommy, I Got You A Date
special_desc: Liam and Annie were a young couple until Annie was nearly assaulted. In the process of saving her, Liam severely injured the attacker, resulting in his imprisonment. The wealthy Holland family head revealed Liam as their heir, forcing Annie to leave him by promising to save him if she agreed, hiding her pregnancy and pretending to love money. Six years later, Annie is a janitor, and Liam is the Holland heir. Despite his resentment, Liam still loves Annie and repeatedly saves her, but she avoids him, fearing for their son Henry's safety and feeling guilty for the past. Liam decides to win her back by focusing on Henry, believing that with Henry, Annie will return. He carefully plans to remove the obstacles that separated them.

In The Lost Quarterback Returns movie, when Asher Bradshaw, the son of hall-of-famer NFL quarterback Trent Bradshaw and former beauty queen Krista, goes missing in a devastating fire, psychotic fan Donny Lewis takes it as an opportunity to swap Asher with his own son, Wyatt. Twelve years later, the two boys cross paths at football tryouts where Asher out performs Wyatt. The Bradshaw's not realizing Asher is their long-lost son, attack him relentlessly. They put him through physical and mental torture, egged on by their adoptive son. Until they uncover the shocking truth—Asher's the one they've been looking for. The Bradshaws then do everything in their power to beg for forgiveness while Wyatt and Donny plot revenge.

In When Wife Won't Forgive movie, on their 25th wedding anniversary, Anne discovers her bestselling author husband, Jonathan, has been having an affair. Anne is fed up and wants to get a divorce. Jonathan thinks he's going to become the CEO of the publishing company, so he immediately kicks Anne to the curb. Utterly heartbroken, Anne decides she won't forgive Jonathan again. She resumes her position as Chairwoman of an elite publishing company, and removes Jonathan from his position. Jonathan finally realizes that Anne who played housewife for 25 years was actually a wealthy heiress.

In Daisy Tucker and Mr. NYC movie, after a flash marriage, country girl Daisy finds herself married to her new boss, Hamilton Smith, owner of Smith Media. But misunderstandings and plots by Hamilton's evil VP, Bianca, threaten to destroy their relationship before they can confess that they really love each other.

book_title: The Call Boy I Met in Paris
special_desc: Sophie met Justin seven years ago, but she doesn't remember who he is. As fate would have it, they reunite seven years later after a one night stand. She mistakens him for a callboy and asks him to fake marry her, but little does she know... he's a billionaire!

Sara was reduced to a maid in a home her late mother built from scratch in In Bed With Your Lies Movie. While she was trying to navigate such injustice, she looked out for a certain painting from her mother to her, which she found in the possession of Noah Dempsey, a billionaire who she was a substitute bride to.

book_title: Fatal Attraction: A Dark Mafia Romance
special_desc: To avenge her mother, Daisy disguises herself as a dancer to get close to the dangerous mafia boss, Hogan. Despite suspecting Daisy's intentions, Hogan finds himself irresistibly drawn to her deadly charm. Will Daisy manage to walk away unscathed, or will she be entangled in passion with Hogan?

When Katie's younger sister's cancer worsens, she finds herself signing a contract to give birth to a mysterious billionaire's heir. However, when proving their relationship to the CEO's grandpa turns out to be more difficult than expected, Katie and Mr. Brandt find themselves growing closer to one another, despite the contract's one and only rule: no falling in love.

In Slimming Revolution Movie, Declan, the Harrison family's heir, marries Claire, the daughter of a wealthy tycoon, due to a family arrangement. However, on their wedding day, Declan is shocked to see that Claire, whom he's meeting for the first time, is a plus-size woman, nearly 300 pounds. The wedding guests quickly turn Declan into the laughingstock of the event. Reluctantly, Declan starts married life with this stranger, and Claire's intense love for him only adds to his stress. When Claire's efforts to protect their love inadvertently anger Declan, he, obsessed with appearances, cruelly takes out his frustrations on her, even criticizing her weight. Feeling deeply hurt, Claire decides to embark on a journey to lose weight, determined to make Declan regret his actions.

In Yellowstone King of Montana movie, Henry Conrad, the legendary founder of Yellowstone Ranch and the King of Montana, hid his identity as a school janitor. Now, after 10 years -- he's returning to his throne. However, before he can reveal who he is, his son gets bullied, beaten and humiliated. Henry vows to protect his son, make the bullies pay and right the wrongs in this valley like a real King.

School hockey star Brady asks brainy wallflower Harper to be his chemistry tutor. In exchange, he promises to be her fake boyfriend, teach her how to flirt — and help her land her crush. But what will happen when their contract backfires, and the chemistry becomes more than just on paper?

In You Drive Me Crazy movie, 6 years ago, car restorer Yasmin was drugged and had a passionate encounter with a handsome homeless guy she thought she’d never see again — only to discover she was carrying his child. Now, fighting to save her 5-year-old son, she takes a job as secretary to Tristen Mars, former race car driver and CEO of Mars Motor Group. Little does she know this billionaire is the father of her little boy!  As old sparks reignite and hidden truths come dangerously close to the surface, Yasmin and Tristen fall for each other while still unaware that they’re the very strangers they’ve spent years longing to find.

book_title: Blood & Silver: Rise of the Alpha's Rejected Mate
special_desc: In Blood & Silver: Rise of the Alpha's Rejected Mate movie, after a devastating betrayal that decimates two powerful wolf packs, young Ann Reed is forced into a mating bond with Alpha Dane Montague—her enemy, her savior, and the man who believes she’s responsible for his family's death. For three years, Dane torments her, determined never to love her. But when he finally claims her body and then shoves her aside, Ann shatters. She cuts their magical soul-bond and disappears—leaving behind only a severed ribbon, a credit card, and a secret she hasn’t even discovered yet. Years later, she returns not as Ann Reed, but as Aurora Moon, heir to a royal European pack, cloaked in wealth, power, and secrets. Her mission is clear: protect her children, reclaim her power, and avoid Dane at all costs. But when she walks back into his world, she triggers the one thing she feared most: his attention. As Dane fights the pull toward the mate he thought he hated, dark forces stir, old enemies rise, and the truth about the past—and their bond—is about to explode. Because Aurora didn’t come back to be claimed. She came back to conquer.

In You Belong With Me movie, Kristine was betrayed by her boyfriend and best friend. She knew about him cheating on her while riding on her intelligence. Kristine decided to get back at him by sleeping with his rich uncle, Henry. Henry was aware he was being used as Kristine made it clear to him. But what started as revenge changed into genuine feelings.

In The Billionaire's Masquerade Movie, after Shelby's father died, he passed on his inheritance to her with unfavorable conditions. She must get married to claim her inheritance. To claim it, she marries a poor stranger, Griffin. She didn't know that Griffin wasn't a poor man as she had thought. He's a billionaire who had admired Shelby from their last encounter, three years ago.

book_title: The Gourmet CEO Turns out to Be My Baby's Dad
special_desc: Betrayed by her family, Skylar is forced into a compromising situation with a sleazy-looking director in exchange for her grandmother's medical bills. However, she unexpectedly has a one-night stand with Maxwell, CEO of Klein Group, instead, leading to an unplanned pregnancy. Sent abroad, Skyhlar returns six years later with her son and opens a restaurant. Fate eventually brings her and Maxwell back... Will he recognize Skylar as the unforgettable woman from that fateful night?

After 15 years, sparks fly when Isabel and Ari reunite and become passionate lovers. She's a police detective trying to make her career by catching a mysterious master thief. As Ari helps her investigation and their affair gets steamier, will she realize that her lover is the criminal she's hunting?

book_title: Pregnant by My Tough Daddy CEO
special_desc: After losing the money to cover her mother's medical expenses to her brother, the female lead gets bullied for being broke, but is saved by the male lead. She finds a part time job at a bar, and bumps into the male lead again, who decides to help out with the medical expenses. The female lead is pregnant with twins after a one-night-stand with the male lead. She ends up moving into his house and becomes everyone's favorite.

book_title: Twilight Romance: Flash Marriage to Mature Tycoon
special_desc: Ray, a middle-aged businessman who has given up on love in Twilight Romance Flash Marriage to Mature Tycoon. Posing as a construction worker, he enters into a flash marriage with Jocelyn, a woman who has just been kicked out of her house. Their union starts off with a sweet and dreamy honeymoon phase, but their love is interrupted by persistent bullying from the family of Jocelyn's daughter-in-law. After repeatedly saving Jocelyn from disaster, Ray reveals his hidden billionaire identity to her, and the two of them embark on a life of luxury. That's when Ray's ex-wife returns to drive a wedge betwen Ray and Jocelyn, and as Jocelyn prepares to sacrifice herself for the sake of her husband's career, Ray gives her the most romantic of surprises...

book_title: The Virgin Stripper and the Hockey Star
special_desc: In The Virgin Stripper and the Hockey Star movie, Jenna leads a double life: by day, she’s a quiet, unassuming student; by night, she secretly works as a stripper to pay for her sister’s medical bills. Her worlds collide one night when Casper, her cocky school rival and the star of the hockey team, walks into the club. He’s instantly drawn to the enigmatic dancer, Angel, unaware she’s the same girl he spars with at school. But the deeper their bond grows, the closer they come to unraveling each other’s truths.

Break My Heart Again full movie story about: To protect her lover from the hands of her debtors, Lucie broke up with Felix giving him the wrong perception. Years later, Felix became wealthy and Lucie became his employee. Still angered by their past relationship, he promised to tear her apart and make her feel his pain. What happens when he finds out her true past intentions?

In His One and Only Love movie, Lyla grows up feeling different from others and struggles with a sense of inferiority. Forced by her family to work and earn money, she faces abuse at every turn. On her 22nd birthday, Lyla wishes for true love. While working a part-time job, she saves Leo, a handsome and gentle president, and unexpectedly becomes pregnant. Leo takes her in and cares for her tenderly, and over time, their love blossoms. However, as they uncover the mystery of Lyla's past, they find themselves entangled in a web of conspiracy and evil. How will Lyla defend their love? What kind of ending awaits her and Leo under the care of the Goddess of Fate?

book_title: Lady Boss Takes on Vegas Bullies!
special_desc: In Lady Boss Takes on Vegas Bullies! full movie, Jane goes undercover as a janitor to investigate allegations of employee abuse. But when she is forced to reveal her true identity to protect her loyal workers, no one believes her, and now, someone has stolen her identity as executive of the casino! What can she do as a meager janitor?

In Undercover Prison King movie, when ex-soldier Troy Poe inherits a corrupt private prison, he decides to go in undercover as an inmate to expose those responsible. But when the head guard, a man who he trusted, turns out to be the leader of the crime ring , Troy must find a way to convince the officials that he is not a prisoner, but in fact, the owner of the prison... or break out. All the while, he must protect those in danger, including a weak old prisoner whose sentence has been falsely extended, and a beautiful doctor who's caught in the crossfire. Will Troy find a way to escape? Or will he become just another casualty of his own prison?
In Song of My Mother's Tears movie, Faith searches for her lost family when she learns that she doesn't have long to live. But turns out, they're the people she hates the most!

book_title: The Alpha King and His Virgin Bride
special_desc: In The Alpha King and His Virgin Bride movie, the Alpha King Killian Storm is cursed to not live past age thirty. Only finding his true fated mate can break the curse, but what happens when his fated mate is a human? Humans cannot mate with Alphas. If he mates with her, she dies, but if he doesn't... he dies.

book_title: Park Avenue Girls Don't Play Nice
special_desc: When Anna Sinclair is cheated out of a prestigious art scholarship in Paris, her only chance to escape her abusive parents, she reinvents herself as a glamorous New York socialite to catch the eye of rich kid Preston Kingsley and secure a second shot at her dreams. But things get complicated when she starts to fall for Preston’s best friend, Brooks Whitmore, Upper East Side royalty and the biggest threat to exposing Anna's true identity. Will her secret turn Brooks against her, or will it bring them the happy ending that neither of them saw coming?

In Queen of the Court movie, after abandoning her career as a tennis star, Lily Pearson dedicated her life to helping her boyfriend Adam's tennis career. But after helping him win his own Grand Slam...the fame changed Adam for the worse.  Adam's not only involved with a younger tennis star Mia Sparks, but he wants Lily to coach her as well. Will Lily accept this betrayal and love a cheating man she no longer recognizes, or will she have the courage to leave, and salvage her potential from all those years ago?

book_title: Do Not Disturb: Lady Boss in Disguise!
special_desc: To become the heiress of her family hotel chain, Violet Trenton goes undercover as a cleaning lady and takes out the troublemakers one by one. Will she succeed and save the hotel? And is her sexy new COO Kasey Johnson just a powerful ally, or something more?

The Heiress Strikes Back movie about: Kidnapped as a baby, Amelia is forced to work as a maid for her kidnappers. Her brothers, the Kellers, never stopped searching for her. Soon, they closed in on her location but a case of mistaken identity hindered their search. A DNA test will be carried out and justice will be served.

book_title: The Secret of My Billion-dollar Marriage
special_desc: Emma, the heiress of the Coffman family ​​who is dumped by her ex, meets Lucas, the billionaire of the Fischer family, in a strip club. At this time, she happened to meet her ex and his cheating partner again. In order to slap her fiancé in the face, Emma asked Lucas to pretend to be her husband, and Lucas took advantage of the situation and proposed a fake marriage. But Emma thinks Lucas is a stripper/escort, and Lucas thinks Emma is a ghetto girl/gold digger. Both of them misunderstand each other, and they don't want to reveal their identities. Therefore, they must carefully conceal their identities from each other during the process of getting along after marriage, and at the same time fight against two villains who are always causing obstacles. In the process, they gradually create sparks, resolve misunderstandings, and eventually move towards a real marriage.

book_title: I Love You More Than Life
special_desc: In I Love You More Than Life movie, during Eric and Grace's wedding anniversary party, Grace's stepsister Amanda suddenly appears and demands that Grace give Eric back to her, shocking everyone at the party. Amanda devises a way to purposely make Grace fall, which causes Grace to have a miscarriage. Instead of looking after Grace, her husband instead leaves with Amanda in his arms. This is Grace's cold awakening. She finally decides to divorce Eric.

Emma Parker is a new transfer to Maple Elite Academy - and she's picked a fight with The Big Four, on her very first day! Four rich heirs who rule the academy, they've decided she's public enemy number one! But maybe there's more than meets the eye. Rowan Calloway acts like a tyrant, but is he really a ruthless bully? And August Langford keeps helping her out. Have they met before? Who's Emma going to choose - her worst enemy, or her childhood friend?

At 16, Bailey's foster mother sold her eggs on the black market, leaving her infertile. Years later, working as a school janitor, she saves a little girl from a kidnapping and meets the child’s father, a secret billionaire caught in a brutal custody battle. As their unexpected flash marriage blossoms into real love, secrets, betrayals, and a vengeful ex-wife threaten to tear apart their fragile new family.

Claire Duval and Christian Cross get married by chance. The Billionaire’s Accidental Bride Movie has it that Claire was glad to have gotten engaged with Dylan Maxwell until he stood her up and she found out that he was cheating on her with her friend, Ava. Claire secretly got married to Christian at the spot as they were both stranded.

Lily met Dax Leone in a masked party where he was running away from his enemies. A forced kiss on Lily sparked what would be a romantic affair between Dax and Lily in My Sugar-Coated Mafia Boss Movie. Dax offers protection to Lily and invests in her pastry business while he deals with his family after becoming the mafia boss.

Stella Hearth was kidnapped while her brother, Dennis watched helplessly. In Darling, Please Come Home Movie, Stella’s life changed drastically as she was saved by a poor and dumb man who became a janitor in her school, forcing Stella to be bullied by her own brother because he could not recognize her after so many years. Eventually, Stella was recognized.

Conscientious class president Emma is keeping a big secret: She's the poorest girl at her wealthy private school. When her rival, uber rich bad boy Lucas Bennett gets her fired from the part time job that's paying her father's medical bills, he makes it up to her — by hiring her to be his personal maid! Lucas agrees to keep their arrangement a secret... as long as Emma caters to his every need.

High school student Lindsay's life takes a dramatic turn when Wayne Adams, a star football player recruited by her dad, Mike, the school’s football coach, moves into her home. Their initial encounter is tense, but Lindsay must suppress her feelings due to Mike's warnings. Determined to find a boyfriend before graduation, Lindsay's attempts often end in awkward situations with unreliable guys. However, Wayne is always there to help when she’s in trouble. As their bond deepens, they start a secret relationship. Meanwhile, bullying at school escalates, prompting Lindsay to take a stand for her peers. Her efforts earn the support and respect of the school community. In the end, Lindsay and Wayne are crowned Prom King and Queen, and Mike finally approves of their relationship.

Married moments after meeting for the first time, new couple Maya Moore and Ethan Armstrong attempt to make their spontaneous marriage work despite interference from their enemies and Maya’s mysterious past.

book_title: Wings of Fire: The Dragon Slayer Is My Ex-Lover
special_desc: In Wings of Fire The Dragon Slayer Is My Ex-Lover movie, Freya Swann turned her back on her first love, Tristan Blackwater five years ago…But she never told him she had his child! Now he’s returned to the kingdom as a dragon-slaying hero and Freya is his personal servant! Will Freya finally tell Tristan the truth?

In Baby, Just Say Yes movie, Victoria was betrayed when she found out about her fiancé's relationship with her stepsister. Still, she needed a husband to claim her inheritance. Who better to ask than her one-time saviour, Teddy? As Teddy and Victoria enter into a contract marriage, genuine feelings arise. Now they must choose to live by their agreement or forsake it.

book_title: OMG, I Got Married in Vegas!
special_desc: Look at how Emily Grace and William Valcor ran away from their engagement, only for them to still end up getting married to themselves in OMG! I Got Married In Vegas Movie. After declaring that they were both too spoilt for each other, Emily and William, unknown to them that they were the runaway bride and groom, eventually got married.

book_title: Fake it Till You Love Me
special_desc: Fake It Till You Love Me Movie is about Edward Forrest and Caroline Dean. Edward has to do everything possible to remain the CEO of his company, and that would mean that he would get married to the lady he was caught in a scandal with to save face. A one-year marriage contract will cause them to fall in love.

book_title: Unexpected Knot: Married to a Billionaire Nurse
special_desc: After learning that her boyfriend is cheating on her and is only after her fortune, Madeline decides to break up with him and accidentally gets married to Caden, a male nurse. She thought both of them were just hard-working poor people, but she gradually realized that her husband seemed to have hidden wealth and power.Caden Wilson Cashmore, the mysterious CEO of the group, became a male nurse volunteer in order to fulfill his brother's last wish. He's been searching for the recipient of his brother's heart, and could that person be the wife he married on the spur of the moment?

book_title: The Hidden Billionaire in First Class
special_desc: In The Hidden Billionaire in First Class movie, they all thought Jett Hawkings was a lowly baggage handler and threatened to throw him off the flight. But when their plane is about to crash due to a storm, he's actually the secret billionaire that can save them.

In The Christmas Switch movie, sixteen years ago, Molly has an affair with Colton, the son-in-law of the powerful Grant family. When she gets pregnant, Colton heartlessly tells her to get an abortion. Furious and heartbroken, Molly secretly swaps her newborn daughter with the baby girl born to the Grant family’s heiress, Rachel.
That baby—Rachel’s real daughter—grows up as Dolores, raised in the slums. Meanwhile, Molly’s biological daughter, Sara, is brought up as the Grant family’s beloved princess.
Now, both girls attend the same prestigious school. Their paths cross again. Dolores, strong and kind, catches the attention of Aaron—Rachel’s father and the Grant family patriarch. At the same time, Sara’s longtime crush, Ryan, starts falling for Dolores. Feeling threatened, Sara begins scheming against her, afraid of being replaced. As tension builds, the secret behind their true identities slowly starts to unravel...

book_title: In Love with a Single Farmer-Daddy
special_desc: Natalie's conniving grandmother and sister marry her off to a rural farmer, Rhett. He's a single father, looking after a mute daughter, Ellie. Natalie's presence isn't taken kindly, as she is shunned by Ellie and the woman next door. Over time, she learns the woman next door is actually abusing Ellie. She develops a bond with Ellie, which deepens when Ellie speaks up for the first time to save her. But as Natalie starts settling in, new troubles arise. Ellie is bullied at school, and Natalie gets tangled in conflicts involving both her old and new families. She vows to protect the hard-won love and family she's built.

book_title: Oh No! I Slept with My Husband!
special_desc: Beth Nelson mistakenly ends up with her husband in Oh No! I Slept With My Husband Movie. After getting married to a man who did not even spare her a glance during marriage, Beth faces her ungrateful father and stepmother who insist on her asking her estranged husband for more money to give them. Beth becomes angry, desperate and drunk.

In Her Secret Crusader movie, Lyndon was the City's hero. After freeing the City from danger, he hid his identity to protect his girlfriend, Tatiana, from harm. Now City Hall is once again in danger as the Sewer rat returns to take it down. The mayor and his daughter are the Sewer rat’s target victims. With Tatiana’s betrayal revealed, Lyndon becomes a hero again.

book_title: In Love with Dr. Baby Daddy!
special_desc: Spencer dumped Jade for a brainy girlfriend. She felt betrayed. They have been together for so long, why now? Infuriated by Spencer's choice, Jade hooks up with a stranger she met at the hospital. Soon, she'll find out that her strange man is her boss and ex-boyfriend's father. She'll also find out that she's pregnant for him.

Valerie Patterson almost lost out a luxurious life with a billionaire lover after the Patterson family nearly succeeded in exchanging her with her sister, Daphne, in Mr. Hills’ Adorable Wife Movie. Born with a birthmark which her mother considered ugly; Valerie was ignored by her family until Andrew Hills fell in love with her after a sexual encounter with her.

book_title: True Heiress vs. Fake Queen Bee
special_desc:
Hailey Kaplan, a wealthy teenager who decides to conceal her true identity when she transfers to Western High, a public school. Tired of being known only for her family's wealth, Hailey hopes to make genuine friends and experience a normal teenage life.
However, her plans are thrown into chaos when Candice Mathis, the daughter of the Kaplan family's maid, arrives at school posing as the Kaplan heiress. Candice quickly rises to the top of the social hierarchy, while Hailey finds herself at the bottom, subjected to bullying and ridicule.

Giselle, the Duke's daughter and rightful heiress of the Von Howard's family, married Patrick Hilton three years ago after he saved her life. She secretly helped his company go public, but constant harassment from Patrick’s mother and relentless taunts from Becky leave Giselle, now pregnant, feeling hopeless. She decides to divorce Patrick. Despite everything, Patrick’s heart belongs only to Giselle. After the divorce, he realizes how much he needs her and begins a long journey to win her back.

book_title: My Ex is in the Navy SEALs
special_desc: In My Ex is in the Navy SEALs movie, six years ago, Regina chose to break up with her boyfriend Julian to avoid hindering his promising military career due to her overwhelming debt. Six years later, they reunite in a foreign land, Julian is now a commanding officer, while Regina is a single mother. Their chemistry reignites, but their bonding faces uncertainties of their class differences and pressure from people around them. This time, will they find their way back to love again?

In Obsessed with His Silent Bride movie, Taken in as a ward of the Calvert family, Eva has always loved Declan Calvert, the boy who grew up as her protector. Nonverbal since birth, she struggles to express her feelings in a marriage built on duty—Declan only married her to honor his grandfather’s dying wish. Trapped in a toxic union, Eva endures Declan’s cruelty and his mistress Selene’s relentless schemes to drive her out. Despite it all, Eva clings to the hope that Declan might rediscover the love they once shared as children. Bound by silence, Eva must decide: fight for his heart or break free before it’s too late.

book_title: Spoiled by the Daddy CEO During Pregnancy
special_desc: Dawn’s fling with a stranger just got a billion-dollar twist: surprise pregnancy, and the baby daddy is none other than billionaire heartthrob Isaac Stanton! You’d think Dawn’s hit the jackpot… except why is she running away?!

In Lassoed by a Cowboy's Love movie, Madison was a Manhattan heiress with it all—until she loses everything, including her now-cruel fiancé who stranded her in Texas. Broke and desperate, Madison wanders into a local saloon…and into the arms of Beau Hayes—her ex’s rugged, dangerously sexy cowboy uncle. After a steamy night, Beau offers her a job -- and an unexpected shelter. Now Madison’s trading pearls for cowboy boots, riding bulls, horses—and maybe even a cowboy.

book_title: Cooking My Way Back to Love
special_desc: Chef Leon Kennedy, once the "King of Cooking," fell apart after his wife died in a tragic car accident. His deep depression led him to fall into homelessness, losing everything except his beloved dog, Dante. A restaurant owner takes him in, giving him a job, not knowing who he is. Working in the kitchen, he faces the abuse of the executive sous chef (Bryant), who belittles and disrespects him. Leon tries to keep his head down, but when a nefarious businessman (William) threatens the restaurant, Leon has to break out the skills and artistry that made him a legendary chef. The restoration of his glory and joy is shortlived, however, as the spiteful chef Bryant defames him, and the resentful William kills his beloved dog. Enduring ups, downs, and devastation once again, the aggrieved Chef Leon picks up his chef's knife, hungry for revenge.

In You Are My Destiny movie, Logan was blind and abandoned—until Giselle saved him, and they fell in love. She sacrificed everything for him, even giving him her corneas. But just as he regained his sight, she was gone. What he didn’t know was that she was pregnant—and fate made her his wife. Five years later, Logan returns as the Hale heir, unaware that his wife and their ailing daughter are the very ones he’s been searching for. When the truth finally comes out, will he win them back—or has he already lost them forever?

book_title: I Swapped Bodies with My Nemesis
special_desc: In I Swapped Bodies with My Nemesis movie, Nick and Lexey were being forced into an arranged marriage by their parents. They despised themselves and so were against the marriage. Cupid, having heard their cries, decided to intervene. He switched their souls into each other's body. Now Nick is Lexey and Lexey is Nick. Forced to experience life from a new perspective, they must live together.

Riley Jones and Xander Thorne meet in Runaway Princess Bride after Riley ran away from her forced marriage to Corbin Hicks when he tried to force himself on her on their wedding day. Riley would come to find out that her parents were actively going to sell her, and that the stranger that saved her was more than a stranger.

When rich heiress Jane Walden's father is imprisoned for fraud, she's left to fight cancer and a secret pregnancy without any money. Wanting to protect her fiance and his new company from her disaster of life, she stages a fake affair in order to get him to fall out of love with her. But years later, even though he's finally a billionaire, Vincent still hasn't forgotten Jane. How does she break it to Vincent that he has a 7-year-old son named Dylan?

Forever invisible Skylar Heron hasn't started her senior year so hot. First, she's embarrassed in front of the whole school when trying to ask out her crush Jamie Donner, her childhood best friend and next-door neighbor. Then, she gets paired up with him to work on a class project together. And, finally, to top it all off, she's forced to live with him when his house burns down and he moves into her room! But now, Jamie's crazy ex-girlfriend is out to make their lives hell. The only thing that can save both their years is... to turn the school freak into the most popular girl in school!

Lovestruck, Beatrice Lawson eloped with her college sweetheart Desmond Belmont and has been secretly married to him for ten years. However, when she discovers his affair with a wealthy socialite, Beatrice decides to divorce him and finally stop living in his shadow. As she begins to make a name for herself with a new apartment and new career, she meets the mysterious and attractive Damian Crowley. As the two men fight for her attention, Beatrice wonders if love is worth all the pain and sacrifice, or if she's better off fending for herself.

Taylor Young made a mistake at first which turned to the best decision ever. She abandoned her dream to go to Nashville where she could be a musician and chased after her childhood sweetheart to Oakville University thinking she stood a chance in his life, but she was humiliated until she met Lord Travis Harrington in Duke With Benefits Movie.

Emma got into a car accident and when she tried to reach her husband, Elijah, he ignored her to be with his wanna-be girlfriend, Stella. She gave up on their marriage after finding out that Stella might be having Elijah's baby. She divorced him without taking a penny from him. This baffled Elijah because he thought she was a gold-digger.

Playing By the Billionaire’s Rules Movie is about Becky Jacobs who had a contract affair with Nick Walton for three years with rules. One of the rules was that they would not fall in love but they both broke it and found it difficult to maneuver Nick’s mother who wanted him to marry someone else for an alliance to ensue.

In Daddy Help Mommy’s in Prison movie, when a powerful CEO discovers his daughter and frees his college sweetheart from prison, they must overcome years of resentment and sacrifice to protect their child from those who tore them apart.

In Married at First Sight movie, Summer has been the ideal girlfriend for her ex-boyfriend, Vincent. From selling her blood to helping him finish medical school, Summer has been the best girlfriend. Yet, Vincent cheated on her. Frustrated by their actions, Summer enters into a contract marriage to save a billionaire she just met. She was shocked to find out about his identity.

In Kiss Me One Last Time full movie, Adeline has cancer. A few months to live and she'll be dead. The one thing she needed was her husband, Blake's love. She couldn't get it as he never saw her as his wife rather as a blood bank for her step-sister. Adeline's condition worsened and donating blood wasn't helping. Soon, Blake finds out about her condition and regrets.

book_title: The Return of the Lost Heiress
special_desc: In The Return of the Lost Heiress movie, Lana experienced her father's death. This made her never speak again. She became a mute. A few days later, she was lost while escaping being sold by her guard. Lana was found and adopted by Ron who showered her with fatherly love. Years passed and her birth family kept searching for her. Unaware of Lana's identity, they mistreated her.

In Runaway Bride Baby on Board movie, after being drugged, powerful CEO Eason spends the night with Chloe, unaware of her identity. When they cross paths again, Eason—failing to recognize Chloe—hires her as his secretary. While working for him, Chloe discovers she’s pregnant with his child. Just as she grapples with this revelation, Eason, desperate to save his grandmother, agrees to marry Maura, shattering Chloe’s heart. Refusing to reveal the father’s identity, Chloe deepens the rift between them. But the situation turns even darker when Maura, determined to keep Chloe away from Eason, kills Chloe’s mother and threatens her to stay away.

Eve Wilson loses her daughter, Amelia Wilson during a Halloween party that saw a shooter cause severe commotion. Thirteen years later, the real Amelia Wilson who had been kidnapped and switched is waiting tables for her fake mother, but her fate changes during a ballet competition that led her back into the hands of her real family, the Wilson family.

In Accidental Triplets with the Billionaire movie, urgently needing an heir to secure his position in the company, Oscar turns to surrogacy. But unexpectedly, his sperm is accidentally injected into Phoebe, who comes in for a gynecological exam. To ensure Phoebe keeps the baby, Oscar proposes a contract marriage, and the two embark on a journey filled with tests...

Arianna dies a tragic death on the day of her graduation, while Derek, the driver's son, takes all the spotlight on stage. She gave him everything—her car, her credit card, even her father’s company—only to be used and discarded. While he spoiled Ivy like a princess, he treated Arianna like a servant. Only in death does she realize that Hayden, the billionaire’s heir - had been waiting for her all along. Now, fate gives her a second chance to make things right.

Grace Esther's life falls apart when her mother kicks her out after discovering she's not her real daughter, and her boyfriend also leaves her for her step-sister. Fortunately, an old family friend takes her in. There, she meets his attractive CEO grandson, Aden, who gives her a job as his assistant, and they soon develop a romantic connection. What she doesn't know is that her real father has finally heard about her and is desperate to find her...

book_title: My Dear Brother is Obsessed With Me
special_desc: Clyde enlists small time actress, Violet, to play the role of his long-lost sister, fulfilling his father's dying wish. Together, they face constant scrutiny and challenges from the antagonist. Living together , they inadvertently developed a forbidden romance. Determined to prove their taboo relationship, the antagonist sought to tarnish their reputation, leading Clyde's father to arrange Violet's marriage to another. In a desperate bid to reclaim their love, Clyde resolved to interrupt the wedding ceremony...

Jasper Tate needed a wife urgently, while Chloe Adams needed money urgently in The CEO’s Contract Wife Movie. Seeking help from the same source leads the two needy people together, and they get married after Madam G recommended them to each other. What was supposed to be a contract agreement morphed into a full-blown love affair that they never expected.

book_title: After Cancer I Turn into A Badass
special_desc: Evelyn has long been oppressed by her stepsister, misunderstood by her husband, and looked down upon by her family. After being misdiagnosed with terminal cancer, she suddenly comes to her sense and decides to live her final days to the fullest. She turns into a fierce diva, taking revenge on her oblivious husband and her evil stepsister. However, her husband suddenly realizes that he has mistaken someone else for his lifesaver...

Betrayed by her fiance and her own sister, Esther marries Ricky without knowing his real identity – a secret billionaire. Together, they have to stand up against Esther's evil family, take back her mother’s company and find their happy ending.

book_title: Fake Married to My Billionaire CEO
special_desc: After Sam's ex cheats on her and steals her money, Calladan Vandalay marries her at first sight. But he doesn't tell her that he's secretly the richest billionaire in the country. What will Sam do when she finds out? And can they keep their true identities a secret from the preying family and friends in Sam's life?

Trapped in an arranged marriage to the cold and dangerously seductive heir of the New York mafia, LUCA, 18yo sheltered mafia princess from Chicago, ARIA must decide if surrendering her body—and maybe her heart—to a man born of violence is her greatest betrayal or her only chance at survival.

book_title: Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad
special_desc: In Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad movie, Fay Alden catches her boyfriend Daniel cheating and breaks up with him. But soon after, Fay meets Daniel's father Kent Lippert, the Mafia King. Kent not only reveals that Fay's real father is Mafia don Lorenzo Alden, but presents Fay with a proposition: marry his son to join the bloodlines, and he'll protect her family from a violent criminal. Fay agrees, and Daniel is all too happy to marry Fay to distract his dad and the mob world from the truth: he's gay. Fay struggles to fit in in the mob world, and can't deny her growing attraction to Daniel's father Kent. Soon, their relationship crosses into a passionate secret BDSM love affair. Don Alden is not who he seems, and is intent on using Fay as a bargaining chip to secure a better alliance with Russian syndicate leader, Ivan Kozlov. Fay and Ivan strike up an unlikely flirtation that erodes her fake engagement to Daniel. Fay's learns all too late that not only are her father and Ivan working together to destroy Kent, but Ivan is an undercover cop hellbent on taking Kent down and taking Fay for himself. Ivan and Don Alden's double cross lands Kent in jail, and after Fay discovers she's pregnant with Kent's baby, she decides she has to do whatever possible to free the father of her unborn child. With Daniel's help, she takes out Don Alden, and pressures Ivan into clearing Kent's name. Fay and Kent are reunited, marry, and live happily ever after.

book_title: You Fired the Backbone of Detroit
special_desc: In You Fired the Backbone of Detroit movie, Hank Walker, mechanic by day and genius auto engineer by night, is fired under new management. Betrayed, Hank is offered a dream job from rival company Mach 15. Will Hank get to build the supercar of his dreams? Or will interference from rivals old and new cost him everything?

book_title: I Accidentally Hired a Billionaire Husband
special_desc: Online, Emma had agreed to meet a man at a place and time whom she would get married to, and he had told her that he was putting on a green shirt. That was how she met Oliver in I Accidentally Hired A Billionaire Husband Movie, who was coincidentally putting on a green jacket, and running away from getting married.

Leading lady, Jess Gonzales, must whittle down 25 male suitors to four that she wants to actively date. After she makes her choice, the remaining singles she rejected have the opportunity to sabotage her dates for a cash prize!

book_title: We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together
