special_desc: In We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together movie, Lisa's contract marriage with Aidan ended without notice. She was agitated that he never valued her as much as she valued him. When they crossed paths again, she took her chance with him leaving an ill note on his chest. Lisa didn't know she would be seeing Aidan again, this time, as her boss.

book_title: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up!
special_desc: Ciara is slated to get married to Adrian Lewis, who is in a coma in Big Bad Husband Please Wake Up Movie. Ciara is desperate to do so because she needs the money to save her sick family, and she is humiliated by her choice until Adrian wakes up to the surprise of everyone and falls in love with Ciara.

Emma, a self-made, country girl, has escaped a difficult life, and now works in the city. Life takes a turn for Emma, when she misidentifies handsome stranger William and is forced to marry him , unaware, that William is the CEO of Irving Corporation. Both William and Emma hope to get a divorce soon after, but sparks begin to fly when they move in together. To admit their love for each other and save Irving Corporation from falling into the wrong hands, Emma and William must tackle several obstacles and villains standing in the way of their blossoming romance.

In CEO's Twins Want Mommy Back movie, with a loving hubby and cute stepkids, Cassandra's flash marriage seems too good to be true.  But will her troubled past catch up to her? And why do the kids seem so familiar?

In Love Bombing movie, in Reelshort's first unscripted series, 40 singles swipe on each other in real life in order to find true love. They are taken on a series of date challenges designed to test compatibility, connection, and long-term potential. But those who didn’t match are given a second chance at redemption: if they successfully break up any of our newfound couplings, they receive cold hard cash. Can love survive love bombing?

Three years ago, they divorced. To her surprise, three years later, her ex-husband turned out to be the director of the TV series she was acting in. After this encounter, she realized that he had misunderstood her, thinking she had a relationship with an older man three years ago.

In order to protect her brother in a car accident, she suffered rupture of the heart. However, her parents, who were only concerned about her brother, missed the best time to treat her, and she died in a corner where no one knew about it.

I married the brother of the man I had always loved, not only to get my mind off of him but to prove to him that I could still get along without him! 
I thought I could win his heart someday, but all I got was the news that he was engaged to someone else. And it was only when I was about to get married to his brother that he realized how precious I was. At my wedding, I looked at the man I once loved with mixed emotions. 
"You didn't want it when I was with you, but you preferred to grab it, isn't that bitchy?"
Moreover, his brother who I flash-married turned out to be a billionaire CEO! How surprising...

He deeply loves his family, works hard every day, and even sells blood to earn money. However, he unexpectedly discovers his wife behaving strangely recently. Is she cheating on him, or has their love already faded?

A century ago, the God-Sealing Order descended upon a monastery, giving rise to the God-Sealing List, where the top ten strongest individuals would appear. Since then, the monastery became a target for numerous factions. The most inept disciple of the monastery was betrothed to a saintess from a powerful faction. Under the pretense of canceling the engagement, she led troops to seize the God-Sealing Order. As the secrets of the Order were unveiled, the disciple, in order to protect the world, unlocked his own seal, causing the God-Sealing List to reappear across the land.

In a heart-wrenching tale of sacrifice and betrayal, she gave everything to save her husband's childhood friend—donating her bone marrow, only to lose her life to a devastating infection. Left behind was her critically ill daughter, abandoned and alone, while her husband, once her pride, shamelessly flaunted his new life with his mistress at a public press conference. For years, he was overwhelmed with hatred, convinced his wife had betrayed him. But when the truth finally surfaced—a cruel twist of fate revealing her innocence and her tragic death—his world shattered. Overcome with guilt and despair, he made the ultimate, irreversible choice: to end his own life.

Six months ago, Jesse lost his best friend, Shane, in a car accident while he was driving Jesse to propose. Out of guilt, Jesse vowed to take care of Shane's wife, Nancy, and their girl, Joy. However, he took his promise so seriously that he even brought Nancy and Joy home. Nancy took this opportunity to step in their marriage as Jesse kept neglecting his wife, Zoe, even turning his back on her when she fell while being pregnant. Will Zoe continue to put up with all their abuse and manipulation, or will she see their true colors and pursue her own happiness? When you can’t get back what you’ve already lost, all you can do is to let go.

I was bankrupt, and to provide my wife live a comfortable life, I worked like a slave on the construction site. However, when I got home from work, I saw my wife, who was just an office clerk, was picked up by a man in a luxury car! And there were suspicious scratches on her body!

In a planned car accident, I was told by the doctor that all the matching blood types had been adjusted by my husband to save his childhood sweetheart. Later, the doctor persuaded me to donate my heart to the mistress to fulfill my husband's wish. Finally, I died on the operating table in despair. However, my soul goes to the third year after my death...

book_title: Stay Alive to See You Don’t Love Me
special_desc: Seven years ago, she traveled to this world and was supposed to leave after successfully winning over her husband. But she altered the rules and stayed for him and their child. However, her husband no longer loved her. So she made a wish to get cancer and die on her husband's operating table, hoping he would remember her forever...

She initially gave up the chance to complete the system's task, transferring her husband's cancer cells to herself. Knowing she didn't have long to live, as a mysterious genius scientist, she created a lifelike robot identical to herself, programming it to always obey her husband and protect her daughter. But after she died, her soul ended up inside the robot, only to watch her husband move his mistress into their home, treat her daughter cruelly, and humiliate her in various ways. At that moment, she began to regret her decision. Does she still have a chance to change everything?

When she discovers that her daughter is being bullied at school for being an illegitimate child, she rushes to confront the school. However, she too becomes the target of slander, labeled as a homewrecker by the other parents. After her husband arrives to resolve the situation, she finally sees the true face of the man she once thought was the perfect husband.

A rural girl who sells pork unexpectedly meets a secretive billionaire CEO. They have a whirlwind marriage, and their feelings gradually deepen. However, when his first love appears, cracks start to form between them, and billionaire's true identity becomes a ticking time bomb for their marriage.

Her father died because of me. Because of that, I had to give up everything—my mother, father, brother, and fiancé. I died because of it. Even when I jumped, my fiancé was with the child. Now, I return to take revenge on them all.

book_title: After Giving Birth, I Decided to Divorce
special_desc: She married a man while hiding her billionaire status and lived as a full-time housewife, silently supporting her husband for six years. But when he failed to define his relationship with another woman, claiming he was honoring a friend's last wish, she grew disappointed and decided to reclaim her true identity and start living her own life again.

book_title: From Poverty to Power: The Hidden Heiress
special_desc: The daughter of the wealthiest man escaped her own wedding to look for her long-lost boyfriend. By chance, she encountered a college classmate who impersonated her, secretly wearing the jewelry of the wealthy man’s daughter and pretending to be the heir. When the real heir was being bullied, she met her boyfriend, who was cold towards her and was about to marry the impostor. At her boyfriend’s wedding with the impostor, the real heir exposed the impostor’s identity.

Thirty years ago, Gu Heng left home to seek his fortune, leaving behind his wife, Shu Ran—who was pregnant with triplets—and his parents in her care. For three long decades, Shu Ran worked tirelessly to raise their three sons and look after Gu Heng’s parents. Suddenly, after all these years, Gu Heng returns with another woman, Li Qi, and demands a divorce. Having achieved success, he now looks down on Shu Ran, regarding her as nothing more than a small vendor. He and Li Qi attempt to kick Shu Ran out of the house. Just then, Shu Ran’s three daughters-in-law arrive, and these three women are not to be trifled with. They will not stand by and let anyone bully their mother-in-law.

She concealed her identity and fell deeply in love with him over the course of a year. Just as they were about to discuss marriage, his mother confidently pulled out a peculiar set of family rules and demanded that she sign and memorize them.

After a tragic car accident, the parents redirected all blood supplies to save the brother, causing her to ultimately languish and die on her hospital bed. Reborn, she finds herself back at the age of ten. Determined not to survive as she did in her previous life, she plans to take revenge, strip the family of everything, and make her mother regret her actions.

After being laid off from a company due to pregnancy, the protagonist regains a key marketing position through personal determination and outside support. Along the way, conflicts and eventual reconciliations with coworkers shape her journey. Ultimately, the company is forced into bankruptcy three months later due to mismanagement.

book_title: Falling Fast: The Magic of an Instant Bond
special_desc: The daughter decides to have a quick marriage with her boyfriend. The father can’t dissuade her but is also worried. When he sees his daughter being bullied at her boyfriend’s home, he feels heartbroken. The father teams up with his friends to devise a plan, determined to rescue his daughter who is love-struck.

On the day of their marriage registration, the heroine found her fiancé registering with another woman.The fiancé tried to persuade her by saying her mother was ill, promising to divorce the other woman after fulfilling her dream and then marry the heroine. But the clear-headed heroine decisively cut ties with him and turned to marry a billionaire instead.

The CEO rushes to the airport to welcome the doctor (female lead), who’s coming to the capital to give birth. But on the plane, she runs into his son and mother. His son steals her belongings, destroys her blueprints and chips, and causes her so much stress that she goes into early labor. Meanwhile, the CEO waits at the airport, only to find her seriously injured upon arrival—while his son and mother stand by, smirking.

book_title: Ditching My Jerk Husband, I Become a Stylish Mama
special_desc: A quietly dedicated homemaker’s life unravels when she inherits a staggering $1 billion fortune, only to discover her husband’s ultimate betrayal: he’s secretly been legally married to another woman for years. As she navigates the emotional wreckage, her grueling IVF journey culminates in motherhood — on what should have been their wedding anniversary. With the fierce support of her confidante Zhao Ying, she dismantles her gilded cage of lies, reclaims her dignity, and rediscovers her identity in a triumphant rebirth. Now armed with wealth and hard-won wisdom, she charts a bold new course — rewriting her destiny on her own terms.

Zed Bass and Vera Lott have been inseparable childhood friends for 20 years, and over time, their bond blossomed into a romance. During their sweet journey together, they made a promise to get engaged on Zed’s 25th birthday. Confident in their love, Zed eagerly proposes to Vera on that day, certain she will say yes. However, to his shock, Vera is seen posing for photos with her schoolmate, Carl Hume, in a way that suggests they are a couple. What stings even more is that Vera doesn’t realize the gravity of her actions. Time and again, she sides with Carl, pushing Zed to compromise and accept her decisions. Despite Zed’s efforts to make things work, Vera’s repeated failures to prioritize their relationship push him further away. Ultimately, Zed, heartbroken and disillusioned, leaves for an overseas job, leaving behind a breakup letter.

Helen Lambert was a boxing champion, but got locked up for killing her daughter’s abusive boyfriend. After getting released, Helen moved in with her granddaughter, Joy, at the house she left for her now deceased daughter. Here she immediately ran into trouble with the Waynes, a family of resident tormentors. Helen learned to push back against the bullies without scaring Joy and slowly restored peace to her neighborhood.

Winona Jensen, the rightful heir, is cast aside as Amelia Jensen, an impostor, wins over their family by faking an illness. On Winona’s wedding day, Amelia pulls another stunt, ruining her marriage and driving her to leave. When Amelia attempts to have her killed, Winona survives and rebuilds her life abroad.

Years later, she returns as a renowned designer. As her family still favors Amelia, Isaac secretly investigates and uncovers the truth. On Amelia’s wedding day, Winona exposes her crimes, leading to her arrest. Though her family begs for forgiveness, Winona walks away—choosing a future with Stefan instead.

Liam Stone, the Culinary God, was left for dead by his jealous apprentice, Max Newman. Rescued with no memory, Liam is taken in by Melissa Jackman, unaware she's helping the legendary chef. Working in the Jackmans' kitchen, his hands remember the art of cooking, though his mind doesn't.

When sabotage nearly kills him, a gas-filled kitchen triggers a flood of memories. Now, with his skills restored, Liam enters the Culinary Clash, turning heads and sparking rumors. As he faces Max in a final showdown, the stakes are high: redemption and the true essence of culinary greatness.

book_title: The Last Beat of Her Heart
special_desc: Seven years ago, Sophia Monroe donated her heart to save Lucian Morgan, choosing to live with an artificial heart that would only last seven years. To help him move on, she faked being a gold digger and severed all ties. Now a powerful CEO, engaged to actress Evelyn Rowe, Lucian crosses paths with Sophia again in a hospital—just as her life nears its end. Still hiding her condition, Sophia pretends to be a gold digger while desperately needing funds for a heart replacement. Her act only deepens Lucian’s misunderstanding, and Evelyn seems to know the truth. She manipulates the situation, sowing discord between them with forged documents, causing Lucian to lose trust in Sophia. In a final attempt to save her, Dr. Cooper reveals the truth—but by then, Sophia has already passed away.

book_title: Dump the Doc, Drain Your Luck!
special_desc: Simon Lane, the successor of the Medical Prodigies' Clan, was robbed. Mr. Candler, the head of the Chandler family saved him. To repay his kindness, Simon helped to cure his daughter Manee Chandler and make Chandler Pharma thriving. But Manee bullied him a lot. After the contract was over, Simon went back to the MPC again. Because of her senility, Manne went to the MPC for treatment but didn't know Simon's real identity...

Verna Faye is a talented chef. She has a one-night stand with Larry Welch while delivering food to him. After that, Yana Lowe causes Verna to have a car accident and lose her memory. Three years later, Verna becomes a cook of the Welch family. She meets Larry again and participates in Who's the Top Chef. Meanwhile, Verna regains her memory. Hence, she uncovers Yana's plot, and finally she has a happy life with Larry.

On Dr. Jake Nicholson's birthday, his wife Tessa and their daughter set out to celebrate with him, only to collide with his first love, Celine Tyler. Tessa and their daughter are critically injured, but when Jake arrives, he ignores Tessa's pleas to save their daughter and chooses to save his beloved Celine and her son first. Due to his negligence, their daughter misses the crucial window for treatment and dies. In her grief, Tessa is dismissed by Jake as being irrationally jealous, even contemplating divorce. Meanwhile, Celine learns of their daughter's death and conceals the truth for an evil plan...When Jake learns the truth, will he shed tears of regret or point the finger at his wife?

For five years, Milo Reed and two childhood friends, Gloria Wade and Sarah Steele, built their startup from the ground up. But their loyalty wavers when a charming newcomer spins his web of deceit. Feeling betrayed, Milo decides to sell his shares and return to his family for an arranged marriage. Gloria and Sarah dismiss it as a rash decision until Milo's wedding invitation forces them to face the harsh truth...

book_title: Daddy, She’s Not Nanny, She’s Our Mommy!
special_desc: Abigail Thorne was set up by her sister and forced to marry Roderic Graham. On their wedding night, Abigail accidentally crippled her husband and was expelled from that family. Five years later, she is back—a miracle doctor with five clever children. Roderic Graham, the man who rejected her, is irresistibly drawn to her and her children, unaware that they are the family he has been searching for.

When Mason Linwood, a college student, is betrayed by his girlfriend Hedy, his life seems over—until campus queen, Jocelyne Switt, reappears, secretly carrying his twins. To secure a future, they enter a fake marriage, unaware that Mason is the lost heir to the billion-dollar Linwood empire. As threats close in, their pretend relationship becomes the only shield against a world of greed and lies.

book_title: Falling for My Best Friend's Uncle
special_desc:
Falling for My Best Friend's Uncle summary talks about the heart-warming story of first love of Lorraine ,a dress designer who's been in love with Tucker Oberton, her best friend's uncle.
She has saved a wedding dress hoping to win Tucker's love, but their age gap makes it hard for her. Meanwhile, Tucker is ready to settle down with someone else.

During a medical examination, I learned that my husband had cancer When I wanted to face the disease together with him, he filed for divorce because he thought I was the one with cancer! And my mother-in-law, started to make a series of unreasonable troubles. In the end, my husband died tragically due to delayed treatment!

Cora Zeller faints from low blood sugar and is saved by Mark York. Grateful, she falls for him and makes a pact with her father: she can be with Mark if he rises to success. Together, they build a future, and Mark becomes CEO of York Corp. Excited, Cora plans to reveal her true identity at her birthday party, but reality hits hard. To grow his empire, Mark begins to flirt with Joey Wade, the heiress of Wade Corp., even giving her the pearl necklace that Cora designed. Heartbroken, Cora breaks up with him, but Mark won’t let go.

In her time of need, Jason Yates, who has secretly loved her for years, steps in to support her. Cora then exposes Mark and Joey’s affair, revealing Mark’s true nature. She later discovers that it was Jason, not Mark, who saved her all those years ago. Together, Cora and Jason face life’s challenges, grow stronger, and build a beautiful future as a couple.

In Last 190 Minutes movie, Renowned Seston physician Max Holt is tasked by Xonos's most powerful family, the Judds, with delivering a life-saving kidney from Valia to Xonos within three hours for John Judd. On the flight, he unexpectedly crosses paths with Jane Yale, the Judds' future daughter-in-law. Tensions rise as Jane and her mother exploit the Judds' influence—jeopardizing John's life.

book_title: Boss, Your Company Is About to Explode!
special_desc: One day, mediocre salesman Talon Crowe awakened a terrifying superpower: the ability to see death countdowns hovering above people's heads, revealing the exact time and cause of their deaths. Determined to help them avoid their fates, Talon tried to warn them. But no one believed him. After the fifth guy ignored his warning and died, Talon found everyone in his office shared the same countdown: they would all die in an explosion at 9:30! Convinced there was a bomb, Talon frantically tried to evacuate the building. But still, no one believed him, not even his own wife. As the clock ticks down, Talon must race against time to prevent a catastrophic explosion and uncover the deadly conspiracy hidden in plain sight.

On my way to my hometown to go through the divorce procedures, my husband and I missed the high-speed rail ticket, so we were forced to take the green train. In the previous life, no one knew that the zombie virus was spreading, and all the passengers on the train died. 
Fate made me reborn and returned to an hour before my death. At this time, I clearly realized that at this moment, there was only one way to save the fate of all passengers, that is, to stop the train and let everyone get off in advance!

Wife of hard-working farmer Harry Spencer left him to marry a rich guy in town. Harry sold his vegetables for years to raise his two kids. His son Liam became the town's top scorer in the uni-entrace exam and refused to call Harry his dad at the graduation ceremony. Fortunately, Harry's adopted daughter Fiona came back to repay her dad's kindness.

Samuel Quick built his greatest fortune in human history but kept his most valuable secret hidden from his only son. Now, as death approaches, Samuel transfers his trillion-dollar empire to Ryan—along with the earth-shattering revelation that Ryan isn't his biological child.

When she learned from the sister of her husband's first love that she was the third wheel in her own marriage, the one who had ruined someone else's relationship and indirectly caused the death of her husband's beloved, her world shattered. Coupled with her husband's contempt and disdain, she ultimately chose to end her life. Her husband, thinking she was merely throwing a tantrum, was indifferent and even relieved by her absence. However, he gradually realized his deep-seated love for her. By the time he started looking for her, he discovered she had died.
In reality, she had been saved from her suicide attempt and had been living secretly in another city. The malicious sister orchestrated a car accident to kill her and steal her husband's love, but she miraculously survived, albeit with amnesia—forgetting nothing except her husband. Now, her husband embarks on a long journey to win her back... Can he earn her forgiveness and successfully rekindle her love?

Mindy Louis was adopted by the Louis family. She used to have three loving brothers and a sweet family. But after Claire Louis, 'the biological daughter' came back, everything changed. Those misunderstandings and harms made her desperate. To repay their upbringing, she decided to be a volunteer for Sleeping Mindy Plan, her brother Gavin's project. She even donated her cornera to her brother Mike. When her family found out the truth, they were so regretful. After thirty years of sleeping, Mindy woke up again but forgot everything...

In Never Too Late to Revenge movie: on the day Felix learns his wife Stella is pregnant, he also discovers she's having an affair with Kyle, a poor student he's been secretly supporting. And apparently, the child isn't his. Instead of lashing out, Felix stays calm and spends the next twenty years carefully plotting his revenge. Now, it's time for Stella and Kyle to pay.

Lü Shu, the backbone of the company, gets abruptly fired by the CEO's daughter who just returned from abroad, triggering a massive layoff that cripples the company. What follows is a series of unexpected and captivating twists.

book_title: The Beauty Who Stole the Show
special_desc: Chen Mo was separated from her family at the age of three. Twenty years later, she returned to her home country in search of her relatives. Her father, Lin Yuan, wanted to give her mother, Zhao Huiru, a surprise and planned a reunion after twenty years of separation at Zhao Huiru's birthday party. However, due to some photos and notes on her father's phone, Zhao Huiru mistook her daughter for a mistress and bullied Chen Mo at the prepared birthday party. It wasn't until the end that Zhao Huiru realized she had wronged her own biological daughter, and she felt deep regret.

The son of a sanitation worker is the president of a conglomerate. On the day of his son’s engagement banquet, he unexpectedly discovered his daughter-in-law’s infidelity. He also bumped into his mother-in-law at the hotel entrance. His son’s wife and mother are unaware that the sanitation worker is the mother of the group’s president, and they humiliated her.

book_title: The Distance Between the Cloud and the Sea
special_desc:
8 years ago, Hailey signed a contract to repay Mrs. Parker's favor. She stood by Colin Parker through his lowest moments and helped him heal from the heartbreak of his first love leaving. She was willing to do anything for him.
But all she got in return was his indifference and a half-hearted promise to "try to love her."
Then, one text from his first love saying she was back made those 5 years feel meaningless.
When the contract was up, Hailey left the divorce agreement behind and walked away without hesitation.
After all, a man who would never love her was not worth keeping.

For 25 years, billionaire tycoon Malcolm Lynch searched for the wife and son stolen from him.
When he finally finds a lead on his son Calvin, he disguises himself as a poor construction worker to test his character, wanting to be accepted as a father, not as a billionaire.

But Calvin's life is tougher than he imagined.
Overworked, underpaid, and raising a sick daughter alone, he's been surviving with dignity in a cruel world.
After witnessing the injustice his son faces, Malcolm quietly steps in, as he changes Calvin's fate from behind the scenes.

From toilet-cleaning interviews to workplace humiliation, family rejection, and a stolen bride-to-be, Calvin fights his way back with grit and integrity.
But when the truth is revealed that he’s the heir to Acria’s richest man, the entire village is left stunned.

With love reclaimed, reputations restored, and enemies silenced, Calvin and Elisa finally get the happy ending they were denied.

The heroine is devoted to her career and her child. As she gets promoted, her friends become jealous and plot to frame her. A man overhears their plan. Later, the heroine saves the man from trouble at a bar. In return, he rescues her when she’s being bullied. Their relationship begins to grow, but her friends are still scheming to ruin her.

After Eve Shaw marries into the York family, her own family is destroyed, leaving her with nowhere to go but York Manor. During childbirth, Sally Wade, a maid from Eve’s past, jealous of her status, swaps their children to secure her own child’s claim to the York family’s wealth. Eve knows what happened but stays silent, secretly seeking treatment for her dying daughter.
For sixteen years, Sally visits as Zoe’s godmother, treating Eve’s daughter with disdain. When Zoe becomes the Crown Princess, Sally reveals the truth, shocking everyone. Calmly, Eve removes her outer clothing to reveal the general's armor beneath. As the descendant of a legendary general, Eve leads an army against her husband.

Brandon Reed is a highly regarded physician, even referred to as a master healer by many. Helped by the hospital director Samuel Lynch when he was a student, Brandon agreed to work for him as head of the Department of Alternative Medicine. Samuel's daughter Jane, however, looks down on Brandon and his traditional approach. After taking over, Jane decided to fire him, citing the losses his department caused them. Pushed to his limit time and time again, Brandon showed off his healing skills, proving wrong everyone who doubted him.

To give her daughter Cher Gould a happy childhood, Leah Gould, whose husband was a CEO, had always been low-key. But Cher's classmates thought her family was poor and bullied her.  Fiona Liam's son was Cher's classmate. She used Leah's identity to act in collusion with other parents and teachers to bully Leah and Cher. Fiona didn't realize Leah was the real rich lady until Leah settled scores with them. In the end, Fiona got a taste of her own medicine. And Cher learned how to protect herself and admired her mother more.

New police academy graduate Misty takes on a daring mission to infiltrate the 'Divine Marriage' ritual in Florals Village. Posing as a Florals Maiden, she dives into the mysterious Florals Cave, outsmarting a criminal syndicate, exposing the village chief's human trafficking operation, and rescuing her sister Lara and other captives.

Ten years ago, she arrived at Nova's doorstep with her children, begging for shelter. Nova opened the locked gate and said, "Stay! No charge!" Since then, Nova has been supporting her and her family. But when Nova's daughter returned with millions to revitalize the land by building roads, she suddenly threw herself on the ground, clinging to Nova's leg, demanding, "I've lived in this house for ten years; it's mine! No one moves unless I get the deed!" The gratitude she once expressed is now replaced by greed, as she forces her benefactor into a corner, trading ten years of kindness for a money-making opportunity. The villagers call her heartless, but all she sees is the rising land value, her eyes filled with greed...

Cecilia Campbell thought she had a happy family until she found out that her husband had cheated on her with Sarah. When her hearing secretly returns, she turns from prey to predator—masterminding a high-stakes corporate and personal counterattack. But the ultimate revelation—a swapped childhood, a tragic patricide, and a sisterhood forged in lies—threatens to destroy everything she thought she knew.

book_title: Three Months Left: Miss Gu's Crazy Affairs
special_desc: After being misdiagnosed with stomach cancer, she decides to cherish the time she has left and live for herself. She leaves her exploitative family and company and heads to a nightclub to have fun, where she unexpectedly meets him, the CEO. After several twists of fate, they discover that they are actually the partners arranged for each other by their families. She then returns to her wealthy roots, reclaiming her status as a heiress.

In her past life, she was betrayed by her mother and sister, who conspired against her. Her newborn baby was swapped with her sister’s stillborn child, leading to her disgrace and a tragic death at home. Her husband was also framed by her sister and ended up dying as well. After being reborn, she uses her memories from her previous life to expose her mother and sister's schemes, ultimately helping her husband rise to power.

book_title: Mistaken at the Wedding, The Sister Fought Back
special_desc: She returns home for her brother's engagement, only to be mistaken for a mistress and humiliated by her sister-in-law. As the truth unfolds, she discovers her sister-in-law's darker schemes: the pregnancy is fake, and she's plotting to kill her brother to take over the company.

book_title: Remarried into Money After a Divorce
special_desc:
For thirty years, she played the role of the perfect wife—while silently enduring abuse no one saw.
When she finally walked away from her toxic marriage, even her own children called her selfish. But fate had other plans. A chance encounter with a powerful CEO led to a sudden marriage that turned her life upside down.
From beaten down to breathtakingly wealthy, she stepped into high society—only to be met with jealousy, betrayal, and the ghosts of her past. As her ex-husband and children tried to tear her down once more, she stood tall and revealed the truth she had hidden for decades.
This time, she wouldn't suffer in silence.

Jared Zane donates his bone marrow to save his ailing mother, only for his adoptive brother, Seth Quill, to take the credit. Betrayed and beaten by his own mother, Jared is cast out, and the Quills plan for Seth to marry his fiancée, Ruby Pierce. Tyler Zane, Jared's adoptive father, seeks justice and, on the wedding day, exposes the Quills' wrongdoings. Ruby, still loyal to Jared, threatens to end her life rather than marry Seth. Tyler forces the Quills to yield by cutting off their business deals. Desperate, they feign remorse, but Seth continues plotting to control the family. With Liam's help, Jared exposes Seth's bribery and bone marrow theft. The Quills retaliate by claiming a stranger as Tyler's biological son, but Jared and Tyler turn the tables, gathering evidence to trap them. The Quills face bankruptcy, and Seth's true nature is revealed. With the truth laid bare, Jared and Ruby reunite and marry, securing their happiness.

book_title: Three Brothers Regret After I Left the Family
special_desc: Unable to give up the blood relationship, she chose to return to her biological family, but found that this family was indifferent to her and preferred an adopted daughter who had no blood relationship with her. After being humiliated for a night, she finally woke up and returned to her original family, which had no blood relationship with her but loved her very much...

To fund Father's treatment, Luna & Caden Clark toiled abroad 3 years, saving $200k. Before returning home, Caden lost it all in a gambling scam. Desperate, Luna—a former card sharp—used their daughter's New Year money to return to the table. In a high-stakes game, she outsmarted the scam, brought villains to justice, and proved "The only winning move is not to play."

The rich CEO Blair's husband Harvey cheated on her with her bestie Cora. Blair found her newborn daughter was not her biological child, but Harvey and Cora's child. During the IVF process, they secretly swapped her fertilized egg. Blair decided to take revenge. She raised Cora's daughter to be a stupid girl on purpose and revealed the truth publicly, reclaiming everything...

Five years ago, while she and her husband were working late, their daughter was tragically murdered at home. Five years later,  to her astonishment, a long-unused phone accidentally rings. Driven by a mysterious impulse, she answers the call, which connects her to the time just before her daughter's death five years ago. The phone becomes a bridge between different timelines. In her desperate attempts to save her daughter, she repeatedly alters the timeline, triggering a butterfly effect. Through her efforts and the clues she pieces together, she uncovers truths she never knew: years of marital betrayal, the identity and motive of her daughter's murderer, and other emotional entanglements. Ultimately, she chooses to sacrifice her own life to save her daughter's. However, five years later, in another timeline, the daughter, now grown, uses the same phone to connect with her mother from the past, initiating another round of mutual redemption between mother and daughter.

After years of secretly being the richest heir, Guang plans to reveal his true identity to her girlfriend Shen Liuli, hoping she'll love him for himself, not his wealth. At his best friend Dong’s wedding, he’s shocked to see Shen Liuli as the bride, realizing she chose Dong for his money, believing Chen was just a poor guy. Faced with betrayal from both his friend and his love,  Guang decides to take a stand and seek the ultimate revenge.

A husband and wife ran a fruit shop. One day, a wealthy businesswoman passing by kindly intervened to save their elderly father from an accident. This act of goodwill forged a bond between them, and the businesswoman began frequently supporting their shop, even contracting their fruit supply for her supermarket chain. Over time, the couple’s fortunes improved.

Later, burdened by debts, the couple decided to sell their shop. Upon learning this, the businesswoman discreetly arranged for her secretary to take over the business to help them settle their loans. However, the couple falsely accused her of using counterfeit money during the transaction and continued to make increasingly unreasonable demands, souring the businesswoman’s goodwill.

The final blow came when the secretary uncovered that the couple had been supplying substandard products to the supermarket chain. This malpractice led to health violations, resulting in the temporary shutdown of the businesswoman’s supermarket. Refusing to tolerate further exploitation, the businesswoman severed ties with them. Only then did the couple realize her true influence and status. Stunned and ashamed, they were left filled with regret—but it was far too late.

Stella and Leo have been married for five years, but they never made it official. When her first love, Ethan, returns to town, old feelings resurface. Encouraged by her best friend, Stella finds herself emotionally torn, crossing lines she can't uncross.
Though she wears Leo's ring, her heart wavers until Leo is finally heartbroken and betrayed. He transfers back to headquarters and walks out of her life for good. Only then does Stella realize who she truly loves... but by then, it's too late.

Raised in the countryside, Whitney returns to her birth family as a high-born lady. Unwilling to marry Gregory, she disguises herself at the academy to gather "evidence" against him. Instead, she bonds with a humble scholar, not knowing he is the fiancé she's trying to escape.

She’s the daughter of the airline’s CEO, but she hides her identity and starts working as an intern in the marketing team. One day, she’s tasked with getting an interview from the company’s famous star pilot. But to her shock, the pilot turns out to be her ex-husband——the man she divorced 3 years ago!
What she thought would be a simple reunion only deepens the misunderstanding between them. The more they had loved, the more they hurt each other now. 
Can they overcome their past and find love again?

book_title: Invincible: The Underdog Stuns the World
special_desc: The man was the most insignificant nobody in the sect, but he got help from an old man and secretly practiced under the guidance of an old man. His strength was far beyond the reach of ordinary people, but everyone still treated him as a waste, not knowing that his hidden strength was very amazing, until...

During an interview, the lawyer’s son was involved in a traffic accident, and the perpetrator was none other than the lawyer’s lover. In an attempt to help his lover evade legal punishment, the lawyer actually forced his wife to sign a settlement agreement. On the other side, the wife discovered that there was more to the accident than what was apparent. She collected evidence and began to fight back against her husband and his lover.

book_title: Baby Don't Cry, Mommy is Sorry
special_desc: Rita Sanchez was overly preoccupied with her first love, Aiden Hughes, and his daughter, Ella Hughes, and repeatedly neglected her own daughter, Mona Barnes. After Mona became completely disappointed with Rita, her father, Elliot Barnes, took her away. Only after they left did Rita realize she had ignored her daughter, and she was filled with remorse.

book_title: Say I Love You After Divorce
special_desc:
Seeing me with some other man, my husband mistakenly thought I was cheating on him. But that was actually my father!
My husband proposed a divorce and I, knowing nothing, signed the divorce papers and left for abroad. Three years later, I returned to the country as a journalist, only to find him targeting and insulting me at every turn. His repeated hurt has finally made me give up on him entirely.
At this time, he finally discovered the truth, and deeply regretted what he had done to me. Should I forgive him?

She was a successful businesswoman with a perfect life—until her husband’s mistress, a live-streaming influencer, barged in with the “Anti-Mistress Alliance,” accusing her of being the homewrecker.
Humiliated and enraged, she began to suspect her husband, who denied everything. As her best friend’s suspicious closeness to him came to light, betrayal surrounded her on all sides.
With her husband and his mistresses plotting against her, she decided to fight back. How will this toxic marriage end?

A resilient mother single-handedly brings up her three sons amidst numerous family struggles. At her father's 70th birthday, each son offers a unique tribute. Family conflicts and misunderstandings spark tensions, but eventually, the truth comes to light, emphasizing the value of emotional connections and family love.

Once wrongfully accused and bearing a heavy grudge, she was reborn into a new life only to find herself at the bottom rung as a maid in a landlord's household. Yet, through her wit and perseverance, she rises to become the landlord’s adopted daughter. Returning to the very place where she was once wronged, she meets the estate’s upright master, and together, they embark on a forbidden journey filled with secrets in their new home. They will uncover corruption and stand up to the tyrants in a tale of justice and intrigue.

book_title: Being Dumped, I Married His Uncle
special_desc: Abandoned at the altar and branded a "jinx," Nancy Reed's world seemed to crumble--until Rowan Joffe, her ex-groom's enigmatic uncle and the wealthiest man alive, stepped in with an unexpected proposal. As Nancy begins to envision a blissful future with Rowan, her past resurfaces when her ex-groom returns with a pregnant girlfriend, hurling accusations of betrayal and demanding a public apology. Will Nancy find her happily ever after, or will her past continue to haunt her?

book_title: My Contract Wife Is My First Love
special_desc: Eleanor Byrd was hopelessly in love with Declan Laurent, despite the fact that there was another woman in his life. Eventually, she married him, hoping he would love her back. Declan, however, harbored resentment towards Eleanor, as he could not marry his beloved Claire Byrd. Misreading Eleanor's love, Declan frequently retaliates against her, not realizing that Eleanor was, in fact, his first love.

book_title: After Being Dumped, the Beautiful CEO Proposed to Me
special_desc: A man, born and raised in the countryside, finds out on his wedding day that his fiancée is pregnant with another man's child and was trying to trick him into marriage. Furious, he leaves for the city alone. His talents soon catch the attention of a wealthy female CEO, and within three years, they achieve massive success together. By chance, he is assigned a major development project in his hometown, returning as a highly successful man that no one there would have ever imagined.

Serena Smith’s picture-perfect life shatters when she discovers her husband’s affair with her cousin, Raina. Pushed to the edge by betrayal and humiliation, the pregnant heiress drops the docile facade and unveils her power as the true heiress to the Smith empire. This is not a breakdown. This is a takeover.

I came from a poor family, where my parents suffered humiliation in the village and couldn't hold their heads up. I studied diligently, eventually achieving top honors through his knowledge, thus changing his fate. Ten years later, I achieved great success and returned home in glory. How dare these people still look down on me and my family! Look how I'm going to make them regret it.

A wealthy heiress realized at her parents' funeral that her trusted husband and best friend conspired against her. In her anger and despair, she loses a child. Just when she thinks all is lost, a billionaire CEO extends a hand to rescue her. Three years later, she returns with a new identity and a stunning appearance, ready to make the unfaithful couple pay for their betrayal.

Keith, once cherished as the adopted son of the Steele family, is thrust into a treacherous web of deceit with the return of their biological son. Betrayed and heartbroken, Keith decides to volunteer for a "Time Capsule" project, intending to leave the Steeles behind forever. But when a staggering revelation comes to light—that Keith is the Steeles' true biological son—regret consumes the family. However, Keith has already turned the page, ready to embrace a new chapter of his life…

Married for 20 years, I worked hard as a cleaner to support the family and provided business resources to my husband by hiding my true identity of being a wealthy heiress. 
Who'd know on the day he succeeded, he actually divorced me and despised me for being a cleaner! 
I won't pretend anymore, as the richest heiress in the city, I will make him regret it!

Modern college student Grace Song wakes up as the villainous pregnant ex-wife in a period novel. The original Grace desperately wanted to marry into power, finally seducing William Hay into marriage. But when the Hay family was framed and sent to the countryside, she abandoned William and aborted their child, later suffering a tragic fate with an abusive husband.

On the day of her long-awaited wedding into a wealthy family, a bride receives a shocking text—her husband is having an affair. She and her friends rush to confront the "mistress," but things take a bizarre turn when the woman’s true identity is revealed—she’s her future mother-in-law?!

book_title: I Fell in Love with My Beautiful Maid
special_desc: The caretaker aspires to a life in the big city and sees the troubled marriage of a professor as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, she soon discovers that everything is part of a larger conspiracy!

book_title: Saying Farewell to My Clueless Husband
special_desc: Her husband’s nephew rode his bicycle into her, just as she was about to give birth. The nephew only suffered minor injuries, but her husband, called by his sister-in-law to take care of the boy, left his pregnant wife unattended. She, who had once thought she married for love, woke up to the harsh reality in that moment. All through their marriage, she had been the one taking care of the family, while he never contributed and always sided with his sister, nephew, and mother. From that day on, she decided to make those who hurt her pay the price, tit for tat. She seeks revenge on her husband for the loss of her unborn twins.

book_title: Five Years, My Husband Wants a Divorce
special_desc: A poor couple married and promised to stay together forever. Five years later, the wife, pregnant with twins, saw her husband being intimate with a female partner at his company. Feeling their love was gone, she prepared a divorce agreement. Later, the three were on a flight that had an engine failure and made an emergency landing. The wife felt unwell but was ignored by the others. She was rushed to the hospital, and when the husband finally arrived, he only received the divorce papers. He vowed to win her back.

book_title: XXL Hubby's Rise: Reborn to Destroy My Ex!
special_desc: In a past life, Jackson was head over heels for Yvonne, the driver's daughter. But she loved Ivor, and together they schemed to end Jackson's life. Now reborn, Jackson turns to Iris, his secret admirer, and vows to bring Yvonne and Ivor's dreams crashing down. As he exacts his revenge, he finds true happiness with Iris.

She and her boyfriend had been in a long-distance relationship for four years. After high school, she went abroad to study and, not wanting him to feel insecure about his own modest background, kept her wealthy family’s status a secret, pretending to come from a regular family and claiming she was studying abroad on student loans. Through four years apart, she always believed in his love for her. However, at a reunion back home, she saw him arm-in-arm with her family’s adopted daughter, and in that moment, her illusions shattered. The adopted daughter had been using the family name to her own advantage, posing as the true heiress. At the reunion, she and a group of classmates mocked and humiliated her, but the real heiress wasn’t hiding anymore—she called in her three brothers, who swiftly put them in their place.

The tycoon, in order to be with his lover, asked his handsome and strong driver to seduce his wife, thereby causing her to have an affair, with the aim of having her leave the house with nothing. In the end, the boss’s plan was exposed, and both he and his lover faced punishment. The driver also realized the importance of being down-to-earth and returned to the countryside.

After losing contact with his birth parents, Alex Webb is taken in by Tom Finch. Upon learning that Neil Webb and May Green are his true parents, Alex returns to the Webb family. Determined to repay them for his life, he dedicates himself to pioneering the groundbreaking 6G technology. But within the family's walls, treachery brews. Levi Webb, their adopted son, secretly undermines Alex, tarnishing his reputation and stealing his life's work. Devastated, Alex refuses to forgive, no matter the pleas for redemption.

Anne Kelly, bed ridden for a long time, found out her husband, Bryan, and their maid, Elaine, had been sleeping with each other and plotting to take her life. She played dumb and sought help from her friend Fred to thwart their plan and find evidence to bring them to justice. Anne used Bryan's mom, an uninvited guest, to work against the cheaters. Step by step, she lured the pair into exposing themselves, even convincing Elaine to be her witness in the end.

book_title: Oops, Roomie, You Picked the Wrong Girl!
special_desc: Aurora Lee wakes up reborn on her first day of college, memories intact of being betrayed and murdered by her best friend, Auria Bowen. This time, the real heiress hides her identity while Auria—the imposter—invites everyone on a fancy overseas trip, secretly plotting to steal Aurora's fortune again. As Aurora plays along with Auria's deception, she maneuvers to unmask the truth in a deadly game of revenge where everyone is a pawn, and no one leaves unchanged.

book_title: Love Was Never Part of the Mission
special_desc: Lia's dream to follow her father's footsteps as a police officer was cruelly shattered when the ruthless crime lord, Caleb, wiped out her family. Surviving the massacre, Lia assumes a new identity as the private tutor of Caleb's child, all for her perfect revenge. However, when she discovers what is in the hidden room of Caleb's house, her world shatters again.

book_title: General! She Rised to the Top
special_desc: In her previous life, she devotedly loved her husband and did everything she could to help him rise in his career. However, he betrayed her, having an affair with her best friend, strangled her, and annihilated her entire family. Given a second chance at life, she encounters her husband's political rival and decides to join forces with him. This time, watch as she becomes resilient and strategic, successfully taking revenge on the scoundrel.

The three major sects coveted the power of the Fire Seal and killed her parents. Before their deaths, her father sealed the Fire Seal’s power within her. Severely injured, she was taken back to her sect by her brother. However, she faced constant exclusion from the sect leader and other disciples, making life difficult, though her brother’s protection kept her safe. Years later, a traitor led the three sects in an attack on her sect, aiming to seize the Fire Seal and take control. With the sect on the verge of destruction and her brother nearly killed, she could bear it no longer and unleashed the Fire Seal’s power, turning the tide and saving them all!

Li Xiaojun, from a wealthy family, falls in love with childhood friend Su Xue. After saving her from an accident, he is left paralyzed. His mother hires doctors to heal him and secretly has him pretend to remain paralyzed to test Su Xue's love. On the eve of their wedding, Li Xiaojun plans to reveal he’s healed but discovers Su Xue’s affair with his best friend, Zeng Jian. Hurt, he agrees to go through with the wedding, secretly turning it into a divorce ceremony. Later, he helps Shen, the eldest daughter of the Shen family, and they decide to marry. On the wedding day, Li Xiaojun announces his divorce from Su Xue, revealing his new bride, leading Su Xue to be humiliated and prompting Zeng Jian to propose to her.

Before dying, 40-year-old Lin Chuxue learns that her husband, Lu Mingzhe, never truly loved her and their son, Lu Xuan, favors his father’s former lover, Su Yun. Reborn into the seventh year of her marriage, Lin Chuxue initiates a forced divorce, which must undergo China's mandatory 30-day cooling-off period. During this time, she joins Professor Wang’s team in Shanghai to tackle advanced brain cancer.

The heroine, a wealthy heiress, firmly married the poor man. When she went to the hospital to give birth, her family died in a car accident, leaving her alive but mentally impaired. Upon recovering her health, she discovered that it was all orchestrated by her husband and best friend. Now，she is determined to make them pay.

Elsa Scott, adopted by Jacob Scott after being abandoned as a baby, grew up on the streets before discovering her extraordinary musical talent. Earning admission to Longland’s top music academy, she puts her dreams on hold to fund Jacob’s medical treatment. To cover the costs, she joins David Mace’s entertainment agency, rising to international stardom as a singer. However, when she decides to leave the industry, David betrays her—reneging on his promise to pay for Jacob’s treatment and using her career as leverage. Manipulating the situation, he drives a wedge between Elsa and Jacob, portraying Jacob as ungrateful and greedy to keep Elsa under his control.

Destined as the scarred maid, she mastered Tai Chi's secrets under her young master's tutelage — yet clan laws silenced her prowess, branding both her face and skills as forbidden. When blades flash to claim his life, her fists rewrite destiny in the arena's dust.

After go master Frank Hughes' death, his spirit possessed Dylan Nolan, an autistic boy who had lost his father and faced family bullying. With Frank's go skills, Dylan won the family competition, saved his father's go academy, and defeated a challenging family. At the Go Master Competition, he beat Gorie's best player, topping the world. Finally, he helped Frank fulfill his wish by facing the challenge of artificial intelligence.

William was diagnosed with cancer. To spare his wife Wilda from distress, he kept it a secret and continued to dedicate himself fully to their game company. Meanwhile, Wilda constantly supported her first love, Josh. Under Josh's influence, Wilda even came to believe that her mother's death was just a lie fabricated by William. As secrets and suspicions mount, the bonds of love and trust are tested in ways neither could have imagined...

Disgraced heir Julian Creed, pursued by the royal family and facing execution, forges alliances with allies like Sophia to seize the throne. By rooting out corruption and restoring order, he ultimately rises to become a legendary emperor.

book_title: I Divorced My Husband for The Chancellor
special_desc: Gloria risked her life to save her husband, Felix. But the remedy requires two doses, taken three years apart, for a complete cure. Felix has already taken one, while the other could save the poisoned Prime Minister. Meanwhile, under the guise of "virtue", Felix pressures Gloria to step down as his legal wife and make way for the Kingsfall Princess. Now with the remedy in her hands, will she still give it to her husband or simply divorce him?

book_title: I Became an Heir on My Wedding Day
special_desc: On his wedding day, a man discovers that his fiancée has been deceiving him and is pregnant with another man’s child. Someone from their childhood, holding a grudge, used his girlfriend to set him up. Just as he faces humiliation from them both, the heiress of a super-wealthy family arrives. He finds out he is actually the long-lost heir of this family, and his sister has come to give him the grand wedding he deserves!

A single mother returns to the city she left seven years ago after breaking up with her ex to seek treatment for her son’s leukemia. Upon learning of her return, the ex immediately searches for the lover who had vanished for years. The son encounters a man at the hospital who he feels resembles his father, but ultimately, the two miss each other. After the misunderstandings are cleared up, will they be able to reconcile and mend their broken relationship?

Tina Judd, the only daughter of Lia Judd, grows up pampered. She eventually marries Zac Bane. Lia, battling cancer, reluctantly lets her go. Years into the marriage, Tina’s life is far from ideal. Zac is unreliable, and Tina, now a mother, silently carries the burden of a failing relationship. At her baby’s one-month party, Tina expects Lia to come. Instead, she receives the news of her mother's death. Heartbroken, Tina argues with the Bane family and begins to question her marriage. To her surprise, Lia reappears. When she sees Tina’s pain, she scolds Zac for breaking his promise. Though she hopes they can fix things, the damage is deep.

In the end, Tina chooses to leave. She wants to rediscover herself, and Lia stands by her. Zac, full of regret, promises to change, hoping she’ll return one day.

book_title: Bound to the Billionaire: Her Unexpected Fate
special_desc: Forced to drop out of school, all she wanted was a simple part-time job. But instead, she ended up being hunted like a rabbit and, after one night, found herself pregnant with triplets! He was known to be cold-hearted and rumored to hate women, even said to be incapable of having children. Yet, he couldn’t control his desire for her. What started as just bringing her home to have the babies quickly turned into something more. When his powerful family tries to mistreat her, he steps in to protect her. When her coworkers bully her, he makes sure they’re all fired and blacklisted.

The CEO, who is the male protagonist, is told that he will not survive past New Year's Eve due to his illness. Unexpectedly, he discovers that a poor female college student is the only person in the world who can cure him. In order to save his life, the CEO forcibly marries her. When he learns that the female student will be in mortal danger after curing him, the CEO, who has gradually fallen in love with her, is plunged into a painful dilemma...

book_title: Oh! The Heiress Proposed to Me
special_desc: The man, from an ultra-wealthy family, falls for an ordinary woman and saves her in an accident, leaving him injured. His mother cures him but convinces him to fake paralysis to test the woman’s loyalty. Before the wedding, he discovers her betrayal with his friend and plans to expose them at the ceremony.

Cael Lyor returns to the Lyors' residence to sever worldly ties and ascend to a higher realm, unaware that his family can hear his thoughts. As he proves himself the true heir, he overcomes the imposter’s schemes and earns the recognition of his three sisters. But just when he believes all is settled, the real crisis begins.

Talia Stone comes from a wealthy family. Her dad is a billionaire and her three brothers are bigwigs in the military, showbiz and finance world. She saved her childhood friend Jack Chase in an accident and almost lost her legs. Talia's legs were saved by top doctors in the field, but she remained in a wheelchair at her dad's request, as a test for Jack's feelings. The day before their wedding, Talia found out Jack was cheating with her friend Rachel. Enraged by the pair's brazen denial, Talia pretended to turn the other cheek while setting up a plan to humiliate them at the wedding. She then met Aiden Brooks who got her purse back from a thief and asked him half-jokingly to marry her. To her surprise, Aiden said yes. The next day, Talia's supposed wedding turned into a big stage for drama.

Falsely accused of treason, Stacey Lonoff was put behind bars by her husband, General Gordie Patzer. To avenge his childhood sweetheart Ciara Rede, Gordie tortured the pregnant Stacey to death, having no idea the true traitor was Ciara herself. But fate gave Stacey a second chance. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself back to the fateful day a month ago when everything began to unravel! In this life, she swore to protect her country and make Gordie and Ciara pay!

When her father becomes critically ill, a young woman is forced to impersonate a missing wife to obtain surgery funds. She juggles deceiving the husband at night while working as his assistant by day, leading to blackmail and misunderstandings. After enduring betrayal and captivity, she escapes and eventually reunites with the husband a year later, resolving their conflicts.

Dark Lord Ethan Quinn, disguised as a deliveryman to endure a mortal trial, reunites with Sarah, Skyward Mountain's High Priestess, and their secret daughter. Dragged into a sect war, he thwarts assassins, tames a Fire Qilin, and shreds divine swords. When celestials threaten his family, his true power erupts—exposing the Dark Lord. Final twist? His daughter’s plea becomes his ultimate weapon.

book_title: The Unbound: A Mortal's Path to Godhood
special_desc: In the South Empire, females rule everything, while males' status is low. Aaron made a living selling pork. He often faced humiliation from some powerful girls. The whole society looked down on men, forbidding them from practicing martial arts. Aaron still dreamed of fighting on the battlefield and defending the country. He practiced martial arts behind his mom's back. Then he participated in the Martial Arts Contest, gradually uncovering his own background. Actually, he was the Queen's son...

Cedric Jaime and his fiancée, Jade Menzie, had been in love for ten years, but their relationship was shattered by the meddling of her apprentice, Davy Rios. At an auction, Jade, eager to please Davy, pressured Cedric to relinquish a family heirloom. Defying her, Cedric bid fiercely, igniting a dramatic public confrontation. His finances left in disarray, Cedric's fortunes seemed bleak—until the intervention of the affluent Maggie Ruell offered him a chance at redemption.

book_title: When We Parted, the World Went Still
special_desc: When Mason sees his wife, Helena, and Wayne making out in the car, he is furious. After being framed by Wayne again and again and betrayed by his wife over and over, Mason is so disappointed that he agrees to divorce. Not until Helena finds out that everything Wayne said is a lie, does she realize how wrong she is. She wants to win Mason back, but Mason has married another girl and moved on.

A newly retired father travels to see his daughter in the city and helps an elderly stranger who has fallen, only to be falsely accused and extorted. Undeterred, he reaches her company and discovers she is a powerful CEO. Outraged by the injustice, her employees rally to defend him. The daughter clears his name, and the two share a heartfelt reunion, cherishing their restored family bond.

Once wrongfully accused and bearing a heavy grudge, she was reborn into a new life only to find herself at the bottom rung as a maid in a landlord's household. Yet, through her wit and perseverance, she rises to become the landlord’s adopted daughter. Returning to the very place where she was once wronged, she meets the estate’s upright master, and together, they embark on a forbidden journey filled with secrets in their new home. They will uncover corruption and stand up to the tyrants in a tale of justice and intrigue.

book_title: See You Never, My Dear Ex!
special_desc:
Andre Xavier gave up everything for love and married Lauren Berry. Years later, Lauren's first love, John Barton, returns. The two's encounters become frequent, and even their son, Frank Xavier, begins to see John as his father.
Infidelity. Divorce. Betrayal.
The pain of losing someone Andre loved the most disappears when he reclaims everything.
What Lauren never knew is that he is the CEO of the Atenas Group, the most influential and important company in the world!

book_title: Hold My Hand Before the Cable Snaps
special_desc: My daughter died in the old elevator of our apartment. But my husband, the property manager, was fixing pipes for his first love at the same time. Getting a second chance, I'd make sure the tragedy wouldn't happen again.

Keira Smith grew up in a happy family, loved and doted on by her parents and elder brother Joshua. Her world came apart when Ruby, their true biological daughter, was taken home. Keira was cast aside and later accused of pushing her grandmother down the stairs. She was sent to a reform school, bullied and tortured for two whole years. The experience changed Keira as a person, mentally and physically.

Abandoned at birth and raised by a mute father figure, Sara knows only gratitude and loyalty. But after a clash with a privileged boy turns dangerous, she saves him from drowning and vanishes in the river, leaving her devoted father to grieve the daughter he risked everything for.

A boy and a girl have liked each other since childhood, but the girl misunderstands and thinks he’s in love with someone else. Years later, they marry without resolving that misunderstanding. When the woman joins the company her husband works for, she is bullied by what she believes to be his first love. But thanks to the man’s timely intervention, the truth comes out: the woman he loved all along was her.

book_title: The General He Loved Was His Wife All Along
special_desc: A decorated female general returns in low profile but is met with her fiancé's request for a divorce! The top scholar is only seeking someone to create a peaceful era alongside him. However, he doesn’t realize that the very person he’s divorcing is exactly who he’s been searching for! Their missed encounters are truly the best arrangements by fate.

After a spontaneous first meeting, they got married right away. She secretly works as a janitor at his company while facing bullying and jealousy from coworkers. As the company president, he quietly protects her whenever she's in danger—but how long can they keep their secret?

After making a heartfelt promise to reunite two decades later, a man returns to propose, only to discover that his beloved has been forced into marrying another. Determined to uncover the truth and expose the wrongdoer's actions, he embarks on a quest to fight for their love. Can true love prevail and justice be served, allowing them to finally be together?

Gloria Cooley is reborn on the day she was married to Alistair Payne. In her past life, she managed to marry him, only to earn his hatred and witness her country fall. This time, she chooses to marry Alvin Walsh, the King of Sabulon, and finds that the King falls in love with her. Meanwhile, Alistair realizes too late that he has always loved her.

She had just found out her biological father was the heir when she was in a car accident. Her mother died on the spot, her father became a vegetable, and she became mute and abandoned by her grandfather. After 15 years, when the rich man finally woke up, her identity was stolen again. When will the truth be revealed?

book_title: The Real&Fake Young Master: My Four Aunties Are Big Shots
special_desc: Once an heir to a wealthy family, a genius boy went missing and was picked up by another family, where he was forced into servitude and endured abuse. However, his four powerful aunts—each a legend in her field, from a warrior to a movie star, a divine doctor, and a business mogul—found him and showered him with love, exposing the fake heir and turning the tables!

A strict, abstinent CEO discovers that due to a rare condition, he won’t live past thirty. By chance, he learns that a poor college student is the only one who can heal him. Desperate to survive, he forces her into marriage. Over time, she falls in love with him and sacrifices herself to save his life. Believing she died in the process, he is devastated. But seven years later, fate brings her back into his life—blind and with a child.

The heroine is threatened by her son and after a physical altercation the heroine is killed。The heroine opens her eyes again but is reborn back in time, however this time she chooses to indulge her son.In this life, the hero suddenly confesses his love for the heroine, who agrees and marries her in a secret flash marriage。The son gets the news and brings people to find trouble for the heroine, the hero protects his wife in a domineering manner，Till the end, the hero reveals his identity, and it turns out that he's none other than the richest man in the country.

During rural poverty alleviation, he sponsored a girl who wrongly felt special to him and turned arrogant. After graduating from university five years later, she lied that he was her brother and brought classmates to intern at his company gearing up for IPO. Mistaken as a relative, she abused power, firing the tech team and even declaring herself chairwoman.
During vital partnership negotiations, her behavior ruined the deal, causing him to be hospitalized from rage. She then tried to bankrupt and sell the company. Upon waking, he exposed her lies. In revenge, she colluded with rivals, but he outsmarted her. Forensic audits uncovered embezzlement and cyber teams stopped her attacks. She was arrested for fraud and espionage.
His company went public successfully with strong investor backing. She became a cautionary tale, and he, a leader rising from the ashes.

book_title: Told You: I’m Really Not a Fool
special_desc: In a tragic accident, Flynn York loses not only his talents but also his mind, leaving him a shadow of his former self—bullied and dismissed as a nobody. Five years later, devastation strikes again when his seven brothers and three uncles perish on the battlefield, never returning home. As his family falls apart, the final blow comes at their funeral—his fiancée abruptly calls off their wedding. Just as Flynn reels from the betrayal, the unmarried partner of one of his late brothers makes a shocking announcement—she will marry him instead. Stunned and uncertain, Flynn hesitates. After all, he is not the broken, feeble man everyone believes him to be.

book_title: Live & Let Lie: The Scandal Show
special_desc: A disappearance or a scandal? After discovering his wife's betrayal, Leroy Cooke put her on trial in the court of public opinion. The media, the police, and countless netizens became obsessed with her mysterious disappearance. But as the story unraveled, so did a darker truth—turned out, she wasn't just unfaithful, she was after his fortune too...

Xavier Grant, a professional cyclist, had a thriving career until a devastating accident left him permanently disabled and hopeless. His once vibrant world faded into darkness, and the thought of ending his own life became his only escape. Desperate to help, his mother hires a personal caregiver—Myra Stroud, a beacon of light in his despair. Coming from a humble background, Myra’s optimism and ambition gradually rekindle Xavier’s spirit. As they grow closer, love blossoms between them. Like a remedy crafted just for him, Myra brings color back into his life, while he helps her chase her dreams. In the end, Xavier makes his final decision, and Myra honors his choice, granting him a peaceful passing—a bittersweet conclusion to their tragic yet beautiful love story.

Fiona Tucker, a woman from the country, was kicked out by her son and in-laws after being accused of theft. She got to know and married Joel Griffin. Fiona's in-law Sarah has been lying to Henry, Fiona's son, about being the one who gave him her kidney and paid for their current house. Even after Fiona moved out, Sarah came up with every way to humiliate her, resulting in a trip to the hospital one time. Joel stood by and protected Fiona all along, and finally convinced her to prioritize her life before her son's.

After a business trip, CEO Abigail returns to find her villa overtaken by security guard Alvin's family and her company near bankruptcy due to his interference. Rescued by Keith, she thwarts Alvin's plot and exposes his crimes, untangling family and corporate conspiracies.

Ace pilot Teddy wakes up in the body of his eight-year-old self on the very flight that once took his father's life. With the plane on fire, the captain unconscious, and hundreds of lives hanging in the balance, Teddy must use his adult mind in a child's body to change fate and save everyone before history repeats itself.

Leonard Poe, descendant of Veronica Poe, falls for Ivory Sowle—unwittingly making an enemy of her jealous admirer, Frank Lawson, who ruins his career and forces him into delivery work. Witnessing her three powerful adopted heirs abuse their power to oppress her own great-grandson, Veronica decides to reshuffle Great Arkland's elite families, overthrow the corrupt order, and raise the kind-hearted Leonard to power.

book_title: The Fallen God & His Mute Muse
special_desc: In The Fallen God & His Mute Muse movie, Levi Tran, an immortal, is reborn to escape a massive debt. He awakens in a gambler's body, only to find his mute wife's voice stolen. Now, will he be able to give the woman her voice back with his mortal body?

He was despised at the bottom of society, bullied by the wealthy. He prayed to become the richest man, and his prayers were heard by the God of Wealth. The God of Wealth made him the proxy God of Wealth. From then on, his life underwent a tremendous change.

book_title: Reverse Rescue in the Great Flood
special_desc: I suddenly gain a superpower that lets me see each person's cause and time of death. When I predict a flood is coming, will I be able to convince the villagers to evacuate? And how can I rescue them from the flood?

book_title: Daddy! You're Spoiling the Wrong Kid
special_desc:
"You wicked imposters, just wait and see how my mommy and daddy kick you and your kid out!"
Six years ago, after a one-night encounter with a stranger, she had a daughter and raised her alone. Now, he’s tracked her down—but her jealous sister has claimed her identity, using every chance to make life hard for her and her daughter. Though he doesn’t know who she truly is, he finds himself stepping in to protect her time and again—and can’t help but fall for her.

Margaret married another country's prince to help her childhood sweetheart fight for the throne. But her lover Prince Edward misunderstood her and thought she betrayed him. After Edward ascended the throne, Margaret and her husband William went to the Snow Empire as hostages. Edward forced William to divorce Margaret, and made her a slave. They still loved each other. But when Margaret found her family all got killed, her heart was full of hatred. She swore to avenge her family...

book_title: Entangled with My Ex Sugar Baby
special_desc: Ten years ago, Sam Lowe was a confident and dynamic heir to a wealthy family, while Zoe Yale was the most popular girl in school despite coming from a poor background. Now, the tables have turned—after his family’s bankruptcy, Sam has been reduced to nothing more than a waiter, while Zoe has risen to new heights as the CEO of a thriving company. Though Sam is determined to rebuild his life, embarrassment and shame flood his heart when he unexpectedly sees her at a class gathering he wasn’t even invited to. He fears she will look down on him, unaware that there isn’t a trace of contempt in her heart. Because regardless of one’s background or achievements, everyone will eventually meet the right person—as long as they stay true to themselves.

Melina Gibson, a famous billionaire, lost everything, even her life, all due to misplaced trust. Only when faced with death did she realize Taylor Sutton, the man once engaged to her daughter Millie, should've been the right choice for a son-in-law. Melina was reborn and taken back to a decade ago, before Millie's engagement with Jaxson Perry, the man who killed her. Touched by Taylor's kindness in her previous life, Melina now swore to protect and help him at all cost, despite Millie's disdain towards him. Conflicts arose between Melina and Milllie as Millie insists on being with Jaxson, oblivious to his motives. After many trials, Melina finally helped her daughter realize what a great man Taylor is. Together, they brought Jaxson to justice and started a new life.

book_title: Love, Lies, and a Wedding Surprise
special_desc: Struggling under family poverty, she was compelled to wed a man she loathed. Her desperate solution? Secretly enlisting a mob boss to stage her "kidnapping" during the wedding. The twist? After exchanging vows, her contractually-bound husband developed profound feelings for her – an awakening of the heart he hadn't yet acknowledged, even in his private thoughts.

In a past life, Ethan married Lily only to find out she couldn't forget her first love. When she learned of his death, she took drastic measures to join him, leading to Ethan's accidental death as he tried to stop her. Reborn, they chose different paths—Lily reunited with her first love, Victor, and Ethan rose to become the richest man. This time, their lives diverged completely...

Amelia Glyn, heiress to the Glyn Group, enters university posing as a commoner—only to be targeted by the bully, Vivian Lowe, who steals her admission spot. But when Amelia's true identity is revealed and an explosive secret about her father’s illegitimate daughter is uncovered, a fierce battle over family name and fortune erupts.

In a world where choices can reshape destinies, two sisters awaken to a mysterious system that demands a life-altering decision: choose between a billion dollars or their own mother. In their past lives, Hannah's younger sister, Ingrid, chose the billion and entered a life of luxury, only to face a downfall. While Hannah chose family and thrived through her own hard work. Consumed by envy, Ingrid killed her sister.

Now reborn to the day of their choices, Ingrid chooses family instead, while Hannah reluctantly takes the billion. But as Ingrid basks in her supposed victory, Hannah smiles. After all, who knows if her sister just picked hell?

Lila Lawson, the daughter of the Murphy family's maid, used her connections to her advantage, posing as the real heiress. Meanwhile, the real heiress, Macie Murphy, faced disgrace when she was accused of cheating, and no one believed that Lila had framed her.
Humiliation. Bankruptcy. Death.
Now reborn, Macie is back in high school.

book_title: The Wrong Beginning, The Right One
special_desc: His jealousy fueled by a misunderstanding led to relentless torment, believing she cheated and carried someone else's child. But as the truth unfolds, can their love be salvaged?

Years ago in an orphanage, the younger twin gave up her chance to be adopted by a wealthy family to her sister, who had a heart condition. As adults, the older sister, now a wealthy heiress, spares no expense in searching for her sibling. Meanwhile, the younger sister suffers through a difficult life in her in-laws' home, deceived and eventually harmed to death.
