The older sister vows to personally avenge all the injustices her sister endured..

book_title: Spoiled by the CEO During Pregnancy
special_desc: Born in a family that favors boys over girls, the money I earned from working as a part-time student was stolen by my mother. And she used it to buy a video game for my younger brother! When I was desperate, the CEO's assistant found me and proposed - if the CEO fell in love with me, I would have money to go to college! I decided to take the chance. Just one night, I got pregnant, and the CEO actually spent a lot of money and loved to spoil me!

I drove a bus for four years, concealing a dark secret the entire time. I’m here to share the terrifying truths you don’t know: the story of how hearses were converted into buses. You might not have experienced this yourself, but the bus you ride may carry more than just the living…

On the day he took over as CEO, he was attacked by thugs, leading to brain damage and memory loss. Years later, his adoptive daughter brought him to reunite with his biological children. However, his children’s family looked down on him for his low status and intellectual impairment, refusing to acknowledge him. They accused him of pretending to be their father for money and subjected him to verbal and physical abuse, eventually pushing him down the stairs. Miraculously, the fall restored his consciousness and memory. But his competitive sister, worried that his return would threaten her position, forged the paternity test results and kidnapped his adoptive daughter and mother. Can he clear the misunderstandings and reunite with his family?

book_title: Love's Second Chance at His Office
special_desc: During his student years, he mistakenly believed his girlfriend was involved in escorting for money. After building his business empire, he bound her to his side as his executive assistant through a contract. Ultimately, amidst ongoing tumult and suspicion, they resolved their misunderstandings and moved towards each other in mutual love.

book_title: Let There Be Awakening: The World Awaits Him
special_desc: Six years ago, the chairman of the World Neurology Association gave up invitations from top-tier medical institutions and chose to go into seclusion, dedicating himself to ensuring one person's awakening. To him, saving this individual was the greatest honor of his career. For six years, this person had remained in a Grade A deluxe ward. Now, the figure who transformed the world six years ago is about to awaken, and the world is destined to experience seismic changes once again.

book_title: 3 Months Left, The Heiress Strikes Back
special_desc: Diagnosed with terminal cancer and given three months to live, she starts taking revenge on those who hurt her. Then, a call from the doctor reveals it was a misdiagnosis!

book_title: Stand Together: A Mother-In-Law and I Fight
special_desc: A skilled bodyguard specializing in protecting women quickly marries a top lawyer, concealing her true profession to avoid burdening him. After the wedding, she discovers signs of domestic abuse within his family and secretly gathers evidence of his violent behavior. She exposes his corruption and abuse in court, leading to his professional and personal downfall. Ultimately, she and her daughter live peacefully, free from his influence.

A honored general is appointed to a high rank. Ten years later, an arranged marriage is disrupted when a woman reveals her true gender, causing public backlash. She resigns and returns home, while her fiancé is granted a prestigious title. Ambitious, he abandons his family, marries an impostor, and mistreats her. Amid foreign turmoil, she is invited back to the capital, where she teams up with the prime minister to expose corruption and foreign threats. Ultimately, they unite and achieve their goals.

After years of devotedly caring for her family, she was met with relentless ingratitude from her husband and son—who even brazenly vowed to form a "real family" with a glamorous actress. Heartbroken by their betrayal, fate intervened when she saved the life of an influential industry titan during a medical emergency. As a skilled doctor, she earned both his admiration and steadfast support, emboldening her to divorce her toxic marriage.
Guided by the mogul’s mentorship, she reclaimed her identity and blossomed into her own spotlight: excelling in her medical career, radiating confidence, and crafting a life of purpose. Meanwhile, the delusional father-son duo, who’d believed their fantasy would thrive, soon drowned in regret—one desperately chasing redemption as a son, the other pleading for a second chance as a husband, both left to mourn the irreplaceable woman they’d taken for granted.

Emelie Newton’s parents are brutally murdered for offending the consort, their lack of status leaving them powerless to resist. Determined to avenge them, Emelie infiltrates the palace, disguising herself as the consort’s loyal servant. But behind her obedient facade lies a carefully woven plan—one that will ensure the consort pays dearly for her sins when the perfect moment arrives.

book_title: A Boyfriend on Loan, A Real Love on Way
special_desc: To appease his family's pressure to marry, Felix Lloyd plans to rent a girlfriend for the festive season. However, a mix-up at the airport lands the wrong woman—Kendal Scott—in his car. Surprisingly, they get along well, and Kendal agrees to go along with the act. At first, she suspects nothing when greeted by Felix’s family, who appear to be simple farmers. But when his grandmother gifts her an expensive bangle, his mother presents her with a lavish gift, and the dining table overflows with luxurious dishes, Kendal begins to question whether the Lloyds are truly just an ordinary farming family.

book_title: Chained by Fate, Claimed by Love
special_desc: Soft-spoken and kind-hearted, Luna Quinn never expected love to find her at work—until she crosses paths with Kieran Scott. Despite enduring a string of blind dates, Kieran feels nothing for the elegant women before him—until Luna walks in, stealing his heart at first sight. Yet, Luna isn’t ready for romance, focusing instead on her career. When her parents arrange a marriage for her, she hesitates but agrees out of responsibility. Upon hearing this, Kieran makes his move—not as a guest, but as the groom, determined to win her heart. Choosing love over obligation, Luna marries into the Scott family, embraced by warmth and devotion. But just as she settles into her new life, a shocking truth emerges—she was switched at birth. As she reunites with her true family, Luna finally finds the life of love and belonging she was always meant to have.

In the ruthless world of high finance, some debts are paid in blood and betrayal. Chloe Neuman had it all—until her father’s ultimatum forced her to shatter Nicholas Silva’s heart. Seven years later, Nicholas rules Axton’s business empire, his heart hardened by revenge. Chloe, now a mere bartender in his elite world, becomes his latest target. But as their dangerous game of vengeance and desire unfolds, a mysterious child with Nicholas’ eyes threatens to unravel everything.

Gary Leed's world is divided between his dangerous construction site where he trades his health for wages and the modest home where Ian studies for a future Gary could only dream of. When Gary's body collapses—years of malnutrition and exhaustion collecting their debt—father and son face an impossible choice. Ian Leed, witnessing his father's suffering, volunteers to abandon his education and enter the workforce, but Gary refuses to let poverty claim another generation. Having once survived on street corners where he exchanged dignity for coins, Gary is determined that his son's hands will hold books, not bricks.

Little Alodia had a tough start. At just five years old, she was stuck living with her mean aunt Rhea who only cared about boys. Life was lonely until she met Jade, the fiery widow everyone in Loess Village talked about.

A funny thing happened after Jade took Alodia in. Suddenly, Jade's struggling herb business took off. Bills got paid. Good things just kept happening. Turns out the quiet little girl was what folks called a "luck magnet" - where she went, fortune followed.

Of course, nasty aunt Rhea came sniffing around when she heard. The village chief, Larry Greene, heard the rumors, trying to take Alodia back. But Jade wasn't having it. With help from folks like Osmond and the neighbors, they showed Rhea for the cruel woman she was.

In the end, Jade got to keep her lucky little girl, proving sometimes the family you choose is better than the one you're born into.

Rae's dream was to be a pilot. But when she found out that she was pregnant, she married her boyfriend and settled down as a housewife. 
 
Seven years later, while on her husband's flight, Rae discovered his secret: he had been keeping a mistress for years. Adding to the horror was the plane crashing in a thunderstorm; it seemed that certain death awaited them...
 
Until she found herself going back in time with her memories intact. 
 
Now, Rae must make new choices to rewrite her future... before it's too late!

Orphaned and desperate to escape their fate, Sophie Bennett and Rachel Morgan hatch a bold plan—pose as the long-lost loves of two wealthy heirs and marry into the powerful Lancaster family. Sophie plays the fragile beauty in public, but behind closed doors, she's tough as nails, caught in a twisted game of make-believe marriage with the spoiled heir, Jason Lancaster.
Just as their lies start to pay off, the real first love returns, and everything spirals. Busted while trying to skip town with a fortune, they're dragged back into the Lancaster world. Sophie gives up the act, ready to burn it all down—only to find Jason obsessed with the real her. Turns out, he's the boy she secretly crushed on in high school.
As secrets explode, fake love turns real. A surprise pregnancy, bitter rivals, and family power plays push them to the edge. But in the chaos, their long-buried feelings come to light—and what started as a lie might just end in true love.

"For a decade, Ruby Nicholson, a brilliant gynecologist, had been shackled in a loveless marriage to her scumbag husband, Kyle Lane. Barren and unable to conceive, she endured relentless torment from his venomous mother, Jennifer Lane, who never missed a chance to belittle her. Kyle had been entangled in a steamy affair with a younger woman, Freya Riley, who was now pregnant with his child. It was in the hospital that Ruby stumbled upon the gut-wrenching truth.
Confronted by the treachery, the taunts, and the suffocating oppression, Ruby launched a breathtaking counterattack. Armed with the law, the power of public opinion, and her razor-sharp professional skills, she was determined to expose Kyle and his family. With every step, she clawed back her stolen wealth and her shattered dignity.
And then there was Maxwell Smith, an internet celebrity and paparazzo who'd been quietly adoring her from afar. With him, Ruby lived a life painted in hues of hope and love."

Jesse was wrongfully imprisoned for ten years. Upon release, he discovered that the real culprits were his own wife and daughter, who even caused his mother's death. Disheartened, Jesse decided to divorce and leave town. In Tont City, he rebuilt his life, becoming a senior engineer and falling in love with Lizzie. Returning to his hometown with newfound success, Jesse is determined to bring those responsible to justice.

book_title: Back to the 80s: Taming My Stoic Hubby
special_desc: Top dancer Ginger finds herself in the 1980s, in the body of a disliked major's wife. Determined to change perceptions, she earns admiration through her exceptional dance skills and persistent efforts. Meanwhile, the stern and reserved Luke becomes increasingly gentle and devoted to her...

Drugged, Cynthia spends a night with Marcus Chase. Unaware he's a business heir, she flees. Reuniting at work, Marcus poses as an assistant, pursuing her—but she avoids him over rumors he's gay. Colleague Leah schemes against her, trapping them in cold storage and framing her. When Cynthia gets pregnant, Marcus faces rejection. Truth reveals: the rumor was Marcus's friend Ryan's lie; Leah jailed. Marcus wins Cynthia, exposing corruption.

Isolde Corven, mute after a car crash, married Cassian Thorne. She thought he was the love of her life, until she overheard the maids gossiping—turned out he had only married her to bear a child for his infertile first love, Selene Vennor. Heartbroken, she got into another car accident. Due to Selene's scheme, Cassian believed Isolde was dead. Six years later, Isolde returned as Ismena, a top architect, with a baby boy, Leif. Fate continually drew her and Cassian together, yet layers of misunderstanding and pain kept them apart. Finally, Leif's kidnapping forced them to work together, and the truth was eventually unraveled...

Leah Turner secretly married Cyril Stosur for seven years before holding their six-year-old daughter Anna for the first time that evening. While Anna was ecstatic, Cyril understood Leah's sudden affection stemmed solely from her reunited first love. Seven years earlier, Leah had married Cyril impulsively after her true love abandoned her. Throughout their marriage, she remained emotionally absent, avoiding family interactions and forbidding Anna from calling her Mom. The final blow came when Anna witnessed Leah showering attention on her ex-lover's daughter while persistently neglecting her. This stark contrast crushed Anna's remaining hope, driving the heartbroken child to leave permanently.

book_title: Married by Mistake, Loved by Fate
special_desc: After returning from abroad, Harper Clark receives devastating news—Aiden Nash, her childhood friend and boyfriend of seven years, has cheated on her. Despite his past devotion, Harper is heartbroken but not ready to give up. She decides to give Aiden 100 chances to hurt her, with the final one occurring at Shae Clark's birthday party. When Harper, Shae, and Abby White fall into the pool, the Clark family saves Shae, Aiden rescues Abby, leaving Harper forgotten in the water. This moment prompts Harper to end their engagement, but Aiden mocks her refusal. In a bold move, Harper marries Ted Nash, the most powerful man in Detril, becoming Aiden's aunt by marriage. Despite continued humiliation from Aiden and his family, Harper proves them wrong at every turn. As Aiden realizes the truth about Abby's actions, he is left with deep regret...

Wendy, heir to a martial arts clan, is betrayed by her own family, left with amnesia, and written off as a fool. However, everything changes after a daring rescue. Posing as a mother to her rescuer, Minny, she teams up with Theo, a "cripple" hiding a deadly agenda. Together, they take down their enemies, reclaim the martial arts studio, and shatter every lie until the final truth reunites them as a real family.

book_title: One More Chance, My Nurse Girlfriend!
special_desc: Adrian Sterling avoids intimacy but is pressured to produce an heir. Sophie Carter, desperate to save her grandmother, agrees to a fake marriage with Adrian. Sophie's uncle Alex and Lillian Lane plot against her, making her believe Adrian doesn’t want their child. After her prenatal report is swapped, she leaves. Five years later, as Beatrice with her son, she’s found by Adrian, who learns the truth, protects them, and rekindles their love.

For 30 years, Sharon Tingey believed she was Caleb Poole's partner, only to discover his secret marriage to another. Viewed merely as a "maid" by the Pooles, Sharon takes her inheritance and begins anew, using her embroidery talents and a fresh bond with Franklin Russell to transform her life.

Deceived by her brother Isaac and husband Zander, business mogul Zelda unknowingly hands her empire to the scheming Yasmina. But Yasmina's dark ambitions lead to Zelda's tragic demise.

Revived with a burning desire for vengeance, Zelda breaks free from Zander, reclaims her power, and ousts Yasmina. However, with Isaac still entranced by Yasmina, Zelda's battle for justice continues...

Will Zelda's relentless pursuit of truth and justice prevail?

book_title: Fate Restarted: I Found My Mom a Perfect Husband
special_desc: In a society where sons reign supreme, she endured a lifetime of neglect. Her dream of college was her ticket to freedom with her mother. But at the station, her father's fury ended in tragedy, leaving her mother lifeless. "I'll follow you, Mom," she whispered, as the icy river claimed her. Awakening in 1980, she found her mother alive, bathed in sunlight. With newfound resolve, she vowed to rewrite their fate and fight for justice.

In his past life, Felipe, a wealthy heir, was strung along by Myrtle, only to watch his family fall apart after their marriage. Reborn with a second chance, he turns away from his past and chooses Reana, a serene woman he believes he's never met. But what Felipe doesn't know is that this mysterious woman is no stranger at all. They shared a beautiful, forgotten childhood memory.

Cecilia Lynch, a brilliant student from a small town, unexpectedly finds herself taken back into a prestigious family in the capital. Despite facing hostility from her newfound relatives and the scheming of a fake heiress, Cecilia remains undeterred. She focuses intently on her studies, leveraging every available resource to excel academically. Her relentless dedication ultimately earns her a place at a top-tier university, securing a remarkable future defined by her own achievements.

book_title: His Morning Sickness Alert & Her Love Signal
special_desc: Chloe Lynch, hailing from a humble rural background, struggles under the scrutiny of her superiors during her probation and faces pressure from her family. An unforeseen encounter with CEO Adrian Hawthorne not only secures her position but changes her life dramatically. Expecting triplets, Chloe discovers a newfound ally in Adrian, who supports her through professional hurdles and familial challenges. Together, they embark on a journey toward lasting happiness.

Charlotte helped her "best friend," Jasmine, over and over again and even died saving her. Reborn, she’s done playing the martyr. This time, she’ll stand back and watch as Jasmine and her psycho boyfriend sink into the hell they made.

After twenty years, when the Lowes finally reunite with their long-lost son, they expect him to be a pitiable figure they can easily manipulate. Little do they know, he is a vengeful soul who has clawed his way back from hell. The adopted son sees him as a thorn in his side, the sister scorns him as inferior, and the parents try to bind him with guilt. But he responds with a cold smile—"I will reclaim everything that is rightfully mine, including the Lowe Empire you hold so dear."

After three years of marriage to Edward Lowe, Serena Tate discovers his obsession with her sister-in-law, Miranda Sharpe, and his manipulative ways. Disillusioned, Serena divorces Edward, reclaims her assets, and revives her career in traditional medicine. Throughout her journey, Larry Sims stands by her side, helping to expose Miranda's plot to sabotage Serena. Eventually, Serena and Larry marry in a whirlwind romance, and Serena's cancer drug "New Life" achieves great success. Edward realizes his mistake, but his regret comes too late.

book_title: For Her, He Never Moved On
special_desc: Bailee was betrothed to the wealthy Dante from a young age. However, Dante had no love for her and left for overseas studies on their wedding night for three years. Seeking revenge, Bailee took a lover, a man she believed to be insignificant. But when Dante returned, she planned to end her affair. Meanwhile, Bailee learned that the marshal of the country had returned from abroad exactly three years ago. Could the marshal be the lover she has been supporting all along?

book_title: In This Life, Crown Princess Steals the Spotlight
special_desc: The Crown Princess of the Qoit Dynasty unexpectedly time-travels to the modern entertainment world, inhabiting the body of a struggling actress named Aurora. Armed with exceptional skills, she captivates everyone, including the initially disdainful superstar Julian. Just as their relationship blossoms, Julian's first love, Claire, returns and schemes to create misunderstandings between them. Despite these challenges, Julian remains determined to win Aurora back.

Sammy and Shane were childhood sweethearts, but a devastating fire left Shane under the mistaken belief that Sammy had deliberately failed to save him. This misunderstanding festered, turning Shane's love into a lingering resentment. Over three tumultuous years of marriage, Shane has filed for divorce 100 times, each time met by Sammy's pleas for forgiveness.

When Shane files for divorce for the 101st time, Sammy's heart finally shatters. Resolved to let go of this unrequited love, she makes the bold decision to walk away and accepts the mysterious marriage proposal of a stranger.

Once the formidable underground king of the Northeast Provinces, Linden Holt has traded his notorious past for a quiet life as a butcher. But when the young thugs demand protection money, his loyal lieutenant, Dominic Walden, arrives just in time with a team of bodyguards to send a clear message. Linden confides that his retirement was meant to provide a stable life for his son, Felix. However, a sudden call reveals that Felix has landed in hot water. Will the retired kingpin be forced to re-enter the fray and reclaim his throne to protect his family?

book_title: The Movie Star's Daughter in the Dark
special_desc: Years ago, a handsome rising star pursued the plus-sized Best Actress against societal norms, becoming a celebrated couple, but after achieving fame, he shockingly killed his wife and daughter, initially blaming a home invasion. Little did he know, his daughter has returned with a hidden identity, determined to avenge her mother and bring him to justice.

The Emperor's daughter, Yun, was betrayed and severely injured. A poor young man, Peng, saved her. To repay him, Yun hid her identity and married Peng, giving birth to their daughter,NiuNiu. While supporting the family, Yun secretly used the Emperor's power to help Peng succeed.
When Yun planned to reveal her true identity, she found Peng cheating and wanting a divorce. Peng's mother humiliated Yun and eventually drove her
and Niu Niu out of the house.At a grand banquet, Yun revealed her identity, exposed Peng's betrayal, punished the traitors, and became the Empress.

A housewife after marriage, she diligently served her husband’s family. However, when her mother fell ill and needed money, her husband’s family refused to contribute, and she discovered her husband’s infidelity, being the last to know in the family, who treated her like a free maid. When her husband brought his mistress home, she decided to divorce and reclaim what was hers. She intended to leave with her daughter and start a new life.

On her wedding day, Heather Dow was called to the battlefield in her father's place. Fighting alongside Crown Prince Waylon Fenn, she secured victory and earned the title of General Laurels. But when she returned, she found her husband Josh Hagar marrying a noblewoman for power. Moreover, Josh sent her poor sister off as a concubine. Fueled by betrayal, Heather set out for revenge. While she turned Josh's world upside down, even darker schemes awaited her and Waylon in the shadows.

Soon after rising to fame as the Silver Chef, Melissa Stone steps away from her craft, fearing her son might misuse her influence and stir trouble. Her best friend suggests finding him a father, and after much thought, Melissa takes the advice—leading to her fateful encounter with Ryan Lester on a blind date arranged by his daughter.

book_title: My Fake BF is Actually a Secret CEO?!
special_desc: Tyrese Huynh, the founder and chairman of NexaDrive Group, disguised himself as a beggar to reward the kind-hearted. Camilla Gordon was the only one who helped him, and in return, Tyrese agreed to pose as her boyfriend to escape her mother's constant matchmaking. But when they attended her mother's birthday party, Tyrese was bombarded with insults from her family. Through it all, Camilla stood by his side. That was when she discovered Tyrese was the Racing Legend she'd secretly admired for years! What began as a pretend romance soon blossomed into something far more real than either of them expected.

Gordon James left for a battalion the day after his wedding with Daphne Kirk. Seven years later, Daphne took their son Freddy to Gordon's camp to meet his dad. There she found out he got married to another woman in the camp. Conflicts with his new wife Flora and her mom Jane led to Freddy dying on the trip. Daphne swore to avenge her son with help from her father, Marshal Simon Kirk. Gordon killed Jane to win his powerful father-in-law's favor, only to get killed by Flora who then committed suicide.

Nanette Mosley, the long-lost heiress, fell for Lemuel Knox, but he scorned her as a mere rube. After a drunken one-night stand with Lemuel, Nanette found herself pregnant, yet Glenda Harris took the credit and became Lemuel's fiancée. When Nanette's adopted sister caused a hit-and-run that left Glenda in a coma, Nanette took the fall to save her adoptive father, and Lemuel threw her in prison. Upon her release, Nanette thought she wouldn't cross paths with Lemuel again, but fate had other plans. For Glenda's sake, Lemuel tortured Nanette time and time again. By the time he regretted it, she had long stopped loving him.

Alan Bauer, secretly the chairman of Müller Group, returns to the Gale family with his wife and son to celebrate a birthday, only to be met with scorn and derision from the Gales and Max Horton, his wife's former classmate.
When Alan reveals his true identity, no one believes it. But as the Gales finally grasp the truth and shift their attitude, Alan is done being patient. The Gale family tumbles from their pedestal, drowning in regret! For Alan is the secret mastermind behind the world's most powerful conglomerate!

book_title: Fate Reborn: Switched to True Love
special_desc:
In her past life, Samantha married Iain, a penniless man who later rose to wealth and success, while her sister Nina married military officer Evan and went mad after Evan died shortly after their wedding. Blinded by jealousy, Nina killed Samantha and was killed in return.
Now, the sisters are reborn.
This time, Nina plots to steal Iain. But she doesn’t know that Samantha also remembers everything. This time, she's already saved Evan's life and is on her way to an even better future.

Talia Greene's life takes a dramatic twist when the Crown Prince violates her, sparking a burning desire for revenge. Once inside Ylego Palace, her resolve is unshakable: bring down the prince. But when she becomes pregnant with his son—while his other wives remain childless—a bold new plan takes shape. Talia sets her sights on raising her son to become emperor and leaving the prince behind...

book_title: Mind's Eye: From Banishment to Blessing
special_desc: Unexpectedly transported into the body of a five-year-old princess, she faces the threat of being banished to the cold palace. Armed with the "Mind Reading System," she grants her family the power to read minds. In the treacherous court, she cleverly outwits schemers, overcoming numerous challenges to protect her family and ensure the peace of her nation.

book_title: The Love I Could Not Speak
special_desc: For years, Jade Spencer's heart has belonged to Gerard Glover. Yet, Gerard, blinded by his own desires, sees Jade as nothing more than a tool to incite jealousy in the woman he truly loves, Sydney Black. Manipulating Jade, he urges her to draw closer to Philbert Ford, the heir to the Duke of Josville, hoping to disrupt Sydney's impending marriage to Philbert. Disappointed, Jade and Philbert's act turns into reality, and they get married, leaving Gerard full of regret.

After dying in disgrace, Leo Vance wakes up reborn—back to the day Ramona Finch, a pregnant woman, first targeted him on the bus. Last life, he was framed as the father of her twins. This time, he refuses to fall into her traps—yet she hunts him down with fake DNA tests, a forged marriage license, and a twisted public trial. Leo must expose Ramona's web of lies before his life is ruined again.

Reina is a long-lost heiress with a secret: Over the years, she's taken over a mysterious overseas syndicate once controlled by her adoptive father, until he was murdered: The very reason she returns and agrees to a marriage of convenience with Edwin Fletcher. Now she's ready to find the truth, but are the Fletchers entirely innocent?

Wild heiress Yuki Ford marries into the Moores to flip their scheme—only to find Jason Moore faking illness to escape her. But when her counter-move traps him instead, their battle turns explosive… and one kiss could ruin everything.

book_title: By Your Side, I Fear No More
special_desc: Clarissa Ainsworth unexpectedly discovers that Isabelle is not her biological sister, that her real sister, Celeste, was switched at birth and endured years of abuse. Determined to make things right, Clarissa brings the timid Celeste home, helping her establish her identity while navigating Isabelle's numerous schemes. As Clarissa delves deeper into the mystery, she uncovers that her great-uncle Walter is the mastermind behind the sinister switch. Ultimately, she ensures Walter faces justice for his actions.

A young graduate applied for a job as a fashion designer, but the CEO thought she was a marriage candidate his mother sent him. The CEO was thus really picky and mean to her, and they didn't get along. But what he didn't know was that she was actually his online girlfriend...

In order to avoid the election of a concubine, the crown prince took the imperial guard out of the city to suppress the bandits. Unexpectedly, he was attacked by bandits on the way. During the escape, he broke into a dense forest and accidentally time traveled.
She is a simple and ordinary girl who has been living in the antique shop left by her grandfather. Once she went to a mid-level villa to deliver calligraphy and paintings, she bumped into him. He was injured and fainted. After waking up from the hospital, he was shocked by the new world before him. At the same time, his abnormal words and deeds were mistaken by doctors for brain injury and stress disorder. Since his identity information could not be found, she could only take him home to take care of him. From then on, the two were tied together and began a life full of excitement and fun..."

The Female General has always supported her husband, while her father and brother sacrificed their lives in war to save him. Yet, her ungrateful husband not only shows no appreciation but brings another woman home, planning to marry her. Devastated, the General divorces him and begins to turn the tables. Everything she once gave him—career, money—she now demands back, with interest.

book_title: Fate Decides: I'll Give You All
special_desc: Huo Tingyu, the powerful CEO of Yao Ting Group, sees his life change unexpectedly when delivery girl Qiao Menghan spends a night with him by accident. Wanting to protect her, Huo offers her a choice between marriage and financial support.As Menghan joins his company, Huo must handle jealous coworkers like Bai Ruyan and uncover hidden family secrets. With betrayals and challenges at every step, Huo fights to protect his business and his relationship with Menghan. Can he balance love and power, or will the pressures destroy everything?

In a car accident explosion, the mother suffered extensive burns. After treatment and recovery, she returned to her country. The son expressed his filial piety, but was instead accused by his wife of having an affair. The daughter-in-law humiliated the mother-in-law in every possible way, even putting her in a sack. It was not until the mother-in-law’s real identity was revealed that the daughter-in-law regretted her actions. The mother-in-law listened to the confessions of all the perpetrators.

Eloise Bishop, a hardworking worker, unexpectedly got involved in the murder of Kieran Harris by Ophelia Evert. Both were killed by Ophelia, but both were reborn with supernatural abilities with the help of Alfred.
Eloise's ability was an indestructible body and a pitiful fate that she could never escape from poverty. She would cause any valuable thing to explode when she came across it. Kieran was much luckier to read minds.
After their rebirth, they met again after a car accident. Kieran learned everything that happened to Eloise through mind reading and felt guilty, so he took Eloise in and had her work for him. He tolerated Eloise's poverty and bad luck and the troubles it brought, and their relationship warmed up as they got along. They also had many jokes because Kieran's ability and Eloise's inconsistency in her heart caused problems.
However, Ophelia believed that Eloise was blocking her revenge plan and constantly set traps, but they were all solved by Kieran, who could know everything, with Eloise's help. Eventually, Kieran's mother exposed the truth of the past, and Ophelia went insane.
The biggest trouble Ophelia created was Felix Laurent.
Felix's second personality planned a murder and involved Kieran and Eloise in it. But unexpectedly, Eloise defeated all the killers. Felix's first personality discovered that Eloise was very similar to his sister, so his second personality changed its attitude. He constantly competed with Kieran for Eloise's attention and affection. The relationship among the three was constantly strained. The second personality designed one conspiracy after another to take away Eloise, but he found that Eloise would always value Kieran more.
So the psychologically distorted Felix intended to eliminate both of them directly. At the critical moment, Baron Yeats, Felix's mother, and Kieran's mother arrived. The long-forgotten misunderstandings were revealed, and everyone knew the truth, leading to a happy ending.

Luna Evans, framed by her best friend, spent five years in prison. Upon release, her lover Cassius Perez labeled her a traitor. He married Luna for revenge but ended up doting on her. While investigating the truth, Luna received help from her friend Nathan Wood, sparking Cassius' jealousy. And at work, Luna defeated her rivals with her competence. Ultimately, love overcame all, revealing the truth and bringing happiness.

While Baxter Jensen was off studying abroad, his wife, Madge Lynch, was the one footing the bill, keeping him and his family afloat.
Three years later, he finally came back. But instead of a happy reunion, he brought home a stylish woman named Ruby Medina. He told Madge that Ruby was a military instructor and a crack shot, way better than a pathetic housewife.
Heartbroken, Madge divorced her loafer husband. Everyone thought she would fall apart, yet she proved her talent in business, military strategy, and marksmanship. Post-divorce, she was shining brighter than ever!

book_title: The Rise of a Forgotten Hero
special_desc: When Darryl Chase was a kid, foreign invaders wiped out his whole family. Before his father died, he passed down all his power and a token that could summon all martial artists. Darryl, the only survivor of that massacre, turned into a dummy with no memories of the past. Since then, he'd been living in the Logan's Martial Club under the name Darin. Fifteen years later, the foreigners invaded once again. During a fight to protect his loved ones, he finally regained his memory and power. With his family legacy, Darryl was ready to defend his nation, side by side with his crew!

Sophie's boyfriend cheated on her with her half-sister, which broke her heart. Accidentally, she slept with a rich and hot CEO, Tyler Grant. Tyler liked her and pursued her, Sophie couldn't resist this man's charm. As time went, they loved each other deeply and had a lovely child...

At five, Lily has a rare gift, Golden Eyes that can see through anything. Raised in the mountains with her great-grandfather to protect the sacred Heartline, she longs to find her real parents and see the world.
When Darklanders steal seven priceless national treasures and threaten her homeland, Lily sets off on a mission to recover them and discovers her missing father, Alex, a powerful but blinded billionaire. Together, they enter a high-stakes treasure hunt to save both family and country.

Autumn Hall, after being betrayed by Daisy Wood, faces the destruction of her family. Consumed by overwhelming resentment, she awakens the Demon Lord Azure within her. Joining forces with Abyss and Fiume, she seeks revenge. As the gods lay siege, they use dreams to mount a counterattack, reuniting the Three Demon Lords and plunging the divine realm into chaos.

book_title: Reborn: To Tear Off Her Mask
special_desc: In the 1980s, Milo secretly admired the factory director's daughter, Hailey. He even risked everything to save her from losing her virginity, only to be falsely accused of assault, ruining his life. Now, reborn on that fateful day of final reckoning, Milo seeks justice. This time, who else will regret crossing him?

Five years ago, Ralf and Jenna were deeply in love, but a tragic car accident left him gravely injured and Jenna missing. Misled, Ralf was convinced that Jenna was the spy who sabotaged his family business. Now, five years later, Jenna returns to Ralf's city with their son!

She was framed by her colleague and went from being a hotel lobby manager to a janitor. However, she unexpectedly encounters the CEO in disguise, only to later discover that she is the long-lost daughter of the CEO...

book_title: Flash-Married My Ex 8 Years After Breakup
special_desc: Years ago, they met when his mom worked as a maid in her house. Years later, he became a top doctor, and his rich family claimed him back. Meanwhile, her family's financial struggles stopped her from finishing school. She worked multiple jobs to support herself, pay off her parents' debts, and cover her grandmother's medical bills... Circumstances have changed; how will their love evolve?

book_title: Entwined Fates: Echoes in the Ashes
special_desc: Nathaniel and Daphne have been in a relationship for many years. Before they got married, Nathaniel's sister died due to an incident involving Daphne's brother, causing Nathaniel's family to hate Daphne. Nathaniel's mom was super mad and sad, so she drove Daphne away. However, Daphne was already pregnant. Five years later, Daphne returned with her son and met Nathaniel again. Nathaniel still loved Daphne deeply. Despite resenting Daphne for abandoning him, he couldn't help approaching her.

book_title: Why Work Hard When Heaven Sends You a Miracle Son?
special_desc: Tian, an ordinary small-town guy, had a fleeting romance with a saintess from the legendary Heavenly Mountain . Fast forward eight years, and Qiangqiang, their now eight-year-old son, descends from the mountaintop to find his long-lost dad. Armed with jaw-dropping superpowers and big plans to turn their lives around, Qiangqiang discovers Tian working himself to the bone hauling bricks at a construction site. Determined to use his magic to make them rich and successful.

book_title: Rise of the Fallen: Ascend to Immortality
special_desc: Fifteen years ago, the Jiang family was annihilated. To protect the family's priceless heirloom, Jiang Chen's mother, Shen Yueshu, placed it on him, diverting the assassins and causing her to fall off a cliff. Fifteen years later, Jiang Chen has become an unparalleled master. When he learns that his mother is not dead and is about to remarry, he eagerly attends the wedding. However, he is horrified to discover that the woman at the ceremony is nothing more than a lifeless corpse.

book_title: My Landlord is Actually the Strongest!
special_desc:
Ethan Lehman owns Unit No. 8 in Shroomville, living off the rent, unaware that his unit is perfect for cultivation. His three tenants—Eve Nicol, Lori Crimson, Dahlia Kemp, and Kylie Crowell—are not ordinary people. Eve, Lori, and Dahlia are former fighters with dark pasts, while Kylie is the daughter of the world's wealthiest tycoon. When Obsidian Corp targets the unit for demolition, Ethan’s life changes forever. His tenants know Ethan is a powerful cultivator—he just doesn’t realize it yet. As they fend off Obsidian Corp, Ethan accidentally defeats their operatives in amusing ways. Kylie then reveals she’s his fiancée and has been secretly observing him. To fight back, Kylie takes Ethan to Azure Sect tournament, where he unexpectedly unleashes his power, winning first place and attracting more attention from Obsidian Corp.

Ethan’s father forces him to confront his true strength, and on the day of his wedding to Kylie, the mastermind behind Obsidian Corp challenges him. Ethan awakens his full potential, defeating all enemies and bringing peace, finally starting a happy life with Kylie.

Noname actress Aria Lynch married Shawn Group CEO Charles Shawn for her family but later asked for a divorce after a one-night-stand pregnancy. Six years later, Charles found out Aria's daughter Nina was his own blood and looked all over town for her whereabouts. Charles saved Aria and Nina from getting bullied at a film set but couldn't tell little Nina was the daughter he'd been looking for. At the birthday party Charles's mom organized for Nina, they finally found out Aria was Charles's ex-wife. Charles got down on his knee to propose to a pregnant Aria, this time with twins.

Tyler Hayden was raised poor, even though his parents were super rich. After college, his girlfriend, Nicky Linden, dumped him to join Sky Corp and teamed up with Felix Clark to go against him. On his first day of work, Tyler helped Mrs. Owen and somehow ended up in a quick marriage with her granddaughter, Maeve Owen, the CEO of Sky Corp. Tyler felt he was not good enough for her and wanted a divorce, but over time, he overcame his insecurities. Later, his dad told him the truth. His family was rich too. But by then, Tyler had already learned that love was not about money.

In her first life, Sherry trapped Ethan into marriage only to find herself abandoned, miserable, and dying with regret. Now, she wakes up forty years earlier, on the very day she gave up her college dreams to marry him. This time, she tears up the form, takes control of her destiny, and sets out to live the life she was meant for.

Keira West is coerced into marrying Clyde Irving, with her mother's well-being held as leverage. Neglected by her husband, Keira finds herself entangled with his uncle, William, the true power behind the family. But as their forbidden relationship deepens, can she build a future with this man, or will their love bury them alive?

When Evelyn Hewitt, a general from hundreds of years ago, wakes up as modern-day heiress and stepmom to rebellious Killian Foster, she brings battlefield tactics to household wars. Armed with pressure points and a fierce spirit, she must tame her spoiled stepson, navigate a marriage of convenience with CEO Stephen Foster—who shares the face of her lost love—and conquer high society’s doubts. This time, her empire is the Foster family.

As a child, Victoria nearly died in the freezing streets. It was Arthur Hope who saved her and adopted her. Years later, she reinvented herself abroad as Phoenix. But her world is shattered when she receives the heartbreaking news of Arthur's passing. Determined to pay her respects, she returns home, only to be confronted by spiteful uncles and ungrateful siblings. Finally, Victoria decides it's time to end this charade once and for all.

book_title: Shattered Dreams: A Daughter's Fight for Justice
special_desc:
Born in a feudal and isolated mountain village, she and her mother depended on each other after her father's death. Upon learning that she had won first prize in a global physics competition, they began to dream of a bright future. However, her uncle's family came to threaten and humiliate them, demanding money and forcing her to marry a fool. During the argument, her mother died from the stress.
Fortunately, on the way to her forced marriage, she was rescued by the governor, who took her out of the mountains and provided her with a substantial scholarship to attend her dream university. After years of hard work, she finally became a company CEO. Returning to her hometown in glory, she punished the wrongdoers and transformed the village, alleviating its isolation and poverty, and ensuring that the children there could receive an education.

As the only heir to a unique bloodline with supernatural abilities, she unexpectedly became the mother of four extraordinary children. However, a dark force tore them away from her at birth. Six years later, the children, using their powers, escape from a secret lab and find their way back to her. Together, they courageously protect their mother from constant attacks by the villains. In the end, they reunite with their father, reclaim their family estate, and are finally able to live happily together as a family.

book_title: On the Verge of Love's Truth
special_desc: Seven years after leaving with his child, she returned to him, desperate to save their leukemia-stricken daughter. To afford the treatment, she endured his constant humiliation, even as he wrestled with conflicting feelings of love and hatred. Their tangled relationship deepened, and the truth about what had driven them apart began to emerge.

book_title: After Divorced, He Finally Saw Me
special_desc: She was a legendary pop diva who vanished for seven years after announcing her sudden retirement. During that time, she found her long-lost childhood sweetheart, now blind after a car accident. She cared for him, but once he regained his sight, he returned to his first love. Realizing it was time to move on, she left him and made her comeback on stage. At her concert, a video of her singing made him realize—his wife was the girl he had been searching for all along.

book_title: Rejected to Renowned: The Chef Queen Comes Back
special_desc: She is a gifted young chef but overlooked by her family due to being a girl. Undeterred, she becomes a renowned chef through self-learning and secret mentorship. After leaving home, she is mentored by a culinary master and rises to the top. Returning to help her family in crisis, she is rejected by her relatives for being a woman. To prove her worth, she holds a grand feast, only to face challenges and provocations from foreign rivals, leading to a battle for honor that will determine her fate, her family’s legacy, and the country’s pride.

A modern culinary competition contestant unexpectedly travels back in time to become a princess. In the royal mansion, she garners attention with her exquisite cooking skills and develops feelings with the prince from misunderstandings. The princess leaves the royal mansion after being framed, and later shines with her culinary talents. Can she overcome others to become the head chef? Meanwhile, another man also has feelings for her, will this affect her relationship with the prince? Stay tuned.

The heroine marries a man in a coma to cure her grandmother. He wakes up on his wedding night and drives her away. She leaves pregnant and works hard to survive. Afterward, the man is attracted to her and pursues her, not realizing she is his wife. When she is about to give birth, they discover the truth. He realizes his love and supports her through the childbirth.

Reborn warrior queen Victoria, bound to a life-for-love system, must seduce four consorts—a defiant prince, a cunning strategist, a vengeful heir, and her loyal shadow—to survive Your Majesty’s lethal schemes. But as fake affections spark real fire, she rebels against fate: forging rebel merchants into armies, trading empires with commerce, and rewriting the system’s rules. Can a weaponized heart crown her as empire-shaper… or doom her as its martyr?

James Bennett suffered amnesia after a car accident, retaining only 5-year-old memories. His passionate pursuit of Claire Reynolds shifted to hesitation after regaining memories. Claire, Ascend Corp's president, battled the Cooper family. James' ex-lover Vanessa Cooper sabotaged their marriage & hired thugs to harm Claire, landing jailed. Despite turmoil—misunderstandings, a rushed wedding & pregnancy—they reconciled & began anew.

Set in an imagined world of Eastern fantasy, the story follows a young man of humble origins who refuses to bow to fate. Faced with endless trials, he rises from obscurity, driven by resilience and an unyielding will to grow stronger and carve out his own destiny.

book_title: Oops,  I Snagged the Starlet's Role
special_desc: Rising star model Nina Smith faces a career-ending ban, but her devoted boyfriend stands by her side. In gratitude, she pours her heart into helping him achieve success. However, on the eve of their marriage registration, she discovers him cheating with her best friend in their new home. Heartbroken, she impulsively marries a stranger and vows to reclaim everything that is rightfully hers.

Harold Lee is the sole apprentice of the legendary healer, Alban Barnes. After the tragic murder of his wife and child, Barnes goes into hiding, assuming the guise of a humble veterinarian. In secrecy, he passes on a mysterious manuscript to Harold—"The Book of Beasts".

Karol Sowle was born into a rural family. At 18, she married Joseph Lee, a young intellectual, and followed him to the city. However, Joseph's family scorned her humble origins and subjected her to constant mistreatment. Unable to endure it any longer, Karol left and met Theo Lipsey, a disabled veteran. With Theo's support, Karol pursued education, honed her sewing skills, and eventually founded her own clothing factory. Meanwhile, under her devoted care, Theo's legs gradually healed.

Finn, a kid haunted by the demon Mota, is raised by Damian Lowell. With his senior, Elara, he hunts supernatural threats—until a ratfolk's conspiracy and a warlord's bloody crusade force him to confront his destiny. As the Blood Moon rises, will Finn save the world… or destroy it?

Three years after their last encounter, Eva Frost's first words to Timothy Moore are: "Let's Get Married, Mr. CEO"...
Betrayed by the boyfriend she had bankrolled for years, who deceived her out of their marital home, Eva decides to move forward and blurts out the unexpected. To her surprise, Timothy clings to her at the marriage office, declaring, "I never said I wouldn't agree".

In a past life, Beatrice was utterly betrayed. After being reborn, she publicly exposes her fiancé's hypocrisy and turns to collaborate with the wildest member of the Sterling family. "Shall we cooperate, Sebastian Sterling?" she proposes, only to be unexpectedly outmaneuvered. "I want to be your devoted ally!" From then on, the lofty heir of the Sterling family bows only to her...

book_title: Secretly Hooked Up with the Blind Prince
special_desc: Jennet Nelson, a wealthy heiress, will do anything to protect her fortune—even seduce a blind stranger to have his child. But the man she chose, Jeffrey Dunn, is not who he seems. He's the regent of the kingdom, and when his sight returns, he'll stop at nothing to find the woman who deceived him. Three years later, Jennet returns with a daughter and a secret. What began as a cold-hearted scheme becomes a dangerous game of love, lies, and legacy.

book_title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith: Pretending to Be CEO‘s Penniless Lover
special_desc: I married my penniless husband whom I have loved for many years, but it seems that he found out that I am not an ordinary hotel waiter? He is not an ordinary security guard?!

book_title: The Broken Me Met Him Again
special_desc: Bullied and forced to break up with her first love, she spiraled into pain, ending up in a mental hospital where she gave birth to a daughter. Five years later, struggling to survive with her daughter, the people who once tormented her return. After leaving her, her first love became a renowned lawyer. When they accidentally meet on the street, can they rekindle their lost love?

book_title: The New Intern is the CEO's Spoiled Wife
special_desc: After a one-night stand with a stranger, she raised twins on her own while attending college. On her first day after graduation, she’s hired by a major company, only to discover that the CEO is the father of her children. Unbeknownst to her, he has been searching for her for years, but has failed to find her.

After being thrust into a tragic novel as the female lead—someone everyone is determined to torment—just recalling the plot makes her blood boil. She vows that if anyone dares to bully her, she’ll smash their “dog head” without hesitation.

After a one-night stand, the woman’s sister steals her identity. Six years later, she becomes the CEO’s legal advisor, and they grow close. The sister, fearing exposure, tries to sabotage her, but the CEO thwarts each attempt. In the end, the truth is revealed, and the CEO’s family reunites.

After a chance encounter, tycoon Gavin becomes infatuated with recent graduate Faye. However, Faye despises him because her father died due to a business conflict initiated by Gavin. This leads to a tense cat-and-mouse game between the two of them. Ultimately, Gavin forces Faye into marriage, and despite her attempts to push him away, she gradually falls for him...

Selena Quinn was falsely accused of murdering her sister-in-law Grace Wallace on her wedding day, jailed, and gave birth to Emily. Years later, Emily reunited with father Ethan but suffered abuse from his obsessive admirer Melissa Dawson. Emily discovered her mother Selena (alias Scarlett Pierce), and together they uncovered proof that Melissa murdered Grace. Melissa kidnapped Emily. Selena agreed to her demands, but Melissa plotted to kill them. Ethan rescued them just in time.

Poisoned by her husband, she is reborn at the brink of death. This time, she will not be a victim. She will settle every score they own her, unraveling secrets and reclaiming her life in a world of deceit and power struggles.

book_title: After the Divorce, She Takes It All
special_desc: Deeply in love with her husband, Dane, Veronica gave him everything and became a housewife. In return, she was cheated on and brutally murdered by the love of her life. Now reborn back to a year ago, she chooses to return to the legal world and use her future vision for revenge. This time, she sees Dane for who he truly is: a good-for-nothing cheat.

Caroline Winsor, once a pawn in her mother's quest for luxury, is betrothed to the controlling tycoon Dominic. On the day of their grand wedding, she decides to escape, only to find herself in the thrilling world of underground racing, ruled by the enigmatic Wyatt. Unbeknownst to all, this icy racer harbors a secret identity. What could happen between a fallen heiress and a street racer?

Hailey's father adopted three boys from the orphanage - the Miller brothers, who showered her with endless love and care. She even thought she would end up with one of them. But everything changed when the maid's daughter, Blair, came. They robbed Hailey's family fortune and her life. Now reborn, Hailey chooses to punish the Miller brothers and allies with the one person they fear. This time, the Miller brothers' world is going to shatter.

book_title: Little Guardian? No, That’s My Big Boss!
special_desc: The ice-cold CEO Chris Preston finds himself in danger due to corporate rivalries. Desperate and with nowhere to turn, he is introduced to a legendary master, only to discover she is a six-year-old girl named Momo who needs hugs and ice cream. Standing no taller than his knee and clutching a worn-out doll, Momo seems out of place. However, when she effortlessly takes down top assassins with a lollipop and her bunny doll, Chris is forced to accept this absurd reality...

"I hope my child stays away from disputes and lives a normal life." 
Fifteen years ago, as a top agent, I retired from the field and became a low-key barbecue stall owner. But my simple wish as a mother didn't come true. 
When my daughter was bullied at school, I was furious. How dare anyone bully her under my watch!
The harm inflicted on my daughter, I will make each of you pay for it, one by one...

book_title: The Inverted Lives of Two Swapped Children
special_desc: After being swapped by her birth mother, who favored boys over girls, she went from being a heiress to a poor girl. By chance, she crossed paths with the fake heir who wanted to kill her for wealth and status after learning their true identities. With danger looming, how will she face it?

On his wedding day, the heir to Jiangcheng’s wealthiest family gives up everything to save his fiancée, only to be framed and killed. Granted seven days to exact revenge and achieve true rebirth—alongside his also-reborn childhood sweetheart—He vows to protect his loved ones and crush those who conspired against him.

A three-and-a-half-year-old girl was forced to tell fortunes on a city overpass to earn money for her abusive uncle and aunt, who beat her mercilessly and nearly sold her to human traffickers. At the critical moment, her young uncle—a professional race car driver—swooped in to rescue her. From that moment on, her four extraordinarily accomplished uncles launched a full-scale campaign to pamper their niece and exact revenge. The youngest uncle vowed to make the villains "pay tenfold"; the third uncle, a triple-crown-winning actor, began leveraging his massive fanbase to expose their crimes; the second uncle, a scientific genius, plotted to make their lives "a living hell"; while the eldest uncle, a ruthless tycoon, threatened to ship them off to Africa to mine coal. When the girl finally returned home, her grandfather wept joyful tears, her grandmother miraculously recovered from a chronic illness, her cousins beamed with pride, and her enigmatic clan-leader father proceeded to spoil her beyond imagination.

Gwen Goodall mistook Genzo Storey for her savior and went all out to help him win the crown, but he repaid her with betrayal and slaughtered her whole family. After jumping to her death, Gwen found herself back to three years ago! Determined to rewrite fate, she sought out the deposed Crown Prince Eugene. While helping him reclaim the throne, she uncovered a shocking truth—Eugene was her true savior! Now, Gwen was ready to turn the tables and make her enemies pay!

Elaine Kelly donated her marrow to save her neglecting father James Chapman, but became too ill and died full of regrets. She was reborn and was determined to take control of her own fate this time. Elaine attended an audition and landed the leading role, beating her half-sister Rachel. Conflict ensued at the audition, leading Elaine to want to leave her dad to live with her new manager, Tracy Ford. It was only then that James started to show more concern towards Elaine. The pair gradually resolved past misunderstandings and started their new happy life.

book_title: Back to the Ring: My KO Mom
special_desc: In Back to the Ring My KO Mom movie, the boxing queen, Tanya Boyle, retires at the peak of her career for love. Unknown to all, Tanya marries Wesley Thomas and devotes herself to looking after the family. Unfortunately, she gets stomach cancer. So, Wesley’s mother introduces a lady to Wesley. Tanya is heartbroken but offers her blessings. After being reborn, Tanya cherishes her health and fights for happiness. But she ends up divorcing Wesley. Then, Tanya rebuilds her life and returns to boxing. At this time, she discovers Wesley’s new girlfriend, Yolanda Lopez, is lying about being the boxing queen. So, Tanya decides to regain her glory. Wesley looks down upon Tanya when fighting her. He even persuades her to quit the game. However, Tanya ignores Wesley and defeats him. Wesley is shocked, and everyone finds out Tanya is the boxing queen. Wesley regrets losing his idol. But Tanya has changed a lot. She only wants to live her life.

book_title: 8 Years Wasted: Now Payback Time, My Ex!
special_desc: For eight years, Deron Crane, heir to Crane Corp, devoted himself to Beth Hart, fulfilling her every wish. Little did he know, Beth conspired with his brother, Odin Crane, leading to his untimely demise. Reborn with a second chance, Deron awakens to the truth, cutting all ties with Beth and embarking on a journey to find his true love.

A modern screenwriter finds herself transported into her own script, becoming the notorious villainess. The original character had tormented the future antagonist into a "fragile" guy! To survive, she switches to "pampering" mode, instantly transforming into a devoted husband-loving fanatic!

Abigail has been kept hidden away by her uncle Victor, who sees her as a harbinger of misfortune. Desperate to revive his failing business, Victor plans to use her as a pawn in his schemes. Trapped like a puppet, Abigail sees no escape. However, the arrival of Adrian brings a glimmer of hope and the possibility of change.

book_title: Pampered by My Silver Fox Uncle
special_desc: On her coming-of-age day, Princess Lia Torres of the Phoen Dynasty finds her soul transported into the body of an 8-year-old girl in the modern world. This girl, deprived of love by an imposter daughter, met a tragic end through neglect. Fueled by indignation, Lia takes on a new life with a disrespected father who is scorned by all.

book_title: The Weak Scholar Who Would Rule
special_desc: Forced to abandon his martial path for a scholarly life, Sean was betrayed by his fiancée, Luna. Her harsh words, "My husband must be a general, not a weak scholar!" ignite a fire in him. With his dignity shattered, Sean vows revenge. Leaving the scholar's life behind, he rises from the ashes to conquer the land and reclaim his destiny as a legendary general. No one can stop the man who's destined to rule.

A girl, pregnant and accompanied by her four brothers, searches for her boyfriend. After a misunderstanding about his infidelity, she gets into a car accident and is found by a boy. Boy  thinks he's found a beautiful woman, but ends up becoming a father. When Baby is three and a half, the girl dies of an illness. Later, at kindergarten, Baby is bullied by girl\r, who claims to be the daughter of the Pei family, until Baby's uncle finds him and starts to stand up to everyone.

book_title: Three Days to Fall For A Guy
special_desc: After catching her fiancé cheating with her half-sister, Zoey spent one night with this man Jarvis. Is it just a fling, or the beginning of a romance? How would she fall for a guy in three days?

When Joy Sarratt saves the impoverished Robin Ward, their bond seems unbreakable. Yet, Robin's ascent to the top of the imperial exams catapults him into the heart of the capital—and into the arms of Mia Love, the influential duke's daughter. As Mia steps into Robin's life, Joy is thrust into a world of betrayal, enduring relentless humiliation and mistreatment.

After eighteen years away, Sara returns to the powerful Graham family, only to be framed by her scheming adoptive sister and dismissed as a country bumpkin. But beneath her humble facade hides a world-class violinist, a luxury jewelry designer, and a gifted healer. When her ex-fiancé Jonathan discovers the truth, he realizes the woman he cast aside was the one he was destined to love all along.
He found himself stranded on a deserted island with two alluring women. With survival skills in his hands, he gradually won over the beautiful women who initially looked down on him.

She was born into a wealthy family but got separated from her CEO mother by accident. Years later, a girl impersonated her and became the family's heiress. When they met again as adults, she became the target of the fake heiress's bullying, and her own mother didn't recognize her. After losing her adoptive mother because of the fake heiress, she hated her biological mother. Then the CEO discovered that the real daughter she had been mistreating all along was her.

Eighteen years ago, due to a car accident, the third daughter of a big family lost a significant amount of blood while trying to save her brother, leaving her on the brink of death. In a cruel act of favoritism towards males, her grand heartlessly abandoned her on a stormy night. Just as her life was counting down to its final moments, a kind-hearted scavenger discovered her. Unable to bear the thought of such a young life being extinguished, he made every effort to save her and gave her a new name. Although life was very tough, for the brave girl, love was always within reach. So how will her life go along?

book_title: The Girl Who Stole the Billionaire's Heart
special_desc: Before meeting the girl, the boy was not interested in women. After a night of passion with the girl, which resulted in her pregnancy, he took responsibility by bringing her home to care for her. Gradually, he began to understand, like, and pamper her. The girl, in turn, fell in love with the boy during their time together.

A wealthy heiress’s mother committed suicide due to her father’s infidelity. The woman her father had an affair with became pregnant and then gave birth to a child. She framed the heiress, which led to her father sending her abroad to study. Because of the mischief of her father’s mistress, the heiress had a very hard life overseas. By coincidence, the heiress met the male lead and had a one-night stand. Their relationship warmed up. With the help of the male lead, the heiress returned to her home country and began her path of revenge.

book_title: The Card Shark Who Plays for Good
special_desc: After years away from home and just donating his entire fortune to charities, global no. 1 gamester Dylan Lynn returned home with his big sister Jane. There he reunited with his two elder sisters, Bella and Sarah, and met his adopted brother Liam. Right away, Liam started plotting to kick Dylan out. At their casino, Dylan won a match against Leon Dunn, also known as the Lightning Hands, and saved the family business. Jane later found out Liam was working with Leon and was killed by him. Dylan swore then to bring his sister's killer to justice. He went on to win matches against Liam's biological brother James Fenn and the owner of Stormhold Hotel, getting back a crucial biochip for his country in the process. Finally, after bringing evildoers to justice, Dylan and his wife spent their honeymoon helping victims of gambling kickstart their new lives...

book_title: Fate's Redo: I Quit Loving You
special_desc: On her birthday, Claire faced a double blow: her boyfriend of four years, Ethan secretly got married to his long-time crush, Natalie. After being abandoned by Ethan, Claire was involved in a car accident. At the brink of life and death, she traded her emotional ties for a chance at rebirth, losing the ability to love in the process. In her new life, she decided to let go of her infatuation with Ethan completely, accepted a family-arranged marriage, and married the playboy Lucas, embarking on a new chapter of her life.

Flora Hayes led a simple, happy life until a tragic car accident abruptly ended it. But in her final breath, she didn't see her past. She saw a devastating future for her children, twenty years later. Miraculously, she awakens in that very future, determined to change their fate.

Charles was just a delivery guy until a car accident with powerful CEO Wendy changed everything. The crash awakened a strange ability: he can now see the countdown of everyone’s remaining life. When Charles saves Wendy from a deadly fate, his own life spins out of control. He discovers his wife's betrayal and faces humiliation. But from that moment on, the tables turn. With his newfound power, Charles rises from the ashes, exposing lies, avenging the past, and rewriting his destiny.

book_title: Divorced, Pursued by a Big Shot
special_desc: She was originally an heiress, but married him, a man with nothing, just because he saved her life. She concealed her identity, secretly helping him to start from scratch, only to be abandoned by him. After their divorce, she no longer hides her identity and is pursued madly by a big shot.

book_title: Mommy, Quick! Daddy's Hot on Our Trail!
special_desc: A one-night stand years ago made her a single mom. Moving back to her old city, she hopes to start fresh with her son. At the airport, her son hands a business card to a stranger, asking him to be his dad. To her shock, the stranger is the man from that one-night stand!

book_title: Your Unwanted Mother Is My Treasure
special_desc:
She has spent years toiling and selling blood to support her son in finishing school and obtaining a successful career. After a decade, She travels to the city to visit her son's family, only to be met with disdain and rejection from the son and his wife, who look down on her rural background. 
Just when things seem dire, a person she saved years ago, recognizes her and offers his support. With his help, she stands up to her son and his family, but will her son be led to a profound realization and heartfelt regret?

book_title: Return to Reckon with His Hateful Village
special_desc: Drama also known as Nobody Wants Him; In a small village divided by strict rules, a young man from the lower village fell in love with his childhood friend from the upper village. Unfortunately, their romance was discovered, leading to a community-wide meeting to judge him.

She was the biological daughter who had been lost for many years, but after being taken back from the orphanage, she was constantly overlooked and even abused by her family due to the manipulations and schemes of the adopted daughter. This led to her developing a stomach illness that eventually worsened into stomach cancer, and even on her deathbed, she was accused of faking her illness. Fortunately, she was given a second chance at life. This time, she chose to cut ties with her family quickly and used her own abilities to build a successful career, ultimately taking revenge on the malicious adopted daughter. Meanwhile, she also reunited with the company's CEO, who was her childhood friend from the orphanage, and they fell in love, experiencing a perfect romance.

book_title: Spoiled by My CEO Husband and Cute Twins
special_desc: Six years ago, the woman had sex with the president by mistake, and one of the children she gave birth to was taken away. Six years later, the woman went to the wrong table during a blind date, and mistakenly thought that the president who was looking for a nanny was her blind date. At the same time, the president's son ran out and hugged the woman's thigh and started calling her mom...?

Twenty years ago, Min Rou was gravely ill, and her husband tragically died in an accident. With no other options, she was forced to abandon her son, Zhao Han, at the doorstep of the affluent Zhao family, hoping that they would adopt him. Twenty years later, Zhao Han graduates with a PhD from a top university and is honored as a chief academician of the National Academy of Sciences. He participates in a family-searching program to find his mother…

After being betrayed by her unfaithful boyfriend, the stunning director Nina Xavier devises a bold plan for revenge. She sets her sights on his older cousin, determined to rise above and crush him with her newfound identity. Little does she know, the man she pursues, Drew Ford, is none other than a legendary figure in the medical field, known as “The Legendary Drew.” Once she steps into his world, there’s no escape.

Elbert Weiss had a dream where a criminal shot him in the head. At first, he brushed it off as just a nightmare, but the reality proved him wrong. Just when he felt helpless, a mysterious simulation system appeared, guiding him through countless life-threatening situations. When a courageous railway officer sacrificed his life, Elbert finally stopped being a coward. With newfound courage and sharp intellect, Elbert took control, outsmarting the criminals and bringing them to justice, saving everyone on board.

A dance that spans millennia, weaving together two lifetimes of love and trials.
In ancient times, the courtesan Lana Smith was betrayed by a heartless lover. 
Reborn in the modern era as a frail girl with cancer, she must gather a hefty sum for surgery. Forced to become a servant for the Harvey family, she sets her sights on winning over Douglas Harvey, heir to a conglomerate.
Douglas, wary of love and devoted to a life of solitude, finds himself overwhelmed by Lana's strategic retreat and captivating dance. 

Her relentless pursuit and feigned vulnerability begin to crumble his defenses. 

As Lana enters the game, believing herself clear-headed, Douglas's restraint and sincerity shake her resolve. 

High society schemes, betrayals, and life-threatening crises arise, with their disparate statuses standing between them. Lana, a wild rose struggling through the mire, refuses to be anyone's "kept woman." 

After three years, she returns triumphantly as a lead dancer, meeting Douglas at the top.
As the prayer beads fall, love grows wild.

Will this time allow her a lifetime of love with him?

Six years ago, Emma was set up and ended up spending the night with Simon and giving birth to quintuplets. Now, she returns with her five kids to take revenge. But when her youngest daughter, Minnie, runs off to find her birth father and ask for a better name, Emma's plan goes awry. When trying to find Minnie, she accidentally becomes Simon's assistant and walks right back into his life.

book_title: Reborn to Ruin You, My DEAR Hubby
special_desc:
Stella, the forgotten wife, was left in the countryside while her husband, Joshua, brought his sister-in-law to the city, claiming it was to avoid gossip. He wrote Stella sweet letters every month, but gave all his military pay to his sister-in-law.
During a famine, while Joshua's sister-in-law and her children dined on meat buns in his city mansion, Stella and her child starved to death.
But death wasn't the end. Stella is reborn, and this time, she's not playing the obedient wife.

Once a heavenly spirit of fortune, Ivory is reborn as a princess, only to be cast aside by her own father. Saved by a disgraced prince, she uses her gift to turn misfortune into blessing, heal the wounded, and uncover her true identity. When a false "blessed girl" steals her name, Ivory must rise again, defying fate to reclaim her destiny and the love that was meant to be hers.

book_title: My Backup Husband is a Tycoon
special_desc: On Fiona's wedding day, both she and her sister Amber are reborn, but Amber seizes the chance to steal Fiona's wealthy groom, Leo Lynch, leaving Fiona to marry the seemingly poor security guard, Noah Porter. Fiona, aware of the Lynch family's deceptive allure, embraces her new path in search of tranquility. Yet, Noah's enigmatic background earns him the respect of powerful business figures. Meanwhile, Amber's dream of a luxurious life crumbles as her husband is unfaithful, leading her to pursue the affluent Porter family, only to find a shocking resemblance between their heir and Noah.

book_title: Daddy, You Passed! Time for Hugs!
special_desc: Four years ago, ancient dragon Caden saved Selena's life and spent one unforgettable night of passion with her before vanishing. Now, Selena returns with five adorable dragon babies, and Caden, now a powerful CEO, discovers he's their father!

To escape her father's control, actress Aurora hastily marries Landon, agreeing to maintain distance for six months. However, fate intervenes, drawing them back together. Aurora uses Landon for her roles, while he mistakenly thinks she's fallen for him. As genuine feelings start to surface, her ex reappears, igniting his jealousy and revealing her manipulation. In a fit of anger, he declares to the world, "This is my wife—who dares to touch her!"

Bonnie was born into wealth and privilege, but thanks to Isabel’s schemes, she married the wrong man, suffering disfigurement, betrayal, and the ruin of her family. Reborn, she quietly sets her sights on the seemingly lowly adopted son of the Nail family. Only she knows that this boy, now overlooked, is destined for greatness. Power, wealth, and influence await him.

book_title: Badass Bodyguard and His Stunner CEO Wife
special_desc: Concealing his true identity, he assumed the role of a security guard to protect his stunning CEO wife. Shielding her and handling her rivals, he also navigates company crises for her. As time passes, he finally captures the heart of his contracted CEO wife...

book_title: Secret Heiress's Flash Marriage with the CEO
special_desc:
Secret Heiress's Flash Marriage with the CEO movie summary takes us on an adventure of Bella Willis who's married to Andy by keeping her real identity as an heiress a secret.
Bella helps Andy to succeed when he was a nobody but when Andy asks for a divorce upon reaching success.
Bella decides to reveal her identity as she marries Ward Tenny,a billionaire in a flash marriage.

book_title: Black Myth: My Master is Wukong
special_desc:
Black Myth: My Master is Wukong is the epic Fantasy Adventure we need.
Perfect. In ancient China, a young disciple discovers his master is the legendary Monkey King, Wukong. Together, they battle demons, gods, and destiny. Think “Journey to the West” meets “The Matrix”. Get ready for action-packed fights, mind-blowing visuals, and a legendary tale of loyalty and power!

After being kidnapped, you were adopted and given a new name, enduring hardships before finally being found. Regaining your status, you are not letting go of your ex-husband! To uncover the truth, you concealed your identity and joined your ex-husband's company. Someone stole your identity, and you are being bullied. But you preserved! You are determined to uncover the truth. You know what? You succeeded and became the new CEO!

She originally pretended to be deaf and mute for the male lead, but ended up being despised by him. When her true identity is revealed, how will she handle this imbalanced love, and will she be able to start a new life?

book_title: The Working Life of the CEO's Wife
special_desc: I helped an elderly lady I ran into at the supermarket, not realizing her son was the CEO! She gifted me a ring symbolizing the CEO's wife. I hid my identity and continued working in his company as a janitor, but I soon faced constant bullying from other employees. Ultimately, I decided to bravely reveal my true identity and face the challenges ahead…

book_title: I Gave My wife A Red Tasseled Spear
special_desc: After three years on the battlefield, the wife returns victorious, but unexpectedly pregnant! I Gave My wife A Red Tasseled Spear Full Movie tells that the former Grand Marshal of the empire's army had retired due to his parents' last wishes and married a woman known for her bravery and ambition. She aspired to achieve greatness on the battlefield, and before she left, he gifted her a legendary spear forged from thousand-year-old cold iron. Three years later, she returns clad in silver armor, pregnant, and holding another man's hand. She presents a letter of divorce, declaring, "My husband must be a heroic figure who stands tall, not a weak scholar with no strength." Unbeknownst to her, the seemingly powerless man she had married was actually the empire’s guardian deity.
