When he dons his marshal armor once again and takes up his legendary weapon, she finally realizes the true identity of the man she once scorned.

book_title: My Four Sisters Beg Me to Come Home After Cutting Ties
special_desc: In his past life, he was ignored by his family and betrayed by his brother, leading to his death. Heartbroken before his end, he wakes up on his birthday ten years earlier. As his sister finally enters his room, she discovers the miserable life he endured as the family's overlooked prince. Unfortunately, he has long lost hope in them.

Song Ling comes from a family with a severe preference for male children. To save her mute daughter, Wang Xiaoxing, she resorts to a desperate measure known as "dragon-to-phoenix transformation." However, an unexpected accident involving a nurse leads to Wang Xiaoxing being found and raised by a commoner named Wang Jianguo. Years later, Wang Jianguo's niece, Wang Yunxing, impersonates Wang Xiaoxing and frames their adoptive father. Determined to save her critically ill father, Wang Xiaoxing relentlessly strives to expose her cousin's true identity and reclaim her rightful place within her family.

A couple who have been married for 35 years. On the husband’s 60th birthday banquet, the wife discovers evidence of her husband’s infidelity that has been going on for 25 years. It is then that the wife realizes that after a lifetime of hard work and dedication, all she has received in return is betrayal. Consequently, the wife decides to expose his true face at her husband’s 60th birthday banquet…

Just as Charlotte was celebrating her fifth wedding anniversary with her husband Seth, her half-sister Lilith jumped out of nowhere. She demanded Charlotte to give back her fiance and shocked everyone present. In a fit of rage, Lilith pushed Charlotte to the ground and caused her miscarriage. But instead of taking Charlotte to the hospital, Seth carried Lilith up and left. Only then did Charlotte realize that her love had always been one-sided. And that it had never been responded.
Now, she's made up her mind and demands a divorce.

Dr. Heal was attacked. The assassins forced him to give them Compendium of Medicine. Dr. Heal sealed his soul in a compass. The chosen one would open it with his blood and inherit all Dr. Heal's medical skills...

book_title: The Rise of a Country Belle
special_desc: Layla Granger, a rural woman, became pregnant after a one-night stand with CEO Asher Roland. At her son's wedding, Asher protected her from bullies. Pursuing her dream at a media company, Layla faced identity theft by Raina Grand but overcame challenges to win the singing competition. She later gave birth safely, earning everyone's respect.

book_title: Cleared for Takeoff: Love Left on the Runway
special_desc: Selene Pearce, the daughter of Yonder Airlines’ chairman, gives up her dream of becoming a pilot to support her husband, Harvey Moore, as an air traffic controller. Seven years later, she uncovers his affair with flight attendant Stacy Judd. Amidst battling stomach cancer, Selene refuses treatment and continues to work, even as Harvey demands a divorce. Realizing she’s sacrificed herself for him, she agrees to the divorce and returns to her family. Harvey, now realizing how much he relied on her, regrets his actions. However, Selene has already moved on, leaving him to face a forgiveness that may never come.

book_title: Timeless Vendetta: General, I Don’t Love You Anymore
special_desc: Noelle Lane, a supermarket owner, unknowingly saves General Sebastian Camden of Devain and discovers a portal linking her store to an ancient era. Using modern resources, she helps him become the legendary God of War and starts a family with him—only to be executed by their own son. Reborn with memories of her tragic fate, Noelle witnesses Sebastian’s betrayal and Jasmine Shaw’s control over their son. Refusing to suffer again, she demolishes her supermarket, destroys the portal, and claims her compensation—ready to live on her own terms.

After a whirlwind marriage to Avery Yale, Blake Lander hides his true identity as a wealthy CEO, mistakenly believing Avery to be a gold-digger. Struggling through a difficult life, Avery faces bullying at work and betrayal by her family, whom she once trusted. Fortunately, Blake is always there to protect her from harm, forging a deep connection between them as they gradually fall in love. However, when Blake's real identity is revealed, a misunderstanding creates a rift in their relationship, which can only be healed when the truth comes to light. Determined to make her his, Blake proposes, and together they embark on a new chapter of their lives.

book_title: Legends Reset When I Wake Up
special_desc: Awakening after millennia, Supreme Lord finds his betrothed Emma Thompson and the scheming Thompson family plotting deicide with foreign allies. At a perilous banquet, he reveals divine powers, crushes their conspiracy to drain the Big Three Families' essence, obliterates the Sunlight lineage, and detects cosmic tremors from Mars heralding godly warfare.

Ethan Smith holds the title of the youngest scientist on Earth. However, contrary to expectations, his life is marred by family conflicts and tragedy. After being reborn, he chooses to distance himself from his family and live for himself. This time, Ethan refuses to be weak. He not only proves his brilliance to his family but also to his deskmate, his school, and ultimately, the entire world—showcasing that he is a genius who will not be underestimated.

book_title: The Housewife Who Touched the Stars
special_desc: Rita Foster sacrificed her space research dreams for her family, becoming a housewife, but faced betrayal when her husband brought back his manipulative first love Monica Hughes. After Monica schemed to turn Rita's family against her, Rita pursued space research, heartbroken. Her departure caused family chaos, exposing Monica's deceit. Eventually, though the remorseful family sought reconciliation, Rita prioritized her career.

Nicole Portman was a long-suffering housewife for 20 years. Physical and verbal abuse? Her husband gave it in spades.
 Dismissive apathy? Her son's a master at it.
 But everything changed when her husband chased her out of the house one day. Christina Nolan, a director with a vision, discovered Nicole and decided to cast her in a movie! 
 Just like that, the housewife turned into an overnight sensation! Is this Nicole's first taste of freedom in her life?
  But more twists and turns await Nicole... and some are more chalenging than others.

book_title: Dragon Crisis! My Turn to Shine!
special_desc: Twenty years ago, a dragon wreaked havoc on Earth. A grandmaster descended from the heavens to save humanity, rescuing a young pair, Bryce Gilman and Emma Lind, and taking them as disciples to inherit his will and protect the world’s peace. Fulfilling his wishes, Bryce assumes the role of grandmaster, sacrificing his own freedom to keep the dragon imprisoned in the Dragon Hold.

book_title: Love in Silence, Vengeance in Echo
special_desc: Nancy Morgan had it all—wealth, status, the perfect life. But when her boyfriend Hank was left deaf and mute after a terrible accident, she gave everything up. Defying her father, Zack Morgan, she ran away from home, pretended to be muted herself just to stay by Hank’s side. For three long years, she worked odd jobs, scrimped and saved, all to pay for his treatments. Then, the unthinkable happened—Hank recovered. But instead of gratitude, he was ashamed of his past, and ashamed of Nancy playing the "poor mute girl." He started chasing after Yana, a woman who only wanted him for his newfound charm, while pushing Nancy away with cruel words and cold shoulders. Finally, enough was enough. Broken but not defeated, Nancy walked away. She returned to her family, moved abroad, and slowly rebuilt her life. And there, she found something unexpected—real love with Noah Vince, a man who cherished her for who she truly was. No disguises, no sacrifices. Just happiness, the way it was always meant to be.

book_title: Mountains Won't Meet, But Revenge Will
special_desc:
Joey Smith was once the beloved heiress of the Lincoln family in the capital. But after returning to the Smith family, she was met with rejection and schemes, eventually being locked away in a basement.

Upon waking up to the truth, she decisively cut ties with the Smiths and returned to the powerful Lincoln family with pride and authority. As the truth unraveled, Leo Smith, her brother, and the others began to feel deep regret. Meanwhile, the Lincoln family officially severed all relations with the Smiths.

At the same time, Yuki Smith continued to squander the Smith family's wealth. Now, the Smith brothers are desperate to seek Joey's forgiveness—but is it already too late?

book_title: Who Knew My Hubby Was A Secret CEO?
special_desc: After a heated family argument involving her sister and brother-in-law, Talia marries Ethan on a whim, unaware he's actually a powerful CEO keeping his identity under wraps. As the newlyweds navigate family drama and close calls that threaten to expose the truth, they grow closer. In the end, Ethan reveals who he truly is and proposes for real. This time, with love at the center. Talia says yes, and they finally get the happy ending they never expected.

book_title: When the Snow Stops — Vengeance Rises
special_desc: In his past life, Eric gave everything for his family, but got betrayed. He went to jail for his adopted brother Felix, but only got contempt. Abandoned by his family, Eric died. After rebirth, he refused to take the fall for Felix and exposed the truth. But his mom and sisters didn't believe him. Heartbroken, he cut ties with them and rose as a radio star. Using his creative talent, he did better than his sisters and Felix. His family realized Eric was the real genius. Felix was only a thief who stole Eric's works...

In his past life, Austin ignored his own daughter for a widow named Anna, raising Anna's two sons. But when he got old and ill, Anna and her sons refused to pay his medical bills. So he died in pain. After rebirth, he wouldn't be a stepfather again. He rejected ungrateful Anna, and decided to earn more money to raise his own daughter well. In the end, he also got a nice wife Daisy...

Stella Drew got a second chance after her "perfect" marriage to Zaid Webb ended in treachery. Back at the altar of decision, she doesn't just walk away from her toxic childhood sweetheart—she runs into the arms of the truly better man, leaving Zaid to choke on his shock and regret.

Ellie has been branded a "jinx" by her village for her eerily accurate predictions, but in truth, she's anything but cursed. When she's taken in by the governor's wife, Irene, after a chance encounter, her presence turns the mansion upside down: flowers bloom, fortunes shift, and lives begin to change, including the governor's.

book_title: Wedded Bliss with My Secret Crush
special_desc: "Uncle, let's have a showdown!" When a cheeky little stranger challenges Nick Grant in the restroom, Nick rises to the challenge and outsmarts him. But this unexpected encounter comes with a twist—now the mischievous kid is determined to make Nick his new dad...

book_title: In Love With My Classmate's Mom
special_desc: Eddie is reborn on the very day before he was supposed to confess his love to the most popular girl in school. Everyone is waiting for his big move, but with the help of a mysterious system, Eddie shocks them all by confessing to her mom, Whitney! From that moment on, his bold pursuit of love turns the whole campus upside down.

book_title: Win Their Hearts, Forge Your Fate
special_desc: In Win Their Hearts Forge Your Fate movie, in a world spiraling into chaos, Baz Lee, a man in his fifties, discovers a system that reverses his aging by marrying multiple women. To navigate these turbulent times, he forms an unlikely alliance with Yasmine Lynch, a wounded female general. Disguised as a man, Yasmine joins Baz as they infiltrate a military camp, embarking on an epic journey from humble farmer to powerful warlord.

book_title: Baby’s Sweet Revenge: Mommy, I found My Dream Daddy！
special_desc: In a world where family ties are tested, Flora, a bright young girl, navigates a turbulent home life. Her father, Shawn, belittles her mother, Winnie, over her looks, while engaging in an affair with his sister-in-law, Mandy. Following Winnie's tragic death, Flora's attempt to thwart Shawn and Mandy's wedding leads to her own demise. Yet, destiny intervenes. Reborn, Flora wields her intelligence to liberate her mother from a toxic marriage.

Eleonora Vaughn, the fallen Aurevian Princess, died in shame—only to awaken three years earlier, gifted with a second chance. Now, she must mastermind her rise in this land, outmaneuvering every enemy who wronged her. But in this lethal game of power and revenge, the most dangerous move might be losing her heart to the very man she vowed to use.

Grassroots singer Matt Lipsey lost his sight three years ago after saving his girlfriend, Sapphire Steele, from a fire. Deceived by Sapphire and his sister Ruth, he was coerced into becoming a stand-in singer for Neal Arnold, who promised to help him launch his career but ultimately betrayed him. Tragically, Matt died due to their betrayal. Reborn, Matt resolves not to be exploited again, embarking on a path of vengeance while rising to stardom.

Luca was a musical genius until someone stole everything from him, including his life. Given a second chance, he vows revenge and gives those who betrayed him the ultimate downfall. This time, his voice will be heard.

Charli Kaplan, the new transfer at Maple Elite Academy, quickly becomes the school's most controversial figure. But appearances can be deceiving. Rowan Hawkins may seem like a tyrant, but is he truly a heartless bully? Meanwhile, Noah Tucker frequently comes to her aid—what's his motive? Now Charlie must decide: Will she choose her enemy or the golden boy?

book_title: Your Highness, Your Family Doctor Is Actually a Girl!
special_desc: A modern female doctor unexpectedly travels back in time to become Elara, second daughter of the disgraced Blair family. To save her family, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the close servant of the war god, Noah Croft. Using her talents and modern medical knowledge, Elara repeatedly saves lives in times of crisis. Noah develops feelings for her but struggles with his perception of her gender until her true identity is revealed. Then, together, they overcome challenges and forge a magical romance that transcends time.

book_title: Through Every Life to Find You
special_desc: Rita Carr, an ancient Channeler, returns as the Carr family's daughter after experiencing a hundred wrongful reincarnations. Amid family feuds, gang conflicts, and the conspiracies of the Krana Empire, she breaks the chains of destiny, achieves female awakening, and ultimately rekindles her past connection with Louie Bale, the young leader of Aegis Syndicate, concluding this time-transcending legend.

book_title: When the Marshal Falls for His Prisoner
special_desc: After saving a secret agent, healer Sylvia is swept into a ruthless power struggle. Young Marshal Edgar imprisons her to hunt for intel, but her courage and wit soon disarm him. As war erupts and lies unravel, the two move from enemies to partners, forging a bond that survives the storm.

A car accident gave Moxie aphasia, yet her husband, eager to please his secret lover, proposed a fake divorce. Moxie finally wakes up. He wants a divorce? He's going to get one. But guess who will be regretting it?

Mina Shaw, is reborn as the daughter of Prince Henry—a man hellbent on revenge. She can read minds, turn anything to gold, and her inner thoughts are broadcast to everyone around her! Now, she must navigate a chaotic court, tame her vengeful father, outwit a cunning crown prince, and win over a grumpy emperor—all while accidentally melting hearts and turning the royal world upside down.

book_title: She Played Obedient, He Paid in Blood
special_desc: Cindy Sutton seems the perfect submissive companion to Winston Scott—but secretly, she is executing a careful revenge. When Winston’s fiancée, Chloe Ashwood, returns, a dangerous game unfolds involving power, betrayal, and transplanted hearts. Everyone is playing to control others while falling into someone else’s trap.

Murdered by her sister Serena, Grace Thorne awakens on her wedding day to the Quinn family. Armed with memories of betrayal, she sees the truth: her charming husband Mason is hollow, her sister is venomous, and her new family is greedy. This time, Grace plays a different game. She'll reclaim her power, expose the conspiracy that destroyed her bloodline, and make every traitor pay. But as her vengeance unfolds, the secrets of her frail husband, Cyrus Quinn, may change everything.

The Emperor yearns for a daughter after 28 royal sons in a row. He vows to cease his ruthless ways. In response to his prayers, Lady Quinn gives birth to Nora, a girl blessed with luck and foresight. Cherished from a young age, Nora uses her abilities to prevent the Emperor's violent impulses, saving lives along the way. Among those she rescues is Simon, a wolfish boy of unmatched strength, who becomes her loyal guardian and protector.
Join Nora and Simon as they outsmart spies from enemy nations and safeguard their empire's future.

Reporter Nina successfully gains the trust of crime lord Leon Mann and takes him down. Three months later, Nina encounters Leon again at a TV network's gala, only to find he has transformed into Chase Kane, with a spotless reputation. Through investigation, Nina confirms that Chase is indeed Leon and suspects he seeks revenge. As she navigates this elaborate deception, Nina feels dwarfed by the cunning Leon, but with no other choice, she must risk everything for a desperate counterattack.

On her first day of work, the CEO's wife is mistaken for someone else, prompting her to play dumb. Her cover remains intact until the nation's wealthiest man arrives to search for his relative, inadvertently revealing her secret identity...

book_title: My Ex Came Back With My Child
special_desc: She loved him deeply, so much so that she was willing to give up everything and disappear just to support his life's ambitions. But after they parted, she thought of him every day. When she finally makes a powerful return, she brings along a chubby, adorable little child.

I come from a poor background and had to give up attending the best university to take care of my seriously ill mother. Fortunately, my girlfriend never left me. She believed in me and encouraged me: “You are the most outstanding person I have ever met, and nothing can compare to you!”
Finally, I got an excellent job opportunity and reluctantly left home to work in the city. My boss’s daughter fell in love with me, but I only love my wife back home.
Years later, I became a CEO. Just as I was planning to return home to reunite with my wife and mother, an accident caused me to lose my memory! When I woke up, two women claimed to be my love—one dressed in luxury, the other in rags. Who should I believe?

book_title: Reborn to Make My Three Brothers Cry
special_desc: In my previous life, as the real heiress, I was framed by the fake one and her three brothers. In the end, I was poisoned and married to a dead person. After rebirth, I used the information from my previous life to send the fake heiress and her three brothers to prison. I will rise to the top step by step and become the chairman of my Group!

She dreamed that her husband was with a mysterious woman and even wanted to kill her. One day, she suddenly realized that everything in the dream was true! In order to protect herself and her child, she sought help from wealthy parents. They teamed up to uncover his husband's true face and bring him to justice!

book_title: Fortune's Gift: Spoiled by My Zillionaire Uncles
special_desc: She was abducted by human traffickers as a child, and when she grew up, she was betrayed by a scumbag who cheated on her. She thought her life was doomed, but one day, her wealthy uncle shows up, offering her the chance to return home and inherit a fortune worth billions.

The CEO of the Pearl Group, in order to support her husband's career, had been secretly delivering takeout for three years, only to be publicly abandoned. The world's richest man, who had known her since childhood, arrived just in time to propose to her, defying everyone’s expectations. It was then that her husband discovered her true identity as the CEO, deeply regretting his actions.

book_title: Rebirth and Cut Ties: My Love-Blinded Son Regrets
special_desc: After dying alone due to pampering her love-blinded son, she’s reborn with memories of her past life. This time, she’s determined to take control, build her empire, and get revenge on her clueless son, his fiancée, and their parasitic relatives.

She plans to tell her husbandabout her pregnancy but finds him with the pregnant  At her mother-in-law’s birthday banquet, she is humiliated and decides to divorce. Her brother steps in, bringing her home and arranging for her to host a business event, where she encounters them again. She tries to embarrass him, but fails. The  family believes he is the boy's mistress, making her life difficult, until it’s revealed that she is the family’s eldest daughter.He finally realizes his mistake, but it’s too late to fix their relationship.

Heir to Lingxiao Temple, She is forced into marrying him rumored to be on his deathbed. Neither wants the match, but fate steps in when she unexpectedly saves his life. Unaware they’re each other’s intended, they grow close amid a flurry of comedic misunderstandings before discovering the truth and embracing their happily ever after.

The hero, once a top soldier, now hides in the city as a designated driver. The heroine encounters trouble and has no choice but to marry him. The man is reluctant, so the girl seeks help from his aunt. After their marriage, the hero is threatened by the heroine's suitor, but he possesses evidence of the suitor's illegal activities. To end the trouble, the man, with the help of his aunt, deals with the enemy. During this time, the heroine truly falls in love with the hero.

To support his wife, Queenie Jensen, in her career, Flynn Cross sacrifices a promising future to become a stay-at-home husband, devoting himself to his family—only to be met with Queenie’s ridicule and their daughter’s disdain. It is only when he returns to Odyssey Group and reclaims his status that Queenie finally realizes his worth, but by then, he has already chosen to start anew, leaving her drowning in regret and self-reflection.

book_title: A Modern Man’s Guide to Ancient Domination
special_desc: The once-unified empire had fractured into three rival nations. Gordon Lovell, Prime Minister of Xaskor, had dedicated his life to fulfilling the late emperor's dream of reunification. After five failed invasions, Gordon launched a desperate sixth Northern Conquest, fully aware it may be his final campaign as illness dragged him toward death. Just as defeat loomed due to dwindling supplies, Angus Mather, a special forces soldier from the future, appeared in Gordon's war tent, bringing with him a truckload of modern weapons and supplies. With advanced technology and his sharp military strategies, Angus helped Xaskor unite the fractured lands and won General Moira Judd's heart.

Nick Drake and Nathan Drake risked their lives to save Sasha Grey, who then agrees to a mysterious old man's terms to become a maid for Harold Godwin and his son for six years.

During this time, Sasha endures Harold's indifference and his ex-wife Naya Smith's schemes, quietly waiting for the agreement to end.

When Naya returns, Harold's favoritism and Tim's betrayal leave Sasha utterly disheartened. 

As the six years conclude, she leaves decisively and reunites with the awakened Nick.

Only after losing her does Harold realize his love for her, but it's too late.

When the truth is revealed, Harold is gravely injured protecting Sasha, who ultimately chooses Nick over him.

This is a story of sacrifice, betrayal, and redemption, where love and hate intertwine as everyone seeks their own place in the world.

Jealous of Mitch Harmon for his luxurious life, Javier Harmon attacked Mitch with a knife, and the cousins both died. But when they opened their eyes, they were back on the fateful wedding night in 1977 that had set their lives on diverging paths! With memories of his last life, Javier married Patsy Reeves, the adopted girl, instead of switching brides with Mitch. He thought he could steal Mitch's future—but only sank deeper into misery. Meanwhile, Mitch built a life richer in love, purpose, and success than before with Margie.

After helping her fiancé secure a multi-million-dollar deal, Stella York witnessed him cheating on her with her younger sister, Kim York. The pair brazenly flaunted their affair in front of her, while her grandma and her father pressured her to break off the engagement and surrender her fiancé, Henry Chase, to Kim.

In her darkest moment, Stella met Kevin Ford, the young heir of the Ford Group, and the two fell in love at first sight, embarking on a new life together.

Emily, a rising fashion designer, wins big in Paris only to wake up in the 1980s as the infamous "evil wife" of factory owner Hector. Known for abusing her timid son and hated by the village, her new life is a mess: a cold husband, a broken family, and a rival eager to steal her place. Determined to turn things around, Emily sets out to win her family’s trust, rebuild their home, and expose the schemer who plotted against her.

Mavis Addams's only wish is to marry her parents' enemy. Life as their daughter has been tough, filled with her family's relentless humiliation and torture, but to her surprise, she finds herself enjoying the role of the enemy's wife. In the meantime, her heart starts to melt for the one guy she shouldn't. Will her plan work out, or is she better off on her own?

Sara throws herself at Edward and becomes the city's biggest joke. Everyone thinks she is hopelessly in love until the truth comes out. Edward is just a stand-in for someone else, and she never loves him at all. But when Sara tries to walk away, the man, once incapable of love, snaps. Now, he'll do anything to keep her.

Dumped on her wedding night, Quinley ends up in bed with Enzo, the capital's returning heir, by accident. With videos as leverage, he pulls her into his orbit and asks her the same question daily, "So… when are you leaving your husband?"

Evelyn, once a poker champion and now a single mother, left the game after Julian's betrayal. However, her innate strength pushed her to confront the challenges of raising her ailing daughter, Rainie, alone. With courage and resilience, and support from Caleb, she triumphantly returns to the poker world, securing a promising future for herself and her daughter.

Sadie has always been a good girl, but she falls for Ethan, her sister's rival. To please him, they indulge in many secret, scandalous encounters. After a passionate camping trip, Sadie discovers the shocking truth: Ethan's love was a revenge scheme against her sister. Sadie is heartbroken and makes the painful decision to walk away.

book_title: My Firefighter Husband Was Once a White-Haired Punk
special_desc: Sammi learns she's pregnant the same day she's told her firefighter husband Fred has died. A diary of his secret, years-long love triggers her rebirth back to 2007, still expecting their child. But the man she returns to isn't her calm, heroic husband, but a rebellious, white-haired teenager who doesn't know her at all. Now Sammi must win his heart from the very beginning and rewrite the fate that once stole him away.

In her previous life, Stella mistook Isaac for her savior and, out of gratitude, agreed to marry him. Unbeknownst to her, the true hero, Adrian, had lost his memory due to an accident and ended up as her bodyguard, silently protecting her. It wasn't until her final moments that Stella realized the truth: Isaac's heart belonged to her stepsister, Ivy. This ruthless pair not only wove a web of lies but also meticulously plotted against her. Stella passed away with a heart full of resentment. However, fate granted her a second chance...

Ivory finds herself coerced into a contract marriage with Wayne. She feigns compliance but attempts to escape, only to be personally caught by Wayne. Betrayal, ex begging her back, and family drama. This marriage born of convenience teeters on the brink of either a grand wedding or a dramatic divorce.

After 30 years of a childfree marriage, Sarah's life implodes when her husband James’s illegitimate son storms in demanding an inheritance. Betrayal turns to shock when Sarah reveals her own secret, 25-year-old twins. As Sarah strikes back with precision, James and his mistress scheme blindly. Fake paternity tests, hidden debts, and a wedding turned bloodbath expose every lie. No one walks away clean.

book_title: The Revenge Of The Returned Heiress
special_desc: To marry her beloved, she gave up her heiress status. But post-marriage, she realized her husband loved only her status. After childbirth, he got worse, even throwing her out. When a billionaire offered revenge, she resolved to reclaim all that was hers, no longer weak.

“You have to remember who the enemy is!” My mom told me when our family was framed and both my parents died protecting me, and I have been bearing it in mind for all my life. 
I was adopted and raised by a kind woman, but when my grandfather finally found me and I was ready to return home, the girl I saved, in turn, harmed me and even pretended to be me! 
I lost my memory, luckily, he, my childhood friend, now the handsome billionaire CEO, saved me, and took me in as his fiancee! I’m going to regain my power, and revenge on the bad!

book_title: My Long-Lost Son Turns Out to Be a CEO
special_desc:
The mother sells fish for a living and supports her two sons. However, because of the scars on her arms, she is considered as having an infectious disease and lives a difficult life. Because the younger son has allergies since childhood and gets more care from his mother, the older son is jealous. During a quarrel with his younger brother, he accidentally causes his younger brother to fall down the mountain and disappear.
The mother always thinks that her younger son is not dead. She searchs for her son for years. Eighteen years later, the younger son who is rescued and becomes the heir of a big Group. He always wants to find his mother. However, due to the demolition of the old house, the lost son misses the opportunity to find his mother. But the eldest son abandons his mother and refuses to recognize her because he wants to marry a rich family.
In the process of searching for her son, she experiences various humiliations and grievances, can she finally recognize him?"

book_title: Rise of Power: Dad, Your Son Comes Back
special_desc:
The protagonist, once the son of a wealthy tycoon, is kidnapped by the tycoon's adopted son and separated from his family. He later joins the Hidden Wolf Special Forces, growing up to become their captain, known as the Wolf King. Just as he is about to reunite with his father, the adopted son poisons him in a betrayal. In a desperate escape, he is injured and loses his memory, only to be saved by his sister.
For eighteen years, the tycoon searches for his son, scouring the nation until he finally finds him in Yang City. Just as the butler brings the protagonist to meet his father, unforeseen events occur. The adopted son intervenes once more, threatening the protagonist by putting his sister's life at stake.

Meryl Shaw, an overweight housewife, loses everything when her husband, Hugh Jensen, conspires with their maid, Yara Quince, to betray her on their fifth wedding anniversary. Shattered but resolute, she vows to turn the tables once and for all. A year later, Meryl returns with a new face and identity as the renowned artist "Rene Ribeth," rising to the peak of success.

Nora Shepard, born into wealth, is the daughter of a corporate chairman and an art school graduate. Her parents insist she stays home to help with the family business after graduation. 

Galen West, a family friend, grows up with Nora and plans to marry her.
Meanwhile, Luna Keats orchestrates a car accident to kill her own parents, gaining sympathy and becoming the adopted daughter of the Shepard family. She studies art alongside Nora, often copying her ideas, and later works as Nora's assistant. 

Luna's ultimate plan is to destroy Nora and take everything, including Galen. She succeeded by killing Nora.

But what she didn't know is that Nora is reborn.

Konwing what will happen in the future, Nora is determined to reclaim everything and tear Luna up! This time, she will have her revenge!

James' girlfriend cheated on him and stole all his money. His company was going bankrupt. But he got a magic system. When he spent money on his employees, he could get ten times cashback. And his employees felt grateful that they could have such a good boss. They worked harder for James. James' career rose...

book_title: What? His First Love Is Me?
special_desc: Janet saved Ethan Sullivan from a car accident, who was the CEO of Sullivan Group. Unexpectedly, when Ethan woke up, he lost part of his memory. He insisted Janet was his girlfriend. For money, Janet didn't deny it. As they spent time together, she was moved by Ethan's kindness and love. She truly fell in love with him, but his mom hated her. In the end, Janet was a rich family's long-lost heiress, and they got together happily...

Tycoon Ethan Fuller weds his 'dying' muse Natalie Song, abandoning lover Jessica Lane. After a fatal crash, Jessica trades her Soulstrand to resurrect, watching coldly as Ethan's empire crumbles—until medical truths expose deadly lies.

book_title: Our Cutie Is Acutually a Ghost Whisperer
special_desc: After being cast out of her village as a jinx following her mother's death, Mia decides to find her father, a Lieutenant General, in the city. With her mystic divination skills, she becomes an invaluable asset to the General's family, helping them navigate through numerous crises. Now, the chance to change her entire family's fate is within her grasp.

Five-year-old Annie, who can understand animals, saved Landon Hawthorne, a wealthy businessman, from suicide. Now she's his whole world and he's her legal cheat-code against every villain fate throws at them. With her innocence and gift, Annie not only survives dangers but also melts his cold heart—a magical tale of mutual healing.

Once a star diplomat, Winnie gave up everything for love, only to be rejected by her marshal husband, Leo, and their son. Determined to start over, she returns to the diplomatic world as the mysterious "Miss Wan," dazzling allies and rivals alike. When Leo finally regrets letting her go, it's already too late. Betrayals are exposed, war looms, and love turns to ashes. As Leo falls on the battlefield, Winnie walks forward. She's stronger, wiser, and ready to face the world on her own terms.

In a psychiatric hospital, Raff Hess, the most dangerous patient, finally passes his 144th mental evaluation and is released. However, unbeknownst to everyone, his condition remains unchanged—his late fiancée, Freya Kim, still whispers vengeance in his ear. Four years after Freya's murder, Raff is now free and ready to set his meticulously planned revenge into motion against her four killers.

book_title: My Husband Is a Hidden Big Shot
special_desc: Wendy got pregnant after a one-night encounter at a hot spring. Five years later, now a stunning and powerful CEO, she launches a city-wide hunt for her mystery baby-daddy, only for her daughter to find him in the countryside, living as a humble farmer. Determined to secure her company's future, Wendy brings him home as a live-in husband until she discovers the "simple farmer" is actually the hidden Lord of the Dragon Sanctum, a man far more powerful than she ever imagined.

After the divorce, her ex-husband saw her as a regular Cinderella, unaware of her wealth. Back home, her billionaire brothers embraced her. Her ex even wrongly thought she had a sugar daddy. When the truth emerged, she made everyone regret underestimating her.

She avoided forced marriage by entering into a contract marriage with him, who was also pressured into blind dates. After a quick marriage and getting their certificates, they went their separate ways. She then discovered that her sister-in-law had taken over her position as CEO, while he disguised himself as a waiter. Both used false identities, but true love began to blossom between them.
Their relationship started bizarrely, each with their own needs. He always thought the wife he brought home was delicate and lacked survival skills, but unexpectedly...

Pressured by her family to get married, she unexpectedly had a flash marriage with her best friend's brother. Right after getting their marriage certificate, he left for abroad due to work. A year later, she has become the top lawyer in the city. The law firm is acquired by a mysterious CEO who recently returned to the country. This CEO is the perfect man in the eyes of her and everyone at the firm. Little does she know, this man is actually her husband whom she hasn't seen in three years...
The CEO, driven by the misconception that his wife was unfaithful, is determined to get a divorce. However, as he interacts with her more, he becomes increasingly attracted to her, eager to finalize the divorce without realizing that his wife is the very woman he longs to win over.

Carrying the weight of joy and anticipation, he looked forward to sharing the news of his acceptance into a prestigious Ivy League school in the U.S. This renowned institution marked the start of his academic dreams and was a reward for his hard work. However, when he opened the door with hope, he was met with unexpected heaviness and an unusual bustle. The crowd wasn’t there to celebrate his success but had gathered due to a sudden and tragic event.

book_title: Lost Heiress: The CEO's Beloved Secretaire
special_desc: At eighteen, she is abandoned by her adoptive mother, only to be rescued by a stranger. The two share an instant connection and fall deeply in love. However, family pressures threaten their happiness, as his relatives have plans for him to marry the daughter of a powerful family. With this arrangement, the heiress moves into their home, uncovering a long-buried secret of an identity swap from twenty-three years ago...

After barely surviving her family’s attempt to kill and bury her, a powerful female CEO loses her memory and is left with the mind of a young child. Wandering the streets as a beggar, she’s taken in by a seemingly frail but influential CEO. The two enter a whirlwind marriage, only to face constant humiliation from his family. A heated clash with his stepmother unexpectedly restores her memories, but she chooses to keep her true identity hidden...

Years ago, a favored imperial concubine, protected by the emperor’s love, committed heinous acts and falsely accused a loyal family of treason, leading to their extermination. The sole survivor, the loyalist’s daughter, later enters the palace as the general’s daughter to compete for the queen's position. She carefully orchestrates her encounters with the emperor, gaining his affection and eventually securing her place as his concubine. When she finally avenges her family and plunges a dagger into her enemy’s heart, the concubine reveals there was someone else pulling the strings all along.

Carly Walker's perfect love story shatters when her fiancé betrays her hours before their wedding. As she struggles to rebuild from the ashes of betrayal, an unexpected twist of fate brings three of the city's most influential men into her life—each offering marriage for their own mysterious reasons.

Clint Olsen, the legendary Beggar King, secretly leads Beggar Clan while searching for Mia Lloyd, a girl who once helped him. His men mistake Mia’s twin, Freya, for her, and Clint offers to marry her out of gratitude. Freya, needing a bodyguard, is shocked when Clint defeats top fighters and asks for marriage instead of payment. Offended, she calls her fiancé, Ryan, to handle Clint, but her father warns that Wrath Pact is targeting the Lloyds and Clint is their best protection. Freya reluctantly agrees. At Ryan’s reunion, Clint exposes an assassin, humiliating Ryan. The shock comes when Mia is revealed as Wrath Pact's leader. Mia tries to bribe Clint into betraying the Lloyds, but he’s already plotting as a double agent to protect them from her.

Naomi Chapman was tormented as a poison tester for 10 long years, till her stepmom got her back to get married on her daughter's behalf. Naomi became the antidote for her husband Samuel Hunt, Highvale's most revered general. She found love at her new home and learned to stand up for herself.

Clara Yates did the time for a crime she didn't commit, and now she's out—with Julian Payne's baby, his ring, and a burning desire for payback. But her quest for vengeance gets complicated when she develops real feelings for her powerful husband, forcing her to reveal the artistic genius she's kept hidden for years.

Angela Davis was trapped into marrying into a wealthy family, only to face jealousy from Amy Miller and be falsely accused of murder, leading to her tragic death. Reborn, Angela is determined to get revenge. Start by leaving this man behind! At first, Jason Brown dismisses her, but gradually finds himself somehow drawn to her. Will Angela's quest for justice and independence lead to unexpected love?

Kicked into the abyss, Dustin Clark refused to stay down. His fight back to the top will be a brutal struggle against the most talented cultivators, treacherous monsters, and cunning women the immortal world has to offer.

Charlene, an orphan, makes the ultimate sacrifice to save her gravely ill sister, only to end up in the wrong man’s bed and spend the night with Helmut. Nine months later, she gives birth to triplet sons and a daughter. Five years on, with her sister’s life once again hanging by a thread, Charlene returns home with her four children and runs straight into Helmut at the airport.

After being reborn, Thea is stunned. Her superstar husband is lovesick and surrounded by stand-ins, her eldest son is a notorious troublemaker, and her daughter is being strung along by a sketchy bad boy. The whole internet mocks the family as a hopeless mess. But Thea isn't one to back down. She whips this chaotic crew into loyal protectors, until even the so-called villainess is begging her for forgiveness.

book_title: My Husband Is Hard to Mess With
special_desc: He was running from a lie that wanted him dead. She offered a truth that could save him. To survive, he built a new lie—one that trapped them both. Now, the walls are closing in, and the love that was built on deception will be tested by a fire of betrayal and a dangerous enemy who started it all. How far would you go to protect a secret that could destroy the one you love?

book_title: Daddy by Accident, Love by Fate
special_desc: Sebastian Sterling, heir to Sterling Global, has raised his twin sons alone for five years, their mother's identity a secret. Evelyn Cloud, the unloved adoptive daughter of the Cloud family, lives a lonely life until a chance encounter changes everything. One twin instantly clings to her, calling her "Mommy". Soon, his brother and their formidable father, Sebastian, draw her into their world. As bonds form with this intense trio, the shocking truth behind the twins' origins begins to emerge.

To pay for her grandmother's treatment, Savannah leaves her rural hometown and heads to Hadleyburg to ask her estranged father for help. On the train, she unexpectedly saves the life of Hudson, the ruthless, untouchable mafia king of Hadleyburg, after he's ambushed and severely wounded. When Savannah arrives in the city, Hudson returns for her, fiercely, publicly, and with an obsession the whole city fears.

book_title: Sweet Revenge: From Betrayal to Beloved
special_desc: Jorie is reborn before her life was stolen, before her fiancé and stepsister destroyed her future. This time, she flips the script by marrying Uncle Theodore, a steadfast, powerful man fourteen years older, and kicks her ex-fiancé out of the family for good.

book_title: After Breakup, Spoiled by Three Big Shot Brothers
special_desc: On the eve of her wedding, she was dumped by her fiancé. However, at the engagement party, she was recognized by three big shot brothers as their long-lost biological sister. It turns out she's a wealthy heiress. From then on, those who bullied her would face the wrath of her brothers.

book_title: Revenge on the Emperor: Becoming the Empress
special_desc: Her family was originally respected for being meritorious in protecting the country but were wiped out overnight, and she was the only one lucky enough to survive. After growing up, to take revenge, she broke into the deep palace alone...

My Secret Boss Dad movie shows how the Duke of peace, Bruce Lowell, while winning the biggest battle, loses his wife to a villain's attack. He vows to never return to war until he finds the culprits behind his wife's death.
Bruce keeps his identity a secret and his daughter ends up hating him since her mother's death, thus challenging Bruce's life.

book_title: My Long-Lost Wife Comes Back With A Baby
special_desc: An accident brings together a wealthy heir and a neglected heiress, resulting in an unplanned pregnancy. Six years later, unable to bear her stepmother's oppression, she decides to go on blind dates and unexpectedly reunites with the man who has been searching for her and their child. After their flash marriage, he had to hide his true identity to avoid misunderstandings caused years ago.

book_title: Promoted by Being My Boss's Sperm Donor
special_desc: In a high-stakes corporate, the vice president, suffering from infertility, orchestrates a plan to secure family inheritance by having his secretary father a child with his wife. The secretary, exploiting his position, frames a rival faction’s supervisor through bribery. When the rival faction's secretary uncovers the corruption and gathers evidence, it leads to escalating internal conflict. Amidst the turmoil and betrayal, the secretary is unexpectedly dismissed from his role. Shocked and determined, he prepares for a fierce retaliation.

Due to jealousy from her stepsister, she was drugged and framed, losing her innocence. However, by an unexpected twist of fate, she spent a night with the richest man. Five years later, they cross paths again, with him now a single father with five adorable kids. With the help of the little ones, they rush into marriage, but he continues to hide his true identity...

After a one-night stand, Tong Yao and Feng Jing rush into marriage. Shortly after, Feng Jing leaves abroad, leaving Tong Yao to raise their son, Xuanxuan, alone. Six years later, Feng Jing returns to find his former wife, and coincidentally, Tong Yao becomes his bodyguard. With the help of their adorable child, they overcome numerous misunderstandings and rekindle their love. Ultimately, the family reunites and lives happily together.

After a drunken mistake, the female lead confuses her husband for a host. When they finally recognize each other, the male lead, a hidden CEO, faces challenges like family disputes and nearly exposing his identity. Overcoming these struggles deepens their bond. He eventually reveals his identity, proposes, and they achieve a happy ending.

Ten years ago, the male lead, a billionaire, killed his ex-wife and her lover after they murdered his eldest daughter. After a decade in prison, he reunites with his younger daughter, only to find her abused by her husband’s family. He takes action, but she resents him. Through struggles and revelations, they reconcile and team up to defeat their enemies.

On the eve of her engagement, the female lead escapes her terrifying family and unexpectedly becomes pregnant with the child of a billionaire male lead. The grand hotel where she works is also acquired by him as he pursues her relentlessly. Though she only wants to work hard and prove her own worth, the man’s persistence wears her down. In the end, she not only achieves success at the hotel through her own efforts but is also pampered beyond measure by the man.

book_title: After Awakening, Falling for My Sis-in-Law
special_desc: Widowed Peach battles gangsters forcing marriage to repay debts. When brother-in-law Johnny awakens mystic herb powers from an ancient lineage, he risks life to expose pharmaceutical conspiracies and Spirit Jade wars. As tycoons blast sacred mountains, Johnny's herb magic rebuilds ecosystems, but discovers Peach's blindness ties to his celestial roots. Their forbidden bond sparks a Chinese medicine revolution against corporate greed, forging a rural redemption legend.

After her father’s business goes bankrupt, Skylar Stone is forced to work as Lucas Ford’s maid as collateral. But just when she thinks things can’t get worse, an unexpected pregnancy shatters her world. Lucas, convinced of her betrayal, demands she get an abortion, leaving her devastated. Heartbreak forces her to leave her homeland, but six years later, she returns—with her child and a story far from over.

There are many business tycoons in the world. While everything may appear glorious on the surface, behind the public eye, countless families are trapped in the vicious cycle of power struggles—and the Yosts are no exception. Once seen as allies with a shared goal and a close-knit bond, the members of the Yost family secretly plot against each other, each striving to gain as much as possible. This rivalry unintentionally pulls Wendy Yost into the conflict after her mother's tragic death in an accident.

book_title: Oops Mr. Gray, That's Not Mrs. Gray
special_desc: Brian Gray had a one-night stand with Sofie Lawson after saving her from two perverts that drugged her. The morning after, Sofie found out she slept with her boss and ran in panic, accidentally leaving behind her cousin Julie's ID. Brian found Julie using her ID and thought she was the one he spent the night with.

Janice Moore, a female CEO abducted as a child, returned from abroad to confront her ungrateful brother and his wife while searching for her birth mother. She elevated her mother into high society and helped her mother find twilight-year love.

book_title: Tormented Girl Got Her Prince Charming
special_desc: Mia's dad used a forged DNA test report to tell a big lie. He took in his illegitimate daughter Natalie, and lied that Mia wasn't her mom's biological daughter. Because of that fake DNA report, Mia's mom bought it and started bullying Mia. Mia became Natalie's blood tank, and they even wanted to take away her kidney. Luckily, Mia met a good man, Brian Frost. This man and his family pampered Mia and loved her. Mia's dark life got sunshine...

book_title: Oops! I Slept My Rival's Billionaire Dad
special_desc: Lily Cole gets publicly humiliated by her secret crush of ten years and his new girlfriend. After drowning her sorrows in alcohol, she accidentally ends up in the room of an older man, William Wilson, mistaking him for a male escort. A month later, she finds herself unexpectedly pregnant. Just as she's panicking about the surprise pregnancy, the guy shows up with a billion-dollar dowry, ready to marry her. Not wanting to become anyone's stepmom, Lily tries to escape, only to find out that the old guy is not just a billionaire but also her nemesis's father! While others lean on their fathers, Lily's got her rival's dad on her side!

To escape the marriage her mother forced upon her, Nicole Smith boldly sleeps with a stranger and runs away from home with a baby bump. Five years later, she's a devoted single mom to her son, Danny Smith. Just as their life struggles, Marcus Jansen steps into her life, determined to win her heart. Yet, his childhood sweetheart, Zoey Reeves, seethes with jealousy and keeps causing trouble. Little do they know, Marcus is the father of Nicole's son, and her true identity holds even more surprises...

Lucy Loxley is thrust into a novel's world as the villainess, surrounded by her three formidable brothers. Her chaotic first day sees her accidentally throwing up on the charming protagonist, Blake Marsh, and scalding his hands with hot water. Later, in a twist of fate, she encounters the enigmatic Julian Field in an elevator, leading to an unexpected night together. At a subsequent banquet, she discovers Julian is none other than the powerful villainous BOSS!

book_title: Oops, My General Hubby Can Hear My Thoughts
special_desc: When science whiz Sydney Long unexpectedly dies, she wakes up in the past as the bride of the infamous villain General Jake! Planning to stay under the radar, she aims to play nice, earn money, and step aside for Jake's true love, the "ninth wife". But on their wedding night, Jake hears her thoughts: "Isn't he the General Jake with the ninth wife scandal?" Confused, Jake wonders, "Father has only eight wives—who's the ninth?"

After Jesse Quinn heroically sacrifices himself to save his fiancée, Hazel Rios, from a missile strike, he awakens in an unfamiliar world, inhabiting the body of a duke's deceased son. Meanwhile, Hazel, now his maid, captures the attention of Curtis, a privileged and spoiled heir from a formidable family. As Jesse navigates this treacherous realm, he must confront formidable challenges and take up arms against an unjust world...

For twenty years, Quinley devoted her life to raising Eric’s children and building his family after their mother abandoned them. But when the ex-wife suddenly returns, the children turn their backs on Quinley, forgetting her decades of sacrifice. Quinley is brokenhearted and decides to leave and start anew. Only then does the family realize that she was the one who truly held them together.

Naomi and Francis have enjoyed three years of marriage, with Naomi wholeheartedly supporting Francis's successful career as a top lawyer. But when Iris, Francis's first love, reappears, Naomi's comfortable life is shaken. As her role as a good wife is challenged, memories of her past as the formidable "Queen of Law" resurface, reigniting her inner strength and ambition.

To cover her brother's medical bills, Aylin Leman spent the night with Ronin Lewis. But the money was far from enough. Desperate, she took leave from school to be a maid for the Lewis family, having no idea Ronin was her employer's son. Captivated by her charm, Ronin offered to keep her—and for her brother's sake, she agreed. Yet what began as a cold deal soon turned into a love neither of them expected...

Avery Daigle, a notorious tomcat, faces pressure from his parents to settle down and marry. His single demand for a bride? Obedience. Hazel Arnold fits the bill and seems like a good match. However, Avery's world is turned upside down when he witnesses her exacting revenge with her own hands...

She was his perfect trophy wife, until his betrayal set her free. Now, Saylor Bell has built an empire from the skills she learned decorating his home and hosting his parties. She's a self-made millionaire with the world at her feet, and her ex-husband, Remi Webb, is desperate to win her back. But he's too late—the most powerful man in town, Jai Nash, is already on one knee, ready to make the woman Remi discarded his queen.

Lillian hides her true identity as the chairwoman of a listed company, living as an ordinary sales rep. But when she discovers her husband Milo's betrayal and his plan with his mistress, Whitney, to steal her fortune, her world collapses. Broken but not defeated, Lillian awakens. With quiet precision and the power she once hid, she exposes Milo's schemes, protects her daughter, and makes him choke on the consequences of his own greed.
She wants a good life for her daughter; he wants to cure his mom. They agree to get married to help each other. But then, another rich girl falls for him because he saved her...

book_title: The Fishmonger is a Secret Big Shot
special_desc: Mocked as a mere fishmonger, deemed unworthy of her, little did they know he was the big shot! Even the heiress to a billionaire was his fiancée. When his true identity was revealed, it left everyone stunned.
Betrayed by her ex-boyfriend and drunken in a bar, she mistook a CEO for a male escort.  He rescued her from her miserable life and supported her revenge. Love sparkles between them...

book_title: Mommy, Let's Kick Out the Impostor
special_desc: After a one-night stand, he left her with an ring, and she became pregnant. Six years later, she returned with her triplets. Just as the three children were about to use the ring as a token to identify their father, the ring was nowhere to be found!

When she still loves him, he does not value it. He always thought that she was the murderer of his parents, and when he finally knows the truth, her heart has been hurt so badly and her illness is so severe...

I was once a billionaire CEO, but my husband tried to murder me to seize my fortune. Miraculously surviving, I went into hiding and was unexpectedly taken in by an incognito CEO. Now, fully prepared, I'm ready to rebuild my empire and reclaim everything that is rightfully mine.

book_title: Pampered by My Ex-husband's Billionaire Friend
special_desc: A stunning and talented heiress finally divorces her husband, who has been absent for four years. Pressured by her grandmother to have a child to inherit the family company, she is introduced to a man she thinks is just handsome and fit. But to her surprise, he turns out to be a billionaire CEO who has secretly loved her for years!

To outsiders, a middle-aged man appears to be a widower with an unremarkable job, looked down upon and constantly troubled by others. However, a hotshot business mogul unexpectedly claims to be his son and stands up for him. At the same time, an accidental encounter with a beautiful CEO leads to her relentless pursuit of him, providing him with support. Despite all this, the man remains indifferent because he has an even more astonishing identity that he has yet to reveal. When the beautiful CEO is forced into a family marriage, he exposes his true identity, using his immense wealth, connections, power, and influence to help her break off the engagement.

book_title: Rising to the Top While I Marry As A Widow
special_desc:
The girl had been mistreated by her family since childhood, and the general was originally engaged to the woman's sister, but because the general was assassinated, the family forced the woman to marry in place of her sister.
But in reality it was all a ploy by the emperor and the general, because they wanted to fake their own deaths to bring out who was behind it.
What happens when the girl fulfills her promise to be a widow at the general's house? Will she be able to unravel the truth?

book_title: Reborn to Marry the Man I Dumped
special_desc: She died, taking the man who loved her with her, only to be killed by the one she loved most. Reborn, she faces an inevitable loss and must gamble everything, trusting that the man who truly loves her will never let her fall. Meanwhile, the deceitful couple who betrayed her will pay the ultimate price this time.
As a seasoned gambler and master of the game, I've seen it all. Here's a simple truth: steer clear of gambling. In this world, nine out of ten bets are a con.

Sam Levin, a top secret agent codenamed "Headhunter," falls for Serena York, daughter of the country's richest tycoon. However, her father, Mason York, and brother, Hugh, are high-ranking members of the criminal Onyx Group. Sam infiltrates the group to bring down its leader, Mr. Black, using Serena’s connections. When Hugh discovers their relationship, he demands a breakup, but Serena refuses. In a desperate move, Mason gives Serena an ultimatum: choose Sam or cut ties with her father. Serena chooses Sam, enraging Mason, who orders Sam’s death. But Maria Lane, Serena's mother, intervenes, testing Sam's love by forcing him to stab himself. Surviving, Sam earns her trust and deepens his infiltration. As Mason and Hugh plot to eliminate Sam, they hire deadly assassin Kate Ross to sabotage his relationship with Serena. Now, Sam must clear his name, dismantle Onyx Group, and win back Serena’s love.

book_title: Last Gift to My Love-Hate Family
special_desc:
Seven years ago, Zane Sterling took the fall for his younger brother Hunter Sterling in a fatal hit-and-run. His own fiancée Diana Archer testified against him, sending Zane to prison while his parents Tyler Sterling and Claire Shaw watched in silence.

During his seven-year sentence, Zane conducted research on controllable nuclear fusion technology (CNFT), earning recognition from the National Science Institute (NSI). Upon release, he discovered his family never wanted him back. After enduring repeated heartbreak, he chose to walk away.

Zoe Smith unexpectedly has a fling with Julian Snider. While she's tormented by guilt over betraying her boyfriend, she discovers that her boyfriend had already been cheating on her with her bestie. Upon learning the truth, Zoe decides to marry Julian, unaware of his true identity...

Caleb Lynn returned to Gorehorn Mountain and discovered that his master had arranged a marriage for him. His fiancée, Yasmin Grant, even came to find him. To prevent Oracle Jade from causing chaos, he decided to follow Yasmin down the mountain in search of the jade.

On the brink of death, Melody McGee uncovers a shocking secret: her husband, Paul Briggs, is alive and masquerading as his twin brother, Basil, while living with Basil's wife! Given a second chance, Melody is hell-bent on revenge.

book_title: Restoring My Life: From Blood Bank to CEO's Bride
special_desc: Betrayed by her own mother, her sister, and her fiancé during her last life, she won't repeat her mistakes this time. With her relic-storing skills and relationship with the tycoon in Kingcott, she's bound to make her way up to the highest. In this life, she'll only cherish true love and exact her revenge.

Elara Raven's daughter was declared dead. Her lover abandoned her. Now, six years later as a music diva, a little stranger's song on a competition stage reminds her of the very song she wrote for her daughter. Her child is alive. The fight to reclaim the life stolen from her begins now.

book_title: The 100-Day Bride I Married Is A Legend
special_desc: In the countryside, Sarah Peay discovers the gravely injured Ted Vaughn and performs life-saving surgery on him. Due to his weakened state, Ted never clearly sees Sarah's face. Unexpectedly, Sarah enters a 100-day marriage with Ted as part of a contract arranged by her grandfather, embarking on a transformative journey as his wife.

Joyce Shaw, a gifted girl from the countryside, enters Juhama University with big dreams, only to be framed for crimes she didn't commit. Expelled and blacklisted, she works in the shadows for five years. Her world changes when Liam Rute, a powerful heir, saves her, seeing the star she truly is. When her past is brutally exposed and her mother falls ill, Joyce decides to fight back. With Liam by her side, she's ready to reclaim her name, her future, and her stolen spotlight.

book_title: Surviving Ancient Times with a Useless Husband
special_desc: When Rosemary wakes up, she discovers she's been transported into the body of a woman from ancient times, burdened with four stepchildren and a deadbeat husband. The family is so emaciated they look like refugees, and to top it off, debt collectors come knocking! Furious, Rosemary kicks her useless husband out. Then, with her sleeves rolled up, she sets out to rebuild the family, excelling at hunting, carrying loads, and defeating bandits...

Framed by Noble Consort Sheffield, Josephine died in a palace fire with her newborn prince. Reborn with a mysterious fertility system, she returns to the inner court determined to change her fate. Battling scheming concubines, a calculating emperor, and a ruthless empress dowager, she climbs the ranks through strategy, alliances, and the children she bears. In the end, Josephine helps Princess Serena claim the throne and secures ultimate power as Empress Dowager.
She lost her job in a company meltdown but landed a new gig as her old rival's secretary. Amid the challenges, sparks fly between them. But can their budding romance survive the tests ahead?

My 25-Year-Old BAE Wife movie summary talks about a flash marriage between Elliana Palmer, a rich CEO of the Phoenix group who marries Edwin Higgins, a single father and a security guard after his date humiliates him for his profession.
Elliana’s story is filled with her savage comebacks at her husband's bullies and a budding romance with Edward as she figures how to be a mother to her stepdaughter.

book_title: Spoil My Wife After Waking Up
special_desc: A wealthy heir conceals his identity and falls in love with his girlfriend. Following a tragic car accident that leaves him in a vegetative state, his girlfriend stays by his side, unwavering in her devotion. Eight years later, he finally wakes up...

When she was young, she witnessed her parents' death. Fifteen years later, she became a general, defending her country, and after triumphantly returning home, she intended to uncover the truth about her past, only to unexpectedly find her grandfather's family being mistreated. The events from years ago seemed not so simple after all.

book_title: Reborn in the 80s: Plus-Size Wife's Success
special_desc:
I finally managed to lose weight, but unexpectedly, I traveled back to 1988 and became a fat girl again! 
In my past life, I was a top fashion designer. In this life, I'm once again overweight and suddenly have a retired soldier as a husband! The villagers dislike me, and another woman constantly bullies me. But my husband keeps saving me from trouble. I need to take action too!
Since I could lose weight in my past life, I believe I can do it again in this life! Watch me transform and use my skills to become rich! As for love...Well, adults don't decide between them. I want both!

A mentally impaired mother gave birth to a pair of twins, a boy and a girl. After her husband's untimely death, the family lived in poverty. The younger brother, craving chicken soup, persuaded their simple-minded mother to steal a chicken, which led to the neighbors demanding compensation when they were caught. To avoid responsibility, the brother falsely accused his sister, and their ruthless grandmother sent the sister away.Years later, the sister, now a successful CEO, unexpectedly reunites with her long-lost mother and brother. Shockingly, she witnesses her ungrateful brother publicly humiliating their mother...

book_title: The Rise of the Mute Beauty with A Ruthless Prince
special_desc: The girl is an unloved child in the family. She is smart and beautiful, but because she is persecuted, she can only pretend to be dumb to avoid the spotlight. Because her sister is no longer a virgin, she is forced to take the girl's place and have sex with the prince for one night. Later, the girl escaped from the house with her mother and found out that she was pregnant. Five years later, she gave birth to a pair of twins. But what she didn't expect was that the man from that year seemed to have discovered the truth and came to her...

An accident let the girl who was originally from a rich family separated from her family. And after many years of meeting again but made a joke of fate, the class prejudice has pushed away the opportunity to recognize each other again and again. How they pushed past their prejudices and met again.

She’s his adopted sister, but he has always kept his feelings for her hidden. When he sees his cancer diagnosis, he decides to find her a good man to marry, someone who will take care of her. She responds, “Do you really hate me that much? I’m not getting married!”

A wealthy heiress is kidnapped during her childhood. While escaping, she sacrifices herself to save a member of a prominent family but is replaced by the kidnappers, leaving her mute and believing her abductor to be her father. Meanwhile, the kidnappers' daughter is transformed into the true heiress. As adults, the mute woman and the wealthy man inadvertently spend a night together. Can they uncover each other's true identities and rekindle their love?
She and he were childhood sweethearts. An accident separated them. She donated her corneas to him. Years later, after regaining his sight, would he still be able to recognize her?

Despite being newly married, Nicole Lane suffers a heartbreaking betrayal at her husband's hands, leading to the tragic loss of her child. Unable to cope with the pain, she loses her sanity—only to reunite with Liam Holt five years later. After enduring years of cruelty from her former mother-in-law and mistreatment by the household staff, Nicole regains her memories and vows revenge. With Liam's help, she sets a trap for her ex-husband. As they navigate hardships together, love blossoms between them, and Liam paves the way for their future with a heartfelt proposal.

Sara, a workaholic from a cutthroat tech giant, wakes up in an imperial palace with nothing but a goofy, scatterbrained "system" by her side. But she's not here for love or loyalty, she's here to climb. Treating palace intrigue like office politics, Sara turns every superior into a stepping stone. Even the emperor? Just another tool for her next promotion.

Fresh out of prison, Irene just wants to start over, but she accidentally falls into John's trap. Now her creditor, John, forces her into a cruel game: to repay her debt by seducing his brother, Eric. But as the dangerous game unfolds, John's revenge turns into obsession, and his heart begins to betray his plan. By the time he realizes he's fallen for her, it's already too late to turn back.

Abandoned on her wedding night, noblewoman Vera is divorced after her husband returns from war with a mistress and child. Refusing to be discarded, she reinvents herself, using her rare medical talent to cure the Prince Regent and earn power of her own. As court enemies close in, Vera rises from betrayed wife to a woman capable of changing the empire's fate.

A rich young lady and a wealthy CEO cross paths while fleeing from their arranged marriages. They agree to a contract marriage, each hiding their true identities. As they navigate this arrangement, caring for one another, love gradually begins to blossom.

She is a mistress hunter, accepting commissions to help housewives find evidence of their husbands' infidelity. But little did she know, this time's assignment would turn out to be a trap. The billionaire had long seen through her disguise, and he offered her a new proposition...

book_title: She Dumped the CEO with His Child
special_desc: Five years ago, they were provoked to break up. She gave birth to their child and had amnesia. Five years later, he returned as the richest man, and met with the downtrodden her, and their destinies were once again entangled.

book_title: Imposter War God: The Return of the Dragon General
special_desc: An ordinary office worker is approached by a beautiful warrior, who asks him to impersonate a fallen commander because they look identical. As he steps into this dangerous role, he must navigate those who want to expose him and those who wish to exploit his newfound identity. He soon realizes that pretending to be the commander comes with immense risks and costs.

When the daughter called her father to save her collapsed mother, he was too busy taking care of his first love and her child. Unable to accept her mother’s death, the daughter continues to care for her as if she’s still alive, while the mother’s spirit lingers, unable to leave. Will the mother finally find peace, and will her daughter ever find happiness?

Four siblings were born into a poor rural family, but they were happy as long as they were together. Everything changed when their parents tragically drowned, causing their already struggling family to collapse completely. The eldest sibling, at just ten years old, was unable to support the younger ones on their own. For their safety, they had to endure the pain of begging others to take care of them, leading to a separation that lasted for twenty years.
Over the years, due to the realities of life, the eldest sibling lost contact with the younger ones. This only deepened the guilt and regret, as they believed they had lost them. Determined to find them, the eldest was shocked when the second sibling returned as the powerful chairwoman of a major corporation.

She died in the year he loved her most. With a billion-dollar fortune, he threw it all away, choosing to follow her in death. When she opens her eyes again, she’s back to the years when she despised him. With a bitter smile, he says, “Want a divorce? Over my dead body.”

An ancient princess is murdered on her wedding day and reincarnates into the body of a modern woman. In her new life, she isn't interested in her CEO husband's affection and asks for a divorce, which grabs his attention. It's then that he realizes his wife is nothing like he imagined, and he begins to be drawn to her step by step, ultimately falling deeply in love with her.

Faced with just three months to live, the once meek Joanna undergoes a bold transformation. She exposes her colleagues' dark secrets, cuts off her toxic parents, and ditches her cheating fiancé. In a whirlwind of liberation, she finally meets her true love—only to find it's too late...

On a full moon night five years ago, Sienna Miller, in a drunken mishap, stumbled into the wrong room and had a one-night stand with Xavier Payne, resulting in the birth of her son, Zack Miller. Fast forward four years, her son Zack begins to show strange symptoms, causing fear and misunderstanding among people, and is labeled a monster and locked up. Just as things seem dire, Xavier appears and saves Zack. It is then that Sienna discovers the mysterious man from five years ago is, in fact, the legendary werewolf...

Medical student Chloe accidentally saves a billionaire, Alaric Lawson, resulting in an unexpected pregnancy. He finds her and insists on marriage, showering her with devotion. But navigating his wealthy family brings jealousy, schemes, and a long-lost uncle. Can their contract marriage blossom into true love against all odds?

Elaine Norman, whose hidden identity was the Master Healer, was coerced by her father into marrying Matthew Stone after serving time in prison for a crime she took the blame for her father, with her twin sons held as leverage. When she tragically discovered her youngest son had died, Elaine stumbled upon an identical birthmark on Matthew's son during her mourning...

Sunny, a modern doctor, is thrust into the ancient realm of Logopolis and bound to a merciless "childbearing system." Tasked with giving an heir to the powerful but heirless General Julian, she wins his trust and bears his child, only to discover the cruel twist: it doesn’t count unless Julian chooses her willingly, as both partner and mother of his future heirs.

Ethan Kelce, a dedicated disciple, descends from the mountain on a mission to reunite with his fiancée, only to discover her injured and wheelchair-bound, tormented by bullies. Driven by love and justice, Ben pledges to shield her from harm. No one dares cross him, especially when it comes to his future wife. With fierce determination, he embarks on a quest to confront those who wronged her!

After catching her boyfriend cheating, Clara's car breaks down in the mountains. There, she meets Terry, a poor college student working part-time as a mechanic. She takes him in, not knowing he's the long-lost heir to a powerful family. Their fragile romance collapses under the weight of his secret, and Terry walks away, unaware that Clara is pregnant. Years later, he returns with power and wealth, and their love story begins again.

Bennett Lilley is dispatched on a covert mission to protect Rachel Snyder, a formidable billionaire. Disguised as a security guard, Bennett delves deep into Rachel's life. As a host of wealthy adversaries closes in, their worlds become inextricably intertwined.

book_title: Love Found Her After the Divorce
special_desc: After a chance encounter reveals her "struggling" husband, Paxon, is actually a billionaire, Sienna's world shatters. When a casual apology is his only offer for gifting jewels to another, she walks away. Now divorced, Paxon expects her to return. But Sienna stuns everyone by entering a marriage contract with a mysterious tycoon.

book_title: My Rich Sis Got My Back
special_desc: She endured workplace bullying and harassment until one day when her badass twin sister finally found her back.

A wealthy young lady is born with a congenital vocal cord defect and is hidden away at home for twenty years. When her parents' company faces severe setbacks, her father, unable to bear the shame, jumps from a building, and her mother follows in a pact of love. Left alone, she is forced into marriage, pregnant...

book_title: CEO Daddy Spoils His Wife Sweetly
special_desc: Since childhood, she bore her parents' disapproval due to a birthmark on her face. Unexpectedly, she saved him from being drugged, and miraculously, the birthmark vanished. Grateful, he planned a billion-dollar gift and proposed marriage.

Forced into marriage by her family, she flash-married a beggar she found on the street, only to discover he was a wealthy CEO who had lost his memory in a plane crash. Under her care, his memories returned, and the secrets behind the crash were revealed!

She worked tirelessly to earn money so her son could attend university. Ten years later, having achieved success, he turned into an ungrateful man and forgets about his humble beginnings. Being disappointed, she found out that the young boy she saved many years ago is now her son's boss...

book_title: Let Me Stay By Your Side
special_desc: You and your sister are orphans and grow up together with your brother who is your neighbor. One day, returning home together, the brother picked up a pack of cigarettes out of curiosity. While all three were inside, a fire broke out, and your sister and the brother were rescued, while you were left behind. Many years later, you grew up to become a successful CEO, while your sister became a worn-out housewife to the neighbor's brother. Initially wanting revenge on your sister, you discover her enduring domestic abuse while pregnant, which deeply makes you hurt too. When your sister faces a life-threatening situation, you face a crucial decision: whether or not to save her.

She is a grassroots girl, and he is a wealthy young heir. They flash-married! After that, the vast difference in their backgrounds creates numerous obstacles for them. How will they weather the storms together? Can they stand by each other until the end?

I was born with a birthmark on my face, which made me disliked by my biological parents. I was bullied since I was a child. When I grew up, I accidentally saved the billionaire CEO who was drugged, and the birthmark on my face miraculously disappeared.
