The mysterious CEO therefore prepared a gift worth hundreds of billions, wanting to marry me...

book_title: My Bestie Wants My One-Night Stand CEO
special_desc:
I was mistakenly sent to the bed of a billionaire by my best friend. Afther the steamy night, he was looking for me all over the city. 
However, my best friend betrayed me for his incredible wealth and disguised herself as me.
But when I successfully passed the interview of the company, why did this billionaire boss look so familiar? Could he find out I was the girl from that night...

book_title: Earning Millions as the CEO's Lover
special_desc: The old CEO died mysteriously. In order to find out the mastermind behind the death, his son pretended to be down and out, and even became a servant. He endured poverty and humiliation from the powerful. And... He endured my plunder. Now the storm has come again, he has returned to the top, and he has taken revenge on those who offended him. And I am actually at the top of his revenge list.

book_title: The Return of the Beggar: Starting from Being Picked Up by a Beauty
special_desc: I once possessed remarkable martial skills, but after a girl risked her life to save me, I sacrificed all my power to bring her back to life, losing my memory in the process and becoming a fool. Grateful for my sacrifice, she took me in as her husband and protected me for three years. However, my foolishness made me an easy target for bullying. Now, as her family pressures her to marry for profit, I unexpectedly regain my memories and powers. I decide to keep pretending to be a fool, secretly guarding her while outsmarting those who underestimate me...

The woman mistakenly thought that the man really loved someone else. When the three-year agreement expired, she left the wedding ring, moved out of the wedding house, signed her name on the divorce agreement, and did not entangle. But her husband...

book_title: The Heiress's Regret: Spoiled by Her Three Brothers
special_desc: Once the beloved little princess of her family, she turned her back on them for the sake of her boyfriend, willing to sacrifice everything for love. But when he reveals his true colors after securing a massive investment, he tries to cast her aside for the wealthy daughter of a powerful businessman. Just as she faces humiliation from her ex and his family, her three brothers swoop in to reclaim her. They embark on a journey of revenge against the ex, showering her with love and support, while she also finds a high-quality fiancé along the way.

book_title: Love Beyond Misunderstanding with My Daddy CEO
special_desc: The uncle CEO rescued the girl who was molested by the bad guys. Unexpectedly, the two had sex after being drugged. Not long after, the girl found out that she was pregnant and found the president. However, because the CEO knew that she was singing with him, he mistakenly thought that the girl was a vain and gold-digger... When will the CEO know that his savior was actually this girl?

Princess Yue Changge fought to secure her brother’s claim to the throne by opposing corrupt officials and leading successful campaigns. After her return to court, she was ambushed, and her cousin Fu Qingluan was killed by mistake. Before dying, Fu Qingluan revealed her mistreatment by in-laws and asked Yue Changge to avenge her and care for her daughter. Disguised as her cousin, Yue Changge seeks revenge while uncovering court conspiracies. She reconciles with Yun Chuxu, whom she had once broken off their engagement with, and together they defeat their enemies and find happiness.

Heiress Joy Quinn hides her identity and cuts ties with her family to marry broke boyfriend Ryan Zimmer. But just as she's about to give birth, betrayal strikes. With the baby in the wrong position, Joy checks into a private hospital. But Ryan's best friend Yasmine accuses her of faking it for luxury. Manipulated, Ryan tries to move Joy to a cheaper clinic, sparking explosive drama. Just then, Joy's father, billionaire Raymond Quinn, arrives bearing lavish gifts. But Ryan and Yasmine mock him, refusing to believe his identity. As three elite CEOs show up honor Quinn, the truth is revealed. But it's already too late. Joy loses the baby and demands a divorce. Desperate, Ryan spreads lies online, accusing Joy and her father of murdering the child. The internet turns vicious. Raymond strikes back with evidence, and calls the police. In the end, Ryan and Yasmine are convicted and sentenced.

Elite agent Neve Flower is thrust into the past, inhabiting the body of the Prime Minister's dim-witted second daughter, destined to marry the infamous Prince Kivar. Tasked with producing an heir, she sets her sights on the capital's most alluring man to secretly father her child. Little does she know, he is actually the true Prince Kivar in disguise...

To get out of an arranged marriage, Jane, the fearless daughter of a gang boss, rushes into a marriage with Luke, a brilliant scientist from an elite family. What starts as a marriage of convenience soon shakes up Luke's quiet, research-driven world, as Jane's bold charm brings color and chaos to his once predictable life.

Fiona Wynn, a charismatic and proud princess, finds herself thrust into the story slandering her—cast as the despised “vicious lady”. Divorced by her husband, mocked by her half-brother whom she once scorned, and pursued by the nobleman whom she once rejected, Fiona faces a world that wants her gone. But soon, the tables begin to turn.

book_title: Miss Secretary, You Stole His Heart
special_desc: Opal is a smart, witty, and resilient young woman, navigating her career with ease as the indispensable secretary to CEO Silas. As she faces the persistent entanglements of a past love and family interference, Silas begins to be drawn to her. Caught in the whirlwind of work and romance, Opal bravely chooses her own path to happiness.

Felicia Snook donates a fortune to aid her cousin, Crown Prince Ollie Gill, with disaster relief, in return for his promise to make her his Crown Princess. Yet, upon his victorious return, Ollie and his father strip her of her title and status and grant them to her half-sister. Feeling betrayed, Felicia empties the marquis's estate, expels the scoundrel, aids her mother in obtaining a divorce, and uses her fortune to secure her position as a princess. With a strategic grip on commerce, she is determined to make all those who wronged her regret their actions.

From the ashes of a legend, Grace Stoll emerges as an adopted daughter and a stand-in bride for her "sister." Everyone assumes she's just a country girl with no manners and that her husband is an outcast from his influential family. But is that really the case?

Cecilia Yeager is reborn on the day of her murder. To survive and get revenge, she agrees to marry Raymond Hawthorne. But on her wedding day, her groom is reported dead. This time, Cecilia must fight to claim her rightful place. Gavin, the mysterious bodyguard assigned to protect her—who hides a shocking secret that could destroy them all or save them both.

Her virgin was sold by her husband to a stranger, and after giving birth, she was deceived into believing her baby had died. Five years later, her husband divorced her for his mistress. Little did she know, she was actually the heiress to a fortune, and the stranger she had a one-night stand with was a billionaire. Moreover, her child was alive..

The mute girl was sent to the CEO's bed as a gift. After marriage, everyone thought he was ashamed to take her out, but little did they know he was completely enamored by her and doted on her endlessly!

book_title: The Runaway CEO Wife Has Two Babies
special_desc: After divorcing his ex-wife, he never got involved with any other woman. He refused to acknowledge that he had once loved her. However, upon reuniting, he realized that, both physically and emotionally, his true love was his ex-wife, not his first love.

The heiress of the wealthiest family hides her identity to repay gratitude, marrying into a family where she remains undercover. Three years later, she discovers her husband cheating and learns that her identity as the heiress has been stolen by the nanny's daughter. Bullied and driven out of home, she faces relentless hostility from those who ousted her. No longer willing to be lenient, she decides to take a stand.

Billionaire’s Second Chance Wife movie summary is all about Lillian Hart, a single divorced mother who meets CEO Frederick Harrington after a blind date mishap.
Frederick offers to marry Lillian Hart when she's bullied by her ex-husband Nathan along with his mistress. Lillian doesn't know her flash marriage husband is a CEO billionaire and that she was on a wrong date.
After my wife pushed me off the building, I was reborn the day before I sold my wife and daughter. This time, I made up my mind to change my bad habits and let my family live a good life.

book_title: Silent Dragonbone: The Dust of the Azure Dragon
special_desc:
He was once the heir of a prestigious family, born with a rare dragon bone and celebrated as a martial arts prodigy, a genius not seen in a hundred years. However, his stepmother, driven by ambition, forcibly transplanted his dragon bone into his younger brother.
From that day forward, he became a cripple. With the help of his childhood friend, he barely escaped the clutches of his family. But she, in order to protect him, was forever left behind in the events of ten years ago.
Now, a decade later, he returns with two goals—revenge and to fulfill the promise he made to her. However, a royal decree of marriage pulls him into a love triangle, torn between two women.
From that day forward, he became a cripple. With the help of his childhood friend, he barely escaped the clutches of his family. But she, in order to protect him, was forever left behind in the events of ten years ago.
Now, a decade later, he returns with two goals—revenge and to fulfill the promise he made to her. However, a royal decree of marriage pulls him into a love triangle, torn between two women.

book_title: Pregnant at 40: The CEO's Unexpected Love
special_desc: After divorcing her abusive ex-husband, a woman struggles to raise her daughter while working as a cleaner. One night, after an unexpected encounter with a CEO who was under the influence, she finds herself pregnant. Unsure whether to reveal the truth, the CEO and his mother appear before her. To her surprise, both the CEO and his family spare no expense or love to support her.

The lady of the house gave birth to a girl, but due to the family's preference for sons, she feared being expelled. In desperation, she secretly swapped her daughter for a baby boy. Her biological daughter was found and raised by a humble, poor farmer. By a twist of fate, the girl fell in love with the boy who had been swapped into the family. The lady, believing the girl was only after money, subjected her to endless humiliation. However, she later discovered that the girl was her own daughter, leaving her full of deep regret.

Theo James’s entire family was massacred 20 years, with him being the only survivor. Saved and taught martial skills by his teacher, Theo became the Heavenly King ruling over Opuland. Three years ago, Theo helped Katie Smith’s family business overcome a crisis when she and her grandfather came to him with the Heavenly Decree. It was prophesied that the woman who came with the decree would be his mate, so Theo approached and married Katie without her knowing his true identity. After some success in her business, Katie wanted a divorce from Theo who was working as a delivery driver. She and Demi Nolan, his ex-fiancée, humiliated Theo in public time and time again. Only at the Red Feast would they find out about Theo’s true identity and regret their past dismissal of him.

After a flash marriage to Silas York, CEO of York Group, Lillian Smith visits his room each night to treat him, fulfilling her mentor’s dying wish. Battling a relentless illness, Silas keeps his distance, unaware that the very woman he pushes away is the miracle doctor he has desperately been searching for all along.

book_title: The Bliss of Loss and Rediscovery
special_desc:
Five years ago, Lyra Jones became pregnant with Charles Coleman's child. During delivery, she suffered severe hemorrhage and was critical. Charles' subordinate posed as her relative, bribed a nurse, took the twins to Charles, and Lyra was told they didn't survive.
Five years later, Lyra was harassed by Raymond Walter in a jewelry store. She pretended to be married with a child and asked her friend Mia Clark to find her a husband. During a blind date at a coffee shop, her conversation with Mia was overheard by Patrick and Andrew Coleman, who posed as the date's children. Charles returned to the shop, discovered the children had replaced the date, and took them away. Raymond suddenly showed up and demanded Lyra repay the money, leading Charles to mistakenly think she was a gold digger. Despite this, Charles married Lyra for the children's sake.
While Lyra was buying gifts for Charles' children at the jewelry store, Raymond appeared. Charles helped Lyra handle the situation, and they went home to celebrate the kids' birthdays. Later, Lyra moved in with Charles. One day after work, Raymond attacked Lyra in retaliation, and Charles, who was picking her up, saved her. Raymond's wife later came to the store causing trouble for Lyra but left upset.
With Charles' assistance, Lyra signed a contract with Mr. Martin, followed by a KTV celebration. Charles, suspecting Lyra's identity, asked Gavin Brown to investigate. While shopping with Mia, Lyra encountered Charles and Zoe Brown, realizing her feelings for Charles. After Charles clarified Zoe's identity, they returned home, where they met Dennis Coleman. Charles explained the situation to Dennis to protect his identity.
While the jewelry store celebrated Lyra's entry into the Coleman Group competition, she discovered Charles' true identity and sought a divorce. Zoe then admitted her feelings for Charles and urged Lyra to leave him. With friends' support, Charles worked tirelessly to reconcile with Lyra. Meanwhile, Zoe found out Lyra was the children's biological mother, destroyed the evidence, and had Lena Shire pose as their mother.
Ultimately, Charles' efforts led Lyra to forgive him while discovering her identity. Later, Lena kidnapped Lyra to threaten Charles, revealing everything to her.

book_title: My Worst Employee Is a Secret Big Shot!
special_desc:
A disgraced heir from an elite family hides his identity while working at a rival conglomerate. Branded as incompetent, he is chosen as a fake fiancé by the company's ice-cold CEO to deflect her family’s pressure. Unbeknownst to all, he is a legendary figure—a shadow monarch of the underworld, a mercenary king, and a revered healer.
At a patriarch’s birthday celebration, his modest gift is mocked until a revered antiquities expert reveals it as a priceless national treasure. He exposes the fraudulence of other heirs’ lavish offerings, humiliating the scheming family. Meanwhile, his own father arrives with an arranged bride, tightening the web of deception.
When the family obsesses over securing invitations to an exclusive state banquet honoring the mysterious "Dragon King," he casually claims he can obtain ten passes. Skepticism turns to shock when a high-ranking envoy delivers them personally, confirming his unimaginable power. As alliances shift and secrets unravel, his true identity threatens to overturn every lie—and rewrite the rules of the game.

Maria Dolton and her father, Zeph Dolton, fled the Infernal Abyss to escape the clutches of Chad Delgado, the ruthless ruler of the Infernal Tribunal. Hoping to build a peaceful life in Graton, they crossed paths with Yvonne Garza, the powerful CEO of Eclipse Group. To avoid an arranged marriage, Yvonne married Zeph. When the Malcoms from Ranham gave Yvonne trouble in the competition for the CloudTop project, Maria defeated them—only to discover Chad was their backer. Then, she lured Chad to Graton and defeated him with Zeph once and for all, bringing peace to both Graton and the Infernal Abyss.

Mia York impersonated heiress Chloe Lynn to attend CEO Silas Ford's matchmaking, demanding huge dowry but unmasked. Silas later became her boss. He enforced a "Ten-Date Pact"; Mia faced false accusations defending Hart Studio but got Silas' covert aid. Posing as "Eve York" to ease his family's marriage pressure, she became his fake girlfriend. Their charade revealed her authenticity and his hidden warmth.​

Right before her engagement, Cecilia escapes a cheating fiancé and a greedy family, only to find herself unexpectedly pregnant after a chance encounter with Springfield's heir, Chris. Determined to build a new life, she starts over at a luxury resort, but she finds that Chris has just bought it. She wants independence. He wants her. In the battle between ambition and love, Cecilia finds both.

After being framed and killed in a car accident, Nancy wakes up in a modern CEO novel. Only this time, she's the despised "villainess" with the same name, the so-called true daughter the Jones family brought back from the countryside three years ago. Bound to a system that ensures everyone despises her, Nancy must fight against her cursed fate, determined to turn hatred into power and reclaim her place in this new life.

Mocked her classmates, Jessie Stark gains x-ray vision suddenly and can spot priceless antiques, predict stocks, and even see illnesses. From hustling in backstreet markets to dominating high-society auctions, Jessie turns her gift into a fortune—all while dodging rivals, outsmarting bullies, and untangling a web of secrets involving Gordon Graham, Leo Lawson, and a mysterious tycoon who knows more about her power than she does.

On the day of the wedding dress fitting, I'm dragged into the fitting room by my fiancé's brother, humiliated, and in pain. I grit my teeth, enduring it, 'Does my innocent brother know you've been played by me?' I've been running for seven years, hoping to escape the nightmare, but I can't seem to shake his grip.

An ordinary office worker reluctantly purchased a foreclosed house to fulfill his girlfriend's long-standing wish for marriage. Little did he know, this house holds a hidden secret... What awaits him?

As a kid, the heiress was taken away but found her family later. Her foster sister got jealous and tricked her, causing her mom's death. But, she also got pregnant by a rich guy. Pretending to be dead, she came back after five years, determined to make those who hurt her pay for it.

book_title: The Devious CEO and His Irresistible Wife
special_desc: She was born into a rich family and would have a happy marriage, but her jealous sister caused her trouble, and the man she loved misunderstood and humiliated her... In a crisis, her real family came to her rescue.

book_title: My Homeless Hubby Is a Trillionaire
special_desc: On the eve of her wedding, she discovers her fiancé's infidelity. In a fit of anger, she marries a stranger on a whim. Little did she know that her handsome homeless husband is actually a trillionaire CEO!

book_title: My Down-and-Out Hubby Is a CEO
special_desc: The rich girl wants to live like normal folks, so she leaves her big house, rents a small place, and starts delivering food, yet she finds an injured guy on the road. She helps him, and he says he's got no money and can't remember where he lives. She lets him stay for a while, not knowing he also has a secret identity...

book_title: My Security Guard Dad Holds a Fortune!
special_desc: A content security guard watches his ambitious son build a billion-dollar empire and advises caution. As the son's business collapses, the father steps in to turn the tide. The son is astonished to discover that his father is not just a security guard but the world's richest!
The groom is a cripple, and the bride is a bumpkin. People make fun of them, but little do they know, both harbor their secrets, waiting for the right moment...

After marriage, she was disrespeced by her husband's family/ Now, back in her elite family, she's out for revenge. She puts her mother-in-law in her place, kicks out her cheating husband, and deals with the mistress. Amid her bold moves, she unexpectedly falls in love with her old savior...

book_title: My Five Brothers Are Big Shots
special_desc: Her foster parents despised her as a poor and fake heiress, but little did they know she would return to her billionaire biological family, where her five big brothers and her billionaire CEO boyfriend doted on her endlessly!

book_title: Back to My Ex-Husband with Our Twin Geniuses
special_desc: Six years ago, she left after an event that nearly cost her life. Now, returning with her son, she met someone from her past at an auction, yet it appeared she had completely forgotten him...
For five years, a woman was the secret lover of her boss, but he never truly loved her back. Fed up, she decided to leave the jerk she'd loved for so long, yet he was in a total panic...

She had a one-night stand with the president due to an accident and got pregnant. However, her best friend took her unborn baby girl and dumped the body down the cliff. Luckily, she still had a baby boy in her womb. Five years later, she returned with her son and reunited with the president.

book_title: The Billionaire CEO and the Quintuplets
special_desc: Rosalind Scott was set up by her family for a one-night stand with a potential investor but along the line, a mistake happened, and another man slept with Rosalind. She quickly returned home in The Billionaire’s Quintuplets Movie. Matthew Albert was the billionaire who slept with Rosalind instead, and when he returned with gifts, Rosalind was exchanged with her stepsister.

Years ago, I had a one-night stand, and ended up pregnant! However, after giving birth, my baby was taken away from me...
Now, I return to the country, and accidentally meet my child and his father! Once, I protected my child from danger, and they started calling me lifesaver. I didn't know, my child has started to be skeptical of my identity since our first encounter! He insists that he should be calling me mommy, and his dad should be calling me his wife.

He was once a genius entrepreneur who dominated the business world. However, due to persecution, he went into hiding, assuming a low-profile life as a designated driver. Twenty years later, to save his son's company from being sabotaged by an old rival, he decides to make a comeback...

Seven years ago, she was falsely accused of cheating by her sister, leading to divorce and her departure from him. Seven years later, she returned to the country with a pair of twins. The two children racked their brains to reconcile with their parents. How would they overcome the enemies' malice and past misunderstandings?

book_title: Never Fall For My Father's Friend
special_desc: Misunderstandings led to her divorce from her CEO husband. To pay for her son's medical bills, she decides to work as a hostess at a club. Little did she expect to encounter her ex-husband again. She believed he despised her and loved her sister, his first love. And the CEO's ex didn't even realize that he had always loved his ex-wife.

book_title: The Two-Faced CEO Falls for the Substitute Bride
special_desc: Forced to marry a man with her ex-boyfriend's heart, she unexpectedly fell in love with him over time. However, when he discovered the truth of the past, he began to revenge her fiercely, causing her miscarriage and the loss of her mother. Can they finally open up their hearts to each other?

She gave up her music career for their marriage, choosing to reenter the workforce under a hidden identity after years. Unbeknownst to her, her husband is the CEO of the company. Faced with a colleague who is impersonating her, she must decide how to handle the situation

"This is the life that you wanted?" She hid her identity as a wealthy heiress and married a poor guy, only to be bullied by his family even during pregnancy. 
Moreover, the girl her husband has been hooking up with is the daughter of the nanny from her original family, who has been impersonating her identity!
No more endurance! She finally decides to fight back, and regain everything!
She also meets a hot billionaire CEO, who is so protective and supportive along her side. Where will this new romance lead them?"

After marrying the young underworld leader, he tragically passed away in a car accident just three months later. At the funeral, she was pressured to relinquish control of the gang. Suddenly returning from years abroad, the second young master appeared. To her astonishment, he looked exactly like her passed-away husband!

I just started my career as a singer, and my boyfriend betrayed me and drugged me! I ran away, bumped into a hot guy, and ended up having a one-night stand with him! Little did I know, he is a billionaire CEO.
After that, during the lowest period of my life, I discover myself pregnant! And in a condition that I didn’t realize, I met the baby’s father again, and he offered me a home! When will I know he is the man I hooked up with? Will he be my redemption?

book_title: I Won't Let You Be Alone
special_desc:
As the best student in the grade, I was bullied, only because I was deaf!
Fifteen years ago, my grandpa who is mute adopted me and raised me. Years later, my grandpa and I were bullied and humiliated by a rich man. I didn't know at that time, that he was my brother!
He knew my identity but is afraid that our mother would care less about him once I returned home, so he threw away my necklace, which was the token. What should I do to protect my grandpa, and where will destiny lead me?

book_title: Mommy, Daddy Wants to Remarry You
special_desc: She had just given birth to twins, but her sister took away one kid, killed her and the other kid, and threw them into the wilderness. However, she did not die. Three years later, she returned with the child and tried to take back the other baby...

book_title: My Ex-CEO Hubby Cries For Remarriage
special_desc: She fake married him to fulfill her grandfather's last wish, but she finds that he has been taking care of his puppy love all the time. She was disappointed and proposed a divorce. On the other hand, he was searching for famous doctors for his puppy love, and finally found her and asked her to treat him. She wanted to stay a way, but can't help her feelings for him.

My husband killed me and my child cruelly to take our family's fortune!
 Unexpectedly, I'm given a second chance to be reborn! I married him to repay a debt in my past life, but he wasn’t my benefactor, just an imposter! The real benefactor helped me again in this life, allowing me to hide and seek revenge. Surrounded by danger, I was attacked again and lost my memory… What should I do?

book_title: Back in Time to be a Plus-Size Chef Concubine
special_desc:
"Ahhh! That meaty mountain reflected in the water is actually me!"
I was a world-class chef, but then, an unexpected explosion caused me to time travel, and turn into a newlywed fat girl!

Time-traveled back, I went from a beautiful chef to a 220-pound fat girl, facing humiliation and bullies. But don't forget, I still have my memories and my skills!
I decided to lose weight, and open a hotpot restaurant!
On my way to success, I discover that my husband, who appears to be a disfigured hunter, has a mysterious identity...

"Daughter, where are you?" My daughter was sold by my gambling-addicted husband, and I have failed to stop him! I was overwhelmed with despair and stabbed him. Afterward, I transformed from a housewife to a self-made businesswoman of power and influence, never ceasing to search for my daughter.
Years later, I encountered a cleaner's daughter. Upon seeing her, familiar feelings flooded my heart, but she had no memories of her childhood! When I lost my daughter, she carried a half-jade pendant that I had given her as a token. If she truly is my daughter, I will use my immense wealth and power to make amends for the hardships she endured in the past!

"I shouldn't have ever saved you and brought you up this mountain!" My teacher scolded me for ruining his precious ingredients to make the divine medicine, but later was surprised at the outcome, that I successfully made it out!
I am an orphan, study divine skilled with my teacher, and now come down the mountain to gain experiences. On the first day, I meet a girl, and saved her fatehr's life. Little did I know, they are my lost family, and little did they know, I'm a powerful figure with strong ability!

What’s happening? Why do I hear a voice that comes from the inside of me?
“Why do I have such a useless descendant like you!” It said. 
In my middle age, my wife cheated on me, and my daughter is ill. At this time of my desperation, a voice inside of me speaks. It says it is the dragon, that has been living inside of me!
How lucky I am! With the help of the dragon power, I will grasp any chance I can to change my fate!

book_title: Underworld King Fights For His Wife
special_desc:
Underworld King Fights For His Wife movie summary introduces us to Walder Turner, a great master who is working as a low-class worker by keeping his identity a secret.
Even his wife considers him a loser without realizing who he really is as she asks for a divorce. But little does she know that all her success is because of her husband, who helped behind her back.

Years after a forced breakup, my ex-boyfriend's mother took the money and begged me to get back together with him! 
“The affection of poorness is worthless.” My family company went bankrupt, my father committed suicide, my mother was critically ill, and I had no choice but to take my boyfriend's mother's money and leave him! Unexpectedly, many years later, his mother once again came to me with a huge amount of money, and begged me to return to his side! Little did I know, he had become a dominant CEO and all he wanted was to get back together with me! Should I say yes this time?

book_title: CEO, That Intern is Actually Your Wife
special_desc:
My billionaire CEO is my contract-married husband! 
My grandmother fell seriously ill, so I flash-married a stranger for her surgery fees. We entered a one-year contract marriage. I bumped into a handsome man, who I later found out was the CEO of the company I wanted to join! But little did I know, he was the man I married...
As the contract period nears its end, we are supposed to divorce. However, both of us lost our marriage certificates. Now what do we do? Does this mean we can't get divorced after all?

Framed by my stepmother and forced by my birth father, I married a man who has become a vegetable for a year for my step-sister.  Everyone said marrying him was doomed and unlucky, but my mother-in-law casually handed me a bank card worth millions on our wedding night! That night, my supposedly comatose husband slowly opened his eyes...
I once trusted my subordinates and brothers, but I didn't expect that they would jointly betray me! I was carried back home by a kind person, and I actually got a wife!

book_title: I'm a Female Urologist in a Drama
special_desc:
As a female urologist, I entered into a contract marriage with a patient who flirted with me!
I was entrusted by an old lady to treat her CEO grandson. He thought I was a blind date arranged by his grandmother and flirted with me. God knows I've seen so many men like him, so I acted super chill. After the treatment, his grandmother actually wanted to set us up. Well, I thought, I can use this chance to uncover the truth about my father's wrongful death years ago!
So I agreed to the contract marriage, but I didn't expect that I would slowly fall in love with him during the process...

book_title: Four-Fingered Dad Helps Me Slap Back
special_desc: Fifteen years ago, a father lost his finger while protecting his daughter, leading to their separation. Now, she faces betrayal from her ex-boyfriend, scorn from her family for her job as a water delivery worker, and the death of her adoptive father due to humiliation. As she struggles, her biological father—now a wealthy man—suddenly returns to take her home. However, the reunion is complicated by another woman who claims to be the true heiress, sparking imminent family conflict.

He has been loving the daughter of his enemy, tormenting her yet unable to release her from his heart. However, what he doesn't know is that to protect him, she endures his misunderstandings and remains by his side.

book_title: OMG! The Superstar's Wife Works Here
special_desc:
"The wife of the famous actor is coming to the set!" The director prepared a warm welcome.
Unexpectedly, dressed casually and riding an electric scooter, I was mistaken for a new actress. To my surprise, someone vain even pretended to be the wife of my husband! 
Everyone flattered her and bullied me. See how will I make them embarrassed!

book_title: The Triple Life of My Billionaire Husband
special_desc: To avoid marrying a old man, I have a one-night-stand with a stranger and impulsively got married to him. I thought he was just a penniless nobody, but it turns out he’s the richest billionaire man in the world! Now, we're teaming up to make everyone who looks down on us pay for it.

As a poor guy, he was chosen by a powerful divine ring, marking the start of his epic journey from zero to hero.  On his way to marry his girlfriend, he faces outrageous demands from his future mother-in-law, ridicule and mockery from friends and family, and a fierce rivalry with a powerful CEO. To defend his girlfriend who has always stood by him, he prepares for an epic battle.

Married for three years, my husband was always cold and indifferent to me. When his first love returned from abroad, he couldn't wait to ask for a divorce. But before we could sign the papers, he got into a car accident and lost his memory! Now, he's become a devoted, wife-loving maniac.

Having become a CEO, she learns that her long-lost twin sister was nearly bullied to death by classmates. She decides to assume her sister's identity and take revenge on the bullying group. Will the bullying gang recognize her true identity? What will their fate be?

She hides her identity as a CEO to go on a blind date, hoping to find an obedient man. He’s the head of a major corporation, but, unwilling to marry a gold digger, he pretends to be poor for the date. They hit it off and get married in a flash. Little do they know, their companies are deeply intertwined, and they come close to discovering each other's true identities multiple times...

book_title: The Contract Wife Who Was Once Loved
special_desc:
Three years ago, a car accident left her in a vegetative state. Her childhood sweetheart stayed by her side, caring for her and waiting for her to wake up. However, a scheming woman deceived his mother into signing a marriage contract, forcing him to marry her with the stipulation that they couldn't divorce for a year. Despite the marriage, he continued to devote himself to his true love, his heart belonging only to her.
Consumed by jealousy, the scheming woman kidnapped her rival, switched faces with her through plastic surgery, and burned her vocal cords, rendering her mute. She then threw her into a fire, causing the two women to swap identities. Miraculously surviving, she woke up to find herself mute and suffering from amnesia. Facing abuse and scorn from her unaware lover, she tearfully accepted her new identity.
Can she, with her appearance and memory completely altered, reclaim her true identity and successfully take her revenge?

book_title: Becoming a Superstar Starts with Breakup
special_desc: After kneeling to his ex-wife for 99 days, he is reborn with a determination to become a superstar. Facing numerous challenges and opportunities, he competes in "The Voice," writes songs live on stage, and showcases his talent at a prestigious family banquet. Along the way, his complex relationships with his ex-wife, friends, and rivals add emotional depth and tension to his journey toward stardom.

She, a gentle and timid illegitimate daughter of a wealthy man, suffers abuse from her husband's family after marriage. When the wealthy man unexpectedly dies, she is the sole heir to his fortune. Her husband hires someone to kill her to seize the inheritance, but the hired woman looks exactly like her. After a struggle, they both pass out and their identities are mistaken.
The straightforward and tough hired woman, at the request of others, helps her reclaim the fortune. They soon discover that they are actually twin sisters. Together, they set out to uncover the truth about their parents' deaths and seek revenge on her husband's family.

She was injured and blinded in an accident, becoming an orphan. Her uncle, greedy for her parents' inheritance, pretended to adopt her. When they found out she didn't know where the inheritance was, they quickly married her off to a seriously ill tycoon. On their wedding day, she was humiliated and injured by her cousin but unexpectedly regained her sight. Upon seeing her mother-in-law having an affair, she continued to pretend to be blind. While acting pitiful and obedient at home, she was a formidable businesswoman outside, eventually becoming the CEO of a company. A billionaire of the partner company fell in love with her at first sight, , unaware that they were actually married for years but had never met each other...

book_title: Sorry, I Refuse to Be the Heiress
special_desc: She was originally a wealthy heiress, but after being abducted by human traffickers, she was raised by a madwoman. It wasn't until her father developed kidney failure and urgently needed a donor that he thought of finding his second daughter. Unaware of her father's true motives, she agreed to return home on one condition: she would bring her adoptive mad mother with her. Her biological sister, worried that she would take away her luxury and the CEO she was betrothed to since childhood, repeatedly tried to frame her. However, the CEO uncovered the truth about her abduction and the bullying she endured at school, and realized that she was the mother of his child—the same woman he had a one-night stand with after being drugged!

book_title: Hades: The Lord of the Underworld is Back
special_desc:
The King of Hell, after being trapped in reincarnation for 3,000 years, leaves the underworld in chaos, with ghost officials in deep slumber. In his final reincarnation, he lives as a struggling food delivery man, burdened by poverty and his mother's illness. Following a fatal heart attack caused by a malicious customer, he is taken back to the underworld by ghost messengers, where he regains his memories and powers as the King of Hell.

Restored to his throne, he returns to the mortal realm, saves his mother, and astonishes everyone with his supernatural abilities. At an auction, he reclaims a lost artifact and subdues a demon. During the Yin-Yang Summit, he defeats powerful sect leaders, reopens the underworld, and restores balance between the realms, ultimately becoming the guardian of both the human and spiritual worlds.

book_title: Marrying A Millionaire with My Baby
special_desc: The framed CEO had sex with the woman, but the person who framed him arranged a scumbag man to lie that he had sex with the woman in order to escape the blame. After the woman gave birth to quadruplets, she was told that only one child survived. Many years later, the scumbag man got a promotion and got the woman's house, so he kicked the woman out of the house. At this time, the woman and the CEO reunited...

book_title: After Cutting Ties, the Genius Baby Triumphs for Mom
special_desc: A seven-year-old programming prodigy, known as a legend in the hacking world, claims to be a genius. However, no one in the city knows his true identity. He confesses to his mother that he is indeed this legendary figure, but she doesn’t believe him, thinking he’s just kidding. She insists on taking him to a research institute to enroll in a program, only to run into his biological father—her first love, who has become a pretentious person.

Four siblings were born into a poor rural family, but they were happy as long as they were together. Everything changed when their parents tragically drowned, causing their already struggling family to collapse completely. The eldest sibling, at just ten years old, was unable to support the younger ones on their own. For their safety, they had to endure the pain of begging others to take care of them, leading to a separation that lasted for twenty years.

Over the years, due to the realities of life, the eldest sibling lost contact with the younger ones. This only deepened the guilt and regret, as they believed they had lost them. Determined to find them, the eldest was shocked when the second sibling returned as the powerful chairwoman of a major corporation.

book_title: Cinderella's Glass Slipper: The One I’ve Always Loved
special_desc: The woman had a crush on the president since she was young, but she didn't dare to approach him because of her fat body. When she grew up, her appearance changed a lot. As his assistant, she accidentally had a relationship with the president, but she was afraid that he would dislike her, so she didn't dare to reveal her identity. Unexpectedly, someone else took her identity and even wanted to kill her...?

She married to a shrewd CEO, she found herself doted on after the wedding. Faced with her fiancé's infidelity, she sought solace in a one-night stand with a stranger. Surprisingly, this man demanded commitment for their intimacy. As it turned out, he was a tycoon who had been eyeing her for a long time.

book_title: The Filthy Rich CEO Proposed to Me
special_desc: She went on a mismatched blind date with the wrong man. Hoping for a down-to-earth partner for an ordinary life, she never imagined that the single father with a child she ended up marrying would be her dream guy!

book_title: Little Cupid's Knock: Love Marked by Fate
special_desc: Five years ago, they had a one-night stand at a hotel and ended up having four children. Now, five years later, she returns with her four kids. Meanwhile, he, marked by her all those years ago, has been searching for her. Fate has brought them back together.

book_title: The Truth Behind the Lies We Loved
special_desc: Once celebrated as a genius painter, she lost her boyfriend in a moment of selfishness. Years later, she meets a man who looks strikingly similar to her late lover. Despite his cruel words and the scorn of those around her, she refuses to leave. But when the man’s first love returns, he finally realizes that the real "substitute" isn’t her, but himself. Two people, hurting and healing each other while calling each other replacements—when will they realize their true feelings for each other?

book_title: Fate Swapped: The Sister Right in Front of Me
special_desc: Two girls, dressed in the same clothes had their fates swapped. One was the rich family’s daughter, but in a flash, she became the mistreated, poor girl in another family. Years later, they meet again in high school, unaware that the girl they've been searching for is right in front of them. The girl is tormented by her mother and brother, who don’t realize the truth. When she can’t take it any longer, she jumps in front of her brother, who learns the truth too late. Can her mother and brother win back her forgiveness, or is it too late?

In a romance-themed observation show, several participants undergo a series of interactions and conflicts filled with love, misunderstandings, and power struggles. In the end, one couple rises to overwhelming popularity, and true love prevails as they happily end up together.

After an unexpected encounter, she gave birth to a son. Six years later, the man from that one-night stand learns the truth and begins searching for the child. In the process, she accidentally crosses paths with him, leading to a series of humorous and contentious interactions. In the end, the son reunites with his paternal family, and they all begin a life filled with happiness and togetherness.

book_title: I Am Bro, Escort, or Boyfriend?
special_desc: He, driven by unspeakable hardships to venture into the business world, encountered two extraordinary women who would become the most radiant beacons in his life's journey.

Award-winning top singer Josie accidentally becomes the wife of the Governor, Jace Gordon, in a drama? First, she needs a divorce. Second, she needs to teach that thief of a stepsister a good lesson. And third, the top singer still got it! She's totally not falling in love with Jace while investigating the death of her mother. But in the face of the scars and pains of their homeland, will the two stand up for their faith?

Six years ago, Taffy Vale spent one unforgettable night with James Carter—only to erase his memory and disappear into the hidden haven of Carshire Peak, where she gave birth to their daughter, Kayla. But when Kayla sneaks away to find a match for her mother, she unwittingly leads James straight back into their lives. And when Kayla calls him, "Daddy," James is struck by a strange sense of déjà vu that refuses to fade.

Lord Marshall Ethan Yates, disgraced by his fiancée Miranda Anderson, faces aristocratic conspiracies until billionaire heiress Melody Moore intervenes. When the Anderson family mocks his hidden power, Ethan unveils divine authority - crushing traitors with a black card and sword. Cornered by the Hawkins syndicate, he commands the Royal Guard, exposing his War God legacy as empires kneel.

In her past life, Aria Judd was neglected by her husband, Seth Hale, and abused by her mother-in-law, Laura Shea, while her daughter, Macy, suffered at the hands of the Judds. Reborn on Macy’s birthday, Aria seizes the chance to rewrite her fate. After taking Macy and destroying the Judds’ home, she seeks revenge on the Hales. She publicly humiliates Seth, exposes Rosie’s schemes, and retaliates against Laura. Seth begins to realize the hardships Aria and Macy endured. As Rosie’s plots fail, she’s exposed for stealing Aria’s achievements. Filled with regret, Seth seeks Aria’s forgiveness, and with Macy’s help, the family reunites.

Was it a one-night stand or was there more to it? After that one night, Mila got kicked out of her family because of her pregnancy. Little did she know that this man, Simon, would find her five years later. Will his persistence move her and her daughter? Will they uncover the twisted truth about that night?

After losing her memory in a cruel scheme, heiress Adela Conley was taken in and married by Shawn Gould. She thought they would live happily ever after—until a staged one-night stand led to her sudden divorce and exile. When Shawn's mistress tried to kill her in a car crash, the Conleys saved her, and her memory miraculously returned. With Dalton Herman, the CEO who had a secret crush on her by her side, she was ready to take back everything and burn her enemies to the ground!

book_title: The Substitute Wife is a Hidden Heiress
special_desc: Olivia, forced to marry CEO Ethan Foster, heals his legs to find her true parents. When her sister Charlotte steals her Owen family heir identity and scars her birthmark, Olivia uses traditional medicine to expose the conspiracy. Amid flames, her jade pendant and wedding ring rewrite two dynasties' fates.

Emily and Jason plan to marry after graduation, but when Jason introduces Emily to his family, she's stunned to find his brother is Ferris—the man from three years ago! Soon after, Jason vanishes. Seeking revenge, Ferris decides to marry Emily in Jason's place. Thus begins a tangled web of love and hate between Emily and Ferris...

Framed by husband Ethan and Mia on her wedding night, heiress Grace Sullivan fakes death after losing her fortune and face. Five years later, she returns as a mysterious woman, uniting with blind ally Jack to expose Mia’s lies and Olivia’s crimes. As Ethan begs redemption, Grace faces Jack’s love and Lily’s rage—Can revenge end where forgiveness begins?

book_title: Love Me Not: A Second Chance at Justice
special_desc: Adopted by the Lear family, Frank Dunn grows up in a loving home, marries his college sweetheart, and starts a family. However, everything changes when his adoptive parents reunite with their biological son, Tim Lear. Outwardly humble, Tim secretly frames Frank to secure the family inheritance. Despite Frank’s efforts to prove his innocence, his adoptive father sides with Tim, while his mother and sisters turn against him, seeing him as a thief of Tim’s rightful life. Though mistreated, Frank stays to repay the Lears, even rejecting his biological parents’ offer to return. But on Tim’s birthday, Tim orchestrates a fatal car accident, leaving Frank’s body abandoned. In his final moments, Frank realizes Tim was behind his suffering—but as darkness consumes him, he opens his eyes again, back on the day his wife tragically died.

book_title: Elite Struggle Between Family and Love
special_desc: Sold by her dad, Nathan weds tycoon Jason to escape a forced marriage. Battling her exploitative family, workplace bullies, and elite scorn, she fights kidnapping, betrayal, and slander. With Jason's power, she rises from poverty to CEO, using pregnancy to shatter misogyny. A ruthless rebellion against toxic kin.

Emma Frost once believed Alexis was her salvation. For years, she quietly yearned for him—until the day she witnessed him locked in a passionate embrace with another woman. In that shattering moment, clarity struck. Without a word, she walked away.
But fate had other plans.
A chance encounter led her straight into the arms of Andy Hudson—ruthless billionaire heir to the Hudson Group. What began as a whirlwind marriage of convenience soon unraveled a startling truth:
He had been waiting for her for a decade.
Now, Emma must navigate a gilded world of power and secrets, where nothing—especially love—is as simple as it seems.

book_title: A Princess? No! I'm the Female General!
special_desc: Adela Taylor, a daughter of a noble family, joined the army in her brother's name to secure the family's Duke title. She achieved unparalleled success, but upon returning victorious, her brother stole her glory. She was forced into marriage, and her brother killed her. She unexpectedly was reborn as a princess. Then she started her journey of revenge...

Mabel Hudson, the lady of the Hudson family, married Colin Walsh, a rural college student. As Mabel neared childbirth, Colin's sister Yvette Walsh insisted on a home birth due to city hospital costs, sparking a dispute. Meanwhile, Greg Hudson, CEO of Hudson Group, and Spencer Ferber, heir to Ferber Group who had fallen for Mabel, visited her in the countryside. Greg offered a ten-million-dollar wedding gift to counter the Walsh family's behavior, but Yvette mistook him for a fraudster and called the police. With Spencer's testimony and police intervention, the Walsh family finally recognized Mabel's true status as the Hudson family's lady.

book_title: When I Can See My Students' Hidden Potentials
special_desc: When Della Avery arrived as the new principal, her first bold move was to appoint Jeromy Munoz—the school's janitor—as the headteacher of its worst class. But Jeromy wasn't ordinary. After a strange turn of fate, he gained a magic system, allowing him to see the hidden talents of each student. As he awakened the potential of these so-called failures, the class began to rise fast. The monthly exam turned into battlegrounds, and the underdogs began defeating the school's top students...

Susan married Cyrus, believing her "tough luck" could balance his "bad luck." But the cold truth is his heart belonged to someone else.
She kept her feelings hidden, focused on paying off her parents' debts, and made the most of the marriage. When Cyrus's dream girl came back, Susan decided to walk away.
To win her back, Cyrus made her his assistant, guarded her fiercely at work, and fought for the marriage she wanted to forget. In the end, love wins out, and so does Susan.

Seven years ago, a chance encounter in Wesley Lowe's hotel room turned Alaya's world upside down. That fateful night led to the birth of twins, but tragedy struck when her father took one child, leaving her with only Tommy. Now, Alaya returns home with Tommy, determined to find her lost child. As fate would have it, she crosses paths with Wesley once more, but neither realizes the other's true identity...

book_title: Love and Remedies: A Princess Physician's Story
special_desc: Doctor Sophia Grace, true Crown Princess, once saved Adrian Sterling, leaving just a Unity Pendant. Six years on in Vallaris she runs Blossoms Clinic with son Sammy, battling jealous Second Princess Isabella. When Sammy proves Adrian’s lost heir, they expose royal treachery and reclaim their future.

book_title: Oops! I Fell for the Cursed Male Lead
special_desc: After being transported into a novel, the heroine survives as a "misfortune absorber," saving the unlucky hero from an accident, only for him to think she's a schemer. She juggles multiple jobs to absorb bad luck, uses her healing skills to win over his grandfather, and fend off his doubts. She also sparks a chaotic, love-hate romance with the very man who won't trust her.

book_title: Survival Begins: I Own a System
special_desc: Clive Owen unexpectedly travels to the Xane Dynasty, finding himself as a down-and-out scholar in a poor place. Orphaned and stripped of his inheritance by his cousin Luke, Clive faces a turbulent world as Xane is at war with Chida. Amidst the chaos, the court assigns each man a wife, which awakens Clive's Favor System! Tasked with building relationships, Clive embarks on a journey with three ladies to achieve wealth and power, ultimately rising as a formidable hero of his time!

Legendary Miss X is reborn after a plane crash as Penny Xander, an adopted and abandoned village girl. To fulfill her last wishes, she returns to the Xander family and is arranged to marry the disabled son of the Hank family, Boris. However, Boris is not entirely disabled; he remains the heir and is secretly searching for her...

Zeph Baena, scorned by his girlfriend's family for his modest background, goes to great lengths to win their approval. He spends his entire savings—and his grandmother's retirement fund—to buy a dream home in full. But little does he know, the story is about to take an unexpected turn...

Rowan's life was shattered when he witnessed his mother's brutal murder, leaving him tormented by vengeance. Yet, his quest for justice is stalled by his master, who holds the key to his enemy's identity. The price? Rowan must honor an ancient marriage contract, forcing him to choose between love and revenge.

Dustin Hill was a middle-aged delivery guy who had achieved nothing. One day, while working, he discovered that his identity had been usurped years ago and was killed on his way to seek justice. Now, after being reborn, he will reclaim what's rightfully his!

After her daughter Starry Smith was kidnapped, Gail Tate adopted Bonnie Smith to ease her heartache. Seventeen years later, Starry, now Jess Brown, unknowingly attends the same university as Bonnie and becomes her bullying target. Gail, not knowing Jess is her long-lost daughter, joins Bonnie against Jess. Overcome with regret, Gail strives to win back Jess's love and trust.

After being reborn in 1984, Luke sees his pregnant wife Rachel and swears to change his ways. Determined to give his wife and unborn son the life they deserve, he starts from nothing, picking up scraps to earn a living. With every step, he works not only to build a future but also to win back Rachel's trust and love.

Joanna, a brilliant ER doctor, collapses from exhaustion after a grueling surgery, only to wake up in a different era. In a twist of fate, she accidentally spends the night with Ethan, a powerful governor, and becomes pregnant. Five years later, Ethan discovers the child and hunts Joanna down, determined to marry her and bring her into his mansion!

book_title: In Love with My Ex's Uncle
special_desc: Betrayed by her fiancé, Annabelle breaks off the engagement and marries her ex's uncle—the heir of a powerful family, Nathaniel Frost, who is terminally ill. What follows is a dangerous game of revenge, desire, and legacy, where every move could destroy them all.

book_title: The Substitute Bride and Her Blind CEO
special_desc: Eleni Stoll, a disabled girl, is thrust into marriage with a blind heir, Josiah Finley. Their union, fated and strategic, sees them shielding their true selves while maneuvering through elite society's schemes. Together, they launch an AI tech venture, uncovering the secrets of a vanished master.

Village doctor, Ava Fleming, works hard to support her fiancé Luke Bax through college, only to discover that he has secretly married and started a family in the city. Determined to cut ties with Luke, Ava inadvertently saves the life of a powerful figure, Jesse Mills, who falls in love with her at first sight and proposes. To Ava's surprise, the ruthless Jesse is actually a gentle and obedient partner at home...

book_title: Reborn Bride: Saving the Crown Prince
special_desc: In her past life, Lydia was betrayed and left with nothing. Given a second chance, she refuses to marry the same man and repeat her fate. Instead, Lydia chooses to marry the dying Crown Prince, a decision that has the entire city anticipating her downfall. But what if the "sickly" prince isn't so sickly after all?

In her previous life, Cara Sinclair sacrificed everything for love, supporting her husband in starting a business and leading him to the pinnacle of success. However, after both are reborn, her unfaithful husband abandons her for her stepsister. Cara decisively chooses Joe, a man disguised as a beggar, as her husband. To her surprise, Joe is capable of anything, and most importantly, he can cook, clean, and keep her warm at night. Together, they embark on a sweet marital journey.

Separated from her mother as a child, Cara is raised by Hudson, the gentle, mute grandfather who protects her through every storm. But as life keeps hitting them hard, Winona, Cara's birth mother, turns a blind eye to her daughter's suffering, unaware that her indifference is breaking the family she still has a chance to save.

book_title: My One-Night Stand Made an Heir?
special_desc: Seven years after a chaotic one-night stand, Thea's son, Sean, accidentally reunites with his biological father, a man with a powerful diviner lineage, Everett. A DNA test exposes everything, pulling the powerful Hopper family into a frantic search for their lost heir. Thea becomes Everett's assistant. Sparks fly, misunderstandings explode, and love nearly collapses until the truth forces them all back together.

In her past life, when the legitimate daughter Leah Bates became pregnant, Elara Bates was deceived into becoming her brother-in-law's concubine. Unbeknownst to her, Leah's childbirth marked the end of Elara's life. Given a second chance, Elara carefully orchestrates her rise, first winning over her brother-in-law's influential father to secure her role as Duchess. She then reclaims her rightful place in the Bates family, exacting vengeance on those who wronged her.

To reignite his grandmother's will to live, Levi Steele pulls a random pregnant woman into the hospital room, claiming to his comatose grandmother that she is carrying his child, miraculously aiding his grandmother's recovery!
Meanwhile, Vanessa Ross believes her encounter with her child's father at the hospital is mere coincidence, but soon finds Levi frequently appearing in her life...

Tyler Clerk, an Uber driver, has to works his ass off to pay for rent and his sister's treatment. After a one-night stand gifts him X-ray eyes, every rough stone he scans spills jade—and secrets. With Chaya's help, he's become an antiques appraiser and earned enough money to cover his sister's medical expenses.

In “The Wife’s Revenge”, betrayal Ignites Fury!
We’ve got a scorned wife seeking bloody vengeance against her cheating husband and his mistress. Secrets, lies, and explosive confrontations ensue! Think “Gone Girl” meets “The Sopranos”. You should get ready for gripping suspense, shocking twists, and an empowering journey of self-discovery!
Time for some of that the fiery revenge!

book_title: Boss, We Found Your Dream Girl!
special_desc: A childhood accident erases her memories of him, but they unexpectedly reunite under a misunderstanding. He resolves to help his childhood sweetheart recover her lost memories. Meanwhile, she discovers her boyfriend cheating with her best friend, who she learns is also her half-sister...

book_title: Odds and Ends for My CEO Hubby
special_desc: Having caught her fiancé cheating with her best friend, she cancels the wedding. When they meet again, her ex mocks her for being a menial diner owner, and she just calls over her new waiter. To the jerk's shock and dismay, he recognizes this "waiter"! His loser ex's employee and husband is a billionaire CEO!

book_title: Vicious Son-in-Law, Don't Mess with Me
special_desc: Her daughter and husband were indirectly killed by her malicious son-in-law and in-laws, yet they still sought to seize her estate. In despair, she decides to seek revenge...

book_title: After the Divorce, My Five Brothers Spoil Me
special_desc: To avoid putting too much pressure on her husband, she hid her true identity and sold vegetables at the market. However, she was despised and eventually divorced. After the

They flash married, each harboring their secret motives. He doesn't know that she is the mysterious doctor he has been looking for to save his brother's life, and she initially marries him with a mission to assassinate him. Now, she must decide how to reconcile her love with her original deadly intentions...

She studied under a genius doctor and was the daughter of the Prime Minister. She married herself into the royal family because of love. Unexpectedly, her loved one didn't love her back. Not only did he confiscate the Prime Minister's Mansion on her birthday, he also allowed his lover to torture her to death. Reborn in a fire, she found that she had been reborn as the Regent's concubine! She decided to avenge her family, assist the Regent to take the throne, depose the crown prince, fight the evil woman, and turn from a coward into a female warrior!

book_title: Sis, I Prepared a Billionaire Husband for You
special_desc: She turned down an acceptance letter from an Ivy League university for her boyfriend, choosing instead to stay at the company as a janitor. But to her shock, her boyfriend proposed to the company's heiress. Devastated and heartbroken, her life takes an unexpected turn when her long-lost twin sister, the powerful figure behind a vast conglomerate, finds her and asks her to take her place for the purpose of handling business affairs, and entering into a marriage with a CEO......

book_title: General, You Got the Wrong Wife
special_desc: In order to protect me, I was forced to separate from the person I loved. Many years later, my father sold me to a ruthless general. But this general had the same last name as the person I loved, and seemed to have the same bracelet as mine, but my bracelet was taken away by the person who bullied me, and he also took my identity...

book_title: CEO, The Maid is Your Stunning Wife
special_desc: As an adopted daughter, she had to marry a paralyzed wealthy old man in order to save her grandmother who had been raising her. However, due to her severe myopia, she recognized the wrong man on the wedding day, and her husband left the country in a hurry after getting the marriage certificate. A year later, she came to a big villa to work as a maid. The famous young president happened to return to China. Although they had never met before, she felt that the president looked strangely familiar...

book_title: Pride of the Clan: The Return of the Martial Sage
special_desc:
I was born into a powerful family, blessed with extraordinary talent and limitless potential. But my mother held a priceless secret, one that led to betrayal by our own blood. In their greed, they conspired with powerful forces to hunt us down.

Before her tragic end, my mother entrusted me to her most trusted friend. In the fight to protect me, my guardian sacrificed everything, losing the use of her legs. For twenty years, I lived in hiding, training under a mysterious master, waiting for the day I could return.

Now, I have come back, no longer the powerless child they once discarded. My first mission is to reclaim what was lost and seek vengeance for my mother. As I dig deeper, the real masterminds behind the betrayal begin to emerge, one by one.

This is my journey—to uncover hidden truths, expose the lies, and bring justice to those who wronged us.

After marrying the man of her dreams, she enjoys a blissful life with him and their beloved daughter. However, on the same day she is diagnosed with pancreatic cancer, she discovers that her husband is at the airport to pick up his first love, along with a boy. With her world crashing down, she must confront the reality of their marriage and question whether their love can survive this devastating betrayal.

book_title: The princess of the Nine Kingdoms actually proposed to me?
special_desc: The Imperial Master, secretly maintaining the balance of power across nine nations, holds authority far above the kings with unrivaled influence. Five years ago, to repay an old family debt, he married the eldest daughter of a powerful family and quietly helped her become a regional leader. However, on the day of her appointment, she, believing him to be worthless, divorced him. As the truth slowly came to light, she realized the man she had scorned was actually the most powerful figure in all the lands. Regretting her decision, she sought reconciliation, only to be outdone by a princess, leaving her with no way back and filled with remorse.

They were once in love, but she was pressured by his mother to leave him when he was seriously injured. Heartbroken, he went abroad for treatment. Five years later, he returns from overseas, only to unexpectedly reunite with her—and discover a child by her side.

book_title: Fated Rebellion: Return of the Forsaken Son
special_desc:
A timid and weak prince, born to a concubine from a former dynasty, was scorned by the people and neglected by the emperor. As an adult, he was never granted a fief and was constantly bullied. His mother, the concubine, begged for her son’s title for three days and nights, kneeling in the rain in front of the palace. The emperor, disapproving of both her and her son, grew suspicious of the prince’s true parentage. In an act of ruthless punishment, the emperor forced the concubine to walk across a bed of nails, leading to her death. The crown prince, through deceit, tricked the weak prince into taking his own life, resulting in the prince’s death.
A modern-day soldier, who transmigrates into the body of the prince, inherits his legacy and vows to avenge his mother’s death, determined to overthrow the dynasty.

After losing her parents in an accident at age five, She was taken in by her aunt and uncle, who treated her poorly. At eighteen, she rescued a woman who turned out to be the mother of a billionaire, He, leading to an offer of adoption. To test She's character, He's three children hid their identities, but they were ultimately moved by her kindness and resilience.

During the sweltering summer of her sixteenth year, She fell in love with a boy . Knowing he was an unreachable star in her sky, she quietly concealed her feelings and endured her affection in solitude for three long years. Unexpectedly, at nineteen, she reunited with him at university. Later, a game led the two to share a brief romantic relationship.

A genius pianist has an accident during a performance and wakes up in a novel she read, becoming the despised secondary female character. Using her knowledge of the story, she realizes she's never been favored in her family and strives to change her fate by confronting a deceitful man and gaining the favor of a key male figure, altering her original life path.

Emory Bailey, a legendary cultivator who had lived for millennia, spent his life seeking the path to the next realm. But when his fiancée, Ruth Lynch, was murdered by the Mauve Sect, his purpose shifted—revenge became his only mission.
Another 2,000 years passed, yet Emory remained trapped in the lowest realm, his power seemingly bound by an unbreakable curse. Just when he felt desperate, he met a woman who looked identical to Ruth. Meanwhile, the Mauve Sect folks had finally broken out from their seal, returning to wreak havoc once more. This time, Emory vowed not to let any of them escape.

After a mysterious fall erases her memory, designer Susan Swift is pursued by four men claiming to be her lovers: CEO Edward (hidden agendas), esports star Jim (passionate pursuit), client Victor (professional seduction), and "first love" Alex (manipulative schemes). Flashbacks reveal corporate sabotage behind her accident. Unmasking false suitors, Susan allies with secretly protective Edward to crush enemies, rebuilding life through his vow.
Julia and Lucian got married for their own purposes. But is he really who he says he is? What would she do when it all comes out, especially when they seem to be falling for each other?

book_title: The Family Plan: Love Strikes Twice
special_desc: Naomi Scott was James Lloyd's secret lover. James was hit by a car while Naomi was in childbirth. Five years later, Naomi came back from abroad with Mia, their daughter. They met James dressed like a beggar on the street and took him in. The trio slowly resolved misunderstandings from the past all while revenging against those who hurt them.

book_title: Oops! I Fooled the Evil into Being Good
special_desc: Kris Nolan got transmigrated to a cultivation world, but soon found his entire village killed and his fiancee kidnapped. Three years later, Kris ran into Hannah Lynch and helped her with her wound in the mountain. She took him back to join her Roving Demon Sect, lying to him it was Roving Divine Sect, in an attempt to use him to refine a human pill. Here Kris made friends with some seniors, all demons who can't wait to cook him up. The quirky gang began to spend time helping villagers and punishing some hypocritical so-called righteous sects. Meanwhile, Kris leveled up to an unbeatable realm and would soon find out Hannah was his missing fiancee.

book_title: The Wife I Despised Is My First Love?!
special_desc: Lily, a blind girl, found her boyfriend Brian cheated on her. She accidentally slept with the richest man, Albert Morgan. After becoming pregnant, Brian forced her to demand money from Albert. Under Albert's grandmother's pressure, Albert married Lily. After marriage, Albert despised Lily while searching for his childhood savior, unaware that the true savior was his hated wife. When Lily regained her sight, another woman Gloria appeared. Gloria pretended to be Albert's childhood savior, and bullied Lily...

In her past life, Olivia's second daughter was given away by her mother-in-law, leaving Olivia consumed by guilt and sorrow until her untimely death. On her deathbed, she confided her deep resentment to her daughter, Georgia, who shared the same hatred for the family. After a tragic accident, Georgia finds herself reborn on the day of her mother's labor...

book_title: How to Tame a Royal Heart
special_desc: Clara Chavez, the daughter of a wealthy merchant, is reborn on the night of her wedding, where her groom, Cole Kerrigan, humiliates her by marrying his sister-in-law as well. Determined to reject this fate, Clara vows revenge and sets out to reclaim everything she has lost. Along her journey, she forms a profound bond with Prince Adrian, leading to the Kerrigan family's downfall and securing her rightful place in the royal lineage, ultimately finding happiness with Adrian.

After she finds that her boyfriend, Marco, cheated on her with Jessica, Gretchen Hayes marries Lorenzo Sterling, the billionaire CEO she just met. But her revenge takes a shocking turn when her ex becomes her stepson. In a world of luxury and lies, Gretchen must outsmart her enemies and claim her power — and maybe find real love along the way.

book_title: My Rise To Power After She Left
special_desc: Betrayed by his wife, Yvonne, and left with nothing, Lennox Hayes suddenly inherits ancient powers that change his destiny. When Amelia Langford—heiress to the powerful Langford family of Grimwood—reveals their long-lost engagement, Lennox must navigate a dangerous new world of cultivation and conspiracy. From the streets of Riverain to the heights of Grimwood's elite, he'll prove that even the most broken can rise to rule.

book_title: Mr. Jackson, Your Bride Is Running Away
special_desc: Cathy is devastated to learn that Paxon, the father of her child, allegedly wants nothing to do with her or their baby. Heartbroken, Cathy thought she had lost the baby and left. Years later, fate brings them back together, but misunderstandings only deepen between them. Can they unravel the past and find their way back to each other?

With no way out, Vera sets her sights on Yael Brown, a top-tier powerbroker known for his coldness and ruthlessness. Yael sees through her intentions from the start, but chooses to indulge her, drawn in despite himself. What begins as a calculated game slowly turns into an emotional entanglement, pulling the untouchable man down from his pedestal and binding him to her fate.

book_title: Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors
special_desc: A wealthy girl keeps her true identity secret and marries a guy who's not as rich. But his family disrespects her because she sells fish for a living. She calmly agrees to divorce, but now, three brilliant men rush towards her, each claiming her as their fiancée!

Five years ago, the blind and paralyzed CEO was abandoned by his family, but she stood by him faithfully. They fell in love, and he gave her half of his jade pendant as a token of their love. However, after a car accident, she suddenly disappeared, and miraculously, the CEO's vision was restored. Since then, he has been searching for her.

book_title: Divorce a Badass, Marry a CEO
special_desc: After discovering her current partner's infidelity, she accidentally got married to him, the CEO, and they embarked on a sweet yet tumultuous love journey.

Corrie Scott, a delivery girl who happened to help an old man. To repay her mother's medical debts, she married his grandson, Charles Francis. Charles is the richest man. At the beginning, he thought this girl was a gold digger, so he hid his true identity. As they lived together, their feelings grew deeper. But his lie gradually became a time bomb, and his childhood sweetheart also came back. Will Charles and Corrie get a happy ending?

book_title: My CEO Dad Has A Secret Identity
special_desc: She agreed to have a child with the CEO for her sick mother. Later, she gave birth to a boy and a girl. He took the daughter away, and she took the son abroad. A few years later, she returned triumphantly with her genius son. By chance, she rekindled her relationship with him and reunited with her daughter as a family.

Can't Say I Love You movie summary is all about Weldon and Chelsea's marriage, which is more of a marriage of convenience as Chelsea is treated as a blood milking cow for Weldon's lover Celine.
Chelsea, realizing the truth, finally decides to seek divorce as she tries to win back at love. However, Weldon is shocked to see Chelsea leave as he always believed her to be a gold digger.

book_title: Hard to Divorce after Flash Marriage
special_desc:
To seek revenge, I flash-married the wealthy young heir! 
I'm a skilled doctor hiding my true identity. By chance, I met the heir from a prominent family. He's seriously ill, and only I can treat him. In exchange for unraveling the truth behind my parents' deaths, I agreed to a contract marriage. Little did I expect, after overcoming numerous obstacles and hardships together, I would truly fall in love with him...

In Reincarnated As the CEO's Wife movie, an overweight female lawyer with a noticeable birthmark has always faced discrimination because of her appearance. One day after work, she witnesses a beautiful CEO's wife being bullied to the point of jumping off a building. Miraculously, her soul transfers into the body of the CEO's wife. When she wakes up again, she takes on her identity, seeking revenge and living an extraordinary life!

book_title: Amnesia CEO Beaten by His Foster Daughter at her Wedding?!
special_desc: After a tragic car accident, the chairman of a powerful corporation lost his memory while saving an orphaned girl. Separated from his family, he adopted the girl and lived as a humble laborer. Eighteen years later, the adopted daughter, eager to marry into a wealthy family, turned her back on the man who raised her, severing their father-daughter relationship, unaware that her adoptive father is actually the long-lost chairman the corporation has been desperately searching for all these years.

One day, she accidentally discovers she’s already married—and to a billionaire! Through various misunderstandings, the two gradually open their hearts to each other. With the help of his grandmother, they finally face their feelings and find true love.

Ten years ago, Edward and Doreen were just classmates. Ten years later, the boy became a double Oscar-winning actor, while the girl became a reporter. They met again on Valentine's Day and got married on the spot. After that, Edward began his long journey of pursuing his wife after marriage.

As a jewelry designer, she finds herself ensnared in a false debt of gratitude to her boyfriend, constantly compromising for the sake of love and withdrawing from society. In the process, she loses her sense of self and becomes a mere pawn in his ambitions. However, everything changes when she meets her true match. Through this new relationship, she begins to realize that her previous understanding of love has been narrow and flawed. A healthy relationship should be built on mutual understanding and support, rather than on oppressing one another for personal gain. With the strong intervention of her new partner, she embarks on a journey of continuous growth, reconnecting with society, returning to work, and reigniting her passion for her craft.

A man survives a plane crash and is rescued by the heroine, who is a doctor. When he wakes up, he has lost his memory, and the heroine takes care of him. A malicious woman finds his identification and schemes to become the heiress, relentlessly bullying the heroine. How will the hero and heroine fight back?

book_title: Fist of Vengeance: The Last Hardys
special_desc: During the massacre of the Hardy family, only two survived—Arlen Hardy and his little sister, Merle. To pay for Merle's medical care, Arlen, heir to the legendary Fist Sage, was forced into the bloodstained arenas of the Valor Sect as an underground boxer. Fight after savage fight, he clawed his way to the top, defeating the sect's four guardians and becoming the new lord. But when he returned home, Merle was gone.
