Now, armed with the skills honed in the pits and a heart burning for vengeance, Arlen sets out on a relentless quest: to find Merle and make those behind the slaughter of his family pay in blood!

Lois Daae, a resilient and kind-hearted woman from a rural background, is unafraid to love and hate passionately. After a drunken encounter with a stranger, Ralph Rucci, she boldly proposes a flash marriage, believing him to be an ordinary office worker. To her surprise, Ralph is actually a powerful CEO. Seven years ago, Lois saved Ralph in a crisis, sparking his love at first sight. However, Ralph left without a word to reclaim Rucci Corp, leading to their missed connection. After overcoming numerous challenges, they finally recognize their true feelings and come together.

book_title: Dumped... But My 3 Big Shot Brothers Found Me!
special_desc: Abandoned by her toxic husband and slandered by imposter heiress Jessica Foster, Lily Foster is rescued by her three elite brothers. The former street-food vendor, revealed as the long-lost heiress of the Foster Family—the city's wealthiest clan—unleashes a triple vengeance: a ​stunning runway debut, ​medical counterattack, and ​financial takedown, crushing the Howards' betrayal and family power struggles. As her adopted brother Brandon Foster inherits the family legacy, Lily rewrites the rules of elite society.

book_title: Mrs. Strauss Is Not An Intern
special_desc: Is it just me, or is the CEO, Pedro, always protecting the newcomer, Lyna? Which one is his real wife and which one is putting on a show here? The one who rides a bike to work, or the one who’s all dressed-up every day?

Sasha Lynch, devastated by betrayal from her favorite male streamer due to her weight, stumbles upon a life-altering system that transforms her into a stunning and wealthy socialite. As she embraces her newfound allure, Sasha realizes that her once unattainable crush isn't all that remarkable. Relishing the attention and admiration from men, she blossoms into her own, reveling in the power of being uniquely herself.

book_title: A Love as Hot as Summer
special_desc: Freelance photographer Violet Beck is forced into an engagement with CEO Roy Payne. He is everything her wild heart rebels against: proper, predictable, and painfully kind. But love has a way of developing. One glance, one touch, one shared silence at a time, Violet’s resistance begins to crack. A love as delicate and striking as a Vendela rose is about to bloom.

book_title: Mr. Moore, My Heart Won't Be Tamed
special_desc: Betrayed by her husband, Mason Kane, Nancy Larson is determined to take her life back. She'll claw her way from the wreckage of her marriage to the top of the business world. But when Frank Moore—a powerful man from her past and one unforgettable night—reappears, he threatens to disrupt everything. Is he her greatest ally, or the one who will burn her new empire to the ground?

Elite lawyer Declan Ford's life is upended when his father is murdered by the victim's family in a criminal case. For six years, he lives in self-doubt, until a migrant worker who has been a great help to him is injured and denied compensation by Denci Construction. Declan decides to step in for justice and initiate a class action, but the true battle for justice has just begun.

Klem Shaw, an actor from modern times, wakes up as the stand-in of the missing Emperor of Argentea, controlled by the ruthless Empress Dowager. Trapped in a palace of lies, he must outwit the Empress and cunning concubines while playing the deadliest role of his life. Using his modern savvy and acting chops, he turns from a puppet into a player.

After her CEO husband asked for a divorce, she coolly requested to proceed with the formalities immediately. Little did she know, he had always loved her. Due to a misunderstanding, she left him when she became pregnant. When she reappeared in front of him, he was determined to remarry her.
Her deeply loved husband poisoned her, cheated on her, and even kicked her out of the house! Maybe its time to let them know who she actually is...

book_title: CEO's Wife Spoiled by Three Big Shot Brothers
special_desc: The daughter of the richest family was taken away by mistake when she was a kid and grew up in another family. When she grew up, she returned to the biological family and was loved by her three brothers. What's more, when she was a kid, she saved the second young master of another top family. After she returned as heiress, the two became acquainted.

To pay off her brother's gambling debt, she's forced to go on a blind date arranged by her sister-in-law. She doesn't care much about who the guy is—just that he's supposedly a rich upstart, and she'll recognize him at the café by the red roses he's holding. To her surprise, the man with the red roses is actually quite handsome. With a cool demeanor, he tells her that he's also being pushed into this date. If she's willing to fake a marriage with him, he'll transfer 3 million as her payment, and they can divorce after three months. This seems perfect to her. However, what she doesn’t realize when signing the marriage agreement is that it's all part of his plan...

book_title: The Masked Heiress with Three Brothers
special_desc: A wealthy heiress left her family to be with a poor young man, living under a false identity for three years while helping him quietly launch his company. However, when she joyfully attended what she thought was her own engagement party, she discovered that her boyfriend was proposing to another woman who was impersonating her as the heiress. Just when she found herself alone and helpless, her three powerful brothers showed up to support her. From then on, she began a life surrounded by their protection and, with their help, successfully sought her revenge.

book_title: Boss, Your Wife Forgot the Marriage Again
special_desc: After a car accident five years ago, a woman wakes up with amnesia to find a man sleeping beside her—her best friend’s boyfriend. Conflicted and feeling guilty about betraying her friend, she is shocked to learn that she is actually married to him and that five years have passed since her last memory. Unable to accept this new reality, she attempts to escape by jumping out the window but fails. Upon waking up again, she discovers that she and her husband also have a daughter together.

The male protagonist, endowed with superpowers, becomes even stronger after a period of cultivation. He defeats and eliminates all the villains who once bullied him. In order to save his mother, he faces numerous dangers. Ultimately, by rallying the strength of his people, he overcomes the rebellion and becomes the supreme leader.

She was regarded as a jinx by her family since childhood. After an accident, she became pregnant with the Crown Prince's child. Subsequently, she was imprisoned by her mother and sister, who sought to take the child from her. Fortunately, she was saved by a divine physician. Seven years later, in order to treat her young son's illness, she returned to her old home and exposed the conspiracy of her mother, sister, and the Grand Commandant. With the help of her sons, she was finally reunited with the Crown Prince.

After being set up by her own family, Nora Wood becomes pregnant with Tyler Holt's child, who is later named Bryan. Unfortunately, when Bryan turns five, he is diagnosed with leukemia. In an effort to cover medical expenses, Nora decides to sell the family jade pendant Tyler had given her, triggering a city-wide search for Bryan by the Holt family. Meanwhile, Nora joins Holt Group as Tyler's secretary. As they work closely together, their feelings for each other grow, and their relationship flourishes over time.

When Vivian's fiancé, Ethan, disappeared without a trace, her world was turned upside down. For five relentless years, she and their children embarked on an unwavering quest, fueled by love and hope. Just as she was on the brink of despair, a chance encounter reunites them. But the reunion takes a bewildering turn: Ethan insists he's never met her, never been in love, and certainly never fathered a child...

book_title: Don’t Mess With My Baby's Mom
special_desc: After one fateful night with Henry Moore, the ruthless tycoon, Hannah Sullivan's world shattered—she was thrown into prison. Ten months later, she gave birth to his child and made a desperate plea to her sister to deliver the child to him. When Henry discovered the cruel truth of her suffering, he vowed to make amends once she was free. Together, they turned the tables on their enemies, forging a powerful love from a broken past.

I'm The Dragon King movie summary introduces us to Chris Young, a Draco sovereign who lives as a taxi driver at Haven port.
His wife Rachel Clark, without realizing her husband's true nature, decides to divorce him once she gets the taste of success without knowing Chris is the one behind her rise.
Unwanted by his wife, Chris is wanted by Harper Smith and others, who want to make him theirs.

book_title: When My Twins Found Their Dad
special_desc: Seven years ago, at a charity banquet, she became his antidote and gave birth to twins. Seven years later, the two kids hacked his computer, drawing the attention of this powerful billionaire. For the sake of the kids, she had to enter into a contractual marriage with him.

book_title: Plus-Size Girl Travels Back to Become a Tycoon
special_desc:
That day, I caught him cheating on me in the lab, and when I confronted him, he shoved me. The chemicals exploded, and the next thing I know, I’ve woken up in another world as an unloved, overweight woman with two starving kids to take care of. 
With no other choice, I decide to make money and get out with my kids. But my scheming younger sister keeps framing me, and the cold, distant husband I wanted to divorce turns out to be the emperor’s son! Just when I think it’s all over, he starts showing up more and more... Can we really make things work?

In her previous life, she was a highly successful actress but was conspired against by her boyfriend and best friend. Not only did she lose her family and home, but she was also driven to the brink of despair. 
However, fate granted her a second chance, and she was reborn! In her new life, she focuses all her energy on her career and seizes the opportunity to seek revenge on the scumbag and the scheming woman.

book_title: I'm the Dragon King & Legendary Healer
special_desc: A legendary figure has disguised himself as a beggar and is now wandering the streets. The eldest daughter of a prominent financial ruler has been afflicted with a mysterious illness. Despite a substantial reward offered by her father, no expert has been able to cure her. One day, the ruler's second daughter happens to pass by a reward notice and encounters the beggar with a tattered bowl. She drops some change into his bowl, and the beggar, recognizing her kindness, offers to fulfill one of her wishes. He then accompanies her to her family home. The ruler is skeptical that a beggar could cure his critically ill daughter, but the beggar calmly performs his exceptional skills and, indeed...

After getting drunk at a bar, Ye Lanxi accidentally spends the night with Lu Yanzhou, the CEO of Lu Group. To her surprise, a passionate night leads to an unexpected pregnancy with his child! Six years later, Ye Lanxi returns to her homeland with her four genius children, embarking on a mission to take down the scoundrels and seek retribution, all while attracting the attention of Lu Yanzhou.

After a night of drunkenness, the neglected young lady stumbled into the wrong room and caught the attention of the insatiable heir to a tycoon. When dawn broke, she fled in terror, but he was like a persistent shadow, teasing her mercilessly and leaving her at a loss. “A night as husband and wife means a hundred nights of favor,” he thought of her every moment, and he wanted her to take responsibility.

book_title: In This Life, I Choose You
special_desc: In her past life, Mara Jones believed Evan Jacquet was her savior, so she devoted herself to him, giving him everything she could—only to be betrayed and murdered in the end. After being reborn, she wastes no time and calls her former arranged fiancé, Charles Xander, determined to change her fate. This time, she proposes to him with an irresistible deal.

Charles Chapman, the powerful boss of Divine King Group and a genius doctor capable of miracles, disguised himself as a beggar to live humbly. When kind-hearted Bianca Smith gave him change, he offered to grant her a wish. She asked him to save her sister Bella, who was gravely ill. Despite mockery from top doctors, Charles effortlessly cured Bella. Grateful, her father offered wealth and marriage, but Charles refused, revealing he had a fiancée.

However, his fiancée, Lily Moore, called off their engagement upon hearing he was a "beggar" and was now with Sam Walker—Charles’s childhood friend, whom he had secretly helped succeed.

In her previous life, Natalie Simpson, born a nobleman's daughter and the wife of General Eden Richter, was betrayed and murdered by her sister Winona Simpson and the general himself, meeting a tragic end.
Reborn into a new life, she vowed revenge and seduced the King to wield him as her weapon. Yet she soon realized her miscalculation because the King had fallen far more deeply than she'd anticipated. To her shock, he resolved to crown her queen against all odds!

When Cynthia Hart was battling on the front lines for her country, her daughter fell prey to the Klein family. In a rage, Cynthia rushed home, only to find her husband was getting engaged to Carrie Klein! Cynthia used her power to crush the wicked and rescue her daughter. But soon, she uncovered a deeper conspiracy—the Kleins were mere pawns of Duke Glenn Palmer, who was scheming to usurp the throne. Now, Cynthia fights a deadlier war—not just to save her family, but to protect the entire kingdom.

book_title: My Script to Sweetness: Healing the Villain's Heart
special_desc: After a sudden death, Lucy wakes up inside the novel she was reading as the doomed villainess fated to die by Chapter 50. When her presence unexpectedly eases the pain of the story’s feared villain, Julian, he takes her in. But with the novel's hero hunting her down, Lucy decides her only chance at survival is to cling to the villain and hijack the plot. This time, she's rewriting her ending, and it won't be death.

book_title: Divorced and Back with His Baby Girl
special_desc: After two years of marriage without conceiving, pressured by her mother-in-law, she left with the baby after getting a divorce...

Her twin sister marries a billionaire, but tragically committes suicide. In order to uncover the truth behind her sister's death, she decides to pretend to be her as the billionaire's wife. The drastic change in wife's personality unwittingly captivates the billionaire...

After she discovers her husband cheating with her half-sister, a heated argument ensues, resulting in her murder and attempted disposal in a river. Rescued, she survives but loses her unborn child. Seeking revenge against her unfaithful husband and the other woman, she plots retaliation.

book_title: He And His Demon Cat Beauty
special_desc: A worker in the workplace accidentally uncovers the secret existence of beastmen in human society. With the help of a black cat transformed into a beauty, he repeatedly thwarts the schemes and persecutions of the snake demon, pig demon, leopard woman, bull king, and other beastmen. Gradually, he uncovers the mystery of his own identity and ultimately wins the heart of a beautiful CEO.

At six, she was kidnapped. Twelve years later, to fund her foster mom's transplant, she wed a supposedly foolish billionaire. Marriage brought endless agony. Broken, she jumped out a window. Only then did they discover: she's the wealthy heiress.

He keeps her close solely because she bears a striking resemblance to his late sister. Unbeknownst to him, she feigns ignorance, intending to use him for her own revenge. Both harbor ulterior motives, yet ultimately, they become each other's salvation and develop a deep mutual affection.

He's a successful young CEO, and I'm the overweight woman everyone looks down on. Our marriage was a laughingstock, and he never respected me. Fed up with the mockery and humiliation, I decided to transform myself. When I returned as a sexy bombshell, everyone, including my husband, was stunned.

The protagonist, after retiring from the northern military, joins a large corporation but is constantly oppressed by his superiors. Frustrated, he argues with them, and this time, he vows to make them pay the price!

After the family reunited with their biological daughter, they expelled the fake heiress from their home. She was then taken in by the grandmother of a man, who arranged for her to work at his company. As they spent more time together, both fell in love, and the truth about her real identity began to unravel.

book_title: The Power of Love: A Disabled Tycoon's Heart
special_desc: The female protagonist marries her boyfriend to inherit the family business, only to discover on her wedding day that she has stomach cancer and is immediately abandoned by her boyfriend! To get back at the scoundrel, she quickly marries a blind man, only to find out after the marriage that he is not blind at all, but the wealthiest person in the city. The female lead and her husband join forces to confront the scoundrel and the unfaithful woman, regain their family fortune, and after learning of the misdiagnosis, they live happily ever after.

The heroine is a perfect housewife, yet she is despised by her husband. After discovering she has cancer, she resolutely decides to divorce him. During her treatment, she meets the hero, a doctor. They quickly fall in love, and her health gradually improves. Her ex-husband realizes his love for her after she leaves, but the heroine will never love him again.

When Emperor Samuel accidentally unlocks the Heavenly Chains, flooding Heaven and destabilizing the Three Realms. Armed with a smartphone and lost memories, he battles Pigsty's heirs and invading gods at a wedding. 9 billion merit points expose his true power—the "poor suitor" caused the cosmic flood, while two golden lotuses hide the key to salvation.

book_title: Ice and Fire: The War for the Ice Saintess
special_desc: Three years ago, Ralph Lucero was blinded and stripped of his powers by his master to learn compassion. Now, with his country on the brink of invasion by werewolves and vampires, Ralph reclaimed his position as head of the Apex Alliance and founder of the Night Legion. The key to invincibility was rumored to lie in marrying the Ice Saintess, Deena Sloan—his promised bride. Humiliated and ridiculed, Ralph must find a way to secure Deena's heart, restore his honor, and protect his homeland.

In Addicted to You movie, Audrey's biggest regret? A one-night stand with Floyd, her secret love for eight years. Despite his arranged marriage and his family's troubles, he kept rescuing her. She thought she was just a fling, but he was already head over heels for her...
Betrayal, miscarriage, and death. Now reborn, Gwen Miller marries the nation's wealthiest man, Caspian Guillot. With newfound strength and determination, she now wants blood.

book_title: Her Baby’s Claimed by the Kingpin
special_desc: Betrayed and reborn, Jennifer returns for vengeance. After exposing her fiancé‘s affair, a heartbroken night leads her to Jayden Yeats—the powerful man who has loved her in silence. Forced abroad by family cruelty, she comes back years later with her son, determined to uncover her mother’s death. Amid sabotage and a falsified DNA test, Jennifer fights to reclaim her legacy, unmask the truth, and claim a love that was always hers.

Six years ago, Cassius walked away to protect Erica's future. Now he is a powerful crime lord, and she has risen to become a top-tier attorney. As fate draws them together in a criminal case, misunderstandings and trouble follow suit. Can the guarded crime lord and the brilliant attorney find the truth and a second chance before the past destroys them?

book_title: Living His Life, Knowing His Wife
special_desc: After his twin brother's sudden passing, he assumes his identity to uncover the truth. But he had no idea his brother had a stunning wife...

God of Evil movie summary takes us to the other side of the world as we see the demon god falling for the Villain’s trap.
Years later, we see Sherri, a widower, getting bullied after her husband Chuck's death. However, Chuck's burial is met with a surprise when Demon god finds himself reincarnated as Chuck as he deals with the bullies.

book_title: The Ugly Duckling and the Billionaire
special_desc: The brilliant designer was dumped by her fiancé because of her ugly appearance. Then, her stepmother and family treated her like trash and kicked her out. In her despair, the CEO appeared and took her to the hospital where she was poisoned. After recovering her beauty, she married the CEO and together they humiliated her ex-boyfriend!

"You'll take responsibility as my wife for one year, and I'll give you five million each month."
I just grabbed this handsome guy to help me block the water splashed by my blind date, and he proposed to marry me! After that, he helped me deal with my ex-boyfriend who kept bothering me. Under pressure from family to get married, we flash-married! At first, I thought he was just a poor man, but it turned out he was a billionaire CEO!

It was when everything was almost over, that the billionaire told me that she found me looked familiar at first sight!
Right after I got into a top college, my mom passed away because of severe illness, and my dad was intentionally hurt by a rich heir!
“Let's make a deal. Want to save your dad? Give me your college enrollment place!” I have no other choice but to agree.
But that was not the end of my fate! I joined the army and became a soldier. Returning home after years, they all don’t know, that I have become a powerful general! Thus, I have discovered that I might be the real heir, instead of that jerk…

"I wish you are the first person I see once I regained my vision." I am a wealthy heir. Five years ago, I became blind in a car accident and was taken in and cared for by a girl who refused to reveal her identity. I fell in love with her. 
But when I regained my sight, she disappeared. I reclaimed my billionaire CEO status and vowed to find her before entering into a contracted marriage. Gradually, I discovered clues pointing towards my assistant... Could she be the love I've been searching for all along?

My loving and peaceful life with my husband was shattered by the sudden appearance of my missing ex-boyfriend. I slowly began to realize that my memory seemed to have problems! As my memory gradually returned, I discovered that my husband not only deceived me but might also be the one responsible for my mother's death. The more I tried to uncover the truth, the more he hid it. Should I still stay by his side?

book_title: Who's the One I Slept With?
special_desc: Six years ago, he was tricked by his stepbrother and had a night with me, an intern who he doesn't know. Six years later, I had become a small vendor and was sold again by my stepsister for a dowry of one million to marry a 60-year-old retired man. However, I accidentally married the one who had just returned from the army, the young CEO and heiress of the man I was sold to...

In the 1990s, a railway worker accidentally saved a city girl, and the fate of the two people intersected from then on. She was betrayed by her ex-boyfriend and her biological mother's preferred boys over girls. Only the love and care of the worker and his son illuminated her life like a light. He was brave, kind, and responsible. He raised the son of his ex-girlfriend who had a heart disease, and took care of the city girl meticulously. After many hardships and twists and turns, the two of them finally got together, but at this time, something unexpected happened again. The generous death of a woman who liked him, and the return of his ex-girlfriend made their lives uneasy. In the end, they made a decision...

Shuri Sanders wakes up to find that her face has been exchanged with that of Liz LePenn, a celebrity! 
 
 Worse, she's also been saddled with a 10 million dollar debt, and her "husband"—the dashing-but-cold Gordon Fair—is on the cusp of divorcing her!
 
 Shuri has only a month to save herself before she ends up in jail and unceremoniously divorced. But as she puts her mettle and skills to the test, it seems like the estranged husband might have begun falling for her...

book_title: Pregnant with My Nemesis’ Brother’s Baby
special_desc: Naomi James's boyfriend pushed her from the rooftop after getting involved with Jenny Walker, a billionaire's sister. Getting reborn, Naomi decided to approach Matthew Walker, Jenny's rich but sickly brother. Matthew was predicted to never have children and possibly dying young, but none of that stopped Naomi from marrying him. Shortly after getting married, Naomi found out she was pregnant!

While foraging in the countryside, Emily is suddenly taken to the capital by her brother's sworn enemy, John. Everyone assumes the ruthless, powerful man will make her life a living hell, but to their shock, John spoils Emily beyond imagination, turning the "poor victim" into the most envied girl in the city.

Fay Reeves, after becoming comatose in the modern world, finds herself inside her own novel. A cute pet informs her that to return to reality, she must complete a mission: return to the Louis family and win back Ronald Pates. Armed with determination, she navigates the challenges posed by her adoptive parents and fights to reclaim her love. More challenges ahead? She's more than ready!

Six years ago, Aria Denton was set up by her fiancé and sister and forced to leave. Now, she returns with her three genius children. She’s determined to expose the lies, reclaim her legacy, and make the man who once shattered her pay for what he did. But as secrets unravel, Aria finds that revenge comes with a price she may not be ready to pay.
Betrayed by her boyfriend and bestie, the girl ended up flash-marrying a roadside vendor. Who would've thought the vendor turned out to be a rich and handsome CEO!?

He is a billionaire, and she is an unknown actress. One accident made them swap bodies. They have to play each other's roles to avoid being discovered. Living each other's lives, solving each other's problems, and even seeing each other's bodies, they start to fall in love.

To cover her mother's medical expenses, she accepted a million dollars from his family and broke up with him, only to discover she was pregnant. Many years later, they unexpectedly met again and had a one-night stand. Once, her daughter saw him and ran up immediately, calling him "Daddy".

Due to family reasons, she grew up proud and had high standards for her partner, only considering "successful men." Initially, she dismissed and looked down on him, a playboy from a wealthy family. However, due to changes in her family, she stepped forward and took on responsibilities, willing to marry him. Gradually, she discovered his virtues.

Seven years ago, she spent a night with him but was expelled due to pregnancy. Seven years later, when they reunited, he suspected her of being the girl from seven years ago and began an investigation. Will the truth finally be revealed?

He suffered from insomnia, and could only sleep well next to her, so he married her. She was disliked and bullied by his mom who has a disease, and they finally divorced. He is eager to find the only doctor who can save his mother's life, but what he doesn't know is that this doctor is his ex-wife.

"Mom, Love Me Again” is about heartwarming eunion.
A mother, diagnosed with Alzheimer’s, forgets her family. Her daughter struggles to reconnect and rebuild their bond. Think “The Notebook” meets “Still Alice”. Get ready for emotional drama, poignant moments, and a powerful celebration of unconditional love!
You can’t ignore the wonder of this amazing tear-jerking.

I flash married a street vendor, but he turned out to be a billionaire CEO!
I am a lost wealthy heiress, betrayed by my boyfriend, and my foster parents even wanted to sell me to an old man. In desperation, I flash married a street vendor!
To my surprise, the vendor is actually a successful and rich CEO. With his support, I will make everyone who wronged me pay!

book_title: Genius Baby with a CEO Daddy
special_desc:
Childhood sweethearts for a decade, yet I was not the bride by his side. In an act of defiance,I took matters into her own hands, sleeping with another guy and accidentally winning over the stranger, who turned out to be the incredibly wealthy billionaire! Overnight, I decided to vanish without a trace... Five years later, I return with a pair of adorable babies, having evaded and concealed myslef, only to be caught by him nonetheless. 
"I swore back then, that if I ever caught you, I'd make sure you'd never leave the bed."

book_title: Madam, Give the CEO Another Chance
special_desc:
In childhood, we made an engagement. Eighteen years later, he accidentally became mentally retarded, but I still married him. 
In an accident, he regained his memory and learned that the one who killed his parents was my foster father! 
After waking up, he vented his anger on me. Now, it's time to reveal my true identity!

When she is suddenly kidnapped, he sacrifices himself to save her, and they both tragically fall. But fate intervenes, and she is reborn. In this new life, she vows to focus on three things: revenge, revenge, and more revenge! Determined to protect him and reclaim her family's fortune, she is set on making the villains pay dearly.

book_title: Immortal King Reborn: Comeback with My Female CEO
special_desc: The strongest genius of the celestial realm, after being betrayed and killed by a close friend during a treasure hunt, is reborn 500 years in the past. Now, he finds himself imprisoned for his wife's sake. Upon his release, she rejects him and files for divorce. However, his formidable strength soon captures the attention of the business queen of Haicheng, who is drawn to him.

The protagonist takes the fall for his girlfriend, going to prison, unaware that the person his girlfriend and a wealthy heir accidentally killed was his own older brother. To make matters worse, his girlfriend had already betrayed him, secretly involved with the heir. Regretful and heartbroken, the protagonist inherits the legacy of a powerful, secretive organization while in prison. The disciples of this organization include influential businessmen, aristocrats, officials, and mafia bosses. He becomes the new leader.
Upon his release, he learns that his father has died from grief, leaving only his widowed mother, younger sister, and sister-in-law behind. At his father's funeral, the heir causes trouble, intending to dishonor his sister-in-law and younger sister. The protagonist fights back, driving away the criminals. Despite his family's misunderstanding, he uses the power of his inheritance to bring his father back to life.
At a major family celebration of the heir's family, the protagonist storms in with his brother's coffin, defeating their numerous martial experts. He avenges his brother and settles his own score, but there are still powerful figures behind the heir's family. Afterward, his own family is targeted by a criminal group seeking to extort them and dishonor his sister-in-law. The protagonist saves his family, then faces challenges involving his sister's workplace bullying and a series of medical incidents with a prominent family head. Through these trials, he earns his family's respect and becomes the true leader of the secretive organization.

book_title: My Brother is a Top Cultivator
special_desc: A man drifting through life, lost and disconnected. While playing a soothing video game, he’s drawn into a surreal, dreamlike journey within his mind, leading to a profound realization about the meaning of life.

Betrayed and crippled, Raven Riverside rises as Empire's Guardian. Returning as Lord Riverside, he exposes his father's murder linked to the Governor's conspiracy, confronting power's corruption while torn between martial supremacy and protecting the people.

Thrown out by her stepmother and left to fend for herself, Sharon Stinger never expected salvation to come in the form of Jenton's most influential man, Henry Forbes. She enters a flash marriage with Henry, and what starts as a mere exchange of benefits soon turns into an unexpected battle for survival in high society. Looked down upon by the elite, Sharon proves her worth with intelligence and determination, climbing to the top of the design world. Meanwhile, the powerful Henry finds himself falling helplessly for her.

Once the strongest genius of the Immortal Realm, Xavier Suncrest is betrayed and killed by his best friend. Reborn 500 years in the past as a regular guy on Earth, he sacrifices everything—including his freedom—to protect his wife.

But after prison, he's cast aside, humiliated, and left with nothing. With his cultivation powers from a past life and a growing band of loyal allies, Xavier rises again—this time, on his own terms.

As darkness looms over society in the form of the mysterious Dark Lord, Xavier steps up to face the threat head-on. Old grudges, karmic justice, and explosive battles await in this thrilling story of revenge, redemption, and rising beyond fate.

book_title: Fake It Till You Make It
special_desc: To get back at her cheating ex, Nancy boldly claims that the elusive big shot, Ethan, is her boyfriend, and overhears the lie. To her shock, Ethan not only plays along but also marries her to lift his ailing grandmother's spirits. They agree to part ways once she recovers, but as they live together, sparks fly, and Ethan discovers Nancy is the miracle doctor he's been searching for. What began as a lie turns into fate.

book_title: Stray to Sovereign: The Power Play of Love
special_desc: Once her stray dog, he is now the most powerful man in town. In a thrilling game of cat and mouse, he is both an ambitious conqueror and a willing admirer at her feet.

Drugged by her stepmother, she had a one night stand with the most powerful man in the city, then she disappeared—only to be found a year later, giving birth to his child. As her hidden identities unravel, he closes in: You can't run from me or our child.

After saving powerful CEO Elliott, Winnie ends up pregnant and severely injured. Eight months later, she gives birth to a premature baby boy.

Desperate to pay for her son's medical bills, Winnie works around the clock just to survive. All the while, Elliott is searching for the woman who saved his life. He is ready to give her all the love she never knew she needed.

Having nothing left to teach his mentee, Victor Hale sent Rhea Kirk, a Go Prodigy, to the Myst Go Club owned by Alaric Drayke. There, she cracked the Ultimate Puzzle and defeated the ruthless Go King. Yet, as the dust settled, hidden secrets began to surface, Rhea and Alaric decided to participate in the Grand Go Game and find the truth of the past!

book_title: Hey Mommy! Time for a New Daddy!
special_desc: Reborn as a five-year-old, Talia only wants to protect her mother. But her charm and secret talents soon win over powerful elders and silence the doubters. With a tycoon father, an even richer stepfather, and a future billionaire husband, she grows up as the family's darling, proving that even the smallest star can shine the brightest.

book_title: From His Tutor to His Darling
special_desc: As a boy, Joseph hated studying until his mother brought Jane to be his little “housekeeper.” Her patience and warmth changed him completely, and he secretly vowed to marry her one day. Years later, Joseph has become one of the world’s most powerful tycoons, and the first thing he does with his success is return to the countryside to make Jane his wife.

After a stillbirth, Seraphina Morgan is manipulated into a one-night encounter with Phil Grant, the wealthiest man in Jiggo City. Unexpectedly pregnant, she is taken into Phil's home. As they spend more time together, Phil begins to uncover the truth. Will he continue to treat Seraphina with respect? And how will the heartbroken Seraphina handle this complicated relationship?

book_title: Served Time, Now I'm His Mrs. Right
special_desc: Forced to be a “lucky bride” to wake comatose billionaire Zander Morris, Elara Switt is discarded after their one night. Years later, she returns as a nanny—only to discover her twin son being raised by her stepsister, Nelly, who now plays the doting mother and wife. Using her medical skills and relentless determination, Elara infiltrates the house, fighting to reclaim her child, expose her web of lies, and make every betrayer pay.
He, a hidden tycoon controlling the national economy, marries her in secret to boost her confidence, but she divorces him before he reveals his identity...
OMG, the husband she is going to marry under family pressure turns out to be not only rich but also very hot! Amid the trivial challenges of rural life, a special bond developed between this couple.

book_title: Turning the Tables: Starting with Foreseeing
special_desc: He worked hard, but his achievements were repeatedly stolen by his supervisor. His greedy ex-wife also left him. Unexpectedly, he got a phone that could predict future events. He won't let anyone look down on him anymore.

After serving five years in prison and anxious to return home to his wife and children, he encounters his enemy on his way home. To protect his family and to take revenge, he decided that he would do the same thing to his family!

book_title: Billionaire Twins Fall in Love with Me
special_desc: Eight years before, the twin heirs fell in love with you at the same time. But fate did them badly, that one died and one suffered amnesia. Eight years later, you encountered the one who don't remember you on a blind date, and he quickly fell for you again. This time, will true love find its way?

To escape the marriage arranged by my parents, I secretly got married. I thought everything would settle down, but my husband cheated on me after the wedding!
Before getting a divorce, I had a one-night stand with a man. I thought it was nothing serious, but the man got attached to me! As I kept dealing with him, I discovered he was the man my parents had arranged for me to marry years ago! What should I do?

The eldest grandson of the my family, urgently needs a bone marrow transplant. The son-loving old grandmother took the bone marrow from her granddaughter, causing her "dead". She was also blinded and thrown into a river so she could never find the way back home. Fortunately, she was adopted by a garbage collector and renamed.
Sixteen years later, she accidentally offended the adopted daughter of her biological family, and was humiliated.
Her adoptive mother was diagnosed with gastric cancer, which made things even worse.
For medical expenses, she endured humiliation and endured all kinds of tortures from the family.
However, the family who never gave up looking for their biological daughter, never thought that she was the lost daughter...
In the end, can the family recognize her? Let us wait and see."

book_title: Awakend: The Female Agent Phoenix's Revenge
special_desc: She took her sister to visit a close friend, only to be betrayed and sold to local criminals. They were brutally abused, and their parents were killed trying to rescue them. This planted the seed of revenge in her. Meeting a former Phoenix who saw her own struggles in her, she became a disciple. She then rose as the new female warrior of the dark underworld, dismantling the criminal syndicate and rescuing her sister.

She was blind, but one day she suddenly regained her sight and discovered her husband cheating with her best friend. They had plotted to kill her for her inheritance. With danger looming, she chose to pretend to still be blind, cleverly outwitting them step by step to uncover the truth.

In her past life, she gave everything to the man she loved, only to be betrayed and killed by him and his mistress. The one who stayed by her side in her final moments was the fiancé she had hurt. Now, she's been reborn 10 years in the past, determined to find happiness this time with the man who truly loved her.

Trapped in a decade-long nightmare of family control, she meets a man who seems like the perfect way out. At first, she uses him to escape, but his unconditional trust and devotion slowly melt her guarded heart. What begins as a calculated plan turns into an unexpected journey of love, healing, and finding the strength to start anew.

book_title: Tell Me Your Secret, My Bride
special_desc: College student Lian Cabot transmigrates into the illegitimate son of the Duke. His mother was murdered, and he is forced to marry into the Croft family, taking a foolish bride. After the marriage, Lian uses his poetic talent to win over his alluring mother-in-law and beautiful sister-in-law during the day, while at night he trains in martial arts with a mysterious woman. However, it seems that the person he shares his bridal chamber with each night is different.

Betrayed, robbed of her inheritance, and murdered by her cheating boyfriend and his mistress, Nancy gets a second chance at life. Upon rebirth, she stuns everyone by marrying Riverport's richest man, Lincoln, and turning the tables on those who destroyed her. To save her late father's company, Nancy must survive a ruthless six-month business wager. With Lincoln as her ally, she crushes her enemies, reclaims her power, and rewrites her fate.

On his way to treat his sick father, Finn saves a drowning old man, unaware he‘s Harborhaven’s richest tycoon. Soon after, Finn is tricked into marrying into the ruthless Spencer family, where he‘s humiliated and exploited. When their cruelty leads to his father’s death, Finn awakens, exposes their schemes, earns the tycoon‘s backing, and rises from despised son-in-law to chosen heir.

She entered a contract marriage with him because she bore his child, but they got divorced because she lost the baby. Later, after clearing up their misunderstandings and planning to remarry, he was arranged to marry the woman who caused her to lose the baby...

During a mission, the young marshal unexpectedly met an heiress. As they navigated the turbulent times, their relationship evolved from curiosity to mutual understanding, deepening amidst the challenges of an era filled with unknowns and warlord conflicts.
She was once kidnapped and saved by him. To repay the favor, she married him, while he mistook another woman for her and proposed a divorce. After the truth came out, he wanted to win her back.

book_title: Back to the 1920s as a Tycoon
special_desc: Traveled back to the old times, he accidentally witnessed his great-grandmother being killed, and his family becoming paupers. He used his foresight to try to save his family time and time again and finally accumulated trillions of wealth.

Under threat, she had to assume someone else's identity to marry into a wealthy family. Unexpectedly, she ends up entangling with her fiancé's brother – a ruthless man who strikes fear into everyone. Due to her fake identity and the threats she faces, she doesn't dare to break things off with him easily. So, she decides to play along with him. When the family that once hunted her entire family proposes a marriage alliance with him, their relationship hits a deadlock... How will their budding romance unfold?

I was an ordinary worker with no parents. But one day, two plainly dressed people came to find me, claiming to be my parents. However, their identities were not as simple as they appeared, they were actually billionaires…

book_title: Married Fast, I’m a Secret Healer!
special_desc: A legendary healer hides her identity and marries into the Gu family to study secret medicine, while the Gu family’s CEO is desperately searching for a healer to cure his son’s mysterious illness. By chance, they enter into a marriage contract—will love blossom between them?

Upon returning to her home country, this woman unexpectedly crosses paths with her male archenemy. Both harbor deep-seated hatred for each other. Yet, unbeknownst to the world, they are also secretly in love with one another.

Trapped by debt, Emily Shaw marries tycoon Ethan Winters, becoming his vengeful pawn. A disputed pregnancy sparks lethal fury until AI evidence exposes scheming ex Olivia Parker's plot and a murderous driver. Emily wields legal battles to dismantle Winters' financial abuse and Parkers' fraud. Under Mrs. Winters' gaze, Ethan's rooftop awakening sparks a redemption quest—conquering corporate warfare to reclaim Emily's heart.

Ten months after Nancy Miller’s fateful encounter with Blake Hart, the CEO of Hart Corp, a devastating accident takes her mother’s life. Desperate to secure her newborn daughter’s future, Nancy leaves her at Blake’s doorstep. Later, with a recommendation from her mentor, Nancy joins Hart Corp. As Blake raises their daughter, he embarks on a relentless search across the city for Nancy, eagerly awaiting the day she will return to him and walk down the aisle in the grand wedding he’s been planning all along.

Jocelyn gave up her tech career for marriage, only to be betrayed and forced to serve her husband's mistress. She divorces him, takes back her patents, and tanks his company overnight. After a flash marriage with her former rival Steven, she returns to the tech world and rises higher than ever, leaving her ex with nothing.

Stella Langford's college shuts down. She has to transfer to another college, but ends up living with Nathaniel Hawthorne, CEO of Hawthorne Group. They are forced into a contract marriage. Bullied by socialite Vicky Swing, Stella fights back with her sharp wits and shooting skills. But when her true identity and a buried past begin to surface, Nathaniel realizes the girl he married on paper is the one he's been destined to protect all along.

book_title: My Dumb Hubby is a Multi-Billionaire
special_desc: Everyone makes fun of her because her husband is a "knucklehead", but they have no idea it is all just a show he's been putting on!

book_title: Seduce My Ex's CEO Uncle After Rebirth
special_desc: In her past life, her husband ruined her family, causing them to go bankrupt, resulting in the death of both parents and leaving her unable to conceive. She died on the night she decided to divorce after learning the truth. Reborn, she vows to protect her family and cherish herself. However, she unintentionally attracts the attention of her ex-husband's younger uncle. Initially considered just a transaction, she finds herself entangled in a deep love with this billionaire...

book_title: I Marry A Tycoon After Being Dumped
special_desc: At 30, she supports her boyfriend through college, but he dumps her for a wealthy connection after graduation. At her lowest, she meets a billionaire incognito. He falls for her, making her his wife. When she meets her ex again, her ex regrets his choice.

book_title: Revengeful Return of the Ugly Beauty
special_desc: Not long after marriage, her husband had an affair with one of her students, and the two caused her, eight months pregnant, to fall into the sea. After plastic surgery, she transformed into a stunning goddess, returned, and embarked on a journey of revenge.

book_title: The Villager Is The Big Shot
special_desc: The migrant worker, scorned by all, is revealed to be the fallen god of war. Betrayed by his wife, he unveils his true identity, determined to reclaim all that is rightfully his...

My Five Stunning Sisters movie summary introduces us to five kick-ass heroines Libby, Giada, Kenna, Lea, and Anaya Powell who help their brother Isaac after he gets dumped by Elena, his girlfriend who doesn't realize he's a Powell.
Isaac along with his sisters decide to teach Elena a lesson for calling him a loser and tagging their relationship with a price.

book_title: The Leaving Pregnant Wife, The Regretful CEO
special_desc: You need this in a long night.

book_title: Spoiled CEO's Wife Flees While Pregnant
special_desc: After an unexpected one-night stand with him, she happened to find a job as his assistant. After a short period of time together, he fell for her. Then his nominal girlfriend discovered their relationship and threatened her to leave!

book_title: War King: My Return Makes the Nation Submit to Me
special_desc: A young warrior, abandoned by his father, witnesses his mother’s tragic death due to a conspiracy. Saved by a mysterious figure, he joins the army and, after ten years of battle, rises to power. Now summoned to the capital, he returns to make those responsible for his mother’s death tremble in fear.

book_title: The Heiress Doesn't Care at All
special_desc:
At your wedding, someone actually brought a DNA report to question your identity! Even your family and boyfriend believed it! On your wedding day, after being humiliated and shut away, you lost your confidence and began to doubt your life. That's when he appeared like a ray of light, helping you stand tall again. 
Slowly emerging from the shadow, you decide not to be weak anymore! With the support of true love, you vow to prove yourself, reclaim everything, and make the wrongdoers pay the price!

After a car accident, she voluntarily married him for luck. However, she found out that he had always had another woman in his heart. After three years of marriage, she couldn't bear it anymore and decided to leave, and gave birth to three children. Unexpectedly, two of the children were diagnosed with a blood disease. Over the years, she painstakingly researched drugs and finally found a cure. Will the CEO find out about all these?

book_title: The Twins' Mom is a Heiress
special_desc: While pregnant with the CEO's child, she was framed and pushed down the stairs by her sister and became a vegetable. Five years later, she met the CEO again with her child.

book_title: OMG! I Blocked My CEO Husband
special_desc:
Since childhood, my family was poor, and my mother was diagnosed with a brain tumor that required 300,000 for surgery. However, all our savings were taken by my father.
I happened to save an old man who had a sudden illness on the roadside. This old man turned out to be the former CEO of a big company! And he suggested that I marry his grandson, a billionaire CEO!
To get money for my mother's treatment, I agreed. Unexpectedly, my husband turned out to be the man I saved ten years ago! But he thinks his savior was another girl. Should I tell him the truth?

Four years ago, she walked into a hotel room to catch her fiancé cheating, only to stumble upon a drugged and injured stranger targeted for assassination. That night, their fates became entwined. She gave birth to twins, but was told one of the babies was stillborn—unaware it was all part of her sister's cruel scheme.
Now, four years later, she reluctantly agrees to a blind date with that very same man, and the unexpected happens: she asks him to take care of her son, while he, in need of a wife, proposes a deal. They quickly marry.
But things take a dark turn when her ex-fiancé kidnaps her son, only to mistakenly abduct the man’s child instead. Amid the chaos, the two twins are swapped, leading to a series of shocking and dangerous twists that will change their lives forever.

After three years of marriage, she has endured constant oppression and humiliation from her mother-in-law. The mother-in-law forces her to care for her husband’s distant cousin, who is actually the husband’s mistress. Meanwhile, her long-lost brothers have just discovered her whereabouts and are on their way to bring her back home.

book_title: The Spoiled Miss is a Hidden Big Shot
special_desc: On the day of her grandmother's funeral, she gets kicked out of her home. In reality, she’s the long-lost sixth daughter of a prominent family. When she returns, her adoptive sister makes her life difficult, and she’s pressured to fulfill an engagement with another family. Little does she know, her fiancé is the very person she has already fallen for.

book_title: Back in Time: Pampered by My Seven Sisters
special_desc: Brilliant scientist Hayden Nash is betrayed and murdered by his best friend, only to be reincarnated as Chandler Nash, the "fool" of the Nash family in the Empire of Celestia. When political intrigue leads to the execution of his family, Chandler, armed with a powerful secret—space manipulation—must protect his seven sisters-in-law while plotting a daring revenge. With a hidden strength and unyielding determination, he sets the stage for a thrilling journey of power, betrayal, and justice.

When Ciara Devin, the long-lost daughter of the Devin family, returns, all hell breaks loose. Status, wealth, and deep-seated grudges fuel tension both inside the family and beyond. Trust crumbles, and misunderstandings cut like a knife, threatening to shatter them completely. But Ciara refuses to back down. Armed with sheer determination, she fights to mend the fractures, forcing long-buried truths into the light. As walls of silence crack and the first sparks of reconciliation flicker, one question remains—can this broken family truly heal, or are some wounds too deep to close? This gripping short drama delves into the power of communication, the weight of societal expectations, and the messy, raw reality of family bonds.

Susie Cobb, a battle-hardened warlord shaped by years of training, is unaware that her husband, Shawn Foley, is actually the mighty Lord Orion. When a schemer with a false identity drives a wedge between them, planting seeds of doubt and damaging Susie’s trust, Shawn ultimately uncovers the conspiracy and reunites with her—strengthening the powerful bond they share.

Sherley Chapman and Alexander Lynch, once childhood sweethearts, are unexpectedly thrust back into each other's lives with a twist of fate that forces them into marriage. As Alexander, a mysterious expert, consistently supports Sherley, a determined CEO, through numerous obstacles, their bond evolves and flourishes.

After being framed and forced to leave the Mystic Blade Sect, Dean Lewis discovers his destiny at the Divine Hall—inheriting the powerful bloodline of the Nine Dragons. Embarking on an epic journey of revenge and growth, he devours infinite spiritual energy and merges the bloodlines of countless realms. Through fierce battles and relentless challenges, he rises against all odds to ultimately rescue his long-lost father and carve his legend into the world.

Ethan, the village's toughest hunter, lives by two rules: hunt wild beasts and stay feared. But when time-traveling Molly insists on marrying him, the man everyone avoids finally meets someone who won't run and maybe even tames his wild heart.

book_title: CEO, Madam Has A Secret Child!
special_desc: Six years ago, she divorced her CEO husband without him knowing she was pregnant. Now, she lives alone with her child. When they meet again during a blind date, can they clear up misunderstandings and reconcile their broken relationship?

After her grandfather's death, she unexpectedly discovers that both her sister and boyfriend betrayed her, taking away the family fortune left by her grandfather. Determined to seek revenge, she decides to get married, only to realize that she married the wrong person. She immediately files for divorce, but her husband disagrees...

The Supreme Underworld King movie summary talks about the Underworld Kingpin known as Lord Opulence who saves damsels who are thrown into auction by lustful men. His secret identity is revealed when his wife and daughter are thrown into the auction.
Lord Opulence story is a modern-day magic realism action packed drama with a happy ending as Lord Opulence defeats the enemies.

She was married by her stepfather to a dying CEO who was comatose. Under her care, the CEO recovered. He discovered she was pregnant and assumed she had betrayed him, so he divorced her. Six years later, she returned to the country with her child and encountered him again, what's going to happen?

To buy back my grandfather’s heirlooms, I attended the appraisal event but was turned away because, due to hiding my identity, I didn’t receive an invitation. 
Before his death, my grandfather arranged three handsome and wealthy suitors for me, but I scared them away pretending to be ugly. Relying solely on my skills, I became a world-renowned collector. However, my low profile led many to believe I was a nobody. At the event, I intended to show everyone who I am! Unexpectedly, I also met him—the person I saved years ago—who turned out to be the wealthiest billionaire!

A young girl's life was shattered by her tutor. She seduced the girl's father, causing the mother's death and leaving the girl with a severe facial scar. The girl was abandoned and suffered countless hardships while suffering from amnesia. When she regained her memory in an accident, she resolved to take revenge on the woman who had ruined her life.

The emperor's beloved princess was kidnapped by human traffickers during an outing and spent over a decade living as a child bride in a peasant family. Years later, the emperor finally finds his daughter's whereabouts, but mistakenly identifies the wrong person... With schemes and plots inside and outside the palace, can the real princess reclaim her identity?

Nicole Webbs found herself married—out of the blue and completely baffled—to the billionaire Stanley Brooks! To make it even more absurd, the groom didn't even recognize his own bride.
After countless near-meetings, mistaken identities, and hilarious misadventures, the two finally come face to face… and sparks fly!

Everyone was scared of him in the city, but he married a countryside woman who turned out to know medicine, fighting, and even owned part of a big company. The CEO gets scared of his wife, "I'm sorry, I won't snoop into your secret identities again!"

She got drugged and sold by her bestie to a guy. After escaping, she meets a drugged stranger, and they spend the night. Waking up, she finds out her bestie and ex-fiancé betrayed her. Confronting them, she's hurt and caught in a fire. Luckily saved, she later has twins, but one is taken away...

My Dream, My Dread movie summary shows an emotional rollercoaster drama as we see Charlotte, who seems like she had a perfect family, finds out her husband Henry Foster already has a separate family with a son named Micheal who needs a bone marrow transplant.
The movie shows how Charlotte escapes from her husband's clutches to save herself and her baby.
Before the divorce, she was nothing but a malicious woman to him. After the divorce, he offered a second chance, to which she replied, "No, thank you."

book_title: I Wish You Were My Wife
special_desc: When they were young, they promised to marry each other, but many years later, he forgot that promise. Though they got married, he never returned to be with her and didn't even know what she looked like. By coincidence, the divorce lawyer he hired turned out to be his wife, the one he wanted to divorce. Through various misunderstandings, he began to remember the promise they made in childhood.

Entangled with the CEO movie summary shows us how Alicia Caldwell ends up having a one-night stand with Callum Fletcher, the head of Fletcher group after finding out her boyfriend was cheating on her.
Their one-night stand becomes a scandal that affects her career and her boyfriend tries to get back with her while the CEO demands more than one night.

On their anniversary, he catches his wife cheating with a wealthy heir. Seven years later, he has become the wealthiest CEO. By chance, they meet again, and she is in disarray, accompanied by a seven-year-old child...

After years of separation from your family, you finally decided to return home as the heiress. How dare these people question your identity at the party that your Billionaire father threw to welcome your comeback?! You married a man, keeping your wealthy heiress identity a secret, but turned out to be bullied by his family and cheated by him. You decided to bear them no more and return to your own family. But, you found out that someone has been impersonating you! Luckily, three handsome men are here to support you. Is your meant-to-be prince one of them? And how will you take revenge, with your own ability and strength?

book_title: The Waiter I Married is a Big Shot
special_desc:
On the day before the wedding, I caught my fiance cheating on me. On the wedding day, I showed up, fully dressed up as a bride, but not to marry him! Instead, I flash-married a waiter! 
I am a young female CEO with a great career, how dare my fiance have been cheating on me all the time? To make him regret, I flash-married a waiter, and decided to revenge on him!
Little did I know, the man I married is a billionaire CEO! After becoming contract lovers, he kept supporting my career, and we inevitably developed feelings for each other...What should I do?

Forensic expert Vivian Smith, shamed for her job, accidentally sleeps with tycoon Ethan Parker—her ex’s uncle. A contractual marriage sparks chaos: their "stench solidarity" masks lethal secrets. As family feuds, conspiracies, and desire collide, they fight prejudice and lies, healing each other’s wounds. Can love survive autopsy tables and boardrooms?

With only seven days to live after sacrificing himself, Sword Master, Caelan Evans, watches Empress Lydia Lockwood become convinced of his jealousy and selfishness—even as she sends him divorce papers. His final battle at Heavenate and the blossoming of the Eon Lotus will reveal a truth: every step of his fall was a step taken to protect her throne… and her heart.

After a night of drinking, a billionaire tycoon unexpectedly time-travels back to 1989. Seizing the opportunities in this era, he smartly grows his business empire, earning the title 'God of Investment.' Eventually, he becomes a respected business magnate, crafting an unmatched legend.

She was offered as a sacrifice by her family of tomb-robbers, but the Lord of the Underworld appeared and marked her as his bride. Ever since, she has wandered between the realms of the living and the dead...

She's a modern archaeologist who casually saves a man in the wilderness, only to discover he's the valiant general of the Great Yan Dynasty. As they get acquainted, they unexpectedly travel back to the Great Yan era. After a series of adventures, they develop feelings for each other and unite to confront a prince vying for the throne...

Seven years ago, he was a down-and-out orphan, and she was a female CEO. For love, she gave up everything to elope with him. Seven years later, he returns as a powerful, influential tycoon, wealthy enough to rival nations. Driven by a desire to make amends for his past and protect her, he ensures her security and comfort.

She was forced to disguise herself as a boy from a young age to survive. Unexpectedly, she became entangled with the heir of a wealthy family and gradually fell in love with him. To conceal her female identity, she could only watch as he mistook others for her. Meanwhile, he mistakenly believed he was falling for a man and thought he had become homosexual...

book_title: From Broken Engagement to Marrying a Billionaire
special_desc:
Only right before our wedding, did I realize the true side of my boyfriend! He only wanted money and didn't care about my thoughts at all. 
Luckily, god has given me a second chance! I met a handsome CEO, and I decided to start my new life. He thought it was a new romance, but he doesn’t know, I was the girl he met and had been looking for seven years ago!

book_title: My Flash Marriage Husband is a Movie Star
special_desc: I was a fallen heiress, struggling with life. I met him in an elevator, and the paparazzi made it a great rumor, causing a big problem. To revenge me, he bought the only house property my dad left me! To deal with the rumors, we decided to flash marry. After our contract marriage, we gradually fell for each other, and he decided to return the house to me. However, more challenges are to be faced…

book_title: Bear the Big Shot's Child After Being Dumped
special_desc: She was dumped by her ex-fiance and unexpectedly had a one-night stand with the CEO. Six years later, she returned to the country with her child. Her child helped her find a husband on a TV program, unexpectedly, it's the CEO!

book_title: Divorced and Now a Billionaire's Granddaughter
special_desc:
Divorced And Now A Billionaire's Granddaughter movie summary talks about Georgia Williams finding out her husband Theodore was cheating on her with Celine Jordan after a plane crash. She decides to seek divorce, realizing her husband never loved her in the three years of their marriage.
Georgia after her divorce goes back to her family as she's the rich heiress to the Logan family and now Theodore is shocked to know his wife's real identity as he tries to win her back.

“Are you not taking any responsibility after last night?” How dare this man to text me such things! 
Six years ago, on my coming-of-age ceremony, my father and sister drugged me, leading to an accidental one-night stand with a CEO. Afterwards, I was kicked out of my home! I later discovered I was pregnant, but one child was stolen from me. Along with the truth about my mother’s death, I felt hopeless and left with my other two children.
Six years later, I’ve become a top doctor and am determined to reclaim everything... Just in time, I met the CEO again, and he is now pursuing me. I know a game of revenge and love is waiting for me to win!

book_title: Pregnant and Quit: The CEO is the Baby’s Dad
special_desc:
I didn't expect to have a one-night stand with my billionaire CEO boss on the night before resigning from the company! 
The next morning, fearing consequences, I left anonymously. Unexpectedly, my stepsister assumed my identity, and the CEO mistook her as the one-night stand! 
Worse still, I'm pregnant, and the CEO rejected my resignation as the secretary! What should I do?

book_title: The CEO Married the Wrong Woman
special_desc:
"His family picked him up from the hospital in a helicopter!"
I've been in love with my handsome boyfriend for years, but he tragically had an accident and then disappeared!
My parents opposed us being together because he was poor, forcing me to marry a wealthy old man. They even told me I wasn't their birth daughter. In despair, my boyfriend was my solace, but a sudden accident tore us apart! Many clues suggest that my boyfriend's true identity might be significant. Now, I've also discovered that I'm pregnant. Should I keep this child?

Daphne thought losing him was the only way to keep him safe, so she walked away and married another man. Five years later, the man she once loved returns, but he's colder than ever, determined to make her pay the price for breaking his heart..

book_title: The Eternal Protector and His Fragile Fiancée
special_desc:
An immortal was tricked before his death into marrying a foolish granddaughter of a powerful family. Initially, he planned to ignore her, but he soon discovered that her unique bloodline was essential to his cultivation. Reluctantly, he decided to secretly protect her. The female lead was once infamous as the "madwoman" of her family, known for her violent and unpredictable personality, as well as her unfathomable skills in poison. However, when faced with her savior, she chose to hide her true self, pretending to be an obedient and gentle girl by his side.

Yet, her younger sister, driven by greed for the family fortune, relentlessly bullied and oppressed her. Forced into a corner, the female lead had no choice but to transform into a ruthless figure in the shadows, hiding her true nature from her savior as she navigated the challenges and dangers that surrounded them.

Anson Shaw, a modern office worker, reborns as Summeria's disgraced prince with mind-reading powers. He shocks the court using poetry, crushes Beatrix with gunpowder, and invents the Mechanical Steed during famine relief—until framed for matricide. When the Grand Empress's death exposes a twin-king conspiracy, he overthrows the throne with explosive tech, forging a technocratic empire where modern logic shatters ancient tyranny.

book_title: My Bricklayer Hubby Is Actually a Billionaire!
special_desc: Heiress Rosalie flees a forced marriage, wedding laborer Ethan—unaware he's an amnesiac billionaire. As fake love becomes real, they battle her family and the Warrens' schemes. Ethan secretly funds Rosalie's jewelry empire, culminating in a record-breaking auction. Revealing his identity, they defy elitism, proving true wealth is self-made success and love.
A sniper with superhuman sight just wants a quiet life until he's forced to marry a stunning CEO and finds himself in a new kind of battlefield: love, lies, and corporate war.

Awakening in an unfamiliar era, Vicky Shaw is unexpectedly thrust into the role of a mother. Time has transported her to a new world, where she must navigate life with two young children by her side. Armed with healing powers and an indomitable spirit, this once-outcast heiress is determined to claim the life she rightfully deserves.

book_title: I Sent My Mom on a Blind Date
special_desc: Joy is a successful woman, but to her mother, Camila, she's just a "leftover" daughter in desperate need of marriage. After a car accident, Joy wakes up in 1994. Determined to give her mother a taste of her own medicine, Joy drags her to blind dates, only to realize love isn't so simple. As Camila faces two suitors and relentless family pressure, Joy begins to wonder if her own existence should matter less than her mother's happiness until a shocking truth reveals she was never Camila's biological daughter at all.

She was murdered by her sister and lover, then wake up six months in the past. This time around, she plans to marry the wheelchair-bound billionaire legend, all for revenge. Little did she know, he'd be on her side. Because he loves her.

A woman wakes up three years in the past after a tragic death in her previous life. Fleeing from her abusive husband, she meets a man who had also been reborn. Little do they know, their pasts intertwine with vengeance and love as they seek justice against those who wronged them before.
She saved his life, but he thought it was another girl. He married her but never wanted to meet her, and finally divorced her. However, this is just the beginning of the story...
She married this blind guy who saved her life to pay him back. A romantic relationship gradually starts, and they are now stepping onto a journey filled with mystery and truth together.

book_title: Stop Acting Dumb, My Billionaire Hubby
special_desc: The father married his daughter to a silly president for money. After the president regained his memory, he found that the murderer of his parents was her father! He vented his anger on her...

Your father suddenly passed away, and life fell into unprecedented hardship. 
In this difficult moment, your only choice was to work as a housekeeper for the person who caused your family's downfall. You endured humiliation, yet deep inside, a flame of revenge burned. You successfully drove a wedge between him and his brother, turning them against each other. However, during this process, you started to lose yourself in his brother's protection of you. His deep affection made you feel guilty, and you began to doubt whether your revenge plan was right...

To repay the kindness of saving her life, she hid her wealthy identity and married her husband. After being with him for three years, she was expelled from his home. After the divorce, she returned to her wealthy family and lived for herself. However, he gradually realized his mistake and regretted it...

After catching her husband cheating, she prepares for divorce, only to discover he’s been secretly transferring their marital assets. To regain control, she forms an unlikely alliance with the mistress. Together, they expose his true colors, destroy his career, and recover the stolen wealth.

book_title: Golden Threads of a Second Chance
special_desc: At 50, facing her mother’s life-threatening illness, Ophelia Jones uncovers a devastating secret—her husband has been secretly sending money to his first love for the past 30 years. Heartbroken, she contemplates selling her embroidery to pay for her mother’s treatment and decides to divorce him. Just when she feels lost, she unexpectedly reunites with her childhood sweetheart, Jacob Hunt. Not only does Jacob selflessly donate a kidney to save her mother, but he also offers unwavering support and protection. Moved by his genuine love and devotion, Ophelia’s heart is rekindled, and after finally leaving her husband, she and Jacob begin a new life together, bound by love and trust.

book_title: Oops! Falling for My Wild Heiress
special_desc: The day Alina Archer realizes she's transmigrated into the body of a wealthy character in a book, she visits an upscale club that night and takes a model named Oliver Nolan back to her home. To her surprise, he’s not only incredibly handsome but also skilled in various areas. He teaches her the ways of business and saves her from crises multiple times. As their bond deepens, Oliver decides to propose when her family pressures her to marry soon. It’s at this moment that she discovers he’s actually the richest man on Earth.

book_title: After Rebirth: Entangled with My Ex's Uncle
special_desc: After reborn, murdered heiress Winnie Spencer allies with enemy Ethan Lawrence. Exposing her fiancé's schemes, she uncovers Ethan's hidden power and her stepsister's tricks. Through corporate wars and a fake marriage, they crush foes, forging redemption in elite chaos.

book_title: Daddy, We're Getting You a Wife
special_desc: Serena Morris enters a whirlwind marriage with the enigmatic Lucas Reed, stepping into the role of stepmother to his two children. However, she soon uncovers a startling truth: Lucas's children are, in fact, her own, lost to her five years ago. As the past unravels, long-buried secrets come to light...
To resist an arranged marriage, the young lady spent a fortune to hire a stranger from the nightclub to fake a marriage with her. But the man turned out to be much wealthier than she was...

The orphan was dying from a serious illness and unable to afford treatment, but he miraculously was reborn as the son of a multi-billionaire. Now, he needs to spend his inherited billion-dollar fortune within three months to gain a new lease on life!

book_title: The Billionaire's Wife Is a Butcher
special_desc: He was injured and saved by her, concealing his identity as a CEO to be with her. After his identity was revealed, they entered a contract marriage for his ill grandmother. By his side, she was deliberately bullied by others, but all were resolved with his preference and love.

book_title: Spoiled by Aristocratic Heirs After Divorce
special_desc: Married for five years, she endured neglect and mistreatment from her husband and his family. It wasn't until a workplace bullying incident and a car accident that she saw the cold, indifferent nature of the man she had loved for so long. She decided to stop pretending and revealed her true identity as the daughter of the world's richest man, which stunned everyone. In the end, she rekindled her romance with her devoted first love.

After a one-night stand, he and she had two adorable babies. One day, the babies discovered that their biological father is a CEO. They brought their mom along to find him, but that's when their mom's twin sister showed up and took her place. When both twins appear at the same time, can those around them tell who is who?

book_title: Stop the Charade, I'm the True Heiress
special_desc: After discovering she wasn't their biological daughter, her adoptive parents and their daughter humiliated her in every way and kicked her out of the house. Little did they know, she was actually the long-lost daughter of the richest family in the city! Once her biological parents took her back, she decided to intern at their company. Unexpectedly, she and the adoptive sister started on the same day. Because she dressed modestly and rode an electric scooter while the adoptive daughter arrived in an expensive sports car, everyone mistakenly believed the latter was the heiress. Amidst these misunderstandings, how will she cleverly expose the true nature of her malicious and vain adoptive sister?

book_title: Love After Rebirth: Spoiled by My Husband's Uncle
special_desc: In her past life, she was betrayed and killed by her husband. Now reborn, she finds herself back on the day they met each other's families. This time, she makes a bold choice—she leaves her husband-to-be and chooses his powerful, enigmatic uncle instead. Despite rumors about his supposed shortcomings, their union quickly blossoms into a life filled with unexpected surprises, including triplets!

Silas Bryant brought a fish bucket to propose to Aurora Hastings, but faced ridicule from her family because Aurora wished to end the engagement. Judith Hastings, however, agreed to marry Silas. He then revealed the hidden billion-dollar diamonds in the bucket, shocking everyone and leaving Aurora regretful. Silas ultimately married the kind Judith.

Chris Lynn descended from the mountain because his master sent him to find the family involved in a decades-old arranged marriage with him. He was told that their patriarch possesses a pendant that could help him find his birth parents. However, upon arriving, he was dragged into a restaurant by a woman who demanded that he become her fake boyfriend...

book_title: When a Morden Girl Fell Into the Prince’s Harem
special_desc: When actress Zoe Sanchez is transported to ancient times, she becomes a concubine to Prince Alfred. Trapped in his treacherous harem, she must outsmart rivals and win the Prince's heart using her modern wit. From unwanted servant to undeniable favorite—her most dangerous role begins now.

Gemma took the fall for a crime she didn't commit so her little sister, Wenny, could live a good life. But the day Gemma walks out of prison, she learns that Wenny is dead. Together with her brother-in-law, Ronan, they find a conspiracy bigger than they thought. Now with both families involved, who's the real murderer?

A rising star in the jewelry design industry, who had concealed her identity, returns to her home country and, through a series of mishaps, ends up marrying a CEO who is also hiding his true identity. After overcoming various obstacles, their affection for each other grows, making them a celebrated couple in the jewelry industry.

She starred in a low-budget horror film. To save money, the crew ignored the warnings of elderly villagers and filmed in an abandoned temple deep in the mountains. Unexpectedly, real paranormal events began to occur. The protagonist in the script who was originally destined to be sacrificed to an evil deity dies tragically. She must take self-rescue measures.

book_title: CEO, Those Twins Look Just Like you
