special_desc: As a single mother raising her twins, she unexpectedly encounters a playboy who disrupts her life. Little does she know, this playboy has a hidden identity as a billionaire. And shockingly, he turns out to be the father of her children...

The world's richest man had fame and fortune, but regretted his whole life when his wife and daughter left. In old age, he was falsely accused and died unfairly. Reborn and thrust back in time, he determined to make things right this time. He gambled, saved the powerful, and confronted those who wronged him with information only he, as a time-traveler, would know...

She's the CEO's wife, and her one-night stand turns out to be her husband whom she's never met in their three-year marriage. But when she wakes up, he doesn't recognize her at all and asks for a divorce...

He possesses superb medical skills, but after marriage, he took the initiative to be a house husband. However, in his wife's heart, he was worthless and unreliable. She insisted on divorce. However, later when she knew the truth, she begged him to save her grandfather and was willing to remarry him...
Everyone thinks she is an ugly and dumb girl, only her husband and herself know the truth. When will be the day that the shocking truth is revealed? Anyways, he will protect her for always.

The real identity of the bricklayer on the construction site was the renowned King of the state. After gifting his ex-wife a ten-billion business, he was humiliated by divorce. She was stunned when she learned the truth!

book_title: Accidentally Seduced the Billionaire Heir After Betrayal
special_desc: She was betrayed by her husband and hadn’t seen him for three years, only to discover he had a child with his mistress. However, she had already seen through everything. During those three years, she had a fling with a call boy, who turned out to be a billionaire heir...

book_title: The Double Life of My Secret Secretary
special_desc: Her parents forced her into a flash marriage with a stranger who was a CEO, so she fled abroad to escape. After returning home, to avoid her mother's nagging, she disguised herself as a man and became her friend's brother's personal assistant. She then discovered that her boss was the man she had a one-night stand with on her first day back—and he was also her flash-marriage husband whom she had never met!

book_title: My One-Night Lover Is My Contract Husband
special_desc: My parents set me up with a contract marriage, and I heard my “future husband” is a total disaster. To escape, I ended up spending the night with a male model. Turns out, he’s actually my husband…

book_title: The Master Returns: Five Girls' Beloved
special_desc: After eight years cultivating his arts atop sacred peaks, where his mastery blurred the lines between human endeavor and natural law, the aging master finally urged him to descend. An ancestral marriage pact demanded fulfillment, while five martial sisters - whose laughter still haunted the mountain springs - had long since carved their legends in the mortal realm. Standing at the stone gate where veils of morning mist parted, he weighed the bridal jade in his left palm against the bloodstained dagger in his right. With dawn's first light, he stepped onto the winding path where duty and vengeance coiled like twin serpents beneath his shadow.

book_title: Marry My Ex's Boss After Divorce
special_desc: After catching her husband cheating, she was kicked out with nothing. After the divorce, her ex-husband's company boss offers a contract relationship to fend off other women. Little does she know, the billionaire has already fallen for her and will always cherish her.

book_title: Contract Love with My Fiancé's Wheelchair Uncle
special_desc: On the eve of her engagement, her family went bankrupt, and her fiancé called off the wedding! Mocked by everyone, she mustered the courage to marry a wheelchair-bound billionaire to fulfill her grandmother's wish. Little did she know, the rumors were false! The billionaire's disability was all a facade!

book_title: Addicted to Spoiling His Flash-Married Wife
special_desc: She came from a rich family but got switched with the maid's daughter years ago. The fake heiress found out and started causing trouble, even trying to take the man she loved. Just as the real heiress faced a fatal illness, fate took an unexpected turn...
After death, she reincarnates as an heiress of a wealthy family. This time, she decides to seek revenge on the scumbag who abandoned her...

After getting pregnant on their wedding night, she fled. He angrily offered a ten-million reward for her whereabouts. Five years later, he unexpectedly traces her and learns they have three children together. He begins a determined effort to win her back.

Five years ago, she had a one-night stand and became pregnant, only to find out later that the man wasn't her fiancé as she thought. After being kicked out of her home, she became a single mother. When she returned to the city with her twins, she was shocked to discover that her boss, the cold billionaire, was the father of her children.

She's a virgin, but is told she's pregnant with her boss's child. What's even more surprising is that her boss doesn't know. When she considers giving up the child, the billionaire asks her if she wants to get married...

He, once the wealthiest man in town and a recluse, wanted nothing more than a simple life with his wife. However, due to his financial situation, she openly cheated on him. During this time, he met her, and together they dismantled her facade of vanity, ultimately finding happiness together.

book_title: The Martial Healer's Journey to Love
special_desc: After succeeding the Ambit Sect, Saul Hagan set out for Alston in search of Alison Carr—his destined love. With his unparalleled mastery of medicine, Saul restored Alison's ability to walk, giving her a second chance at life. Along the way, he punished those who tried to harm her and saved countless lives with his martial arts and healing skills. Through relentless trials, Saul and Alison's bond only grew stronger, until at last they reached their long-awaited happy ending.

Fresh from his secluded mountain home, a young man with unrivaled medical and martial arts skills arrives in the city. He's immediately entangled with four stunning women, but their beauty is a mask for their true intentions. In a dangerous game of power and seduction, he's the prize, and they'll stop at nothing to claim him.

book_title: Contracted CEO Husband Regrets On Divorce Eve
special_desc: Two years ago, we entered into a marriage contract. For two years, we never met each other. Just when we were about to divorce, we ended up having relations. And he doesn't even remember that the person he had a one-night stand with is me! Now, he wants to divorce me. But knowing the truth, he regrets it.

book_title: Wedding Night, Slept With Another Man
special_desc: On the wedding night, she was forcefully kissed by a stranger at the hospital. The next day, she discovered that the stranger was actually her husband. What's more surprising, her husband didn't recognize her and wanted a divorce.

book_title: Reborn As The CEO's Darling Wife
special_desc: She's framed by her fiancé and best friend, left ruined and eventually killed. Upon her rebirth, she becomes a billionaire's wife. Seeking revenge, he stands by her side, always ready to help.
Three years into the marriage, she did everything a wife should, but she couldn't make him care. Disheartened, she chose to end their marriage...

book_title: CEO, Your Wife Ran Away Again
special_desc: On her engagement day, she was arrested and imprisoned, with nobody believing her innocence. Five years later, she's released. Living in her fiancé's house like a servant, as he believes she killed her first love. But the truth is far from that.

To cure her blind sister, she was sold by her boyfriend to someone else. Through a twist of fate, she becomes entangled in a plot involving an heir to a wealthy family. And then, unexpectedly, a billionaire proposes a marriage contract with her...

book_title: My Ex Regrets On Divorce Day
special_desc: On their wedding day, he forced her to kneel in front of his brother's coffin, believing she was the murderer. Despite his mistreatment, he also loved her. Can their relationship be repaired once the truth is revealed?

book_title: Divorced My Husband Then Lost My Memories
special_desc: She was married to him for three years until one day she requested a divorce. Shortly after, she suffered a car accident. When she wakes up, she has lost five years of memories and has become different from how she was. The woman gradually discovers mysteries surrounding her amnesia, and it seems someone is manipulating everything behind the scenes...

She was a wealthy heiress but her family was destroied. When she grows up, she seeks to avenge her past. One day, a young general accidentally stumbles into her bathroom. Soon, they realize they have a marriage contract, and their feelings deepen as they seek revenge together.

He worked diligently to support his family, but he was betrayed by his wife and framed by his rival. Not only was he imprisoned, but he was also sold to the black market. As he faced imminent death, he unexpectedly received a mysterious inheritance...

Oh My Proud Heiress! summary introduces us to Yvette Harris, who finds herself getting cheated on by her fiancé Brandon. So she drunkenly has a one-night stand with a stranger who turns out to be Brandon's uncle, Edward Campbell, who doesn't want Yvette to marry Brandon.
The age gap romance makes Yvette and Edward's relationship a secret as Yvette plans to expose Brandon's lies.

She and her daughter were bullied by her husband's family for five years, but they didn't know that she was a heiress of a wealthy family. When they divorce, the truth is revealed, can he win back her heart?

book_title: My Ex-CEO Hubby: Anything for Remarriage
special_desc: After being drugged, she had a one-night stand with the CEO. Her best friend framed her and caused misunderstandings between them. She decided to stop being weak and launch a counterattack.

As a child, she experienced the massacre of her entire family. After being rescued, she went overseas, and once had a profound love affair with him, but later discovered that he was the younger brother of her enemy and reluctantly broke up with him. Upon returning to her country, she marries his brother to get close to her enemies...

The person who harmed my family, I will make you pay! 
When I was 6, my parents were killed, and my brother became mentally impaired. To take care of my brother, I learned many skills and started investigating our enemy. I became an assistant to her as a therapist and began to cause trouble between her and her husband. Luck was on my side, and I gathered evidence against her. Now, let's see what you'll do!
Meanwhile, I encountered a special man, who is a billionaire CEO. It seems that I'm losing control over my heart this time...

After years of hard work, he becomes the most respected CEO. However, he is betrayed by his lover and best friend. When he wakes up again, he finds himself reborn back to the year 2000, carrying all his memories from the future. Determined to make those who betrayed him pay, he begins the plan of revenge. He also falls in love with a woman, the beautiful female president of their city.

In order to make her fiancé successful, she had been secretly supporting him, but she didn't expect that her fiancé would do something shameless on the wedding day! When she was bullied by her scumbag fiancé, a delivery man who passed by stood up and said he was her boyfriend, so the two of them got married quickly. But it seems that both of them have hidden identities that are unknown to the public......

After three years of silent treatment following their marriage, when she insisted on finalizing the divorce, he was filled with regret. She had always thought he was charming yet unfaithful, but it wasn't until after they married that she realized how heartless he could be. She believed he loved her, but when faced with a sudden breakup, she discovered her deep affection was nothing more than a self-deceptive joke; he had loved someone else all along. As their three-year agreement came to an end, she left her wedding ring behind, moved out of their home, and signed the divorce papers without any entanglement.

As she prepares to embark on a lucrative job in Africa, she unexpectedly crosses paths with the enigmatic CEO of a major corporation. After a misunderstanding leads to a whirlwind marriage to quell public scrutiny, they apply for divorce on the very day they obtain their marriage certificate, agreeing to a cooling-off period before their separation. What starts as a temporary cohabitation soon becomes complicated by his charming advances and the looming conflicts of high society. With a month to navigate their complicated relationship, how will she choose between her heart and her ambitions?

book_title: Secretly Spoiled by My Billionaire Husband
special_desc: On the day of her blind date, she impulsively marries a stranger, expecting a calm and ordinary life. To her surprise, her new husband turns out to be incredibly clingy, like a piece of stubborn gum. What astonishes her even more is that whenever she faces challenges, he swoops in to effortlessly solve all her problems. When she presses him for answers, he always brushes it off as good luck—until one day, she discovers that her husband is actually the wealthiest man in the city. He dotes on her beyond measure, showering her with love and attention. Could she be the one he truly cherishes?

Out of revenge for her fiancé's betrayal with her best friend, she gets close to her fiancé's uncle, only to unexpectedly become involved with him. Not only does he offer his help when she faces difficulties, but he also supports her in secret. As their relationship deepens, they face a series of misunderstandings and challenges. Will they be able to recognize their true feelings for each other?

During the Wanli era, a deputy minister of the Ministry of Revenue is framed and killed, then transmigrates to the modern world. He learns to navigate contemporary society, falls in love with a woman, and strives to save his past self.

He travels back in time and is mistaken for a Special Prince. Despite facing accusations and ridicule, he earns respect with modern technology and helps the nation during crises, winning the Empress's favor. However, he is accused of treason and must defend against the enemy navy.

Billionaire Luke Knight was mistaken for ground staff while boarding a plane of his own airlines. While on board, he helped head stewardess Melanie Lewis when she was harassed. After landing, Luke agreed to help Melanie by playing her boyfriend, but this led to a misunderstanding by his son Henry. Luke and Melanie worked together to resolve his family trouble and company crisis, but he had to pass a final test to have Melanie's hand in marriage.

A delivery guy, Gale Lewis, unexpectedly saves the mafia queen, Kira Logan, who falls head over heels for him and begins her relentless pursuit. Gale, however, finds himself trapped by the schemes of his fiancée, Victoria Scott. On their wedding day, Kira makes a dramatic entrance, turning the ceremony upside down. Yet fate deals Gale a cruel hand as he loses his memory, but Kira's unwavering devotion never falters. Together, they navigate a labyrinth of treachery, with Tyler Shaw and others weaving deceitful plots. As Gale's memories slowly return, he discovers that there's more to his true identity...

book_title: Goodbye Ex, I Return To Being The Heiress
special_desc:
Goodbye Ex, I Return To Being The Heiress movie shows us how Alice gets framed for cheating by her sister Maura. Alice's husband Alaric sides with Maura by doubting and harassing her, which leads to Alice losing her unborn child.
Alice vows to seek her revenge for the loss of her child while Alaric holds the paternity test to prove that the child was not his.

book_title: Marry My Fake Brother After Rebirth
special_desc: She's the adopted daughter of a billionaire family, yet she bears her brother's child. She always thought he just wanted to possess her, but after their adoptive mother's murder, she realizes her brother truly loves her. Upon rebirth, she decides to be with her brother and not repeat past mistakes.

book_title: Kicked Out Then I Inherited Billions!
special_desc:
Kicked Out Then I Inherited Billions! Movie summary shows how Mu Wan wan gets kicked out by her foster mother after finding her biological sister Mu Lanlan.
Mu Wan wan goes from being homeless to a rich heiress as her lost billionaire father finds her.
Mu Wan wan also finds love with Ye Mohan who offers her a home and a job when being homeless.

book_title: Spoiled By The CEO After Rebirth
special_desc: In her past life, she was framed and lost everything by her husband and cousin. It's only on her deathbed that she realizes the billionaire she was once engaged to truly loves her. Reborn two years earlier, she wakes up and sets her sights on marrying the billionaire. This time, she won't allow tragedy to strike again. And this billionaire? He's not a playboy at all. His heart belongs only to her.

book_title: Marrying a Billionaire After Ex's Runaway
special_desc: On her wedding day, her fiancé runs away, and her parents don't show up either. Feeling down, she gets hit by a billionaire's car. Surprisingly, the Billionaire turns out to be a hot guy, and guess what? He wants to marry her!

book_title: My Lord, The Concubine Has Remarried
special_desc: She always knew her husband loved her sister. He married her to provide blood for her. But she never expected he would distrust her. When she lost her child, he learned the truth and regretted it. But it was too late.

book_title: Sleep With A CEO After Fiancé's Betrayal
special_desc: On my wedding day, my fiancé told me my sister was pregnant with his child. For the sake of family honor, I had to break off the engagement. That night, I had a one-night stand with a stranger. I thought he was just a cowboy, but little did I know, he was a possessive billionaire.

book_title: Escape After Pregnant with My Vegetative Husband
special_desc: She got married while pregnant. But on the wedding day, her sister played a video of her being intimate with another man, claiming her unborn child was illegitimate. Just as everyone scorned her, the child's father appeared - he turned out to be a billionaire! Rumor had it that the billionaire was a vegetable, but how can he be so handsome?

book_title: Kneel For My Foolish Wife's Return
special_desc: She is the heiress of a wealthy family, but an accident causes her to lose her memory, turning her into the foolish wife of a tycoon. However, he deceives her into divorcing him after she becomes pregnant. Abandoned, she regains her lost memories. Returning to her status as the heiress, she believes she can lead a peaceful life with her child. Yet, unexpectedly, a business alliance brings her back into contact with him.

After getting married, her husband becomes cold and even cheats on her. Feeling disheartened, she decides to divorce him. But after the divorce, her ex-husband's uncle-in-law aggressively pursues her. Surprisingly, her ex-husband also tries to win her back...

CEO, Your Wife Is Gone summary is about Elise, who's suffering from cancer. Despite her health declining, she wants to be a perfect wife to her husband George.
Trinity, Elise's sister, frames her for George's father's death, thus leaving George hating his wife.
Elise goes through her husband's brutality as she tries to find ways to prove her truth.

book_title: In My Ex's Arms Again After Divorce
special_desc: She loves him in secret for seven years and marries him at last. But he acts coldly towards her, so she decides to divorce him. Later, he regrets it. It's surprising how possessive a billionaire can be!

book_title: My Flash Marriage Husband Is A CEO
special_desc: After discovering my cousin was pregnant with my husband's child, I divorced him. On the night of the divorce, I found a cowboy. Little did I know, this cowboy was actually a billionaire, and he insisted on marrying me!

Flash-Married and Utterly Spoiled movie takes us on an epic journey of Alice who finds out her fiancé Sam is cheating on her with her sister on the day of their engagement.
When she's pushed into the water, her fiancé chooses to save her sister, leaving Alice to die alone. But CEO Leo Klein saves Alice, thus embarking on a loving relationship.
She was deceived by a villain, left broke, and saw her son die. After rebirth, she's back for revenge with her billionaire CEO hubby, raising her son and living happily ever after.
She loves him dearly, yet he betrays her by plundering her home and bringing his lover. When he learns she is dying, he begs for another chance, but it's too late.

book_title: Assigned A Billionaire Husband By The Nation
special_desc: After being dumped by her four-year boyfriend, she was kicked out of her home. According to policy, the state assigned her a spouse, who turned out to be a billionaire. From then on, her life reached its peak, becoming the cherished one at the top of the rich list.
When his wife was insulted, he stopped being just a stay-at-home husband. He was actually the young master of a prestigious family! Watch how he deals with anyone who tries to take his wife away!

book_title: My Flash Marriage Wife Is A Business Genius
special_desc: After catching her boyfriend cheating with her sister, she broke up with him ruthlessly. Then, she married the CEO of a major business empire. But that's not all, she's also a business whiz. She started her own company, making big stars. The CEO is always worried about her leaving him!

book_title: My Foolish Husband Is A Billionaire
special_desc: He was originally a billionaire, but an accident caused him to lose his memory and disfigurement. Saved by someone, he decided to marry the granddaughter of the person who saved him, in gratitude. However, when she woke up, she despised him immensely, even filing for divorce. Finally, he regained his memory and reclaimed his status as a billionaire. Five years later, she came to see him with their child.

book_title: Oops, I Become The Heiress To A Billionaire
special_desc: She was a bricklayer at a construction site until her wealthy grandmother found her, restoring her status as a wealthy young lady. Surprisingly, her grandmother had selected three handsome and wealthy men for her to choose as her future husband.

She was once an ancient princess, but sacrificed herself for her kingdom during an enemy attack. Upon awakening, she finds herself in modern times, now a wealthy heiress bullied by her fiancé and his other love interest. Unwilling to be pushed around, she fights back against her tormentors and catches the eye of a billionaire seeking her hand in marriage.

book_title: The One-Night Stand Daddy Is A CEO
special_desc: On my birthday, I received a birthday gift, a cowboy. And this cowboy is a daddy type. Originally thought it was just a one-night stand, I didn't expect the other party to be a billionaire. And this billionaire seems to have fallen in love with me, he insists on marrying me!
She was accused of murder, and her husband believed it. He blinded her and tortured her. But when the truth came out, he regretted it...

book_title: Back To The CEO With A New Face
special_desc: After being betrayed in her marriage, she decides to seek revenge. Returning with a new face after undergoing plastic surgery, she is no longer the submissive wife she once was. This time, she will make everyone pay for underestimating her.

book_title: Reborn At The Pinnacle Of Showbiz
special_desc: She was a top artist in the showbiz, but for her fiancé, she chose to be a housewife. Little did she know, her fiancé and his mistress killed her. But she is reborn now. This time, she focuses on her career and seeks revenge on her ex-fiancé and his mistress...

She intended to kill her CEO husband on their wedding day, but unexpectedly discovered she had the power to read minds. Listening to his thoughts, she realized her despised husband was actually her puppy love.

She loves him for five years, believing her obedience could warm his cold heart. But when his fiancée returns, he dismisses her, unaware of her terminal illness. After she resigns herself to leave, he suddenly goes crazy, chasing after her desperately...

book_title: The Thirty-Three Escapes of the Darling Wife
special_desc: She once saved him, thinking they would be together forever. But he mistakenly believed another woman was his savior. After experiencing a breakup and being separated from their child, he finally realizes he loved the wrong person.

After being framed and losing her baby, her husband and mother-in-law were still harsh to her. Feeling disheartened, the woman reluctantly agreed to divorce. Adding to her misery, she was kicked out of the hospital because she couldn't afford the fees. Helpless and eventually passing out on the streets, she discovered that she was actually a rich heiress!

Owing her life to the heart donated by her sister, the girl is determined not to waste it. With the support of a billionaire CEO, she seeks vengeance against those who wronged both her and her sister...

A young woman saved a billionaire's grandfather, and they ended up getting married as arranged by the old man. However, when her bestie discovered the woman was a missing heiress, she plotted to steal her identity...
For the sake of her family's interests, a young girl must impersonate her twin brother, only to accidentally enter the wrong room and inadvertently spend a passionate night with a billionaire CEO...

A powerful evil spirit appears, threatening the world. To restore peace, a young man is tasked with collecting five symbols. Along the way, he encounters funny and romantic incidents with various women, including his destined partner...

book_title: I Refuse to Be a Love-Struck Protagonist
special_desc: Upon waking up, she finds herself reincarnated as the most lovesick woman of ancient China. Deserted by her husband, the woman never complains. But that's not her style! When she saves the crown prince, he instantly falls for her...

book_title: Married by Mistake: CEO's Sweetheart Bride
special_desc: The young woman tried to help an injured man but ended up sleeping with him. She left in embarrassment, but then was forced to marry into a rich family, where she found out that her new husband was...
Returning once more, she's no longer the emperor's prime minister. Now, she's his concubine, trying to overthrow the nation!

book_title: Marry Me When the Snow Melts
special_desc: For three years, everyone around them claimed they were the perfect match. It was said so often that even she began to believe it. However, it was later on that she came to realize they never belonged to the same world after all.

book_title: I'm Marrying Someone Else, Mr. CEO
special_desc: She spent her whole life chasing after the man she loved, but in the end, he hurt her the most! Still, she never regretted loving him, not even in her final moments.
A young mom faces mistreatment from her in-laws. After divorcing, she discovers she's the long-lost daughter of a big boss. However, someone else is trying to impersonate her as the heiress.

book_title: Divorce Me, In the Name of Mercy
special_desc: The billionaire married the daughter of his father's killer not out of love, but to torment her. Even when she fell terminally ill, he showed no mercy...

She's the mightiest ruler in the Dragon Kingdom, but a year ago, she lost her memory. Hoping to remember and wed properly, she caught her husband with another woman just before their wedding. Furious, she pulled a random young man to pose as her boyfriend and revealed her true identity, shocking everyone!

book_title: Reincarnated As The General's Chubby Bride
special_desc:
Reincarnated As The General's Chubby Bride movie summary shows how Lily who after finding out her boyfriend was cheating on her, travels back in time to find herself being an overweight woman married to a general suffering from health issues.
When the concubine frames Lily for cheating, she decides to use her skill from the future to save herself and prove her truth.

She was a general who was framed and ended up with her entire family being executed. Reborn, she meticulously plans her revenge while also protecting a "silly" prince who had supported her at every turn in her previous life. Drawn in by his sincere devotion, she resolves to spend her life with him, only to unexpectedly discover that he was playing dumb the entire time...

She had been with him for 5 years as his secret lover. Thinking that being obedient would eventually make him love her back, she didn't expect to be abandoned. She left his world, without even asking him for a single penny. But when she was about to marry someone else, he pinned her against the wall and kissed her...

On the day my billionaire lover mistakenly believed I had committed murder, he personally sent me to prison. Since then, I've endured unimaginable torment. If I could, I wish I'd never met him! Yet, on my very first day back, I encounter him again. But this time, I won't forgive him!

She went into hiding to support her children with part-time jobs. After five years, the CEO found her, but there was another woman meddling between them. Could they patch up their relationship under such love-hate entanglements?
She woke up from a hangover next to her fiancé's uncle. What she didn't know was that he had secretly been in love with her for ten years...

After her mother's recent passing, she was forced into marriage but unexpectedly had a one-night stand with him. Seven years later, a young boy rushes up to him, shouting "Daddy!" He is confused, about to push the child away, when the boy's mother steps forward. He recognizes her as the woman from seven years ago...

To help pay for her grandmother's medical bills, she took on extra freelance jobs and accidentally disrupted a matchmaking event. There, she met him, who, to avoid being controlled in his marriage, chose to flash-marry her. There begins their contract marriage...

book_title: Mr. CEO Is Her Substitute Lover
special_desc: After an accident, her lover unfortunately passed away in a car crash, and she donated his heart as he wished. She changed her name and appeared by the side of the man who the heart had been donated to, willingly becoming a substitute for the person he loved.

As he was dying of a serious illness, he discovered that his child was not his own, and even his insurance and inheritance had been swindled by his wife. He died with regrets, but when he opened his eyes again, he had been reborn in 2000.

Due to a misunderstanding, he believed that her sister's death was related to her, and forced her to have an abortion. In despair, she chose to commit suicide. Three years later, she returned with a new identity, and he wanted to win her back.

After being framed by my husband's first love, I was driven out of my home! 
As an orphan, I had diligently managed household chores after marrying my husband, only to suffer a miscarriage at the hands of his first love, who then falsely accused me of orchestrating it. Feeling disheartened, my father and brother finally acknowledged me. It was then that I learned I was the heiress to a wealthy family!
Reclaiming my identity, I leveraged the power of my influential family to embark on a revenge plan, confronting everyone who had bullied me in the past!

I’m accidentally pregnant with the CEO’s child!
I have always been ignored and bullied at my own home. In desperation, I will hold on to this chance to change my life! I entered a contract marriage with the CEO and decided to leave him after giving birth to the child. 
But dangers are always lurking. I was kidnapped, and to my surprise, the CEO who acted careless of me showed up in person to save me! Why?

Five years ago, we fell in love, but his mother forced me to leave him. Shortly after we broke up, I discovered I was pregnant! 
Initially, I had decided to raise the child on my own, but the child was diagnosed with leukemia and urgently needed a bone marrow donation. Helpless, I sought him out, hoping he could save our child. However, his fiancée continuously interfered, creating numerous obstacles. Will my child survive, and can we get back together?
Framed 6 years ago, she was deeply hurt. Luckily, her genius babies helped her with her career. They will let him know, that it's too late to regret what he had done.

At the lowest point in your life, you suddenly discover that you are the heir to a wealthy family! 
You were once a poor migrant worker who accidentally offended your boss and suffered betrayal from your wife. Feeling utterly hopeless, you learn that you have inherited billions from a wealthy family!
With this newfound wealth, you confront your fiancée and those who once mistreated you! At the same time, you reunite with the woman who, at your lowest moment, extended a helping hand and whom you now realize is the one worth guarding for life.

Facing my troublesome family members again and again, I can't take it anymore!  Many years ago, I had a one-night stand with a woman who disappeared after giving birth to our child. I hide my identity as the Dragon Master, making a living as a taxi driver and raising my daughter alone, yet people look down on me.
Now, I've reunited with a woman who seems to be that one-night stand of mine. This time, I will reveal my true identity and reclaim everything that belongs to me!

book_title: Ex Regrets After I Struck It Rich
special_desc: As an intern doctor, when he went out to save someone, unexpectedly saw his fiancée and a CEO's son having an affair in public. After being kicked out of the hotel, he met his biological father. In order to take revenge, he chose to inherit the family and severely made his fiancée regret.

At three years old, he was framed in prison. Three years ago, before his master passed away, he passed him all his medical knowledge. Now, out of prison, he’s fighting against numerous villains to restore his family’s honor. On the way, the handsome and wise man meets many beautiful women and sparks a romantic flame with them.

Born a freak of nature, she accidentally caused her mother’s death and was rejected by her grandmother. Raised by a virtuous onmyoji master, her innate powers to exorcise evil attract dark forces. After enduring numerous supernatural trials, she becomes the final onmyoji master...

book_title: The Supreme Warden Rescues His Young Bride
special_desc:
In the chaotic northern region, a young man, once exiled after a family dispute, rose to power in the Sixth Prison, becoming the "King of the North." Poisoned and nearing death, his master arranged several special women as fiancées to cure him, but he hesitated to involve them.
One fiancée insisted on marrying him, but during the wedding, family secrets surfaced, leading to his collapse from the poison. His wife and the other women united to save him, becoming the key to his cure. Together, they restored peace to the northern region.

After a car accident, she found herself transmigrated into the body of the discarded empress in the Cold Palace. To gather money for an escape, she started selling storybooks. By chance, she met the emperor in disguise. Her boldness and lively spirit left a deep impression on him. Later, the emperor discovered she was the empress relegated to the Cold Palace. Will her desire for freedom and wealth be swayed by the emperor's deep affection?

book_title: When a Billionaire Can’t Let Go
special_desc: Three years ago, Gu Keyan’s former boss forced her into a contract that handed her over to billionaire CEO Gu Yuxiang. After spending one night together, Gu Keyan wanted to leave. However, her mother’s expensive medical bills forced her to use that night as leverage, making Gu Yuxiang keep her. The unfair contract made Gu Keyan give up everything, and she felt inferior because she was just a substitute for Gu Yuxiang’s true love, Su Xiaoya.Three years later, Su Xiaoya returns to the country, and Gu Keyan is heartbroken to step aside. But Gu Yuxiang threatens her with the contract, preventing her from leaving. Gu Keyan doesn’t want to watch Gu Yuxiang and Su Xiaoya show their love, and she is deeply troubled. Unexpected and complicated schemes lie ahead. Caught between love and deceit, what will she choose?

After being betrayed by her ex-husband, she decides to celebrate her newfound single life with a night of drinking at a bar. There, she unexpectedly encounters him, and their chemistry leads to a passionate encounter. Believing he is just a wealthy heir, she has no idea that he is actually her ex-husband's uncle—and the most mysterious tycoon in the city. As secrets unravel, will their connection survive the truth?

book_title: Fake It Till We Make It
special_desc: A once-privileged heiress, now facing financial struggles, steps in for a friend at a blind date with a wealthy second-generation tycoon to cover her mother's mounting medical bills. Aiming to sabotage the date with her unappealing antics, she is stunned when her plans backfire, leading to an unexpected marriage!

Three years ago, Oren Flores walked away from his career and family business to marry Nadine Kline. For her, he dimmed his brilliance and buried his ambition, content to live in her shadow as the picture-perfect husband. But his devotion was repaid with nothing but scorn and humiliation. When Nadine betrayed him and tossed divorce papers in his face, Oren finally realized it was impossible to thaw her heart. Reclaiming his former life as a top-tier lawyer and heir to a powerful business, Oren swore to make her pay!

Margaret Shawn saved Wesley Stark many years ago. But Wesley didn't know about it. After they got married, Cathy Getty showed up. She framed Margaret again and again. She even lied to Wesley she saved him before. Then Wesley started ignoring Margaret. Wesley didn't know the truth until they got divorced. But it was too late...

book_title: The Secret Life of My Husband
special_desc: Zoe Yale, a reporter, crosses paths with Finn Gold, a CEO who is working as a server at a wedding for some reason. She falls in love with him at first sight. Keeping his true identity a secret, Finn uses his status and power to help her through difficult times, and together, they find lasting happiness amidst a series of eventful twists and turns.

Recently returned to his homeland, James Moore inherits a massive fortune from his late father. Under pressure from greedy relatives and his stepmother Victoria, James devises a cunning plan: he pretends to be in a vegetative state to thwart those eyeing his inheritance. Meanwhile, Victoria, during a chance encounter at a restaurant, meets the sharp and resourceful Rachel Lee. Impressed by Rachel's skills, Victoria hires her as a spy to uncover whether James is truly incapacitated...

book_title: Oops! My Takeout Guy is a Tycoon
special_desc: Vivian, a takeout girl, flees forced marriage by wedding Charlie—a billionaire disguised as a deliveryman. At his empire, her stepsister Yvette frames her with a 6-year-old "illegitimate son" scandal. Charlie discovers Vivian was drugged years ago and is his child's mother. Battling forged paternity tests and deadly plots, they expose family crimes. After Charlie nearly dies saving their son, amnesia strikes—but love reignites as the family survives each crisis.

Clarissa and Pierce used to be this perfect couple, but when passion faded, life drove them apart. After their divorce, they took different paths. Will fate pull them together again? What choices will they make?

book_title: Where Is My Dear Mrs. Ford?
special_desc: Sadie's new boss, Spencer, strikes her as her mysterious husband, Ewan, who vanished right after they registered their marriage a year ago. Could the two actually be the same man? How would she handle it when the truth comes out?

Jovan Wiley spent three years in jail for the girl he loved, only to be betrayed the moment he walked free. On the brink of death, he heard his late grandfather's voice whisper that his trial had ended. When he awoke, his wounds were gone—and he had been thrust into a hidden world of cultivators!
Mystical arts, ancient martial techniques, talismanic magic, and unrivaled medical mastery all bent to his will. What began as heartbreak became the forge of his vengeance, and the world would soon witness his rise to unstoppable power.

Elian Wright was a down-on-his-luck salesman, crushed by debt and forced to swallow his pride just to survive. Yet even in hardship, he remained kind. One night, he saved Elvia Malone from a predatory playboy—never realizing she was his CEO. Beaten for his bravery, Elian awakened with the power of the Golden Eyes—a gift that let him see through everything. With this newfound ability, he aided Elvia, struck fortune in stone gambling, and began rewriting his destiny from the ashes of defeat.

book_title: The Cute Baby's Dad Is A CEO
special_desc: The night she was brought back to her wealthy family as an heiress, she was set up and had a one-night stand with a stranger. What's more surprising, she got pregnant. Her father considered her a disgrace to the family and kicked her out. Five years later, she unexpectedly reunites with the man from that night, only to discover he's a billionaire.
During the three years of her marriage to him, she was tortured by misunderstandings. After she decided to leave him, he suddenly realized his mistake and tried to win her back.

After being betrayed by a scumbag, she had a one-night stand with him while drunk and ended up pregnant. Kicked out of her home, she raised the quintuplets on her own. Years later, she returned with her children, and coincidentally met their biological father.

My boyfriend cheated on me with his good brother, so I seduced their friend—a CEO. Now, in the face of my ex's betrayal and obsession, the male mistress's jealousy and murder attempt, and the CEO's fiancée's schemes, what should I do next?

The war god male lead is called back to the northern camp but is betrayed by his men. After killing the traitors, he vows to protect the female lead while hunting down the rest. He discovers the national advisor is the mastermind, who then chases them to the capital, leading to an epic showdown.

Isabel Gould's parents died when she was a kid, so she had to live with her brother and sister-in-law. But her brother was a gambler and her sister-in-law always mistreated her. Adam Shelby, also titled Duke Shelby, was a strong general. People admired him and called him War God. He and Isabel had a one-night stand, and then Isabel got pregnant before marriage. This was a shameful thing in her empire. Her sister-in-law meant to sell her to an old man to get money. Adam saved her in time...

On the day of Hazel Lynn's engagement, her mother, Madison Lynn, attended the party as a cleaner and was mistreated by the Carter family. A BMW woman stole her parking spot, the future mother-in-law laid down the rules, and the fiancé demanded a huge betrothal gift. Madison then revealed her true identity, with Wyatt Lowe, Miguel Patel, and Anthony Blake arriving with a dowry of billions. Subsequently, Madison demonstrated her strength on multiple occasions, resolving the crisis of the Pangea Group. Ultimately, due to threats from foreign capital, she took Hazel abroad.

Shunned by high society as an illiterate, illegitimate daughter, Wren Chase is the outcast everyone loves to hate. But when they write her off, she begins to write her own rules. Refusing to be defined by those labels, she leans on sharp instincts and determination, turning skeptics into believers. Step by step, she rebuilds her name, reclaims her dignity, and discovers her true worth.

Philip, the last surviving heir of the Yate family, descends the mountain to heal the sick and save lives after mastering the healing arts. Along the way, he crosses paths with Kaia, a meeting that sparks a deep and fateful connection. And this changes both their lives forever.

book_title: The CEO Goes Mad After Her Resignation
special_desc: A one-night stand made her the CEO's contract lover. She loves him, but he's unaware. Just when she decides to end it all, the CEO regrets it.

book_title: The Shadow Lord's Return to Glory
special_desc: A betrayed young man, once crippled and left for dead, rises to power and returns to repay the girl who saved him. Mistaken for a criminal by her family, he soon discovers it was her cousin who saved him all along and proposes to her instead.

book_title: Runaway Bride Met My CEO Ex!
special_desc: Fleeing her wedding, amnesiac Sophia collides with ex Ethan. A DNA test exposes their secret daughter, triggering vicious schemes from her adoptive father, a deranged ex-fiancé, and Ethan’s aristocrat mother. As memories reveal her true identity as Mitchell heiress and Ethan’s past sacrifices, they combat corporate enemies through kidnappings and car chases. Defying elitism, Ethan vows to marry into her family, reigniting their love in a storm of vengeance and shocking DNA twists.

book_title: Cry Your Eyes Out by My Tomb
special_desc: The billionaire seeks wild revenge on his beloved who left him years ago, unaware she secretly bore his child. Now, as her life slips away, his heart aches with regret...

Just because he overtook someone once, he was bullied, and sadly lost his wife. Fighting for his life and dignity, he refused to take money and settle. On his quest to get justice for his wife and himself, he unexpectedly discovered the secret of his true identity and gained the power to turn back time, to undo everything...

book_title: Back to Modern Times as the Richest
special_desc: His mother fell from a building, his fiancée betrayed me, and in my despair, the world suddenly experienced hyperinflation, with prices skyrocketing by a millionfold. Yet, his wealth remained unaffected, making him the world's richest man.

After enduring a seven-year relationship, the couple ultimately breaks up due to various misunderstandings and betrayals. Subsequently, one partner completely loses the other to an idealized love, leading to a profound realization. Determined to make amends, he attempts to win her back through various means.

To save her sister's life, she sold her virginity at a high price, giving herself to a stranger. A year later, at a gathering with her suitor's friends, she encountered the stranger again. He recognized her and pinned her against the wall. She fled in panic, but when she returned to the private room, she was dragged to him and told that the only medicine that could save her sister was in his possession. She stooped to beg for the medicine, but he made things difficult for her, determined to drag her back to the madness of that night.
A modern actor unexpectedly time-travels to ancient times, becoming a princess entwined with a general. Despite misunderstandings and other obstacles, their mutual love triumphs...

The Hidden Big Shot movie summary is all about drama and action as we see War master Colton working as a waiter at a club. He's supported by the royal guards, while he keeps his identity a secret.
When a Damsel gets bullied by goons, Colton breaks his identity as he saves her, thus leading to question his true identity.

She is the true heiress as well as an adopted daughter in two families. But her biological parents favor the adopted daughter, her foster mother constantly challenges her, and even her own little brother sees her as an enemy. Bound by a marriage contract, she weds the business mogul Jamie. Luckily, there's one man who stands as her protector, shielding her from the storm.

He concealed his status as the Nation’s most influential figure while uplifting his wife’s family to nobility. Yet, she belittled him for his lack of wealth and chose to divorce him. By the time she uncovered his true identity, it was far too late to make amends.

Rosalind Lawson died betrayed by her husband, William Sloan. Reborn as the true heir of Prince Jason, she returns with a healer’s hands and a vengeful heart. Now, with Commander Damian Shaw at her side, she will reclaim her title, her fortune, and her future—no matter the cost.

This series follows the journey of a man betrayed by his lover and left at the lowest point in his life. Despite these challenges, he never gives up, persevering with hope. He rises from the ashes, protecting his family, finding true love, and ultimately reclaiming his former glory and success.

He was nothing but a discarded husband left in the gutter. She was a destined heiress who saw his true power. Now, with one year to prove himself worthy, Julian Quinn must rise from the ashes to conquer the underworld, defeat his rivals, and win back the woman who believed in him.
After she moves from the big city to the family farm with her mom, Amanda stumbles upon a hidden village of fairies in the forest that is being threatened by a land developer.

Sorceress Arden and her warrior girlfriend Katia are deeply in love. But the veil between Earth and the World of Magic keeps them apart. When the evil sorcerer Zareth arises from the dead, Arden and Katia are sent on a quest to defeat him.

Ivy League Freshman, Aaron Milton (17) gets a different kind of education when he falls for Linda (34) a vivacious former wild-child who has returned to college to straighten out her life. The curriculum gets more challenging when Aaron meets Linda's sarcastic 14 year-old daughter, Beth - who quickly develops a crush on him. The math doesn't work in either direction but the dysfunctional triangle becomes a learning experience for all involved.
Teen series Flunk explores contemporary coming-of-age issues, as a group of queer students navigate the intricacies of high school relationships.

Katie just wants to keep her career on track, but when she meets Brent, love finds its way into her heart despite her best efforts to keep it out. Over time, the couple fight to stay together until Brent chooses to leave for war.
Lauren wants to rebuild her community, including her family home, in the aftermath of a devastatingly disastrous storm and finds herself face-to-face with Collin.

To the cheerfully clueless Ethan, it seems like his overbearing mother and older brother are hell bent on sabotaging his entire life. The only person who seems to understand him is high school hottie Madison-not the real Madison, but the life sized cutout of her that's affixed to Ethan's closet door. When things at home become unbearable, Ethan heads out to California to spend the summer with his cousins. An already complicated situation spirals hopelessly out of control, however, when it becomes unmistakably apparent that Ethan's cousin Cleo wants to be more than just family.

A modern romantic psychological thriller in the tone of Fifty Shades of Grey and Secretary, Assistant is dark, seductive, outrageously thought-provoking, and riveting. Directorial debut of genre filmmaker Louisa Warren (Cannibal Cabin, Hard Copy).

After experiencing torturous abuse, a young woman named Verity commits vengeance upon her abuser before seeking safety and healing elsewhere. On the road, Verity meets Bec who shares a similar past. What will their future bring?

A young man and son of a wealthy family runs away with his thirty-ish high school art teacher for a weekend together. He discovers with horror that he has fallen into a trap as the teen must fight to save his life.

After being dumped by her boyfriend Ben - who is completely blind - Allyson forms an unlikely partnership with a cantankerous drama professor who agrees to teach Allyson how to act so that she can win back Ben by pretending to be another woman.
The dark side of online dating is real and this one takes it there. "Body of Night" is a balance of horror, humor, and social commentary that is extremely powerful.

Claire’s life as a nurse in a busy hospital is complicated by a supervisor who is intent on making her miserable with tedious and extra tasks. Claire’s only relief is the patients she treats, and even that is not always a picnic. On a rare night off, she attends a dance performance and gets trapped in an elevator with a charming man. There is an instant connection between them, but as they are “rescued” from the elevator, they are pulled away from each other before they can exchange names and numbers. The next day, Claire meets the man again when he is presented as the newest doctor at the hospital. But he doesn’t recognize her in her hospital scrubs and pushes away her attempts to reconnect. Claire is convinced that he isn’t interested. But as she works with him, she can’t ignore her feelings. Meanwhile, the doctor is torn between his developing feelings for Claire and the fond memory of the woman in the elevator. Despite the efforts of some to thwart her, Claire must find the strength to stand up for herself and go after what she wants and deserves: her own chance at happiness.

After two girls cruelly impersonate her online in a "reverse cyber bullying" plot, Ashley's reputation is ruined and she and her mother flee a growing threat to their lives. Starting over at a new school, romantic interests and the poignant lessons from an eccentric history teacher draw them out of seclusion until they realize confronting a hurtful past is essential to ensure a brighter future.

Izzy is ready to make a difference in the world as she starts her career in public relations. When Grant Beiste - the big-headed corporate celebrity in town - accidentally hits her father with a car, Izzy is thrown into a public scandal that forces her to work closely with Grant. As she fights to save both her father and Grant's public image, she falls in love and learns not to judge a book by its cover.

How do you get even with a womanizer? You make him a woman! The wheel of karma takes a hilarious spin when a magical curse transforms Sam, a misogynistic playboy, into a beautiful woman who must learn how to value females by being one herself. But when she starts feeling more romance than bromance for her best bud, she wonders if she'll ever master the feminine mystique...or remain firmly planted in the friendzone.

Fraternal twin sisters Emma and Lilly have an insatiable desire to play matchmaker, even though they've never fallen in love themselves. But soon they find that their matchmaking skills run in the family-their father is actually Cupid!
When Emma and Lilly fall in love with the same guy, all bets are off-until Emma and Lilly find that their parents' marriage is falling apart. Setting aside their differences, these two matchmakers have to pull together like never before to bring their parents back together.
A mural artist and an architectural engineer are instantly drawn to each other, but their budding romance comes to a halt when the past comes back to haunt them.

"Stay" is a 90-minute dark romantic psychological drama that explores the relationship of a woman and her captor over the course of several months. Seeing just how dark a love story can be and still be considered a love story.

book_title: Christmas with a Prince: Becoming Royal
special_desc: CHRISTMAS WITH A PRINCE: BECOMING ROYAL is an American Christmas romantic drama from director Justin G. Dyck (Anything for Jackson, A Very Country Christmas), starring Nick Hounslow (The Catch, Good Behavior) and Kaitlyn Leeb (Total Recall, Locked Up).

After a white lie in a bar spirals into his separate worlds colliding, Tom must learn to embrace what's really important before his deception ruins his love-life, his friendships, and his chances at a local darts competition.

Still hurting after their breakup, Tabby's stunned when she comes face to face with ex girlfriend Heidi at a friend's sleepover. Forced to spend the night together - can they put the past behind them? Or will they fall in love again?

Reborn with a chance at retribution, Sun vows revenge—but the threads of fate binding him to Liu Che refuse to sever. Amidst ruthless power struggles and shadowy conspiracies, they manipulate each other even as they burn with irresistible attraction. In a tempest of love and hatred, they rage against destiny’s grip, only to find themselves inexorably drawn back to the bond they cannot escape...
An incredibly bright, but socially awkward teenage girl decides to take her virginity into her own hands.
Afraid to tell her family she's been dumped, Hillary hires an actor to play her fiancé during a four-day Thanksgiving weekend at her parents' house.

A man feeling pressured to propose to his girlfriend has a chance encounter with a runaway bride; in an effort to escape the pressure from his girlfriend, he leaves to Greece where he meets the former bride-to-be.

Desperate to find a wife, Shawn goes on one awkward date after another until he meets Violet. He thinks she's his soul mate but his autism and trusting nature keep him from realizing she's actually a prostitute.
A recovering alcoholic returns to his hometown after a hiatus, and falls in love with a man who will turn his world upside down.

Muffin Top: A Love Story follows Suzanne, a SoCal Women’s Studies professor who, after a messy divorce, finds herself struggling with her own femininity and body image in a place where self-esteem and self-worth are compromised at every corner: Los Angeles.

In a twist on the classic Beauty and the Beast tale, Isabelle is all beauty - on the outside. A glamour-queen socialite, she spends her days spoiling herself and spending money like its going out of style. When Isabelle injures herself and gets lost in an isolated winter land, she stumbles on the solitude of Jeremy, a man hiding from both the world and his past. He's the first person to put Isabelle in her place, and Isabelle realizes she might be more beast than she wants to admit. Through Jeremy's influence she begins to change - and fall in love. But will she revert to the beast and give up her chance at real love when she returns home? Discover beauty that runs more than skin-deep in this heart-felt romance!

Trish Harper misses her blind date with Adam thanks to Daylight Savings Time, and instead mistakenly meets Parker, a thoughtful paramedic. However, when she discovers her error, she's eager to cast aside Parker and the sparks between them. As Parker tries to convince Trish to give him a chance, Trish keeps him at arms-length, focusing instead on her thriving bakery shop. But slowly she falls in love with him, until another misunderstanding drives them apart. It's only when Trish has lost Parker that she realizes how much he meant to her. Months later, another fateful time change might just give them a chance to make things right.

A private investigator unwittingly gets caught up in the dangerous web of a covert organization led by an enigmatic figure known as Phoenix. When the investigator becomes involved with a woman who is married to a man associated with the organization, they find themselves in a perilous situation...
Sue, Cheryl and Lexi are best friends. They do something special every year for their birthday as they were all born on the same day. Now their 18th birthday, they set out to lose their virginity.
A socially shunned columnist finds his romantic match online, but messaging under the wrong account causes his sleazy roommate's picture to be forwarded, creating an identity mix-up.

With a childhood filled with Love and abundance, Gigi Philips grows up to be ray of sunshine with nothing but love and sweetness. James and Laura Philips (Gigi's Parents) own and control the biggest shares of the cosmetic industry, ROSE beauty and cosmetics. Gigi is being groomed to take over the company as the only existing heiress of her parents...

This gripping mystery-thriller unravels the dark secrets hidden within the walls of Crestwood Academy, a prestigious but enigmatic institution. As four friends embark on a quest to find their missing classmate, they stumble upon a world of ancient rituals, sinister societies, and chilling revelations that will test the limits of their courage...

In the captivating narrative, we delve into the intricate tapestry of human emotions, where love and desire collide, and the choices we make reverberate through the lives of those we hold dear. Follow the compelling journey of Finch, a diligent middle-class man, whose unwavering dedication is directed towards crafting a life of contentment for his cherished wife, Mira, and their young son...

In the glamorous world of high fashion, Elara crosses paths with Damon at a fashion show. Fueled by a desire for revenge, Elara seizes an opportunity to make Damon pay for an undisclosed grievance. However, as she delves deeper into Damon's world, she discovers unexpected layers to his character, leading her to question her motives…

In the heart of a bustling city, we meet Emily, a dedicated and hardworking office assistant striving for a better life. When a passionate one-night stand with her charismatic boss, Richard, leads to an unexpected pregnancy, her world takes an unexpected turn...

Lea is the daughter of one of the world's most renowned mafia bosses. She lives a life of privilege and luxury, with her bossy attitude, but soon her father dies in a tragic plane crash. After accepting the demise of her father, Lea takes over the mafia business. She is companied by her new bodyguard, Ryan. Under Ryan's urge, Lea announces to call off her engagement with Michael. Lea's insult made Michael leave her house in a rage, promising her dreadful revenge...

book_title: In Love With My Godfather's Daughter
special_desc: After the death of his father and elder brothers in a ghastly motor accident, Luca Marcini becomes the new don of the Marcini crime family. At the young age of twenty-five, he is perceived as inexperienced and weak. However, Luca is determined to prove them wrong...

book_title: Sisters Have Crush On The Same Man
special_desc: Rosa and Emma are sisters, living their fantasy life in a castle their father had inherited, Rosa is engaged to Edward Douglas. As a result of an unfortunate accident, Rosa fell into a coma, but the marriage was not called off, and Rosa's name was replaced by Emma. Times goes on, the couple find themselves in difficult situations, and Rosa comes back to life after six months. When she opens her eyes, the growing tension urges Emma to confess the truth to Rosa...

Living under the control of a stepfather, Cleopatra has faced challenges in her quest for survival. Despite the circumstances she possesses a determination that cannot be crushed. Enduring one hardship after another， Cleopatra holds onto the glimmer of hope that some day she will break free from the shackles of her situation and carve out a better tomorrow...

Mia and James, both grappling with personal and professional challenges, find themselves entangled in a contract marriage, a unique arrangement that promises to solve their individual problems. As they navigate the complexities of pretending to be a loving couple, their relationship evolves in unexpected ways. Bonded by secrecy, they embark on a journey filled with laughter, misunderstandings, and growing attraction...

book_title: Never Mess With A Badass Girl
special_desc: Ava, who discovers that her boyfriend Ben and her best friend Sarah have betrayed her, decides to seek revenge, enlisting the help of her new partner, Max, and gradually revealing her meticulously crafted plan for retribution. They employ a series of clever and manipulative tactics to expose the depths of deception in their relationships. The plot takes unexpected twists and turns as Ava and Max, lead Ben and Sarah on a rollercoaster of emotions. Can revenge truly bring closure?...

Lyla's path to vengeance begins with her working as a waitress in a prestigious restaurant, a far cry from the life she once knew. With each passing day, Lyla's transformation is remarkable. She evolves from a broken-hearted waitress into a formidable and cunning businesswoman, fueled by a quest for revenge, works her way to the top. Does she get her desired revenge?...

Housewife Elise's life takes an exciting but dangerous turn when she begins an affair with Felix, who encourages her to experiment sexually. When Elise tries to end the affair, Felix blackmails her, in this tale of love, fantasy, and sexual obsession.
A heartwarming and delightful Christmas rom-com, fun for the whole family. Madeline Leon (Workin' Moms) gives a cozy, relatable lead performance, creating a lovely, entertaining cinematic experience.
Anna Nix is sent to a juvenile prison for the murder of her abusive stepfather. In the prison, she discovers relationships, drugs, complex mental illness, and her eventual search for redemption.

Lucy is excited to be chosen for a reality TV style game show, being streamed online, where contestants complete challenges sent in by the audience, to win big cash prizes. The fun soon turns sinister, as the viewer requests become more perverse.
Brian Cook has been a firefighter for over 15 years, but he is now facing the biggest battle of his life–not the fire in the field, but the fire burning inside.

In this modern adaptation of Jane Austen’s Sense and Sensibility, Elinor (Ashley Williams) and Marianne (Marla Sokoloff) find themselves penniless after their father’s fortune is taken away. As they look for ways to pay the bills, they encounter people who judge them and try to keep them down in the dumps. Add falling in love into the mix, and determining whom to trust becomes a mine field. Can the sisters find a balance between relying on their hearts and using good sense without losing everything they hold dear?

Layla is ten years old and about to meet her new family. She just doesn't know it yet. An act of kindness met with deception leads to Layla's abduction and descent into a life of human trafficking hidden in an ordinary neighborhood.
After falling victim to a scam, a Filipino filmmaker extends his stay in Los Angeles and forms an unexpected connection with his cute but serious Korean-American roommate.

Introverted Cameron, is desperately in love with his high school crush Diane. But his romantic pursuit is halted when Victoria, a female vampire moves in next door. Cameron soon discovers he's in the middle of a life-and-death adventure.

Andy Miller has asked a large number of women he didn't know to marry him. They said no. But Emma, a beautiful veterinary student agrees to go on some dates to see if they'll fall in love. Emma thinks this is all a joke set up by her roommate Mandy, but it's all a reality TV show created by Andy and Emma's the oblivious star.

Invited to a secret streaming broadcast, Jae-in begins the "Falling Quiz Show," where she can win 1 billion won by answering only the truth. However, the host unexpectedly starts asking about the death of her younger brother Jae-ha, who recently died in an accident, leaving Jae-in flustered under suspicion that she may be connected to his death. Following the rules, the floor gradually opens while ropes tighten around Jae-in’s neck… Jae-in claims that Jang Doo-yeol, who had bullied Jae-ha since childhood, is the culprit.

Jang Doo-yeol, kidnapped and brought to participate in the quiz show after being named by Jae-in, points to the owner of the chicken shop where Jae-ha worked as the real culprit, while the owner in turn accuses Jae-in. Amid endless mutual accusations and revelations, a “Chicken Game” among the three protagonists—rushing toward a catastrophe that could have been avoided—truly begins.

book_title: My Guy Friend is a Chaebol
special_desc: A woman discovers her boyfriend's affair and is forced to take on his enormous debt. She turns to her old friend for help, who unexpectedly reveals himself as the heir to a major conglomerate. As they work together, a secret romance unfolds between them.

Mia died on her third wedding anniversary—abandoned and ignored by her cheating husband until her last breath. But fate gives her a second chance.  
Reborn into the past, she serves her husband divorce papers the moment she wakes up. This time, the queen is playing for keeps.

book_title: Bridezilla, Never Provoke The Billionaire Mother
special_desc: On the male lead’s wedding day, his mother (the female lead), who’s been abroad, comes to attend the ceremony—but the bride-to-be (the female villain) mistakenly accuses the male lead of cheating. The villain, along with her family and bridesmaids, bullies the female lead. When the male lead arrives, the truth comes out: the villains realize she’s his mother. To get her son to call off the wedding, the female lead reveals the villain’s true, malicious motives for marrying him. With the female lead holding power that could bankrupt them with a single call, the villain is betrayed by her family and friends one after another. Finally, her own infidelity is exposed publicly. The male lead sees through her, cancels the wedding, and the villain ends up being brought to justice and losing everything.

Claire Evens, an aspiring actress, is in a secret relationship with producer, Mitch Sterling. All is well until the day Claire finds out that she is pregnant. Her lover turns aggressive and pressures her to abort the child. Heartbroken Claire is forced out of his life till she finds a friend in a struggling screenplay writer, Alex.
Claire makes the mistake of threatening to inform the press about the pregnancy. Mitch changes his tone and Claire believes that they have reconciled. Claire goes out with Mitch despite Alex’s disapproval. Mitch betrays Claire and tries to dispose of her and their unborn child in the most gruesome way possible. Alex witnesses the incident and passes out just before they are rescued.
Twenty years later, Alex is a highly successful screenplay writer. Clara, Claire’s orphan daughter, has become a renowned actress. Both are highly sought after by everyone in the industry. They are determined to make Mitch pay for what he did…

book_title: After the Divorce, the Heiress Takes It All
special_desc: After divorcing her indecisive husband, the mysterious writer Dorothy chose to prove herself through her talent — she created her most important work, silenced her jealous sister-in-law, and finally found her true love.

I gave up everything for my husband, only to learn that he had been lying to me from the very start.
His mistress tried to explain, but I didn’t want to hear it. I turned away—only for both of us to fall into the water.
When I woke up… I was her.
And then I discovered the truth. The real person my husband had been having an affair with wasn’t her—it was someone else.

book_title: The Double Life of Mr President
special_desc: Claire, a small-town girl working at a fried chicken shop, accidentally stumbles into the hotel suite of U.S. President William. After helping him relieve an aphrodisiac’s effects with her body, she then aids the gunshot-wounded president in evading his pursuers. Grateful, William proposes a contractual marriage—but Claire mistakenly believes he’s just a presidential body double. The truth only comes crashing down when she’s kidnapped by the mafia and William storms in with a Special Forces team.

book_title: Champion, She is Not the One
special_desc: Anya, an intern journalist, unexpectedly met Michael, the most popular star athlete, while filling in for her good friend Nancy. After that night, Anya was worried about the potential consequences and decided to keep it a secret. However, Michael mistook Nancy for Anya, which led to a series of misunderstandings and challenges...

In Bad Sister movie, a student at a Catholic school has suspicions when one of the nuns begins acting creepily towards her brother. But she can't tell anyone, because who would believe that a woman of God would do such a thing?

In "Mysterious Murderer" follow the gripping tale of a brilliant young woman on the brink of medical school, poised for a seemingly idyllic life. However, her world shatters when a distress call from her father draws her back home, only to discover her parents brutally murdered under enigmatic circumstances. Driven by a relentless pursuit of justice, she becomes entangled in a web of town secrets that unravel a haunting mystery. As she delves deeper, she discovers that the elusive clues are not only closer than she could have imagined but also pose a dire threat to her own existence. Prepare for a suspenseful journey as she navigates through shadows, uncovering the unsettling truth that transforms her quest for justice into a battle for survival.

book_title: Pregnant By The Luxury Empire Heir
special_desc: Sofia, a sales associate at a luxury boutique, and Bryan, the domineering CEO of a luxury conglomerate, unexpectedly have a one-night stand that results in her pregnancy. At work, Sofia faces bullying and sabotage from jealous colleagues, while at home, she is exploited by her mother and younger siblings for money. Throughout her struggles, Bryan steps in to confront her toxic coworkers and family, gradually becoming captivated by her resilience. Eventually, he proposes to her formally, and the two embark on a happy life together.

To save her mother, Rose enters a binding master-servant contract with noble heir Harry—unaware she's the idealized first love he's secretly yearned for years. Tangled in a whirlwind of mutual obsession and jealous torment, they navigate a labyrinth of misunderstandings before confessing their passion, only to be torn apart by their clashing worlds. In a climactic twist, Harry storms Rose's wedding ceremony as she's poised to marry another. Defying societal chains, Rose embraces her true desires, culminating in a kiss that rewrites their destiny.
A high school senior becomes the victim of an elaborate frame-up after learning that her boyfriend is sleeping with their teacher.

In a tale of transformation and revenge, bullied high schooler Alexandra reinvents herself as "Lexi" with the help of childhood friend Dan, returning to expose her tormentors, reclaim her dignity, and find true love.

Successful actor Hee-su, notorious for his poor fashion sense, teams up with veteran fashion coordinator Hyo-jin for the drama Paintings and Coffee. Though they initially clash, they gradually grow closer and build a strong bond. However, hidden schemes and obstacles put their relationship to the test. What will their fate be?

book_title: Loving You For The Price Of Betrayal
special_desc:
On her 7th anniversary with her boyfriend, aspiring filmmaker Sia plans a surprise celebration, only to catch him cheating. 
Reflecting on her past, she sees a pattern of love and betrayal. In the aftermath, three men seek her forgiveness: Woo-jin, her long-time friend and secret admirer; Min-seong, 
a film company rep she drunkenly kissed; and her unfaithful boyfriend, who won’t let go.
As Sia struggles to find love and follow her dreams, a shocking truth surfaces: the man she kissed that night wasn’t Min-seong but Woo-jin. Can she overcome the chaos and discover her true feelings?

book_title: Awakening: Tragic Tale Of Training Academy
special_desc:
In a mysterious center, six passionate students and their parents gather to receive methylphenidate, a clinically approved drug known as the ""study shot."" 
which enhances blood flow to the brain to improve learning effectiveness. 
While the children, who have received the study shot, are locked in and studying, the parents practice administering injections inside. 
As the test results are announced, a tense atmosphere develops among the students, resulting in an incident that Kyung-min stabs Ye-jun in the neck with a pen. 
Meanwhile, subtle infidelities and conflicts begin to ignite among the parents.

One day, a villain moved into her neighborhood.
It seems like she’s gotten herself into a mess with a crazy guy.
“Could it be that he’s doing this because I rejected his confession?!”
The villainous neighbor who suddenly appeared in her life
vs.
The bold woman who suddenly appeared in his life
A battle between the two!

I trusted my husband—until I found out he was cheating with a college girl. And as if that wasn't enough, he tried to kill me and our daughter.
After losing my child, I had nothing left. That’s when he appeared.
""Why are you helping me?""
"Because I have a debt to settle with your husband and his mistress’s family."
Now, with a new face, I’ve returned to stand before them. It’s their turn to suffer.

book_title: Becoming the Wife of a Dark Cult Overlord
special_desc:
I was kidnapped. And that’s when I realized—my gentle, loving boyfriend was nothing like I thought.
The man who used to smile so sweetly at me now commands others to kill without hesitation.
He swears he’ll protect me, no matter what it takes. Even if it means becoming a monster.
I should be terrified. I should hate him.
But when I see the way he looks at me—like I’m the only thing keeping him alive—how can I?

One day, Hana wakes up to find herself in the world of a romance novel—as the first fiancée of the male lead. The problem? Her character is a minor one destined to be poisoned at the engagement party of Cheon Nam-joo, heir to the Cheonnam Group. To avoid her tragic fate, Hana proposes a contract marriage to Park Woo-jin, the notorious "tyrant" and acting chairman of the rival Samjeong Group. Woo-jin accepts the offer, and Hana’s destiny begins to veer in an unpredictable direction.

Ben, a famous celebrity actor, is on the height of success. But soon, his career comes at a risk when he is rumored to date another famous male celebrity. Allen(Ben's manager) offers Blake to be Ben's fake date for a while, until the rumors settle down. Ben and Blake start to blend in together, and go exclusive to suppress the rumors. Hearing the ongoing drama, Ria(Ben's ex-girlfriend) suspects their relationship, hence digs more into their lives. Soon, Ria unveils Blake's reality and the whole set-up to the world...

Tonia is a twin who has been bullied all her life by her twin sister– Steph. Who always manages to ruin everything Tonia has. Even to the extent of destroying Tonia's engagement.
Tonia's best friend is back in town, richer, more handsome and well connected. The tides are now in Tonia's favor. A love story is also blossoming.
Would Steph and Jaden succeed in destroying the blooming love between Tonia and Michael, would Michael be able to protect Tonia, and would he be able to serve Steph a cold plate of revenge.
The path to Michael's and Tonia's path to happily ever after is filled with dark twists and turns, would they fight for their love and survive?

book_title: I'm Obsessed With My Boss Part I
special_desc: Lucilia is an average woman who lives a very mundane life, but she has a guilty pleasure, she is in love with her boss, Ricardo. Lucilia's boyfriend, Jeremy, becomes suspicious of her. One day he goes through her phone and finds hundreds of Ricardo's personal pictures and unsent love letters for him. Things get heated up. Her and Ricardo start having an affair under Jeremy's nose...

book_title: I'm Obsessed With My Boss Part II
special_desc: Lucilia informs Ricardo that she's pregnant. She wants him to do the right thing: take responsibility for the child and marry her. Ricardo refuses.
