As Chloe seduces Edmund and torments Ava, their schemes only bring Edmund and Ava closer. In a stunning twist, Ava learns she is the true heiress to a luxury hotel empire. With the truth revealed, Edmund and Ava finally claim their happily ever after.

book_title: Submitting to My Best Friend's Dad
special_desc: Becca needed the break after a rough year attending Yale and a break-up with her boyfriend. She didn’t expect for her summer of fun to include sleeping with James, the Italian Stallion–her best friend's father. Knowing it’s wrong, she allows James to pull her into a vortex of pleasure that has her breaching the surface of reality and grasping for survival. Can Becca endure this pleasure without Tally finding out? Or will her secrets cause her world to crash around her?

book_title: Fated To My Billionaire Call Boy
special_desc: Diane makes a deathbed promise to her grandmother to have a baby—only to immediately uncover proof of her husband Miles' affair. Devastated, she ends their seven-year marriage. In a drunken rebound move (courtesy of her bold bestie Maggie), Diane spends a wild night with a gorgeous callboy named Eddie… but her night blindness hides a jaw-dropping truth:  Eddie is actually Dominic—her and Miles'college classmate who's been secretly in love with her for years. After studying abroad, he's now returned as a ruthless billionaire… and he'll stop at nothing to win Diane back. By day, he's a powerful tycoon; by night, he voluntarily plays her devoted callboy, determined to make her fall for him.

Yu-Jin was murdered by her husband Chan-Yeong and his mistress Na Ju-Hui. Shortly after, her sister Yu-Ri is also killed and finds herself back in time before Yujin and Chan-Yeong's wedding. Determined to avenge her sister, Yu-Ri decides to marry Chan-Yeong. Just then, her first love Tae-O reappears before her.

book_title: A Couple Who Got Married First
special_desc: Dojun, who married out of necessity and immediately left for a foreign country, suddenly appeared at his marital home and then at his company, without any prior notice. He brought with him several photographs. 'With this innocent face, was she always seducing men?' 'I thought we had only two months left until the divorce...!' Is this marriage really okay? And who could have sent those photos to Dojun?

Against the backdrop of raging wildfires in Los Angeles, the contractual marriage between firefighter Liam and novelist Natalie is thrown into crisis due to misunderstandings, betrayal, and life-and-death trials. As the wildfires spread, Liam gradually realizes his true feelings for Natalie, while she reexamines their relationship through the pain. The two grow closer amid disaster and conspiracy, ultimately rekindling their love from the ashes.

After a one - night stand with a handsome stranger, Sarah, a young campaign intern, realized that he was her boss, Senatorial candidate Christopher. In a tough campaign, their affair would be a career - ending scandal for both of them, so she concealed her identity. But did Christopher fall in love with her or the role she was playing? Will their love story destroy them or can they survive the scandal and become a powerful couple in the political world?

Vesper, who is determined to raise money to save her father, finds Raymond, the boss of the Hell Gang, to become his contracted lover. However, Vesper doesn't know that Raymond has been secretly in love with her for many years. How can they overcome the misunderstandings between money and love...

After three years in a no-love, no-sex arranged marriage, Edith asks for a divorce when she discovers her sexy firefighter husband has gotten another woman pregnant! Even though it means burying her decade-long crush on him! However, her husband refuses to sign unless she agrees to play as a loving couple with him for one last month... Edith is shocked to find that there's a huge misunderstanding between her and her husband...

Olivia is the daughter of a wealthy family who didn’t live a good life growing up. After she graduated from college, her step mother forces her to marry the bastard son of another wealthy family so Olivia’s step sister won’t have to, because Andrew Wright, the said bastard son, does not have the best reputation. Little does Olivia know, her life is about to take a turn, because Andrew Wright isn’t just a bastard son...

Ava was sent to prison by Liam for causing the death of his friend. After being released, Ava was tortured by Liam and her love for him was tested to its limits, yet little did she know, Liam also endured incredible agony. In the end, the couple let go of their grievances and started a new life together.

book_title: I'm Calling Off the Engagement with the Male Lead
special_desc: One day, I, a struggling romance novelist, suddenly found myself inside the world of my own romance novel. The twist? I ended up as the story's villainess—the one doomed to a tragic end after committing countless misdeeds! To change my fate, there's only one way out: I have to break off my engagement with the male lead!

She is a wealthy heiress and a renowned fashion designer who gave up her career for her husband. However, his coldness and distrust broke her heart. After their divorce, she met a handsome, wealthy, and caring new man who helped her slowly forget the pain of her past. She thought she had found her true love, but little did she know that he was only after her money and power. When she discovered the deception and left him, he realized he had truly fallen for her. At the same time, her ex-husband wanted to reconcile. Who will she choose?

"How dare you still say words like going home together!" I couldn't believe that the man I love so deeply has betrayed me! I killed him with my own hands,  and I was framed and killed by my sister.
But I'm given a second chance. Reborn back to when everything hasn't surfaced, this time, I'm going to take the initiative! Those who has ruined me in my past life, I will make them pay.

Heather found her mate James was cheating with his uncle's fiancee. She was so hurt that she went into his uncle Antonio’s room to seduce him, and kissed him... However, The cold man seems had feelings for her so that he couldn't control himself and kissed her hardly...

Left heartbroken at the altar, Liana impulsively marries Jacob, a mysterious billionaire hiding his own pain. What begins as a cold agreement transforms into a journey of passion and healing. As they navigate meddling exes, family drama, and corporate battles, will their whirlwind romance blossom into true love, or will their pasts tear them apart?

book_title: My CEO Dad Chasing My Mom Back
special_desc:
"Why are you still alive?" I don't know this crazy woman at all, and she just came up to me and shouted at me!
I suffered a car accident five years ago during pregnancy and was saved by a handsome stranger, who later I married. I've always noticed that my daughter looks very much like him, but because of amnesia, I can't recall the truth. 
Five years later, I now entered a tycoon jewelry company and met this crazy woman. Plus, many other people are saying that I look exactly like the CEO's daughter, the missing heiress! What's my husband and my real identity?

A woman with only three months left to live is caught in a dangerously seductive web. There’s the billionaire playboy who kept her as a secret lover but now brings his fiancée around, an ex-boyfriend back in her life with no memory of their painful history, and a mafia boss who sees his late wife in her, harboring a twisted desire to keep her close by any means. As lies and secrets blur the lines between love and obsession, what choice will she make?

The lawyer Choi Yoon-ha, once called the undefeated legend, loses everything in a mysterious fire. To cover her only surviving sibling's medical expenses, she starts a risky deal with Sung Ji-hoon. "I need a woman who won't stand out." "Is that my mission?" Yoon-ha finds herself increasingly entangled between those who desire her, both good and evil. Can she uncover the truth behind the fire that took everything from her?

On the night of Seojin's engagement, her stepbrother Dohyun saves her from danger.  
"Don't go, I'm scared... please..."  
After that day, the relationship between the two, who had been siblings for 19 years, changes.

Maid's Vendetta tells the story of Diana, whose perfect life was destroyed when her father had an affair, her younger brother died in a tragic accident, and her mother suffered a mental breakdown—all because of one woman. Swearing vengeance, Diana sets in motion a dangerous game of revenge.  
Twenty years ago, Diana lived a charmed life as the beloved heiress of a wealthy family—until her family tutor, Sophie, seduced her father and tore her world apart. Now, under the alias Raven, she infiltrates Sophie's household as a maid, determined to make her pay for ruining her family.

Stella is deceived by her fiancé and sister and ends up in someone else's bed. Fortunately, she meets Kevin, the CEO of Galkin Group, but she thinks he’s a gigolo. To save her company, Stella has a flash marriage with him. She’s afraid of encountering troubles, but actually she meets her true love.

book_title: Got Pregnant With My Ex Boss's Baby
special_desc: In the company, I was my boss’s secretary, but privately, I was his bed partner.

book_title: You Had Me at First Base
special_desc: Masaomi Shimizu is a single mother. Eight years ago, a misunderstanding arose between her and her first love, Shuhei Watanabe, and she broke up with him without telling him that she was pregnant. Eight years later, Shuhei shines as the youngest MVP in baseball history and is about to transfer to a new team. As fate's gears start turning again, will the two, who meet again at the ballpark, be able to resolve their misunderstandings and communicate their feelings?

book_title: My Billionaire Husband is an Ex-Convict!
special_desc: Will is a loser and an ex-con. No girl in her right mind would marry him... until you!

Adeline Rhodes is diagnosed with stage four kidney cancer and has months to live. Her husband, Blake Rhodes, seems preoccupied with her half-sister Rebecca, whom she constantly has to donate blood to. Blake mistakes Adeline for a calculating gold-digger, and she thinks he’s never loved her. All of this changes when Blake finds out Adeline’s dying, but it might be too late for him to tell her that it was her that he loved all this time.

book_title: After Being Reborn, I Got Married to My Ex-boyfriend’s Uncle
special_desc: In a past life, I wed my childhood sweetheart, Drake Elledge, only to find heartbreak as he remained tangled with his first love, resulting in a tragic end for me and our unborn child. Little did I know, his uncle had been silently in love with me for seven years. Now, with a second chance at life, I refuse to repeat the past. When my mother asks if I'll marry Drake, I say no and choose Jace, sparking a new journey fraught with Drake's relentless attempts to win me back...

Celia meticulously planned a family trip, only to have her husband Vince cancel her ticket at the last minute so his childhood friend Dana could join them. Realizing her years of unappreciated efforts, Celia embarks on a journey of revenge and self-discovery...

Growing up side by side, Vickie fell for Xander early on, unaware of his roving eye. After graduation, he took her virginity, treating it as mere practice for winning over the campus beauty. Shattered by his betrayal, Vickie chose to study abroad, and her parents cut business ties with Xander's family, plunging them into crisis. Driven by revenge, Xander kidnapped Vickie, but soon discovered that payback comes at a steep price...

In Ivy & Thorn Ivy Never Fades movie, in their past lives, Ivy and Daisy were both at the orphanage, waiting to be chosen by prospective parents. Daisy opted for a wealthy family, while Ivy joined a humble cleaner's household. Yet, Patrick Vance, the heir of the affluent family, was drawn to Ivy's independence. Consumed by jealousy, Daisy killed Ivy and then took her own life at their wedding. Reborn on the day of the selection, Daisy decides against the wealthy path, hoping to replicate Ivy's fate. However, she soon discovers that the cleaner's family is far from the paradise she imagined...

Aurora Quinn loved Oscar Russel, but he and his sister Luna betrayed her. After death, she learns Oscar’s brother, Lucian, was her true protector. Reborn, she returns to the moment Sir Russel asks her to choose a husband and picks Lucian. Oscar keeps scheming but at the wedding Lucian exposes him onstage. In the end, Sir Russel revives and expels Oscar, while Aurora and Lucian start anew.

Annie Grant, neglected by the Grant Family because of foster daughter Vivian Linwood, was betrayed by her fiancé Max Hunter before their wedding. Heartbroken, she broke off the engagement and chose teaching in the mountains, where she reunited with Marcus Chandler, found true love and the warmth of the Chandler Family, and embraced a new life.

Whitney Stone and Jonsen Grant's five-year romance shatters when Whitney uncovers Jonsen's secret IUI with his dying benefactor, Daisy Lynn, just before their wedding. Heartbroken, Whitney cancels the wedding and dives into her research, while Jonsen, seeking answers, discovers Whitney was his savior six years prior. As he attempts to win her back, Whitney finds new purpose and love in her work.

For seven years, Elle Gold secretly helped Joe Judd build DK Corp into a successful company. On their wedding day, pregnant and ready to reveal the truth, she is humiliated by Joe. In an attempt to please his first love, Sue Cole, Joe allows Sue to steal Elle’s spotlight by wearing a wedding dress. Elle endures their cruelty time and again, only to discover that Joe and Sue are having an affair. Worse, Joe believes Sue’s lie that she’s the founder of DK Corp. Devastated, Elle demands a divorce. With Carl Irwin’s help, she plans her revenge. At the signing banquet, she exposes her true identity, pulls her investments, and watches as Joe crumbles in regret.

After losing her parents in an accident, Anna, the only daughter of a renowned medical family, leaned on her brothers Eddie and Evan until an orphaned girl named Tina entered their lives.
Tina manipulated her way into the family, turning the brothers against Anna. Anna was cast out and dedicated herself in secret to completing her parents' cancer research.
12 years later, she returns as a brilliant scientist. Her brothers beg for forgiveness, but Anna has already made peace with the past.

In Genius Babies Saves the Day movie, in the final of the Global Super Brain Showdown, Team Ofror was on the brink of defeat. Just when all hope seemed lost, an unexpected hero emerged—8-year-old Leland Griffin. He solved impossible Rubik's cubes, detected microscopic differences in water, and assembled a star chart with pinpoint accuracy. Against all odds, he led his team to a stunning victory. Turned out, in his body was the soul of Harvey Bowers, the greatest scientist on earth!

Five years into her "marriage", Queenie Saad discovers a devastating secret: Yosef Gray's legal wife is his first love, Vivian Lynch, and they have a daughter together. Reflecting on her sacrifices, including severing ties with her family, Queenie realizes Yosef's heart never left Vivian.

Shattered but resolute, Queenie files for divorce and reveals Yosef and Vivian's hidden affair. Embracing a fresh start, she marries her childhood friend, Chris Jones. Only then does Yosef realize his mistake, but it's too late...

book_title: Dumping My Ex, Founding My Love
special_desc: Five years ago, Thora Snider gave up everything to marry Marc Neel, transforming him from a broke nobody into a powerful CEO. But on their fifth wedding anniversary, Marc "surprised" her with his pregnant mistress, Ella Frost, and forced her to step aside for their true love. Disillusioned, Thora vowed to take back everything she had given him...

book_title: My Fiancée Carried My Brother's Child — I Married Another
special_desc: Elliot and his fiancée Betty were getting married. But Betty cheated on him and carried his brother's baby. Elliot felt very frustrated. But Betty still wanted to marry him and take away his house. Elliot rejected her and chose to marry a rich heiress, Amelia. Betty thought she got a successful career on her own. Actually, it was all Elliot's credit. In the end, Betty regretted it and tried to win Elliot back, but it was too late. Elliot was in love with Amelia...

Maya has devoted her life to raising Matthew, an abandoned baby she loves as her own. On his wedding day, his biological mother, Lillian, returns to reclaim him and accuses Maya of stealing her son. Instead of believing Maya, Matthew leaves with Lillian. This is Maya's wake-up call. She finally decides to walk away. But when her daughter-in-law's life is in danger, she makes one final sacrifice as his mother.

After being betrayed and murdered by her boyfriend, Samuel, and his lover Jessica, Nina wakes up before it all happens. Determined to rewrite her fate, she secretly records their affair and plots her revenge. When Samuel tries to scam her again, Nina walks straight into his trap to spring her own. At a tense family gathering, she reveals the proof of their lies, exposing their affair and fraud for everyone to see. This time, it's not Nina who's ruined, it's them.

Jane Dunn, a general's daughter, and Charles Spencer, an unloved prince, were in love and promised to spend the rest of their lives together after Charles came back from battle. While Charles was away fighting, Jane was forced into marrying Charles' brother Dylan by the dying king. Back from battle to find his beloved now Empress, Charles was livid and made Jane his servant in exchange for not killing her and Dylan, as well as guarding Dylan's throne. While she was there, Lady Katelyn who fancied Charles came up with many plans to tear them apart and hurt Jane, but the plans were all thwarted by Charles. As Jane and Charles got closer together, Dylan got into a jealous rage and forced Jane to help him kill Charles. Thinking his plot was about to succeed, Dylan revealed the truth about framing Charles to become the crown prince and killing the late king. Just then Jane came back to save Charles. The pair resolved their bitter feelings in the past and Charles won the throne back from his brother.

book_title: The Double Life of My Deliveryman Husband
special_desc: In The Double Life of My Deliveryman Husband movie, Verna Collins came to the city to visit her daughter Sheryl Vance, who had just given birth to a baby. However, she met Ivy Wright, who was posing as a beggar to find an ideal wife for her wealthy father Emerson Wright. Ivy was charmed by Verna's kindness and arranged a blind date between Verna and Emerson. Emerson, thinking Verna was a fraud, pretended to be a delivery man. But to his surprise, Verna didn't care. Emerson was captivated by Verna's kindness and gentleness and quickly married her. However, at this time, Verna discovered that Sheryl had been deceiving her by using excuses not to let her see her grandson. Sheryl even hired an actor to pretend to be her at her grandson's party. Verna angrily confronted Sheryl, but the latter accused her of being a fraud. Just as Verna was being beaten by her in-laws, Emerson, who had been attending the party incognito, stepped in to stop them. The Dylan family, unaware of Emerson's identity, learned from Sheryl that Emerson was just a delivery man and insulted him. At this moment, the vice president of the Wright Group was invited to the party and was shocked to see Emerson. He immediately stopped the Dylan family from insulting him. But at Emerson's hint, he didn't reveal Emerson's identity. As a result, the Dylan family lost the cooperation with the Wright Group that was within their grasp, but blamed Verna, thinking she had deliberately embarrassed. Verna was heartbroken after seeing through Sheryl's true colors. To cheer her up, Emerson took her to a real estate agency and said he would buy her a house. Of course, to maintain his poor image, he bought a second-hand house. But they happened to run into Sheryl, who was there with Natalie to buy a house...

In Dispel the Clouds movie, after decades away, Ingrid Berry returned home with her grandkids, answering her mother's birthday invitation with cautious hope. She dreamed of a heartfelt reunion—but instead walked straight into a nightmare. Her father and siblings humiliated her, and her dad even tried to sell her off for money. Luckily, her son and grandkids came to her rescue just in time. Ingrid finally realized these people weren't family but leeches. Without hesitation, she cut ties for good and left the past behind, starting a new life abroad with the only ones who ever truly loved her.

book_title: Kneel, Your Majesty! The Exiled One Returns
special_desc: In Kneel Your Majesty  The Exiled One Returns movie: Neal Stone, the mastermind behind Dragon Hall, covertly transformed Patricia Fleming's small nation, Qruling, into a formidable force. Yet, under Edgar Meskill's sway, Patricia dismissed Neal as just a consort and exiled him. Enter Empress Lillian of Jofdon, who boldly confessed her love for Neal. In the end, Neal not only proved Patricia and her officials wrong but also found true happiness with Lillian...

book_title: Blind to Love, Bound to You
special_desc: To save himself, Xander Quinn must find the one woman with dark energy—Sienna Jade—and make love to her, even if it costs her life. He deceives her into marriage and secretly pays for her grandmother’s treatment. Grateful, Sienna gives herself to him—unaware of the deadly price. Xander later falls for her and desperately searches for another cure. However, before he can save her, she discovers the truth. Heartbroken, she tries to escape, only for fate to seal her tragic end. Miraculously revived by her grandmother's pill, she wakes up blind. Seven years later, she returns with her daughter, unknowingly crossing paths with Xander. Oblivious to their identities, he torments them—until the truth shatters him. Determined to win her back, he conceals his identity. But when Sienna regains her sight, she finally sees the monster who once stole her life.

Jane Lynch was sponsored by a rich billionaire, Mr. James. Because of a misunderstanding, Jane thought she was Mr. James's long-lost daughter. But it was not true. At the billionaire's house, she met his real daughter, Maya, whom he also sponsored. Jane kept bullying the true heiress Maya, and she caused many problems in Mr. James's company. Jane almost ruined Mr. James's company. Will this evil and mean girl get punished?

In Blossom in Armor movie, Riley Hale joined the army in her father's place and saved the emperor from the enemies. As a reward, the emperor granted her the largest estate as a dowry and promised to fulfill any request with a jade token. Returning home, Riley shed her armor for a wedding dress and married Steve Barron. Five years later, Steve brought his confidante, Fiona Smith, to Riley, asking her to give up her position as his wife and give him the estate because Fiona wanted to hold her wedding there. Steve and his family pressured Riley to leave and even demanded she provide a dowry for Fiona. Humiliated, Riley resolutely went to the palace and requested a divorce with the jade token. She asked to return to the battlefield to defend the borders and the people. There, she met her true love. The Crown Prince fell for Riley at first sight, and together they subdued the turmoil in the north, earning Riley great military merit once more. The Crown Prince was determined to marry Riley, but faced many obstacles...
Episode List

book_title: The Beggar Prince & His Runaway Bride
special_desc: Sasha Tyler happens to save the drugged Crown Prince, Felix Wayne, and takes his token by mistake. Disguised as a little beggar, Felix sets out to find his savior and the token. Their paths cross again when Sasha, desperately needing money and food, signs up for Crown Princess selection, unaware that the beggar she knows is actually the Prince seeking a bride!

Hector Kellow, head of the Hall of Mars, lived peacefully with Kira Laird after repelling invaders. Tragically, after their daughter Sophia's birth, Kira was taken by her family, leaving Hector to raise Sophia alone. Five years later, discovering Kira was forced to engage Ian Nelson, Hector attended Harriet Nelson's birthday party with Sophia. There, he revealed his identity, intimidated the guests, rescued Kira, and struck a blow to the Nelson family. Reunited, they returned to Kellow Village, where Hector repaid villagers with gold. However, a misunderstanding led to conflict with his father Jude, putting family ties at risk...

book_title: Super Godfather: Ex-wife Begging Me to Get Remarried
special_desc: Vincent Rogers was framed by his wife Lauryn Torres on the charge of having an affair with his mother-in-law and was forced to leave with nothing. At his wit's end, he was unexpectedly recognized as Don Watson's grandson and inherited the Eye of Satan, becoming the heir of the Grand Group. With his ability to see through treasures and his business acumen, Vincent made a comeback, trampling on the Torres family, swallowing up the Evans Group, winning the heart of Sabina Strauss, and making a billion-dollar profit in the stone gambling field, thus foiling the Anti-Grand Group's conspiracy. As Don Watson's tests for him were gradually unlocked, Vincent eventually took over the Grand Group, exposed Lauryn's crimes, married his true love Sabina, and reached the peak of power.

book_title: My Poor Husband is a Big Shot
special_desc: The man worked hard outside for many years, eventually escaping poverty and becoming a well-known tycoon.After achieving success and fame, he returns to the small town, hoping to hold a belated wedding ceremony for his wife. However, his wife's family believes he is a down-and-out loser. In order to force the poor woman to remarry a social elite, they insult, beat the hero, and even force him to divorce. Faced with such bullying, the wife remains calm and works together with his wife to resolve various crises. He ultimately reveals his true identity to everyone, reclaiming his dignity.

In The Heiress's Dilemma movie, Lucille Scott, secret heiress of Brookston's wealthiest family, must live in poverty for 20 years to break a curse that ties her fate to money. Raised in a rundown home by quirky parents, she crosses paths with Bryan Hawkins, a powerful heir dodging an arranged marriage. He offers her a million to pretend to be his girlfriend. But fate takes over when her parents unknowingly pick him as her blind date.

Pretending to be a rich heiress, Lucille enters high society only to be humiliated at a charity gala. Just as things fall apart, a mysterious billionaire claims her as his daughter, flipping the tables on everyone.

From secret identities and fake relationships to sudden love, kidnappings, and outrageous family tests, Lucille and Bryan must navigate chaos, sacrifice, and a curse on the verge of breaking. When she turns 23, her true identity is revealed. And with Bryan giving up everything to be with her, Lucille finally claims love and power on her own terms.

book_title: A Mother’s Wait: Mom, Dad, I'm Back
special_desc: In A Mother’s Wait Mom Dad I'm Back movie, fifteen years ago, Elijah Morton was separated from his mother Sabrina Lester at a fair and adopted by General Hale Gibson. After Gibson became the King, he appointed Elijah Duke of South and ordered him to build a palace in his hometown while seeking his parents. Staying at Lord Gideon Quain's estate, Elijah repeatedly missed recognizing Sabrina, who worked there as a servant. When Sabrina's house was seized for palace construction, her nephew Wyatt Morton attempted to force her out. Elijah intervened, confirming their mother-son bond through a keepsake. Wyatt later kidnapped Elijah to curry favor with Gideon, who panicked upon discovering this and freed Elijah by revealing his status. Sabrina and her husband Alfred Morton sought help from Elijah's fiancée Camille Elwood. Camille's stepfamily framed her for theft, leading her father Larry Elwood to sentence her to marry Chester Quain. Elijah rescued Camille and punished the conspirators. At Sabrina's estranged father Paul Lester's 70th birthday, Sabrina presented Elijah's expensive wine in plain packaging. Her jealous sisters denounced it as fake, prompting Paul to disown her. Elijah arrived with officials bearing lavish gifts, exposing the family's hypocrisy. He departed with his parents as Paul regretted his cruelty.

book_title: Fated Mate of the Nine-Tailed Fox
special_desc:
Rin, the sole heir of the White Nine-Tailed Fox clan, was kidnapped as a child by the Black Nine-Tailed Fox and raised in darkness.
On her 20th birthday, she plans to escape—once her fox powers finally awaken. But fate has a cruel twist in store: her destined mate is revealed to be Hyun Dong-joo, the cold and powerful leader of the Black Nine-Tailed Fox.
Rin and Hyun Dong-joo resent one another and reject the bond. But just when White Fox leader Baek Do-yoon steps forward and claims Rin as his fated partner, Hyun Dong-joo suddenly declares he will marry her instead.
Who will truly be Rin’s fated mate?

A reality dating show where the prize money increases with every touch between the opposite sex — <SO HOT>!On an island of pleasure, eight men and women with flawless looks, perfect bodies, and exceptional dating skills come together. Among them is Ava Brown, a 20-year-old dance major who fails to stand out and faces elimination. Just then, a game-changing charismatic contestant enters the show and completely shifts the dynamics. This man feels strangely familiar… and it turns out he is James Wilson, a UDT soldier who works under Ava’s father and the man Ava has secretly had a crush on for years!On this island filled with excitement, jealousy, and pleasure, can the two of them finally find love? A sexual romantic comedy about Ava, who’s never been in a relationship, reuniting with her first crush,James.

Now try it in thriller. A chilling anthology series where people record their final moments through their smartphones. A helpful husband opens his door to strangers, a lonely man pays for companionship, a rich kid tries to play hero – all through the unblinking eye of their own cameras. When the recording stops, only the killers remain to tell their version of the story.

Isabella Méndez cleans rooms at a luxury hotel in Miami, quietly dreaming of one day opening her own café. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she's mistaken for Mariana Echeverría—a glamorous heiress and influencer set to buy the hotel, remodel it, and fire the entire staff. Instead of telling the truth, Isabella slips into the fantasy and accepts a dinner invitation from Alejandro de la Vega, the hotel's owner and Mariana's future business partner. What begins as a harmless mix-up spirals into a whirlwind of secrets, romance, and high-stakes consequences. As the real Mariana closes in and the truth threatens to unravel, Isabella must choose between protecting her heart… or facing the fallout.

book_title: Bound by Marriage - Freed by Love
special_desc: What began as a marriage of convenience soon became a maze of lies and hidden faces. Diana thought her cold husband was the enemy — until the real nightmare revealed itself. Now, trapped in a house of secrets, the only heart she might come to trust… belongs to the man she was never meant to love.

book_title: Love Trap with My Dashing Knight
special_desc:
In Love Trap with My Dashing Knight movie, the wealthy heiress Emily White marries Tim Carter, a man from humble beginnings, for love. She spares no effort in elevating him to the position of CEO, using her family’s vast resources to secure his success. Yet, after ten years of marriage, Tim betrays her, secretly engaging in an affair with his secretary, Laura Green. Stripped of power, Emily is reduced to a housewife, trapped in a hollow, loveless marriage, suffering alone.
Eager to secure her position, Laura devises a ruthless scheme—she hires a male escort to seduce Emily, planning to obtain "evidence" of her infidelity and force her out of the marriage with nothing. However, in a twist of fate, she mistakenly targets Ryan Clarke, the illegitimate son of the influential Clarke family, believing him to be an escort. The moment Ryan sees Emily, he immediately recognizes her—she is the woman who unknowingly saved him years ago.
Harboring unspoken emotions, Ryan seizes the opportunity and infiltrates the White household, becoming Emily’s chauffeur and live-in assistant. He relentlessly flirts and teases her, awakening long-buried desires within her.

Pregnant. Widowed. Dragged into the Mancini mafia. Ava never expected her late husband to be the hidden heir—nor to crave his ruthless brother. Ice-cold don Luca vows to shield her, but every touch ignites a forbidden fire. Rival gangs close in, her birth family plots betrayal, and the dynasty teeters on war. How long before Luca shatters every rule to claim the woman worth killing for?

book_title: The Scent of My Fated Luna
special_desc: A half-witch, half-werewolf teen forced to hide her true identity struggles to survive a high school divided by magic and fangs—while resisting her fated mate, the future Alpha who doesn’t remember their childhood bond, and battling the jealous rival willing to destroy her to claim him.

When Alejandro (Claudio de la Torre), a groom left at the altar, escapes to a remote estate to mend his broken heart, his life takes an unexpected turn when he meets Clara (Francis Rodríguez), the messy, sarcastic, and surprisingly vibrant caretaker. What begins as a chaotic clash turns into a Christmas entanglement filled with humor, jealousy, misunderstandings, and revelations that force them both to discover that love’s miracles happen where least expected.

book_title: Alpha Revenge: Wolf King and His Human Luna
special_desc: Her parents were cruelly killed by werewolves, yet she has now become the Fated Luna of the werewolf Alpha. However, their love defies werewolf traditions, sparking conflict as they face rogue wolves and ancient prophecies. With hidden powers and fierce rivalries at play, love, destiny, and power clash in this thrilling tale of passion and survival.

book_title: Heiress Returns: Boss's Defense and Love
special_desc: In Heiress Returns: Boss's Defense and Love movie: The daughter of the world's wealthiest man pursued a man who manipulated and mistreated women for three years, during which she endured emotional abuse. Despite transferring hundreds of millions in assets to this manipulative individual, she received no formal recognition or respect in their relationship. On their third wedding anniversary, this deceitful man brazenly introduced his mistress to her, mocking her lack of wealth, beauty, connections, and desirability, claiming she deserved to be betrayed. Unbeknownst to him, with just a single decision from her, he and his mistress would lose everything. At this critical moment, the male protagonist—a peer of the female lead in terms of wealth and family background—appears. However, due to misunderstandings orchestrated by the antagonistic secondary characters, he is mistaken for a hired model intended to embellish the scene. Ironically, both the male and female leads initially perceive each other as impostors, with the male lead even mistakenly believing the female lead is his arranged marriage partner. Enraged by the betrayal of the secondary male character, the female lead hastily signs a divorce agreement and marries the male lead. Yet, the secondary characters remain oblivious to the gravity of their actions. Let us observe how they are subsequently humiliated in various ways.

In Crossing The Line To Love movie: three days before her wedding, freelance writer Nichole catches her fiancé in bed with her bridesmaid. In a moment of heartbreak and rage, she storms into a bar and kisses a random stranger—only to realize he’s Fabian Winston, a wildly popular contemporary artist and the sole heir to a powerful elite family. The kiss goes viral overnight. Faced with mounting public pressure and relentless media, Nichole is pushed into a contract marriage with Fabian. What starts as a scandal-driven deal slowly unravels into a messy, irresistible entanglement of power, secrets, and unexpected feelings.

A sudden hospital fire reunites Cindy with her first love, Jackson, after eight long years. Now a heroic fire captain, Jackson risks his life to rescue a nurse trapped in the blaze—only to discover she's none other than Cindy, the woman who shattered his heart during a college break by seemingly cheating on him. As fate begins to turn its wheels, long-buried truths slowly surface. Cindy never betrayed him—instead, she chose to hide her pregnancy to protect Jackson’s future, raising their son Noah alone ever since. Now, facing the child who doesn’t know his true identity, Jackson’s paternal instincts awaken, while Cindy’s long-hidden maternal secret teeters on the edge of revelation. As the flames of their past reignite, they’re met with overwhelming obstacles: a jealous boss, a ruthless mother, sneering colleagues, and a kidnapping plot that pushes Cindy to the brink once more. This is a story of misunderstanding and sacrifice spanning eight years—a journey of love, forgiveness, and impossible choices. When the flames die down, can true love rise from the ashes? He once promised, “Wait for me. I’ll come back to marry you.” She gave everything to keep that hope alive: “For you, I held on to hope.” Love never died—it was only waiting for the fire to return.

Four years ago, at the wedding arranged by their families, Max, the scion of the conglomerate, was absent, leaving the down-and-out socialite Alice as the nominal Mrs. M. Four years later, Alice has transformed into a well-known divorce case investigator, while Max returns home as the chairman of the M Group and entrusts her with handling his divorce case—neither recognizing the other. The meddling of a scheming colleague and the conspiracy of a cousin pile up one misunderstanding after another. When the truth comes to light, the two, who once passed each other by, finally come together after resolving their knots.

book_title: Secret Life of A Mafia Sweetheart
special_desc: Two heirs of rival mafia families fall in love under false identities. A gang war leaves Alyssa injured with amnesia, Dylan poses as her fiancé，entangling them in love, betrayal, and buried family secrets…

In Dungeons of Ecstasy movie, after a near-fatal car crash shatters her body and her heart, travel journalist Emily escapes to remote Italy—only to be ensnared in the mysterious Dungeon of Ecstasy, where her captor, uncannily resembling her long-abandoned ex-husband, forces her through dangerous, sensual trials that awaken forbidden memories and a love she never knew was meant to heal her.

When Sophia sets out to find her missing twin sister, Tina, the trail leads her to The Red Veil, an elite vampire nightclub ruled by the ruthless Von Drák family. As she digs deeper into its dark, seductive world, Sophia discovers a chilling prophecy, a forbidden romance, and a supernatural war that could consume them all.

book_title: Slay to Fosters: I Took His Uncle
special_desc:
Reborn heiress Emily remembers everything - the false accusations, her family's betrayal, and her death at Olivia's hands. Now armed with knowledge of the past, how will she handle the fake heiress who destroyed her life?
Caroline Harrington, the only daughter of a top wealthy elite family in LA, concealed her true identity and broke away from her family to marry middle-class CEO Liam Foster. Throughout their marriage, she secretly used her family's resources to support Liam's business. However, Natty Parker, the youngest daughter of the Parker family, had long harbored feelings for Liam. She conspired with Liam's mother to set a trap—engineered to make Caroline appear engaged in inappropriate physical contact with Liam's uncle, Connor, right in front of Liam. This misunderstanding led to their divorce, and Caroline was driven out of the household. Heartbroken, Caroline returned to her family, determined to take revenge against her ex-husband and his relatives. Yet, amidst her quest for vengeance, she unexpectedly developed profound feelings for Connor. Meanwhile, after discovering his mother and Natty’s plot to frame Caroline, Liam became determined to win her back. Now torn between Connor—her mature and alluring current husband—and Liam, the man she once deeply loved, Caroline faces an agonizing choice: which path should she take?

When Olivia signs up for a life-saving surgery that will erase every memory - including the man who broke her heart - she's finally ready to walk away from her painful marriage. But with 14 days left on the clock, her cold, distant husband realizes too late what he's about to lose.
Tessa and Asher were first loves. Asher left without a word due to family reasons. Three years later, they reunite, but Tessa is now the fiancée of Asher's nephew.

In I Leashed A CEO movie, a drunken woman walking her dog late at night was led by the dog to a tycoon’s private car. Chasing the car, her clothes got caught and torn by the door. The two had an intimate SM encounter in the car, fully photographed by paparazzi and making gossip headlines. To calm public anger, the tycoon lied that the woman was his fiancée and searched for her using a dog leash as a clue. His stepsister faked her identity after seeing the news. The woman knew the man that night was the tycoon but dared not tell anyone, nor did she know her sister’s impersonation. She later became his personal bodyguard via an interview, and affection grew between them. Yet the stepsister kept sabotaging their relationship, causing constant conflicts. Will this scandal - triggered farce reveal the truth? Will the two lovers finally get together?

In The One I Never Forget movie, five years ago, a tragedy that claimed the lives of loved ones from both sides forced Sofia​ and Justin​ apart, a separation further complicated by Doris's​ lies, Sofia's miscarriage, and Justin's severe injury. Five years later, Sofia returns to Los Angeles as a renowned journalist, while Justin has become a baseball superstar. Their reunion is fraught with conflict, fueled by misunderstandings (Sofia falsely claims to be married; Justin mistakenly believes Sofia left him for money), obstructions (continued opposition from Doris and schemes by Esther), and danger (Esther's plot to commit murder). Ultimately, Justin uncovers the whole truth about the past, Doris confesses her wrongdoing, and Esther is exposed for her crimes and arrested. Transcending their pain, Sofia and Justin achieve dual fulfillment in their careers (Sofia completes her major report; Justin wins a championship) and in love. Their story highlights how honesty and forgiveness can allow love to be reborn from the ruins of lies and violence.

Catherine Rogers might only be the contract wife, so we can't compare her with the rightful partner! My Billionaire Sugar Baby Trailer shows this part as she has a steamy intercourse with her sugar baby, Adam Hartford. Adam teaches Catherine golf, the arts of kissing, and staying away from predators! What are his methods?

The new intern, Isla, never imagined that the cold and demanding CEO Christian — who shoved her relentlessly on the tennis court during the day — was the same person who broadened her view to unknown territories at night in an exclusive BDSM club. But when the mask comes off and secretive identities assimilate into reality, is this a game she can stay afloat… or submerge deep within the shadows of desire seeking unexpected redemption?  Produced by：Vantage Entertainment

Mia Langford, a talented but financially struggling art student, never expected her quiet life to collide with power, desire, and betrayal. A single reckless moment in class—an impulsive gaze and a forbidden sketch—draws the attention of her professor, Wesley Winslow, a brilliant yet dangerous man whose presence alters the trajectory of her world. Before Mia can understand the shift, her manipulative stepmother arranges a sudden engagement between her and Wesley’s entitled son, Darius—an alliance designed entirely for wealth and influence. But everything changes on a fateful night when, drugged and blindfolded, Mia ends up in Wesley’s arms instead of her fiancé’s. What should have been a mistake becomes an irreversible entanglement—emotionally, physically, and morally. As their forbidden bond deepens, Mia becomes trapped between two powerful men—one who seeks to possess her and one who risks everything to protect her. Darius, driven by jealousy, control, and entitlement, escalates his obsession. He forces Mia into humiliation, threatens her reputation, and captures evidence meant to destroy her future, using blackmail and emotional warfare to keep her under his control. Meanwhile, Mia fights for dignity in a world determined to shame and silence her. Rumors spread on campus, classmates turn against her, and her image becomes a weapon used to dismantle the life she worked so hard to build. Wesley becomes her only refuge—but also her biggest contradiction: the man she should run from, and the only one she wants. Their connection grows from forbidden desire to something dangerously close to love—forcing both to confront their fears, ethics, and the power structures binding them. In a world where everything—her body, her name, her future—is being claimed by others, Mia must decide whether to surrender…or fight for her identity, her freedom, and her own voice.

book_title: The Doctor Will See You Now
special_desc: In The Doctor Will See You Now movie, when Jane visits the hospital for an allergy, she falls for the handsome doctor, Henry Darcy, at first sight. Gathering her courage, Jane asks for his contact information, only to be coldly rejected multiple times. Undeterred, Jane crafts a plan to win his heart. A sweet romance unfolds between a determined ballerina and a reserved doctor.

After a car accident, Memi falls into a coma—but her soul awakens and witnesses a nurse secretly swapping her newborn son. Powerless to act, Memi watches for seven years as her real son, Nick, suffers abuse. Just as the nurse plans to harvest his corneas to cover the truth, Memi miraculously wakes up and rushes to save him.

Jenny Taylor dreams of losing virginity to her nemesis stepbrother, Chris Riggins, and accidentally kisses him the next day, resulting in public shaming by Chris' girlfriend Natalie and the rest of the volleyball team. However, Chris suddenly becomes caring and considerate, defending Jenny every step of the way. Could this actually be the start of a taboo relationship?

book_title: A Sweet Contract with the Mafia Boss
special_desc: In A Sweet Contract with the Mafia Boss movie: by chance, Tessa, an emergency room nurse, saved Victor, a dangerous and charming gang boss, but was strongly targeted by him. He was closing in on her, and she was running for her life—until fate tore away her last hope. Her brother was dying, and the sky-high medical bills were crushing her. Victor narrowed his cold eyes and said, "Be my woman, and I'll save him." She was forced to sign a marriage contract. She resisted his world but indulged in his protection and tenderness. When she found out that the mysterious man who saved her on the rainy night five years ago was actually him, the boundary between hate and love completely collapsed...

book_title: The Betrayed Mother is the Divine Heiress
special_desc:
Lena — heir to the divine legacy of Athena.
A nurturing, gentle mother figure, easily moved by compassion, yet beneath her warmth lies a sharp, commanding presence. Once the High Strategos of the fabled Order of Aegis, she vanished from power after a devastating fire twenty-five years ago—when she risked her life to save seven infants and raised them as her own.
For decades, Lena kept her true identity hidden. But on her fiftieth birthday, the seven sons she sacrificed everything for are swayed by their birth families, turning against her and branding her a trafficker. Betrayed and heartbroken, Lena awakens her long-buried power. No longer willing to endure in silence, she rises to reclaim control, expose the truth, and remind the world—and her sons—why she was once feared as a leader destined to command.

book_title: Guarding Her Body, Claiming Her Heart
special_desc: Her life was a fairytale lie until she caught her fiancé in bed with her own brother. When an attempt on her life shatters her last illusions, she is thrown together with the only man she can trust: her new bodyguard, Derek. He’s cold, aloof, and frustratingly professional - yet a single look from his piercing eyes is enough to make her burn. Can she truly trust the man sworn to protect her when everyone else has betrayed her?

Law student Lily Wingrove has run out of options. Her mother is dying, and the bills keep coming. Desperate, she signs a contract with young mafia boss Eric Moretti, offering her body in exchange for money. Eric moves fast. Money appears. Threats disappear. He is ruthless but magnetic, and every time he saves her, his power pulls her closer. Then he places her in the world of his sworn rival, star prosecutor Daniel Hayes. To the city, Daniel is justice itself. To Lily, he is patient, kind, and everything Eric is not. He protects her with law instead of fear. His love feels pure, even healing. But something beneath his perfection feels wrong. He knows too much, reacts too quickly, and his care sometimes feels like control. Now two men fight for her in opposite ways: one through dominance, the other through devotion. As her mother’s time runs out, Lily must decide who to trust before both the devil’s power and the angel’s secret destroy her.

book_title: Royal Heir Breaks My Heart in a Warzone
special_desc: In Royal Heir Breaks My Heart in a Warzone movie, the emergency room doctor fell in love with a special forces officer at first sight. But because of family difficulties, she had to pretend to be unfaithful and break up with him. She didn't know that after breaking up, she found out she was pregnant…and the special forces officer's other identity was actually a royal heir fulfilling his military service. Years later, she was forced to join an international medical team and met him again at the international peacekeeping base. She reunited with her special forces officer, her prince, whom she had been thinking about for a long time, but they were like strangers...

Driven by an instinctive pull, Xavier, the Alpha of a rogue wolf pack, senses the emergence of his fated mate. Tracing this profound connection, he finds Dr. Isla, an Omega. Captivated by her unique blend of gentleness and resilience, Xavier is determined to claim her. However, Isla believes her destined partner is another. This sparks intense rivalry as Xavier relentlessly pursues her. Initially wary and misunderstanding Xavier's motives, Isla gradually comes to understand the complex male beneath the Alpha exterior. Their journey unfolds into a thrilling and passionate romance. Yet, their burgeoning bond faces relentless trials: treacherous internal pack politics and looming external threats. Ultimately, through shared peril and unwavering resolve, they overcome every obstacle, their love culminating in a lasting union.

book_title: Midlife Flash Marriage: My Billionaire CEO
special_desc: After her divorce, Amy lost her daughter and raised her son alone. One day, on the way to visit her grandson, she unexpectedly saves Sophie and is introduced to the powerful Mr. Smith. Hiding his true identity, Smith impulsively marries Amy. During their life together, Amy is often bullied by her in-laws, but Smith always steps in to defend her, humiliating the bullies and helping her build a better life. Though Amy’s son is weak and not very capable, he is filial and kind-hearted. Eventually, when his wife’s family goes too far in mistreating Amy, he finally stands by his mother’s side. In the end, Amy discovers that Smith is actually the richest man in the city—and that Sophie is her long-lost daughter. At last, the family is reunited.

In My Cold-Hearted Mafia King movie, after her father's death, Vivian was abandoned by her stepmother Catherine and stepsister Olivia, then kidnapped and trafficked—until she was rescued by Damien Russo, the king of the mafia, and brought into his home. Despite their age gap, Vivian gradually develops feelings for Damien, while he struggles to resist the temptation. When an arranged marriage between Olivia and Damien is revealed, chaos ensues, putting their already complicated and budding romance to the ultimate test.

After quelling external disturbances, the best warrior of Republic of Valoria, Zoe Miller, returns to home. However, she discovers that her daughter has been mistreated by her relatives David's family. In a fit of rage, Zoe unleashes a massacre at the banquet, accidentally revealing herself to be the legendary Secretary of Defense. Later, she learned that her adopted son Jacob had already been betrayed by enemy spy Robert, and what was even more astonishing was that Mia's father, President Louis, was also deeply involved in a power vortex. With Mia critically injured and on the verge of death, can Zoe successfully protect her daughter?

book_title: Falling For My Ex's General Dad
special_desc: This story follows a naive yet kind-hearted American girl who travels to Russia in search of her husband, only to discover he is a notorious playboy. Stranded and endangered in a foreign land, she is rescued by a Russian general. Through their growing interactions, her fear of him gradually transforms into admiration and affection. However, in an unexpected twist, the Russian general she falls for turns out to be the father of her deceitful ex-husband. Where will their forbidden love lead them?

book_title: Wake Me Up, My First Love
special_desc: In Wake Me Up My First Love movie, Cathy, the fierce boss of the Scorpion Gang, falls into a coma after a staged car accident. When she wakes up, her family elders deceive her into bringing home Prince Alexander of Monaco as a sperm donor to secure an heir. Though they start off disliking each other, sparks slowly begin to fly. Neither of them realizes that Alexander is actually Cathy's long-lost childhood sweetheart—and they’ve been searching for each other all along.

In The Beast on Her Leash movie, to find evidence of Vincent's crimes—the murderer of her parents—Eliza accepts an invitation from Vincent's father to become the president of Evertech AI. Unexpectedly, the father imposes an additional condition: she must educate his youngest son, Ryder, who is as ferocious as a wild beast, into a civilized man. After agreeing, Eliza finds Ryder an extremely difficult man to handle, and the two often clash with intense tension. However, during their coexistence, Ryder falls in love with Eliza. When Eliza realizes she has feelings for Ryder too, she is forced to push him away in order to pursue Vincent's crimes. The entanglement among them is filled with ambiguity and excitement, where opportunities and dangers coexist.

book_title: Beg for My Return After Kicking Me Out
special_desc: The U.S. nuclear medical professor Charlie Clare quits his career for family, but is abandoned as his wife and daughter favor his love rival Isaac. After suffering his family’s ignorance, he decides to leave for the Unicorn Project, which he designed for healing his daughter’s neuro-skel birthmark as his life work. But unaware that Charlie’s burning his life for them, his wife and daughter deepen the rift with Charlie upon reunion and eventually destroy everything Charlie left for them with their own hands before realizing their errors, only to find it too late.

In Love Again At 40 movie, Emily, a janitor with minimum wage and a sick daughter to care for, flash marries her ex-boyfriend Mark Cardmon twenty years after he disappeared. And got his face reconfigured due to a car accident. However, neither Emily nor Mark suspected each other of being the person they knew before while falling with each other in love for the second time. Through helping Emily's daughter Selene with her surgery and fending Emily at work from toxic colleagues, Mark gradually realizes that Emily is his boyfriend and Selene is his daughter. Will they finally be able to get married now they are well into their 40s?

In Surrender to My Dangerous Boss movie, Clara was in trouble for her mother's medical expenses and was forced to be a barmaid. The powerful Elliott appeared and rescued her, bringing her into his own world. The two gradually developed feelings in a complex emotional and workplace environment. Elizabeth repeatedly framed Clara and tried to drive her out of Elliott's life. With Elliott's support, Clara gradually found herself and learned to face life bravely.
A thrilling law firm romance between a man who can erase all memories in the world and a cross-dressing woman who remembers everything.

In The Year in His Chains movie, when Anna's husband racks up a massive debt to dangerous mob boss Jeremy, she becomes the price - literally his property for one year. She expects cruelty from the notorious crime lord, but discovers something unexpected: a wounded man hiding behind his cold mask.
Her cheating husband wants her to seduce Jeremy for money. His controlling father wants her eliminated. But as Anna finds herself caught between lies and loyalty, she realizes the man who owns her might be the only one who truly sees her. Sometimes the chains that bind you are the only things that can set you free.

book_title: After Divorce, I Built A Fabulous Life
special_desc: In After Divorce I Built A Fabulous Life movie, once a talented designer, Mia married Tyler for love and became a housewife post-graduation. However, a three-year marriage ended with a divorce decree. Tyler's heartlessness makes Mia give up hope, leading her to reclaim her beloved career. Eventually, Mia shines in her passion, and Tyler realizes his true feelings, allowing them to rediscover love...

book_title: Taming the Mafia Boss, He's Mine Now!
special_desc: In Taming the Mafia Boss He's Mine Now movie: Leah, the daughter of the Cruz family, appears to be a "fierce delicate flower" who throws money around in nightclubs and acts in a cynical way on the surface. In reality, she is a down-and-out heir whose power was seized by her stepfather. During a misunderstanding, Leah, fueled by alcohol, generously spent a large sum of money and "kept" Allen, the "bankrupt noble young master" — little did she know that this man whom she could pin against the wall and whose shirt she tore open was actually the person in power of the Smith family, a mafia clan. A misunderstanding about "keeping someone" kicks off: He can wear an apron and cook dinner, and when she is framed by her stepsister Lisa, he will press the muzzle of a gun against the forehead of the enemy. She once thought that he was a person in distress who needed her protection, but when she herself was in trouble, she discovered that the overwhelming power of the Smith family could be casually wielded by him — she thought she was the hunter, but she didn't know that from the moment she pinned him against the locker, he was willing to shed all his disguises just for her... Let's see how Leah makes a comeback from the "sugar mommy" to become the wife of the mafia boss, staging an ultimate love story between two powerful individuals where "You hide your power to protect my vulnerable part, and I shed my thorns to give you my sincere heart."

In Cohabitating Lover full movie: Corinne, fleeing her wedding in her gown, and Andre both end up at an apartment leasing office due to the landlord's error and become reluctant roommates after arguing over who gets to stay. Later, Corinne lands a job at a rising advertising agency, only to discover Andre is her boss. A colleague grows suspicious of their relationship, spreads rumors, and while Andre defends Corinne, he asks her to keep their living situation a secret. Despite the rumors, they gradually fall in love. When Corinne's fiancé James appears and tries to get her back, she refuses and is subsequently slandered at work. To Corinne's dismay, Andre doesn't support her initially but secretly introduces her to a new project. They meet friends for dinner, leading to the friends falling for each other and revealing that Andre has been hiding something, which intensifies the conflict between him and Corinne. Corinne leaves the company and is found by James. Meanwhile, Andre's mother has also arranged a fiancée for him, causing their love to face numerous challenges.

In The Woman Starts The War movie, when nurse Cindy gets caught in a deadly mafia shootout, ruthless crime boss Allan D'Angelo saves her life by declaring she's his fiancée. Now she's a prisoner in his world - living in his mansion, wearing his ring, and playing a role that could get her killed.

Jennifer Sullivan, a lawyer, becomes a spy for Isaac Marks in order to save her sister. In the midst of love, hate and conspiracy, she gradually uncovers the truth of the arson case, and when the murderer is finally caught and Isaac reforms, Jennifer decides to let go of her past and make a fresh start with Isaac.

Vera and her husband Lucas once survived a life-or-death fire together. Yet years later, in their contractual marriage, Lucas—plagued by selective amnesia—failed to recognize that his wife was the "white moonlight" he’d never forgotten. Instead, he treated her with cold indifference and even pressed her for a divorce. Vera tried to reveal her true identity to Lucas, only to be sabotaged by her romantic rival. She narrowly escaped death in a car crash, but was rescued just in time by Victor, a powerful mafia boss—who soon realized Vera was his long-lost biological sister. Overnight, Vera—still suffering from memory loss—transformed into a globally dazzling mafia heiress. Meanwhile, Lucas, who’d seemed cold and heartless on the surface, began to act with "tsundere" reluctance: he couldn’t help but go to great lengths to win her back, embarking on an arduous, bittersweet journey to chase his wife. The two navigated countless predicaments—from a wealthy tycoon vying for Vera’s affection, to a two-faced rival scheming against her, and even a seemingly kind man setting traps for them—before finally clearing up their misunderstandings and committing to each other. Just as they found their way back to one another, however, the haunting doubt of "unexpectedly becoming a father" (to a child he didn’t initially recognize as his own) came crashing back…

book_title: Too Late for Love: 15 Days After Miscarriage
special_desc:
In Too Late for Love: 15 Days After Miscarriage movie, Iris and Benjamin were once the ultimate power couple—total relationship goals for everyone, and loaded to boot. They went from college sweethearts straight to tying the knot, and he even gave her a kidney to save her life, swearing he’d love her forever. But by their third year of marriage? Benjamin was hooking up with his mistress out in the open, no shame at all.

Crushed and done with his nonsense, Iris set a "15-day countdown" and quietly planned her divorce and escape. But his pathetic lies and the mistress’s bold-faced disrespect pushed her over the edge—she lost the baby. Completely broken, she finally took off, all by herself.

Benjamin had no clue how much he’d hurt her until she was gone. That’s when his brutal "redemption tour" started—you know, when someone messes up bad and then begs for forgiveness, but it’s already too late. He offered a reward worldwide to find her, but Iris outsmarted him at every turn. His career and reputation? Gone in a flash.

Even after he dumped the mistress, got on his knees to beg for mercy, and took a knife for Iris (ending up seriously hurt), he couldn’t melt her cold heart. In the end, he just had to watch—lonely and full of regret—as she built a new, happy life. And that’s when he finally got it: "Belated love ain’t worth squat"—affection that shows up too late? It’s totally useless.

The story follows Leilani, whose adoptive father has been framed by her ex-boyfriend. Desperate for help, she turns to the one man she trusts the least—Diego Marlowe, a ruthless, undefeated attorney who also happens to be her enemy’s future brother-in-law. What begins as a dangerous deal and a fake relationship soon spirals into a high-stakes game of power, secrets, and irresistible attraction. As they use each other to navigate the battles surrounding them, one question lingers: Is Diego truly just her lawyer—or something far more dangerous to her heart?

Woo-Yeon, a second-generation chaebol, starts an internship at her father's company, where she works with Jae-Hwan, a notoriously prickly but highly capable and sexy boss. She soon discovers that Jae-Hwan’s wife, Ji-Su, was the one who bullied her in the past. Determined to get revenge, Woo-Yeon decides to make Jae-Hwan her own man.

In How To Trap President's Son movie, in a world where money rules everything, he’s the President’s son - a handsome, spoiled playboy above the law. She’s just a cleaning lady with a dream and… a mop. One accidental kiss turns into a media scandal, and suddenly they’re forced to fake a romance for the public.
Ada, a math genius reclaimed by the noble Selivis family, is treated as an outsider and framed by her scheming sister. But they picked the wrong genius to cross.

The mysterious secret agent Peter Rogers was awarded the National Medal of Honor by the President and had retired from the military. While dining out with his daughter Leslie, Peter is mistaken for a blind date by the beautiful CEO Sydney Greenfield, and the two unexpectedly get married. When his classmate and ex-girlfriend, who were unaware of Peter's true identity, encountered him again, they subjected him to various insults and ridicule. Upon hearing about this, Sydney publicly revealed that Peter was her husband, putting everyone to shame.

Jung Se-jung, the ghost laundromat owner who helps ghosts find peace, meets bachelor ghost Ma Do joon who can't find peace no matter what he tries. A romance between a human and ghost who struggle together to help him find peace

book_title: A Relationship Kept in The Dark
special_desc: In A Relationship Kept in The Dark movie, renowned photographer Jane falls for rookie model Hector, unaware he's the heir to a business empire. Hector hides his identity to win her heart, but jealousy and misunderstandings drive them apart. When Jane’s life falls apart, Hector steps in secretly to help—and later reveals his true self with a grand gesture of love and a proposal.

book_title: My Sunset Love Affair with the Billionaire CEO
special_desc: Middle-aged and jobless, Jennifer loses both her pension and home to her greedy son and daughter-in-law. In a desperate attempt to turn things around, she joins a dating reality show, The Diamond Bachelor—only to meet the mysterious and charming Paul Marshall. Unbeknownst to her, Paul is a CEO hiding his true identity. Moved by Jennifer’s kindness and independence, he proposes, and they marry in a whirlwind romance. But to protect Jennifer, who despises lies and deceit, Paul and his stepdaughter Emma keep their wealthy background a secret. Together, they fiercely shield Jennifer from those who wish her harm—including her own son. Through family conflicts and emotional twists, Jennifer eventually uncovers Paul’s real identity... and the shocking truth: Emma is her long-lost daughter. A dramatic journey leads to heartfelt reunion and healing.

She was an ordinary school teacher. After discovering her husband’s affair, she angrily divorced him, only to be mysteriously kidnapped while on the run. Upon waking, she is told that she has been mistaken for the deceased leader of a powerful crime syndicate and is forced to take control of the underground empire. To survive, she must navigate both the criminal underworld and the law, all while secretly investigating the conspiracy behind this case of mistaken identity. When the true culprit’s identity is revealed, she discovers that this impersonation scheme is shockingly linked to her own origins.

book_title: From One Night to Mrs. Billionaire
special_desc: In From One Night to Mrs. Billionaire movie: Claudia is the adopted daughter of the richest man, Kaden. She drugged and framed Anastasia, wanting to ruin her reputation and divorce her husband Lucius. However, Anastasia was rescued by the drunk Kaden by mistake and became pregnant with Kaden's only child. Clarissa, relying on her status as the richest man's adopted daughter, was arrogant and domineering, targeting Anastasia at the company and at the banquet, but she didn't know that Kaden had taken Anastasia home to take care of her and fell in love with her. In the end, Claudia's true identity was also discovered by Kaden...

She sacrificed her career for her husband, only to discover he was cheating and secretly transferring marital assets. To gather evidence for a divorce, she guided her husband's mistress to see his true colors and convinced her to cooperate. Will the alliance between these two rivals be unbreakable or filled with jealousy?

In Love On the Sidelines movie, Natalie had it all—engaged to football star Karl and carrying his child—until tragedy struck. Her brother caused Karl’s sister’s death, and Karl’s injuries ended his career. Yet, she vanished for seven years. Now, Karl sees her with a "husband" and "daughter," seemingly happy. But he won’t let her go.

In Accidentally Pregnant Forever Spoiled movie: since childhood, Ella has lived with her remarried mother and stepfather after her parents divorced. She endured indifference and abuse in her stepfather's household. After her mother passed away, her stepfather and half-brother treated Ella as nothing more than a tool to make money. Her stepfather even spent all of her college tuition, forcing her to work part-time to pay for her education. While working at a bar, Ella was drugged by a customer, but was rescued by a drunken Edward, leading to a one-night stand. Two months later, Ella discovered she was pregnant! Her stepfather, wanting to sell her off for a good price, attempted to force her into having an abortion. In a critical moment, Edward arrived in time to save Ella and brought her home, offering her care and protection. However, due to her low status, Ella faced insults from Edward's sister and bullying at school. A wealthy heiress, who also had her eyes on Edward, threatened her as well. Yet, Edward remained firm in his commitment to protect her. After overcoming multiple challenges, Ella transformed from a timid, self-conscious girl into a brave and strong woman, gradually winning Edward’s heart. She safely gave birth to their child, and years later, became a brilliant AI researcher.

book_title: Never Too Late to Love You
special_desc: Ariel, a medical aesthetics sales rep, reunites with her college crush Evan during a clinic visit. As work forces them together, old feelings resurface, but romantic rivals and past misunderstandings stand in their way. When Ariel becomes the face of her company’s products, she rises to fame—until Evan’s fiancée, Sienna, frames her, turning public admiration into scandal. Can Ariel reclaim her love and reputation?

In Love at Dangerous Speeds movie, when Violet flees her abusive fiancé on their wedding day, she hides with Marcus, a notorious street racer. Their protection-for-a-kiss deal ignites into passion, giving her the freedom she craves. Then Marcus confesses a dark secret: the hit-and-run accident that haunts him killed Violet's father. Will she forgive the man who stole her heart but destroyed her family, or return to the controlling life she desperately tried to escape?

book_title: Attractive Model is a Billionaire CEO
special_desc: In Attractive Model is a Billionaire CEO movie: on the night of her divorce, Selina's best friend ordered the top escort, Morgan, at a high-end club. Morgan claimed to be a professional male model, while Selina pretended to be an unemployed office worker. It wasn't until Selina started working at ZT Group that she noticed the new president had the same scratch marks on his neck as that night, and his magnetic voice was all too familiar. At the merger meeting, he threw Selina's proposal in front of her ex-husband and saying: "After all, your wife... no, your ex-wife's taste is indeed much more refined than your lover's."

book_title: Boss, Your Wife's a Whole Detective!
special_desc: After a flash marriage arranged by her late mother’s best friend, Jenny waits three years for her husband Charles, who left abroad right after the wedding. When he returns, misunderstandings, accusations, and missed chances drive them toward divorce. Just as Jenny is framed by rivals, Charles steps in to protect her, but new twists and family schemes continue to keep them apart.

book_title: The Mafia Boss Happens to Be My Sex Partner
special_desc:
In The Mafia Boss Happenes to Be My Sex Partner movie, Fiona Shaw's life of luxury shattered when her family's empire collapsed, leaving her burdened with a crushing $500 million debt. To save what's left of her family, she agrees to a cold-hearted bargain: a marriage of convenience to Henry Sterling, the second son of a powerful business dynasty.  

But behind the glamour of high society lies a painful truth. Henry is gay, deeply in love with his male secretary, Louis, and indifferent to Fiona. He married for one reason alone—to produce an heir under his mother Elizabeth's pressure, secure the family fortune, and defeat his rival half-brother, Jeff.  

Now, trapped in a loveless marriage and yearning for freedom, Fiona finds herself drawn into a dangerous affair… with a man whose secrets are even deadlier than her own.

book_title: Desired by Two: the Vampire and the Hunter
special_desc: I'm a disaster. One minute I'm spilling coffee on my ridiculously hot boss, Simon, the next I'm discovering I have a secret power I can't control. My world is a mess of spilled coffee and tangled feelings, and I'm caught between two unbelievably hot guys. Simon, my mysterious boss, is as alluring as he is dangerous - a vampire who promises to teach me to harness my magic. Then there's Michael, my kind and loyal best friend. But he's hiding a deadly secret: he's a hunter sworn to destroy everything Simon stands for. They both want me. And as my magic gets more powerful, so does the fire burning between us. How can I choose when they both know my darkest secrets?

book_title: The Fighter Who Stole My Pulse
special_desc:
Mia's impulsive kiss with mysterious bartender Troy pulls her into the violent underground fighting world where he reigns undefeated. When she saves his opponent's life during a police raid, their dangerous attraction ignites. 
But Troy harbors a devastating secret. His manipulative girlfriend Amanda uses this pain as a weapon, while crime boss Serge plots revenge for his own dark reasons. 
When Mia is kidnapped and used as bait to destroy Troy in the ring, she must save the man she loves from becoming the monster he fears. In this brutal world, love becomes the ultimate fight for redemption. 
He stole her pulse. She might save his soul.

When the British heir dies suddenly, a modern royal family spirals into chaos. Party-loving twins Prince Liam and Princess Eleanor are forced to grow up fast—Liam is thrust toward the crown while falling for Ophelia, the palace security chief’s American daughter, and Eleanor hits rock bottom after a dangerous betrayal. As King Simon grieves and the monarchy teeters, ruthless Queen Helena joins forces with scheming Prince Cyrus to keep control at any cost. A dynasty built on glamour is about to face its darkest reckoning. Buy full season: https://www.lionsgate.com/shows/the-royals/the-royals-season-1

The CEO rushes to the airport to welcome the doctor (female lead), who’s coming to the capital to give birth. But on the plane, she runs into his son and mother. His son steals her belongings, destroys her blueprints and chips, and causes her so much stress that she goes into early labor. Meanwhile, the CEO waits at the airport, only to find her seriously injured upon arrival—while his son and mother stand by, smirking.

Renowned Seston physician Max Holt is tasked by Xonos's most powerful family, the Judds, with delivering a life-saving kidney from Valia to Xonos within three hours for John Judd. On the flight, he unexpectedly crosses paths with Jane Yale, the Judds' future daughter-in-law. Tensions rise as Jane and her mother exploit the Judds' influence—jeopardizing John's life.

Mindy Louis was adopted by the Louis family. She used to have three loving brothers and a sweet family. But after Claire Louis, 'the biological daughter' came back, everything changed. Those misunderstandings and harms made her desperate. To repay their upbringing, she decided to be a volunteer for Sleeping Mindy Plan, her brother Gavin's project. She even donated her cornera to her brother Mike. When her family found out the truth, they were so regretful. After thirty years of sleeping, Mindy woke up again but forgot everything...

On the day Felix learns his wife Stella is pregnant, he also discovers she's having an affair with Kyle, a poor student he's been secretly supporting. And apparently, the child isn't his.
Instead of lashing out, Felix stays calm and spends the next twenty years carefully plotting his revenge. Now, it's time for Stella and Kyle to pay.

New police academy graduate Misty takes on a daring mission to infiltrate the 'Divine Marriage' ritual in Florals Village. Posing as a Florals Maiden, she dives into the mysterious Florals Cave, outsmarting a criminal syndicate, exposing the village chief's human trafficking operation, and rescuing her sister Lara and other captives.

book_title: XXL Hubby's Rise: Reborn to Destroy My Ex! (English-dubbed)
special_desc: In a past life, Jackson was head over heels for Yvonne, the driver's daughter. But she loved Ivor, and together they schemed to end Jackson's life. Now reborn, Jackson turns to Iris, his secret admirer, and vows to bring Yvonne and Ivor's dreams crashing down. As he exacts his revenge, he finds true happiness with Iris.

book_title: Oops, Roomie, You Picked the Wrong Girl! (English-dubbed)
special_desc: Aurora Lee wakes up reborn on her first day of college, memories intact of being betrayed and murdered by her best friend, Phoebe Bowen. This time, the real heiress hides her identity while Phoebe—the imposter—invites everyone on a luxurious overseas trip, secretly plotting to steal Aurora's fortune again. As Aurora plays along with Phoebe's deception, she maneuvers to unmask the truth in a deadly game of revenge where everyone is a pawn, and no one leaves unchanged.

Talia Stone comes from a wealthy family. Her dad is a billionaire and her three brothers are bigwigs in the military, showbiz and finance world. She saved her childhood friend Jack Chase in an accident and almost lost her legs. Talia's legs were saved by top doctors in the field, but she remained in a wheelchair at her dad's request, as a test for Jack's feelings.
