The day before their wedding, Talia found out Jack was cheating with her friend Rachel. Enraged by the pair's brazen denial, Talia pretended to turn the other cheek while setting up a plan to humiliate them at the wedding. She then met Aiden Brooks who got her purse back from a thief and asked him half-jokingly to marry her. To her surprise, Aiden said yes. The next day, Talia's supposed wedding turned into a big stage for drama.

Falsely accused of treason, Stacey Lonoff was put behind bars by her husband, General Gordie Patzer. To avenge his childhood sweetheart Ciara Rede, Gordie tortured the pregnant Stacey to death, having no idea the true traitor was Ciara herself. But fate gave Stacey a second chance. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself back to the fateful day a month ago when everything began to unravel! In this life, she swore to protect her country and make Gordie and Ciara pay!

Keira Smith grew up in a happy family, loved and doted on by her parents and elder brother Joshua. Her world came apart when Ruby, their true biological daughter, was taken home. Keira was cast aside and later accused of pushing her grandmother down the stairs. She was sent to a reform school, bullied and tortured for two whole years. The experience changed Keira as a person, mentally and physically.

After a spontaneous first meeting, they got married right away. She secretly works as a janitor at his company while facing bullying and jealousy from coworkers. As the company president, he quietly protects her whenever she's in danger—but how long can they keep their secret?

book_title: The Fallen God & His Mute Muse (English-dubbed)
special_desc: Levi Tran, an immortal, is reborn to escape a massive debt. He awakens in a gambler's body, only to find his mute wife's voice stolen. Now, will he be able to give the woman her voice back with his mortal body?

"For a decade, Ruby Nicholson, a brilliant gynecologist, had been shackled in a loveless marriage to her scumbag husband, Kyle Lane. Barren and unable to conceive, she endured relentless torment from his venomous mother, Jennifer Lane, who never missed a chance to belittle her. Kyle had been entangled in a steamy affair with a younger woman, Freya Riley, who was now pregnant with his child. It was in the hospital that Ruby stumbled upon the gut-wrenching truth.
Confronted by the treachery, the taunts, and the suffocating oppression, Ruby launched a breathtaking counterattack. Armed with the law, the power of public opinion, and her razor-sharp professional skills, she was determined to expose Kyle and his family. With every step, she clawed back her stolen wealth and her shattered dignity.
And then there was Maxwell Smith, an internet celebrity and paparazzo who'd been quietly adoring her from afar. With him, Ruby lived a life painted in hues of hope and love."

Rae's dream was to be a pilot. But when she found out that she was pregnant, she married her boyfriend and settled down as a housewife. Seven years later, while on her husband's flight, Rae discovered his secret: he had been keeping a mistress for years. Adding to the horror was the plane crashing in a thunderstorm; it seemed that certain death awaited them... Until she found herself going back in time with her memories intact. Now, Rae must make new choices to rewrite her future... before it's too late!

Leah Turner secretly married Cyril Stosur for seven years before holding their six-year-old daughter Anna for the first time that evening. While Anna was ecstatic, Cyril understood Leah's sudden affection stemmed solely from her reunited first love. Seven years earlier, Leah had married Cyril impulsively after her true love abandoned her. Throughout their marriage, she remained emotionally absent, avoiding family interactions and forbidding Anna from calling her Mom. The final blow came when Anna witnessed Leah showering attention on her ex-lover's daughter while persistently neglecting her. This stark contrast crushed Anna's remaining hope, driving the heartbroken child to leave permanently.

book_title: Fate Reborn: Switched to True Love (English-dubbed)
special_desc:
In her past life, Samantha married Iain, a penniless man who later rose to wealth and success, while her sister Nina married military officer Evan and went mad after Evan died shortly after their wedding. Blinded by jealousy, Nina killed Samantha and was killed in return.
Now, the sisters are reborn.
This time, Nina plots to steal Iain. But she doesn’t know that Samantha also remembers everything. This time, she's already saved Evan's life and is on her way to an even better future.

The Female General has always supported her husband, while her father and brother sacrificed their lives in war to save him. Yet, her ungrateful husband not only shows no appreciation but brings another woman home, planning to marry her. Devastated, the General divorces him and begins to turn the tables. Everything she once gave him—career, money—she now demands back, with interest.

After a one-night stand, the woman’s sister steals her identity. Six years later, she becomes the CEO’s legal advisor, and they grow close. The sister, fearing exposure, tries to sabotage her, but the CEO thwarts each attempt. In the end, the truth is revealed, and the CEO’s family reunites.

book_title: Back to the Ring: My KO Mom (English-dubbed)
special_desc: The boxing queen, Tanya Boyle, retires at the peak of her career for love. Unknown to all, Tanya marries Wesley Thomas and devotes herself to looking after the family. Unfortunately, she gets stomach cancer. So, Wesley’s mother introduces a lady to Wesley. Tanya is heartbroken but offers her blessings. After being reborn, Tanya cherishes her health and fights for happiness. But she ends up divorcing Wesley. Then, Tanya rebuilds her life and returns to boxing. At this time, she discovers Wesley’s new girlfriend, Yolanda Lopez, is lying about being the boxing queen. So, Tanya decides to regain her glory. Wesley looks down upon Tanya when fighting her. He even persuades her to quit the game. However, Tanya ignores Wesley and defeats him. Wesley is shocked, and everyone finds out Tanya is the boxing queen. Wesley regrets losing his idol. But Tanya has changed a lot. She only wants to live her life.

book_title: I Gave My wife A Red Tasseled Spear (English-dubbed)
special_desc:
After three years on the battlefield, the wife returns victorious, but unexpectedly pregnant! The former Grand Marshal of the empire's army had retired due to his parents' last wishes and married a woman known for her bravery and ambition. She aspired to achieve greatness on the battlefield, and before she left, he gifted her a legendary spear forged from thousand-year-old cold iron.

Three years later, she returns clad in silver armor, pregnant, and holding another man's hand. She presents a letter of divorce, declaring, "My husband must be a heroic figure who stands tall, not a weak scholar with no strength."

Unbeknownst to her, the seemingly powerless man she had married was actually the empire’s guardian deity. When he dons his marshal armor once again and takes up his legendary weapon, she finally realizes the true identity of the man she once scorned.

Ethan Smith holds the title of the youngest scientist on Earth. However, contrary to expectations, his life is marred by family conflicts and tragedy. After being reborn, he chooses to distance himself from his family and live for himself. This time, Ethan refuses to be weak. He not only proves his brilliance to his family but also to his deskmate, his school, and ultimately, the entire world—showcasing that he is a genius who will not be underestimated.

Jealous of Mitch Harmon for his luxurious life, Javier Harmon attacked Mitch with a knife, and the cousins both died. But when they opened their eyes, they were back on the fateful wedding night in 1977 that had set their lives on diverging paths! With memories of his last life, Javier married Patsy Reeves, the adopted girl, instead of switching brides with Mitch. He thought he could steal Mitch's future—but only sank deeper into misery. Meanwhile, Mitch built a life richer in love, purpose, and success than before with Margie.

After the divorce, her ex-husband saw her as a regular Cinderella, unaware of her wealth. Back home, her billionaire brothers embraced her. Her ex even wrongly thought she had a sugar daddy. When the truth emerged, she made everyone regret underestimating her.

After barely surviving her family’s attempt to kill and bury her, a powerful female CEO loses her memory and is left with the mind of a young child. Wandering the streets as a beggar, she’s taken in by a seemingly frail but influential CEO. The two enter a whirlwind marriage, only to face constant humiliation from his family. A heated clash with his stepmother unexpectedly restores her memories, but she chooses to keep her true identity hidden...

book_title: After Breakup, Spoiled by Three Big Shot Brothers (English-dubbed)
special_desc: On the eve of her wedding, she was dumped by her fiancé. However, at the engagement party, she was recognized by three big-shot brothers as their long-lost younger sister. It turns out she's a wealthy heiress! From then on, those who bullied her would face the wrath of her brothers!

To escape the marriage her mother forced upon her, Nicole Smith boldly sleeps with a stranger and runs away from home with a baby bump. Five years later, she's a devoted single mom to her son, Danny Smith. Just as their life struggles, Marcus Jansen steps into her life, determined to win her heart. Yet, his childhood sweetheart, Zoey Reeves, seethes with jealousy and keeps causing trouble. Little do they know, Marcus is the father of Nicole's son, and her true identity holds even more surprises...
As a seasoned gambler and master of the game, I've seen it all. Here's a simple truth: steer clear of gambling. In this world, nine out of ten bets are a con.

When she was young, she witnessed her parents' death. Fifteen years later, she became a general, defending her country, and after triumphantly returning home, she intended to uncover the truth about her past, only to unexpectedly find her grandfather's family being mistreated. The events from years ago seemed not so simple after all.

She died in the year he loved her most. With a billion-dollar fortune, he threw it all away, choosing to follow her in death. When she opens her eyes again, she’s back to the years when she despised him. With a bitter smile, he says, “Want a divorce? Over my dead body.”

book_title: CEO Daddy Spoils His Wife Sweetly (English-dubbed)
special_desc: Since childhood, she bore her parents' disapproval due to a birthmark on her face. Unexpectedly, she saved him from being drugged, and miraculously, the birthmark vanished. Grateful, he planned a billion-dollar gift and proposed marriage.

book_title: My Bestie Wants My One-Night Stand CEO (English-dubbed)
special_desc:
I was mistakenly sent to the bed of a billionaire by my best friend. Afther the steamy night, he was looking for me all over the city. 
However, my best friend betrayed me for his incredible wealth and disguised herself as me.
But when I successfully passed the interview of the company, why did this billionaire boss look so familiar? Could he find out I was the girl from that night...

Heiress Joy Quinn hides her identity and cuts ties with her family to marry broke boyfriend Ryan Zimmer. But just as she's about to give birth, betrayal strikes. With the baby in the wrong position, Joy checks into a private hospital. But Ryan's best friend Yasmine accuses her of faking it for luxury. Manipulated, Ryan tries to move Joy to a cheaper clinic, sparking explosive drama. Just then, Joy's father, billionaire Raymond Quinn, arrives bearing lavish gifts. But Ryan and Yasmine mock him, refusing to believe his identity. As three elite CEOs show up honor Quinn, the truth is revealed. But it's already too late. Joy loses the baby and demands a divorce. Desperate, Ryan spreads lies online, accusing Joy and her father of murdering the child. The internet turns vicious. Raymond strikes back with evidence, and calls the police. In the end, Ryan and Yasmine are convicted and sentenced.

book_title: Underworld King Fights For His Wife (English-dubbed)
special_desc:
Upon discovering my true identity, my ex-wife deeply regretted her actions! 
I was originally the great master, but after meeting my wife, I chose to hide my identity and live as an ordinary worker on a construction site. However, once on our wedding anniversary, while I waited eagerly, she was celebrating a birthday in a wealthy household!
Unable to tolerate it any longer, I divorced her. At a banquet later on, I revealed my true identity, only to be met with skepticism from the crowd. Just as doubts arose, my subordinates finally arrived, confirming my powerful status!

book_title: CEO, That Intern is Actually Your Wife (English-dubbed)
special_desc:
My billionaire CEO is my contract-married husband! 
My grandmother fell seriously ill, so I flash-married a stranger for her surgery fees. We entered a one-year contract marriage. I bumped into a handsome man, who I later found out was the CEO of the company I wanted to join! But little did I know, he was the man I married...
As the contract period nears its end, we are supposed to divorce. However, both of us lost our marriage certificates. Now what do we do? Does this mean we can't get divorced after all?

After an unexpected encounter, she gave birth to a son. Six years later, the man from that one-night stand learns the truth and begins searching for the child. In the process, she accidentally crosses paths with him, leading to a series of humorous and contentious interactions. In the end, the son reunites with his paternal family, and they all begin a life filled with happiness and togetherness.

"I shouldn't have ever saved you and brought you up this mountain!" My teacher scolded me for ruining his precious ingredients to make the divine medicine, but later was surprised at the outcome, that I successfully made it out! I am an orphan, study divine skilled with my teacher, and now come down the mountain to gain experiences. On the first day, I meet a girl, and saved her fatehr's life. Little did I know, they are my lost family, and little did they know, I'm a powerful figure with strong ability!

In a romance-themed observation show, several participants undergo a series of interactions and conflicts filled with love, misunderstandings, and power struggles. In the end, one couple rises to overwhelming popularity, and true love prevails as they happily end up together.

Susan married Cyrus, believing her "tough luck" could balance his "bad luck." But the cold truth is his heart belonged to someone else.
She kept her feelings hidden, focused on paying off her parents' debts, and made the most of the marriage. When Cyrus's dream girl came back, Susan decided to walk away.
To win her back, Cyrus made her his assistant, guarded her fiercely at work, and fought for the marriage she wanted to forget. In the end, love wins out, and so does Susan.

book_title: Marrying A Millionaire with My Baby (English-dubbed)
special_desc: The framed CEO had sex with the woman, but the person who framed him arranged a scumbag man to lie that he had sex with the woman in order to escape the blame. After the woman gave birth to quadruplets, she was told that only one child survived. Many years later, the scumbag man got a promotion and got the woman's house, so he kicked the woman out of the house. At this time, the woman and the CEO reunited...

Seven years ago, a chance encounter in Wesley Lowe's hotel room turned Alaya's world upside down. That fateful night led to the birth of twins, but tragedy struck when her father took one child, leaving her with only Tommy. Now, Alaya returns home with Tommy, determined to find her lost child. As fate would have it, she crosses paths with Wesley once more, but neither realizes the other's true identity...

Village doctor, Ava Fleming, works hard to support her fiancé Luke Bax through college, only to discover that he has secretly married and started a family in the city. Determined to cut ties with Luke, Ava inadvertently saves the life of a powerful figure, Jesse Mills, who falls in love with her at first sight and proposes. To Ava's surprise, the ruthless Jesse is actually a gentle and obedient partner at home...

A genius pianist has an accident during a performance and wakes up in a novel she read, becoming the despised secondary female character. Using her knowledge of the story, she realizes she's never been favored in her family and strives to change her fate by confronting a deceitful man and gaining the favor of a key male figure, altering her original life path.

book_title: The Wife I Despised Is My First Love?! (English-dubbed)
special_desc: Lily, a blind girl, found her boyfriend Brian cheated on her. She accidentally slept with the richest man, Albert Morgan. After becoming pregnant, Brian forced her to demand money from Albert. Under Albert's grandmother's pressure, Albert married Lily. After marriage, Albert despised Lily while searching for his childhood savior, unaware that the true savior was his hated wife. When Lily regained her sight, another woman Gloria appeared. Gloria pretended to be Albert's childhood savior, and bullied Lily...

book_title: My Rise To Power After She Left (English-dubbed)
special_desc: Betrayed by his wife, Yvonne, and left with nothing, Lennox Hayes suddenly inherits ancient powers that change his destiny. When Amelia Langford—heiress to the powerful Langford family of Grimwood—reveals their long-lost engagement, Lennox must navigate a dangerous new world of cultivation and conspiracy. From the streets of Riverain to the heights of Grimwood's elite, he'll prove that even the most broken can rise to rule.

book_title: Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors (English-dubbed)
special_desc: In Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors movie, Ivory, a secret billionaire heiress, has invested her time and money in growing her husband. After three years of marriage, her husband, Nelson, changed. He openly embraced another woman. This made Ivory divorce him. Now revealing her identity and being pursued by three wealthy suitors vying for her affection, Ivory navigates her single life.

"After four years of secret love and six years of marriage, you repay me with this?"
During our six years of marriage, I worked tirelessly at home like a servant. Yet my husband wanted to drive me away because of his first love's return！ Unable to endure it any longer, I chose to divorce him. 
When we meet again, I’m already a confident businesswoman negotiating at the table, and also a returned heiress, and he is no longer worthy to stand by my side.

Corrie Scott, a delivery girl who happened to help an old man. To repay her mother's medical debts, she married his grandson, Charles Francis. Charles is the richest man. At the beginning, he thought this girl was a gold digger, so he hid his true identity. As they lived together, their feelings grew deeper. But his lie gradually became a time bomb, and his childhood sweetheart also came back. Will Charles and Corrie get a happy ending?

After being set up by her own family, Nora Wood becomes pregnant with Tyler Holt's child, who is later named Bryan. Unfortunately, when Bryan turns five, he is diagnosed with leukemia. In an effort to cover medical expenses, Nora decides to sell the family jade pendant Tyler had given her, triggering a city-wide search for Bryan by the Holt family. Meanwhile, Nora joins Holt Group as Tyler's secretary. As they work closely together, their feelings for each other grow, and their relationship flourishes over time.

Audrey's biggest regret? A one-night stand with Floyd, her secret love for eight years. Despite his arranged marriage and his family's troubles, he kept rescuing her. She thought she was just a fling, but he was already head over heels for her...

He's a successful young CEO, and I'm the overweight woman everyone looks down on. Our marriage was a laughingstock, and he never respected me. Fed up with the mockery and humiliation, I decided to transform myself. When I returned as a sexy bombshell, everyone, including my husband, was stunned.
She was framed to death, and he misrecognized their daughter. Given another life, she is going to protect her love ones, and punish the bad!

Trapped in a decade-long nightmare of family control, she meets a man who seems like the perfect way out. At first, she uses him to escape, but his unconditional trust and devotion slowly melt her guarded heart. What begins as a calculated plan turns into an unexpected journey of love, healing, and finding the strength to start anew.

Jocelyn gave up her tech career for marriage, only to be betrayed and forced to serve her husband's mistress. She divorces him, takes back her patents, and tanks his company overnight. After a flash marriage with her former rival Steven, she returns to the tech world and rises higher than ever, leaving her ex with nothing.

Forensic expert Vivian Smith, shamed for her job, accidentally sleeps with tycoon Ethan Parker—her ex’s uncle. A contractual marriage sparks chaos: their "stench solidarity" masks lethal secrets. As family feuds, conspiracies, and desire collide, they fight prejudice and lies, healing each other’s wounds. Can love survive autopsy tables and boardrooms?

book_title: Love After Rebirth: Spoiled by My Husband's Uncle (English-dubbed)
special_desc: In her past life, she was betrayed and killed by her husband. Now reborn, she finds herself back on the day they met each other's families. This time, she makes a bold choice—she leaves her husband-to-be and chooses his powerful, enigmatic uncle instead. Despite rumors about his supposed shortcomings, their union quickly blossoms into a life filled with unexpected surprises, including triplets!
Her fiancé is snatched by her sister, then she flash-marries a trillionaire and gets showered with love!

After enduring a seven-year relationship, the couple ultimately breaks up due to various misunderstandings and betrayals. Subsequently, one partner completely loses the other to an idealized love, leading to a profound realization. Determined to make amends, he attempts to win her back through various means.

book_title: After Being Reborn, I Got Married to My Ex-boyfriend’s Uncle (English-dubbed)
special_desc: In a past life, I wed my childhood sweetheart, Drake Elledge, only to find heartbreak as he remained tangled with his first love, resulting in a tragic end for me and our unborn child. Little did I know, his uncle had been silently in love with me for seven years. Now, with a second chance at life, I refuse to repeat the past. When my mother asks if I'll marry Drake, I say no and choose Jace, sparking a new journey fraught with Drake's relentless attempts to win me back...

Celia meticulously planned a family trip, only to have her husband Vince cancel her ticket at the last minute so his childhood friend Dana could join them. Realizing her years of unappreciated efforts, Celia embarks on a journey of revenge and self-discovery...

In their past lives, Ivy and Daisy were both at the orphanage, waiting to be chosen by prospective parents. Daisy opted for a wealthy family, while Ivy joined a humble cleaner's household. Yet, Patrick Vance, the heir of the affluent family, was drawn to Ivy's independence. Consumed by jealousy, Daisy killed Ivy and then took her own life at their wedding. Reborn on the day of the selection, Daisy decides against the wealthy path, hoping to replicate Ivy's fate. However, she soon discovers that the cleaner's family is far from the paradise she imagined...

For seven years, Elle Gold secretly helped Joe Judd build DK Corp into a successful company. On their wedding day, pregnant and ready to reveal the truth, she is humiliated by Joe. In an attempt to please his first love, Sue Cole, Joe allows Sue to steal Elle’s spotlight by wearing a wedding dress. Elle endures their cruelty time and again, only to discover that Joe and Sue are having an affair. Worse, Joe believes Sue’s lie that she’s the founder of DK Corp. Devastated, Elle demands a divorce. With Carl Irwin’s help, she plans her revenge. At the signing banquet, she exposes her true identity, pulls her investments, and watches as Joe crumbles in regret.

book_title: My Fiancée Carried My Brother's Child — I Married Another (English-dubbed)
special_desc: Elliot and his fiancée Betty were getting married. But Betty cheated on him and carried his brother's baby. Elliot felt very frustrated. But Betty still wanted to marry him and take away his house. Elliot rejected her and chose to marry a rich heiress, Amelia. Betty thought she got a successful career on her own. Actually, it was all Elliot's credit. In the end, Betty regretted it and tried to win Elliot back, but it was too late. Elliot was in love with Amelia...

Student Body President Kaden Russell just made an enemy of Star Quarterback Donovan Miller. When the two clash over school activity funds, Donovan goes too far with a cruel remark. As revenge, Kaden dyes the football uniforms rainbow. But when the prank gets Donovan injured during a game, Kaden is sentenced to serve as Donovan’s “waterboy”. The forced proximity stirs up feelings Donovan never expected, and when their rivalry turns romantic, both boys have to decide what they’re willing to risk for love.

Kate's always fantasized about a sexy man who will dominate her in the bedroom, but finding one is way easier said than done. Until Catacombs' notorious Master, Banner Jennings, offers to help her find the perfect Dom. But once he finds her sexual match, will he be willing to let her go?

In Pregnant by My Ex's Dad movie, Lucia's boyfriend cheats on her with her best friend, Brooklyn. It was a day to their residency, and catching them cheating broke Lucia. Pregnant by My Ex's Dad trailer shows Lucia lost in the arms of her ex's dad a few hours later. What she didn't know was that one encounter with him would lead to her getting pregnant.

After a job interview doesn’t pan out the way Stella Evans plans, she’s desperate to save her house and her mom. When Aston Montgomery gives her the offer of a lifetime — pretend to be his fiancée and mother of his love child in exchange for paying off her debts — she has no choice but to take it. Though it’s all temporary, Stella and Aston soon lose sight of what’s pretend and what’s real. Will Stella always be the borrowed bride, or will she win over the billionaire?
In Alpha's Regret movie, Lila's fated mate, the rival alpha, rejected her. Now, he's back, wanting her and a second chance. But can she trust him...especially when she's hiding their son?

In The Senator's Son movie, Emma Andrews wants to lead a quiet life in college, but that’s impossible when Zach Walker, son of a famous senator and the hottest guy on campus, targets her for relentless bullying. When they end up locked in a boathouse overnight (in their underwear!), Emma discovers more to this bully than she thought.

When high school swim team captain Aidan Crew loses his essential after-school job due to his rich bully Will Harrison standing up for him to his boss, he has no idea how he's going to pay his mother's substantial medical bills and rebuild his college fund, until Will offers Aidan a humiliating, but lucrative job as his pool boy. Aidan reluctantly takes the gig and the two start to fall for one another, but they must navigate the hatred between their families and vicious school bullies, while protecting the secret of Aidan's pool boy gig and the feelings building between them.

book_title: My Billionaire Husband Doesn't Remember Me
special_desc: Emma and Cameron were once in love until a fire tore them apart. Years later, Cameron returns seeking revenge, believing Emma betrayed him. After an accident causes him to lose his memory, he thinks Emma is his wife. Can their love survive the secrets, or is it too late for a second chance?

When Chloe's first day of camp, her nemesis Morgan reveals that she's a virgin to all of the other counselors, and the guys at camp compete to see who takes Chloe's V-Card. But when she's saved by bad boy counselor Asher, she meets the first person who gets her to let her guard down. Can Chloe and Asher's relationship a summer of crazy campers, wild bonfires, and a hoard of counselors who want to tear their relationship apart?

In The Ultimate Fight for Love movie, after her parents' mysterious deaths, Harper finds herself deep in debt to shady businessman Travis Noble, who forces her to spy on enigmatic billionaire Andrew Barrett to pay him back. When Harper discovers Andrew's secret — he's an underground MMA fighter — Andrew convinces her to join him to take down Travis. But neither Harper nor Andrew ever expected the heat building between them... or how much they'd be willing to fight for it.

Jules needs to fake a relationship with Noah to pay off her mom’s medical debt. There’s one problem: Jules and Noah hate each other. But when they work together to get revenge on their backstabbing ground of friends, Noah and Jules realize that their feelings for each are totally real. Can Jules ignore her feelings for Noah to save her family?

book_title: Oops! I’m in Love with My Stepbrother
special_desc: Olivia and Finn are total opposites - she's a studious, artistic good girl, and he's a rebellious party animal straight out of rehab. But when they hook up the night before Olivia's dad marries Finn's mom, they realize they have one thing in common: their obsession with each other. Can Olivia put her feelings for her bad boy stepbrother aside?

When Amelia Monroe finds out that hoemcoming queens are dying at her family's academy, she poses as a student to investigate the cause. But she meets her match with Kristy Troy - the baddest bully at Monroe Academy. When they face off for homecoming queen - who will win? And will Amelia save her family's school?

After losing her family and her pack, pre-med student, Yara, wants to leave the wolf world behind and live as a normal college girl. But when she stumbles across Alpha Warren, a strong, sexy pack leader and saves his life, he’s hellbent on proving to her she belongs at his side. Convinced they’re fated mates, Warren takes Yara back to his pack to make her queen. When he crowns her pack doctor, Yara goes from shy student to leading Luna, and slowly falls for the Alpha who loves her as she is.

book_title: Tricked into Having my Ex-Husband's Baby
special_desc: Erica Lemon hires an escort to get her pregnant after finding out she'll soon be infertile. When her ex-husband, Damon finds out, he replaces the escort and tricks Erica into sleeping with him instead. Now pregnant with her ex-husband’s baby, Erica must decide if it’s worth giving Damon another chance to love her.

In Shhh Professor Please Don't Tell movie: Ellie is living a double life as a student by day, masked stripper by night. When the handsome Jackson Steele walks into the club, Ellie takes him on as her new favorite client. But when Ellie realizes that Jackson is her college professor, she must fight the attraction that is burning between them. Can Ellie keep her double life a secret? And can she continue to resist her professor who watches her dance every night?

When Becca Morris gets a soccer scholarship to her dream school, Cliffton College, she gets some startling news alongside her orientation packet: she’s pregnant. But that doesn’t stop the varsity captain, Max, from falling for her. Together, Max and Becca hide her secret from scheming soccer players, a vengeful ex, and the soccer coach from Hell. But with a baby on the way, will Max give up his picture perfect image to be with Becca?

When Logan Everett rescues Alexis Lee from her abusive boyfriend, a night of passion leads to pregnancy. As their feelings deepen they discover they share a terrible connection: Logan accidentally killed Alexis’s brother during a hockey game the previous year. Can Logan and alexis overcome their violent pasts and build the family they so desperately want?

book_title: The Genius and the Bad Boy
special_desc: In The Genius and the Bad Boy movie, when two hot brothers go after plus size Sophie, will she pick the true-hearted bad boy or the lying quarterback?

The night before her unwanted wedding, the overly practical Holly throws caution to the wind for her final night of freedom and crosses paths with Nick Grayson: sexy, experienced santa stripper, and her (ex) groom's Best Man. Can Nick and Holly make the Christmas magic last, or will she end up standing alone under the mistletoe?

When Scarlett Jameson is put in prison for a crime she didn’t commit, she ends up on the radar of sexy prison guard, Jack Rayne. He taunts and tortures her with sexual delights but does he have a darker motive for chaining himself to her?

book_title: I Hate to Love My British Bad Boy
special_desc: In I Hate to Love My British Bad Boy movie, during her first year in high school, Hannah Morrow is losing her virginity to the powerful Jamie St. Clair in their prestigious private school’s library. Jamie breaks up with her in front of the whole school and she loses her scholarship. When the two are reunited their final year, they fake a relationship despite hating each other. But real feelings lay underneath their fake relationship. Will Hannah get back the boy who broke her heart? Or will she lose everything when their fake relationship is exposed?

In Saved by the Sexy Cowboy movie, Ava is on the run from her abusive ex, who will stop at nothing to get her back. But then she encounters a sexy cowboy who saves her and teaches her how a woman is supposed to be loved. Can Ava learn to love again or will her abusive ex catch her before she has the chance?

In DILFS movie, after moving to a new city, events out of Jordan’s control force her and her daughter to stay with three sexy single dads: Mason, who is gruff and bristly with a tragic past; Landon, the bad boy charmer; and Eli, your ice king boss. But after a night of passion with all three of them, Jordan finds herself pregnant. Which DILF is the father?

Mia needs her wedding planning business to succeed to pay for her sister’s medical treatment. But when she falls for the groom–presidential candidate Eli Thorne–she’ll have to juggle bouquets and emotions to keep her heart and career from falling apart.

book_title: Double Life of My Military Man
special_desc: When a small-town doctor unexpectedly crosses paths with a sexy, mysterious soldier, sparks fly. But as their relationship blooms, both are forced to keep the real reasons for their whirlwind romance and the truth behind their identities a secret. He's a special forces ace and secret billionaire. She's a special ops agent undercover. Both operatives have a single mission--to investigate and ultimately eliminate one another.  Will they risk sacrificing everything for loyalty or love?

book_title: Selling My Virginity to the Mafia King
special_desc: In Selling My Virginity to the Mafia King movie, desperate to save her dying sister, Tessa agrees to auction off her virginity -- only to be claimed by the most dangerous man in the Mafia. Will she ever be able to trust the man who bought her love... or will trusting him cost her everything?

book_title: Swept Away by My Janitor Husband
special_desc: In Swept Away by My Janitor Husband movie, Ethan, the CEO of Rutherford Enterprises, is undercover as a janitor to uncover a company mole. However, his secret identity complicates things when he falls for Melanie, a secretary at his company. Meanwhile, Melanie, unaware of his true identity, is dealing with betrayal from her fiancé and best friend, as well as family pressure to prove her engagement with a successful man.

book_title: Captured and Bound By My CEO
special_desc: In Captured and bound by my CEO movie, Lydia's father is dying and the family's company is drowning. She's the next in line appointed to take over her family's company. Her brother and her boyfriend wouldn't want that to happen. They joined hands with a common enemy, Declan, to bring her down. With Lydia being the longtime crush of Declan, she's about to win over her brother.

Yeonju joins Perfect Match, a survival dating show where several men compete for one woman’s heart. Moving into the “Match House,” she begins a seven-day experiment in love — a whirlwind of unexpected chemistry and temptation. From poolside challenges and secret touches to one-night dates, each day brings new excitement, new connections… and new betrayals. As emotions blur between sincerity and strategy, passion and hesitation, Yeonju finds herself sinking deeper into a storm of desire and confusion. With every elimination and every choice she makes, her heart grows heavier — until the final day, when her decision will shape one of five completely different endings. Who will you choose to complete your story of love?

Happy Holidays, Hollywood! The first annual ReelShort holiday shoot is here. Your favorite lead stars come together to reflect on their journeys in verticals, share dream collaborations, and spread festive cheer in this must-watch holiday special.

special_desc: Ever wonder what really goes on inside a girl’s head? Is it girl math? Delusion? Pure genius? This is the episode for you. special_desc: To wrap up Mental Health Awareness Month, Autumn Noel gets real with her bestie Amanda Liguori in a heartfelt conversation. special_desc: Our fashionistas are back! We’re giving thanks with the dynamic duo, Sarah Moliski and Aaron Oberst! Join them as they catch up over a delicious Thanksgiving dinner, share what they’re grateful for, and reminisce about their time working together on Her Double, His Trouble. They even unwrap some special gifts from Laifen. Tune in. You might just win 100 coins to watch even more on the ReelShort app!

book_title: ReelTalk EP5-How Hard Is Letting Go?
special_desc:
In this episode, we sit down with actress, Haley Lohrli, for an intimate conversation about her journey in the world of acting, her personal life, and the transformative self-love journey she’s been on. From navigating the ups and downs of her career to embracing life changes, Haley opens up about what it truly means to live authentically.
We also challenge Haley to guess which iconic women—past and present—said some of the most memorable quotes and lyrics that have shaped culture. It’s a blend of insight, laughter, and celebration of women who inspire us all.
Tune in for a heartfelt episode that will leave you feeling empowered, motivated, and ready to embrace your own personal journey of growth and self-love!

In this episode, host Sarah Moliski continues her conversation with the talented actor and musician Luke Charles Stafford. special_desc: It’s back to school for the cast of Taming My Bullies! Meg Bush, Cameron Porras, and Travis Owens face off in a series of games in this High School Challenge episode to see who really rules the school. book_title: ReelTalk EP 38-Backstage: Cooking My Way Back to Love
special_desc: Get ready for a fresh slice of Cooking My Way Back to Love! Host Laze stirs things up with Adam Daniel, taking us behind the scenes of this fiery new show. From the exciting BTS footage to Adam’s take on what makes the series special, you won’t want to miss it. Plus, keep your eyes peeled for another furry guest in this Backstage episode!

The stars of Miss You After Goodbye are back and bringing the laughs on this episode of ReelTalk! Haley Lohrli talks all about her bold new role while Ben and Josh spill about their own unforgettable characters. Just when you think it can’t get any better, the trio face off in an improv game and a lightning round of ReelFast questions. Chaos, giggles, and roasts guaranteed!

book_title: ReelTalk EP13-Queen Bee Meets Queen Bee
special_desc:
Get ready for a buzzworthy return as the queen bee herself, Daniela Couso, joins the latest episode of ReelTalk with Sarah Moliski! These two legendary villains dish on the reality of bringing their characters to life and the fun side of it all. Daniela also spills the tea on surviving the chaos of high school drama, how she conquered it, and made her way to the Hollywood spotlight! She even dives into fan comments. Some sweet, some downright crazy!
This episode also packs a bonus clip with another villain you love, Michael Vaccaro! Tune in for a candid convo about the power of representation for mature actors and why they absolutely deserve to take the lead in those swoon-worthy romance stories too.

book_title: ReelTalk EP9- The Reel Happily Ever After
special_desc: In this enchanting episode, join Richard and Jessica Sharrah as they take us on a heartwarming journey through their fairy tale romance. From the moment Richard swept Jessica off her feet on a motorcycle to their happily ever after, their story is nothing short of magical. Our host, Sarah Moliski, puts their love to the test with a whimsical challenge, and even invites their children for a game of 'Who is Most Likely To.' Be sure to stay tuned until the end for a surprise that will add an extra touch of magic to their family story!

book_title: ReelTalk EP26-The Adjuster Meets The Original Influencer
special_desc: "The Adjuster" star Evan Brown sits down with none other than Perez Hilton, making his first-ever appearance on ReelTalk. Together, they reveal a bold new era of storytelling with the first fictionalized show depicting true crime. Watch them react live to the trailer and exclusive scenes, and uncover juicy behind the scenes secrets from set that you won’t find anywhere else.

We go deep in this episode with the badass queen we all know and love, Eli Jane. She takes us through the highs and lows of her journey, sharing how every experience, even the tough ones, helped shape who she is today. No regrets, just realness. Grab some tissues and get ready because she’s also answering fan questions you’ve all been dying to know!

book_title: ReelTalk EP 37 -Confessions of a Casting Director
special_desc: Ever wonder who’s responsible for bringing your favorite stars to the big screen? Our incredible Casting Directors pull back the curtain on the world of casting. They share what they look for in fresh talent, their wildest audition stories, and advice on how to thrive as an actor.

book_title: ReelTalk EP8- From Hinge to Unhinged
special_desc: We’re swiping right on Sarah today as she returns for another round of hot seat questions with your host, Rachel Bencosme! In this episode, we yap about the wild world of dating apps and of course, those horror stories that are way too good to keep to ourselves. Sarah also spills the tea while multitasking as she whips up a delicious smoothie, so tune in for the perfect blend of relationship wisdom and fruity goodness.

book_title: ReelTalk EP10- Turning Dreams Into Reality
special_desc: Richard takes us on his journey of discovering his "why" and how he channels that magic with some inspiring main character energy. Plus, learn why you should never squash someone's dream! Stick around for some lightning-fast, out-of-this-world quickfire questions from a galaxy far, far away!

book_title: ReelTalk EP11-From Memory Lane to Fast Lanes
special_desc: Strap in for a wild ride with the one and only Luke Charles Stafford! In this episode, Luke takes us on an unforgettable journey from the heart of the Midwest to the bright lights of Hollywood. Get ready to hear stories he’s never shared before, as he opens up about his personal experiences and the road less traveled. We also switch gears with a fun and unpredictable game, testing Luke’s knowledge of his ReelShort shows.

OG ReelShort stars Autumn Noel and Kasey Esser are back and better than ever! The duo reunites on screen in this episode, rekindling their chemistry. Watch them react to their latest show, Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire, and spill all the behind the scenes tea about working together again. Trust us, you won’t want to miss this one!

Get ready for a devilishly fun episode as your favorite villain, Sarah Moliski, joins host Rachel Bencosme for a deep dive into the thrilling world of playing the bad guy. From guilty pleasures to the craft behind playing iconic villains, they explore it all. They also play a playful round of Would You Rather with moments from The Virgin's Bucket List. Get ready for laughs and absolute chaos.

We’re bringing back the cast of ReelShort’s first unscripted hit, Love Bombing. The singles (and not-so-singles) reunite to spill the tea, revisit the drama, and relive the jaw-dropping moments that made this dating rollercoaster unforgettable.

book_title: ReelTalk EP 39 - Mystery and Sensuality in Italy
special_desc: We’re thrilled to welcome Nicole Mattox back to the show, alongside first-time guest Eric Guilmette, as they sit down with host Sarah Moliski to talk about their new series Dungeons of Ecstasy. Together, they unwrap this mysterious vertical thriller that’s captivating fans. Shot at a stunning location in Italy, the show not only delivers thrills but also reveals an exciting, more sensual side of Nicole.

book_title: ReelTalk EP28-Backstage: How to Kiss a Vampire
special_desc: Sink your teeth into this dangerously addictive inside look at Seth Eden and Nicole Mattox’s new show, How to Kiss a Vampire. For the first time ever, we’re getting an intimate glimpse into their life on set and everything in between. From Seth’s morning routines to Nicole’s workouts and a few daring stunts shared between on-screen lovers, this is more than just a love story. Follow along this reunion told through video diaries. Get ready to fall for the ReelShort stars you already adore, all over again.
